attributes.references: SPE PRMS (Petroleum Resources Management System) - Reservoir Pressure Definition

attributes.name: shutin_period_count
attributes.description: Number of shut-in periods during the test. Shut-in periods allow pressure buildup for reservoir characterization and permeability estimation.

attributes.name: skin_factor
attributes.description: Dimensionless skin factor derived from pressure transient analysis. Positive skin indicates formation damage; negative skin indicates stimulation or fracturing. Critical for well productivity optimization.
attributes.references: SPE Pressure Transient Analysis - Skin Factor Definition

attributes.name: static_bottomhole_pressure_psi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Static Bottomhole Pressure (SBHP) in Pounds per Square Inch (PSI)
attributes.description: Stabilized bottomhole pressure measured during shut-in period, in PSI. Represents reservoir pressure at the wellbore and is critical for material balance analysis.
attributes.references: SPE Reservoir Engineering - Static Pressure Definition

attributes.name: test_comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for test engineer notes, observations, operational issues, data quality concerns, or interpretation caveats. Provides context for future analysis.
attributes.references: Avocet Production Operations - Test Documentation Standards

attributes.name: test_duration_hours
attributes.description: Total duration of the well test in hours, from start to end. Critical for pressure transient analysis and EUR (Estimated Ultimate Recovery) calculations.

attributes.name: test_end_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when the well test concluded. Marks the completion of data acquisition and the end of the test sequence.

attributes.name: test_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the well test, typically assigned by the operator or test engineer for tracking and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: test_objective
attributes.description: Primary business objective of the well test (e.g., reservoir characterization, productivity assessment, reserves estimation, completion evaluation, interference testing).
attributes.references: SPE Well Testing - Test Design and Objectives

attributes.name: test_quality_flag
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of test data quality and reliability. Excellent indicates clean data suitable for reserves booking; poor or invalid indicates data should not be used for critical decisions.
attributes.references: SPE Well Testing - Data Quality Standards

attributes.name: test_start_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when the well test commenced. Represents the beginning of the flow or shut-in period for pressure transient analysis.

attributes.name: test_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the well test. Tracks progression from planning through execution to completion or termination.
attributes.references: Avocet Production Operations - Test Workflow States

attributes.name: test_temperature_f
attributes.description: Reservoir temperature measured during the test, in degrees Fahrenheit. Required for PVT analysis and fluid property correlation.
attributes.references: SPE PVT Analysis - Temperature Measurement Standards

attributes.name: test_type
attributes.description: Classification of the well test method. DST (Drill Stem Test) is conducted during drilling; buildup and drawdown are pressure transient tests; interference and pulse tests evaluate reservoir connectivity; production tests measure flow rates and fluid properties. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DST|buildup|drawdown|interference|pulse|production_test|extended_production_test — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SPE Well Testing Monograph - Test Classification

attributes.name: water_flow_rate_bwpd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Water Flow Rate in Barrels of Water Per Day (BWPD)
attributes.description: Water production rate measured during the test, in BWPD. Used to calculate WOR (Water-Oil Ratio) and assess reservoir water influx or aquifer support.

attributes.name: wellbore_storage_coefficient
attributes.description: Wellbore storage coefficient from pressure transient analysis, representing fluid redistribution effects in the wellbore. Affects early-time pressure response interpretation.
attributes.references: SPE Pressure Transient Analysis - Wellbore Storage

attributes.name: wor_ratio
attributes.description: Water-Oil Ratio calculated from test flow rates. Indicates water breakthrough and reservoir sweep efficiency, critical for EOR (Enhanced Oil Recovery) program evaluation.

Supports SEC reserves disclosure.

attributes.name: reservoir_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reservoir from which production is forecasted. Links to reservoir master data for subsurface characterization.

attributes.name: simulation_run_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the specific reservoir simulation run that generated this forecast. Enables linkage to detailed simulation inputs, assumptions, and sensitivity cases.

attributes.name: well_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the well asset for which this production forecast applies. Links to the well asset master data.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the production forecast was formally approved by the qualified reservoir engineer. Critical for audit trail and SEC compliance.

attributes.name: approving_engineer_name
attributes.description: The name of the qualified reservoir engineer who reviewed and approved this production forecast. Required for SEC reserves certification and internal governance.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-X Rule 4-10, SPE PRMS

attributes.name: b_factor
attributes.description: The hyperbolic decline exponent (b-factor) used in Arps decline curve analysis, ranging from 0 (exponential) to 1 (harmonic). Defines the curvature of the production decline profile. SEC guidance limits b-factor to 1.0 for PUD reserves.
attributes.references: SPE Monograph - Decline Curve Analysis, SEC Compliance and Disclosure Interpretations

attributes.name: confidence_level
attributes.description: Probabilistic confidence level for the forecast: P10 (10% probability of exceeding, high case), P50 (50% probability, best estimate), P90 (90% probability, low case), or deterministic (single-point estimate). Used for risk assessment and reserves booking.
attributes.references: SPE PRMS - Petroleum Resources Management System

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this production forecast record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for data lineage and governance.

attributes.name: decline_rate_annual_percent
attributes.description: The annual production decline rate expressed as a percentage, representing the rate at which production decreases over time. Critical parameter for decline curve analysis (DCA) and EUR calculation.

attributes.name: decline_type
attributes.description: The mathematical decline curve model applied: exponential (constant percentage decline), hyperbolic (variable decline with b-factor), or harmonic (special case of hyperbolic with b=1). Determines production forecast shape.

attributes.name: economic_limit_rate_boe_per_day
attributes.business_glossary_term: Economic Limit Rate Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE) Per Day
attributes.description: The minimum production rate in Barrels of Oil Equivalent per day at which the well or reservoir remains economically viable. Below this rate, operating expenses exceed revenue and production is abandoned.
attributes.references: SPE PRMS - Petroleum Resources Management System

attributes.name: eor_program_type
attributes.description: The type of Enhanced Oil Recovery (EOR) or Improved Oil Recovery (IOR) program applied: primary depletion, waterflood, Water Alternating Gas (WAG), Steam-Assisted Gravity Drainage (SAGD), Cyclic Steam Stimulation (CSS), CO2 injection, polymer flood, thermal steam, chemical EOR, or none. Impacts recovery factor and production profile. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: primary|waterflood|wag|sagd|css|co2_injection|polymer_flood|thermal_steam|chemical|none — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: eur_boe_mmboe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Ultimate Recovery (EUR) Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE) Million Barrels of Oil Equivalent (MMBOE)
attributes.description: The total estimated ultimate recovery expressed in Million Barrels of Oil Equivalent (MMBOE), combining oil, gas (converted at 6 MCF = 1 BOE), and NGL. Standard metric for aggregated reserves reporting.
attributes.references: SPE PRMS - Petroleum Resources Management System

attributes.name: eur_gas_bcf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Ultimate Recovery (EUR) Gas Billion Cubic Feet (BCF)
attributes.description: The total estimated ultimate recovery of natural gas from the well or reservoir over its entire productive life, measured in Billion Cubic Feet (BCF). Critical for gas reserves reporting and development planning.
attributes.references: SPE PRMS - Petroleum Resources Management System

attributes.name: eur_ngl_mmbbl
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Ultimate Recovery (EUR) Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) Million Barrels (MMBBL)
attributes.description: The total estimated ultimate recovery of Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) from the well or reservoir over its entire productive life, measured in Million Barrels (MMBBL). Important for gas processing economics and reserves classification.
attributes.references: SPE PRMS - Petroleum Resources Management System

attributes.name: eur_oil_mmbbl
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Ultimate Recovery (EUR) Oil Million Barrels (MMBBL)
attributes.description: The total estimated ultimate recovery of oil from the well or reservoir over its entire productive life, measured in Million Barrels (MMBBL). Key metric for reserves booking and asset valuation.
attributes.references: SPE PRMS - Petroleum Resources Management System

attributes.name: forecast_comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, assumptions, limitations, or qualifications related to this production forecast. Captures engineering judgment and context not represented in structured fields.
attributes.references: SPE PRMS - Petroleum Resources Management System

attributes.name: forecast_effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this production forecast becomes effective and applicable for reserves booking, economic evaluation, and development planning. Aligns with SEC reporting requirements for reserves as of year-end.

attributes.name: forecast_method
attributes.description: Technical method used to generate the production forecast: Decline Curve Analysis (DCA), reservoir simulation (Petrel/Eclipse), material balance, analogy to offset wells, empirical correlation, or integrated approach combining multiple methods.

attributes.name: forecast_name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name or identifier for this production forecast scenario, used for tracking and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: SPE PRMS - Petroleum Resources Management System

attributes.name: forecast_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the production forecast period, representing the economic limit or abandonment date when production is no longer commercially viable.
attributes.references: SPE PRMS - Petroleum Resources Management System

attributes.name: forecast_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the production forecast period, typically the first production date or the date from which future production is projected.
attributes.references: SPE PRMS - Petroleum Resources Management System

attributes.name: forecast_scenario
attributes.description: The business scenario or case name for this forecast (e.g., base case, upside, downside, accelerated development, infill drilling). Used for sensitivity analysis and decision support.
attributes.references: SPE PRMS - Petroleum Resources Management System

attributes.name: forecast_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the production forecast: draft (in preparation), under review (pending approval), approved (validated by reservoir engineer), active (currently used for planning), superseded (replaced by newer forecast), or archived (historical record).
attributes.references: SPE PRMS - Petroleum Resources Management System

attributes.name: forecast_type
attributes.description: Classification of the forecasting methodology used: deterministic (single outcome), probabilistic (P10/P50/P90 distribution), simulation-based (reservoir simulator output), analogy-based (type curve), or hybrid approach.
attributes.references: SPE PRMS - Petroleum Resources Management System

attributes.name: gor_scf_per_bbl
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gas-Oil Ratio (GOR) Standard Cubic Feet (SCF) Per Barrel (BBL)
attributes.description: The Gas-Oil Ratio (GOR) representing the volume of gas produced per barrel of oil, measured in Standard Cubic Feet per Barrel (SCF/BBL). Critical for reservoir characterization, facility design, and production optimization.

attributes.name: initial_production_rate_gas_mcfd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Initial Production (IP) Rate Gas Thousand Cubic Feet per Day (MCFD)
attributes.description: The initial gas production rate at the start of the forecast period, measured in Thousand Cubic Feet per Day (MCFD). Used for gas reserves estimation and decline curve modeling.

attributes.name: initial_production_rate_oil_bopd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Initial Production (IP) Rate Oil Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD)
attributes.description: The initial oil production rate at the start of the forecast period, measured in Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD). Key parameter for decline curve analysis and EUR estimation.

attributes.name: initial_production_rate_water_bwpd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Initial Production Rate Water Barrels of Water Per Day (BWPD)
attributes.description: The initial water production rate at the start of the forecast period, measured in Barrels of Water Per Day (BWPD). Important for Water-Oil Ratio (WOR) tracking and facility design.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this production forecast record was last modified. Tracks changes for version control and audit purposes.

attributes.name: recovery_factor_percent
attributes.description: The percentage of Original Oil in Place (OOIP) or Original Gas in Place (OGIP) that is expected to be recovered over the life of the reservoir. Calculated as EUR divided by OOIP/OGIP. Key indicator of reservoir performance and Enhanced Oil Recovery (EOR) effectiveness.
attributes.references: SPE PRMS - Petroleum Resources Management System

attributes.name: reserves_category
attributes.description: SPE-PRMS and SEC reserves classification: PDP (Proved Developed Producing), PDNP (Proved Developed Non-Producing), PUD (Proved Undeveloped), Probable (2P), or Possible (3P). Critical for SEC reserves disclosure and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SPE PRMS - Petroleum Resources Management System, SEC Regulation S-X Rule 4-10

attributes.name: simulation_model_name
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the reservoir simulation model (e.g., Schlumberger Petrel, Eclipse) used to generate this production forecast. Provides traceability to the technical basis for the forecast.

attributes.name: wor_bbl_per_bbl
attributes.description: The Water-Oil Ratio (WOR) representing the volume of water produced per barrel of oil, measured in Barrels per Barrel (BBL/BBL). Important for waterflood monitoring, artificial lift design, and facility capacity planning.

attributes.description: Sequential cycle number for cyclic injection processes such as CSS (Cyclic Steam Stimulation) or WAG (Water Alternating Gas). Null for continuous injection schemes.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - Cyclic EOR process standards

attributes.name: cycle_phase
attributes.description: The phase within a cyclic EOR process during which this injection event occurred. Applicable to CSS and other cyclic methods.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - Cyclic EOR process standards

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Automated data quality score for this injection event record, ranging from 0 to 100. Based on completeness, accuracy, and consistency checks.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which this injection event data was captured (e.g., OSIsoft PI System, Avocet Production Operations, Schlumberger Petrel).

attributes.name: downtime_hours
attributes.description: Total hours of unplanned downtime or interruption during the injection event. Used for operational efficiency analysis and NPT (Non-Productive Time) tracking.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - Operational efficiency standards

attributes.name: downtime_reason
attributes.description: Description of the cause of any downtime during the injection event. Supports root cause analysis and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: eor_method_type
attributes.description: The specific EOR/IOR technique employed for this injection event. Classifies the recovery method according to SPE standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WAG|SAGD|CSS|CO2_FLOOD|POLYMER_FLOOD|STEAM_FLOOD|WATER_FLOOD|GAS_INJECTION|CHEMICAL_INJECTION|MICROBIAL — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - EOR classification and PRMS standards

attributes.name: hse_incident_description
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Incident Description
attributes.description: Detailed description of any HSE incident that occurred during the injection event. Null if no incident occurred.
attributes.references: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration) - Incident documentation standards

attributes.name: hse_incident_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Incident Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether any HSE incident occurred during this injection event. True if an incident was reported, false otherwise.
attributes.references: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration) - Incident reporting standards

attributes.name: injected_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Total volume of liquid injected during this event, measured in barrels. Used for water, steam, and liquid chemical injections.

attributes.name: injected_volume_mcf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Injected Volume in Thousand Cubic Feet (MCF)
attributes.description: Total volume of gas injected during this event, measured in thousand cubic feet. Used for CO2, natural gas, and nitrogen injections.
attributes.references: API (American Petroleum Institute) - Gas measurement standards

attributes.name: injection_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the injection event occurred. Primary business event timestamp for production reporting and performance tracking.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - Production data standards

attributes.name: injection_duration_hours
attributes.description: Total duration of the injection event in hours. Calculated from start and end timestamps or recorded directly from operational systems.

attributes.name: injection_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the injection event concluded. Used to calculate injection duration and operational efficiency.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System - Real-time data historian standards

attributes.name: injection_event_number
attributes.description: Business-assigned unique identifier or tracking number for the injection event, used for operational reporting and cross-system reference.

attributes.name: injection_pressure_psi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Injection Pressure in Pounds per Square Inch (PSI)
attributes.description: Average wellhead injection pressure during the event, measured in pounds per square inch. Critical for reservoir pressure maintenance and fracture risk management.
attributes.references: API (American Petroleum Institute) - Pressure measurement standards

attributes.name: injection_quality_flag
attributes.description: Quality indicator for the injected fluid. Flags deviations from specification that may impact EOR performance or reservoir integrity.
attributes.references: API (American Petroleum Institute) - Fluid quality standards

attributes.name: injection_rate_bopd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Injection Rate in Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD)
attributes.description: Average injection rate for liquid fluids during this event, expressed in barrels per day. Key operational parameter for EOR optimization.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - Production operations standards

attributes.name: injection_rate_mcfd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Injection Rate in Thousand Cubic Feet per Day (MCFD)
attributes.description: Average injection rate for gas fluids during this event, expressed in thousand cubic feet per day. Critical for gas injection EOR schemes.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - Production operations standards

attributes.name: injection_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the injection event began. Used for detailed operational analysis and SCADA integration.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System - Real-time data historian standards

attributes.name: injection_temperature_f
attributes.description: Temperature of the injected fluid at the wellhead, measured in degrees Fahrenheit. Particularly important for thermal EOR methods like SAGD and CSS.
attributes.references: API (American Petroleum Institute) - Temperature measurement standards

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the injection event. Tracks the lifecycle state from planning through completion or termination.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this injection event record was first created in the data system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: record_updated_by
attributes.description: User or system identifier that last modified this injection event record. Supports audit trail and data stewardship accountability.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) - Internal controls and audit trail requirements

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this injection event record was last modified. Audit trail for data lineage and change tracking.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, observations, or special conditions related to this injection event. Supports operational knowledge capture.

attributes.name: simulated_injection_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Predicted injection volume from reservoir simulation model (e.g., Schlumberger Petrel). Used for variance analysis between actual and simulated performance.

attributes.name: variance_to_simulation_pct
attributes.description: Percentage variance between actual injection volume and simulated prediction. Key metric for reservoir model calibration and EOR optimization.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - Reservoir simulation validation standards

products.name: petrophysical_interp
products.description: Stores petrophysical log interpretation results for wells within a reservoir, providing the subsurface property inputs for volumetric calculations. Captures well identifier, interpreted interval top/bottom depth, gross pay, net pay, net-to-gross ratio, average porosity (total/effective), average water saturation (Sw), average permeability (horizontal/vertical), shale volume (Vsh), hydrocarbon pore volume (HCPV), interpretation method, cutoff criteria applied (porosity/Sw/Vsh cutoffs), software used (Landmark DecisionSpace), and interpretation date.
products.reference: Landmark DecisionSpace Petrophysical Analysis; API RP 40

attributes.name: petrophysical_interp_id
attributes.description: Primary key for petrophysical_interp

attributes.name: contract_id

attributes.name: core_sample_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to exploration.core_sample. Business justification: Petrophysical log interpretations are calibrated against core sample measurements (porosity, permeability, saturation). The log-to-core calibration workflow is a mandatory QC step in reservoir charact

attributes.name: exploration_well_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to exploration.exploration_well. Business justification: Petrophysical interpretations from exploration/appraisal well logs quantify reservoir quality and hydrocarbon volumes. Essential for discovery evaluation, reserves booking, and static model population

attributes.name: finance_afe_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_afe. Business justification: Petrophysical interpretation programs are authorized via AFE in O&G capital planning. Linking to finance_afe enables cost-to-AFE variance tracking and ensures G&G study expenditures are captured under

attributes.name: reservoir_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservoir.zone. Business justification: Petrophysical log interpretations are performed on specific reservoir zones. Currently has reservoir_id but not zone_id. The interpreted_zone field is a STRING - this should be normalized to FK. Petro

attributes.name: well_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the well for which this petrophysical interpretation was performed. Links to the well asset in the asset domain.

attributes.name: average_hydrocarbon_saturation
attributes.description: Arithmetic or weighted average hydrocarbon saturation across the net pay interval, calculated as 1 minus water saturation, expressed as a decimal fraction (0 to 1).

attributes.name: average_permeability_horizontal
attributes.description: Arithmetic or weighted average horizontal (lateral) permeability across the net pay interval in millidarcies (mD), representing the ability of rock to transmit fluids parallel to bedding.
attributes.references: API RP 40 Recommended Practices for Core Analysis

attributes.name: average_permeability_vertical
attributes.description: Arithmetic or weighted average vertical permeability across the net pay interval in millidarcies (mD), representing the ability of rock to transmit fluids perpendicular to bedding.
attributes.references: API RP 40 Recommended Practices for Core Analysis

attributes.name: average_porosity_effective
attributes.description: Arithmetic or weighted average effective porosity across the net pay interval, expressed as a decimal fraction (0 to 1), representing interconnected pore space available for fluid flow.
attributes.references: API RP 40 Recommended Practices for Core Analysis

attributes.name: average_porosity_total
attributes.description: Arithmetic or weighted average total porosity across the net pay interval, expressed as a decimal fraction (0 to 1), representing all pore space including isolated pores.
attributes.references: API RP 40 Recommended Practices for Core Analysis

attributes.name: average_shale_volume
attributes.description: Arithmetic or weighted average shale volume across the interpreted interval, expressed as a decimal fraction (0 to 1), representing the proportion of non-reservoir rock (clay and shale).
attributes.references: Gamma Ray Log Interpretation - API Standard

attributes.name: average_water_saturation
attributes.description: Arithmetic or weighted average water saturation across the net pay interval, expressed as a decimal fraction (0 to 1), representing the fraction of pore space occupied by formation water.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for interpreter notes, assumptions, data quality issues, or special considerations relevant to this petrophysical interpretation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this petrophysical interpretation record was first created in the system, in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format.

attributes.name: depth_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for all depth values in this interpretation record (feet or meters).

attributes.name: gross_thickness
attributes.description: Total thickness of the interpreted interval in feet or meters, calculated as bottom depth minus top depth.

attributes.name: hcpv_unit_of_measure
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hydrocarbon Pore Volume (HCPV) Unit of Measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for hydrocarbon pore volume: acre-feet, cubic meters, or barrels.

attributes.name: hydrocarbon_pore_volume
attributes.description: Total hydrocarbon-filled pore volume for this interpreted interval, calculated as net pay thickness × effective porosity × hydrocarbon saturation × area, typically in acre-feet or cubic meters.

attributes.name: interpretation_date
attributes.description: Date when this petrophysical interpretation was completed and finalized, in yyyy-MM-dd format.

attributes.name: interpretation_method
attributes.description: Petrophysical interpretation method or model used to calculate water saturation and reservoir properties (e.g., Archie, Simandoux, Waxman-Smits for shaly sands).

attributes.name: interpretation_name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name or label for this petrophysical interpretation run, typically including well name, zone, and date for identification purposes.

attributes.name: interpretation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this petrophysical interpretation indicating its approval state and usability for reserves calculations and production forecasting.

attributes.name: interval_bottom_depth_md
attributes.description: Measured depth in feet or meters to the bottom of the interpreted interval along the wellbore trajectory.
attributes.references: API RP 7G Recommended Practice for Drill Stem Design and Operating Limits

attributes.name: interval_bottom_depth_tvd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Interval Bottom Depth True Vertical Depth (TVD)
attributes.description: True vertical depth in feet or meters to the bottom of the interpreted interval, corrected for wellbore deviation.
attributes.references: API RP 7G Recommended Practice for Drill Stem Design and Operating Limits

attributes.name: interval_top_depth_md
attributes.description: Measured depth in feet or meters to the top of the interpreted interval along the wellbore trajectory.
attributes.references: API RP 7G Recommended Practice for Drill Stem Design and Operating Limits

attributes.name: interval_top_depth_tvd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Interval Top Depth True Vertical Depth (TVD)
attributes.description: True vertical depth in feet or meters to the top of the interpreted interval, corrected for wellbore deviation.
attributes.references: API RP 7G Recommended Practice for Drill Stem Design and Operating Limits

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this petrophysical interpretation record was last updated or modified, in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format.

attributes.name: net_pay_thickness
attributes.description: Cumulative thickness of reservoir rock within the interval that meets cutoff criteria for porosity, water saturation, and shale volume, representing producible hydrocarbon-bearing rock.

attributes.name: net_to_gross_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of net pay thickness to gross thickness, expressed as a decimal fraction (0 to 1), indicating the proportion of the interval that is productive reservoir rock.

attributes.name: permeability_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for permeability values: millidarcies (mD), darcies (D), or nanodarcies (nD).
attributes.references: API RP 40 Recommended Practices for Core Analysis

attributes.name: porosity_cutoff
attributes.description: Minimum effective porosity threshold applied to define net pay, expressed as a decimal fraction. Rock below this porosity is excluded from net pay calculations.

attributes.name: quality_flag
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the interpretation quality based on log quality, data availability, and confidence in the results.

attributes.name: shale_volume_cutoff
attributes.description: Maximum shale volume threshold applied to define net pay, expressed as a decimal fraction. Rock above this shale volume is excluded from net pay calculations.
attributes.references: Gamma Ray Log Interpretation - API Standard

attributes.name: software_used
attributes.description: Name and version of the petrophysical interpretation software application used to perform this analysis (e.g., Landmark DecisionSpace Geosciences, Schlumberger Techlog, Paradigm Geolog).

attributes.name: water_saturation_cutoff
attributes.description: Maximum water saturation threshold applied to define net pay, expressed as a decimal fraction. Rock above this water saturation is excluded from net pay calculations.

products.name: decline_curve
products.description: Stores Decline Curve Analysis (DCA) parameters for individual wells and reservoir aggregates used in EUR estimation and production forecasting. Captures well or reservoir identifier, decline type (exponential/hyperbolic/harmonic), initial production rate (IP), initial decline rate (Di), hyperbolic exponent (b-factor), terminal decline rate, EUR oil (MSTB), EUR gas (MMCF), EUR NGL (MSTB), forecast start date, forecast end date, economic limit rate, DCA software used, analyst name, and approval status. Feeds reserves booking and production planning.
products.reference: Arps Decline Curve Analysis; SPE-PRMS EUR Estimation

attributes.name: decline_curve_id
attributes.description: Primary key for decline_curve

attributes.name: reservoir_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reservoir being analyzed. Links to the reservoir master data for subsurface characterization context.

attributes.name: reservoir_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservoir.zone. Business justification: Decline Curve Analysis is performed at both reservoir and zone level. Zone-level DCA is critical for multi-zone reservoirs where individual zones have different decline characteristics. The decline_cu

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: DCA studies for reserves certification are routinely performed by external reservoir engineering consultants (e.g., Ryder Scott, D&M). Vendor attribution on decline_curve is required for audit trail,

attributes.name: well_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the well for which this decline curve analysis was performed. Links to the well asset master data.

attributes.name: analysis_date
attributes.description: Date on which the decline curve analysis was completed and results were finalized.

attributes.name: analysis_name
attributes.description: Business name or label assigned to this decline curve analysis for identification and reference purposes.

attributes.name: analysis_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the decline curve analysis is for an individual well or an aggregate of multiple wells at reservoir, field, or zone level.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the decline curve analysis was formally approved by the technical authority.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the decline curve analysis in the technical review and approval workflow. Approved analyses feed reserves booking and production planning.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Name of the senior reservoir engineer or technical authority who approved the decline curve analysis for use in reserves booking and forecasting.

attributes.name: b_factor_hyperbolic_exponent
attributes.description: Hyperbolic decline exponent used in Arps hyperbolic decline equation. Value ranges from 0 (exponential) to 1 (harmonic). Typical shale values are 0.5-2.0. Only applicable for hyperbolic and modified hyperbolic decline types.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for analyst comments, assumptions, limitations, and special considerations related to the decline curve analysis.

attributes.name: confidence_level
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of confidence in the decline curve forecast based on data quality, production history length, and reservoir understanding.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this decline curve analysis record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: cumulative_production_gas_mmcf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cumulative Production Gas in Million Cubic Feet (MMCF)
attributes.description: Total gas produced from the well or reservoir aggregate up to the forecast start date, measured in million cubic feet.

attributes.name: cumulative_production_ngl_mstb
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cumulative Production Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) in Thousand Stock Tank Barrels (MSTB)
attributes.description: Total natural gas liquids produced from the well or reservoir aggregate up to the forecast start date, measured in thousand stock tank barrels.

attributes.name: cumulative_production_oil_mstb
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cumulative Production Oil in Thousand Stock Tank Barrels (MSTB)
attributes.description: Total oil produced from the well or reservoir aggregate up to the forecast start date, measured in thousand stock tank barrels. Used to calculate remaining reserves.

attributes.name: dca_software_name
attributes.description: Name of the software application used to perform the decline curve analysis, such as Schlumberger Petrel, IHS Harmony, or Aries.

attributes.name: dca_software_version
attributes.description: Version number of the software application used for the decline curve analysis, important for audit trail and reproducibility.

attributes.name: decline_type
attributes.description: Mathematical model used for the decline curve analysis. Exponential assumes constant percentage decline, hyperbolic uses variable decline rate with b-factor, harmonic is special case where b=1, and modified hyperbolic transitions from hyperbolic to exponential.

attributes.name: di_initial_decline_rate
attributes.description: Initial decline rate parameter used in Arps decline curve equations, expressed as a decimal fraction per time unit (typically per year). Represents the rate of production decline at the start of the forecast.

attributes.name: economic_limit_rate_bopd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Economic Limit Rate in Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD)
attributes.description: Minimum production rate at which the well or reservoir remains economically viable. Production below this rate results in negative cash flow and triggers abandonment consideration.

attributes.name: eur_boe_mstb
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Ultimate Recovery (EUR) in Thousand Barrels of Oil Equivalent (MBOE)
attributes.description: Total estimated ultimate recovery expressed in thousand barrels of oil equivalent, combining oil, gas (converted at 6:1 ratio), and NGL volumes for unified reporting.

attributes.name: eur_gas_mmcf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Ultimate Recovery (EUR) Gas in Million Cubic Feet (MMCF)
attributes.description: Estimated ultimate recovery of natural gas from the well or reservoir aggregate over its entire economic life, measured in million cubic feet.

attributes.name: eur_ngl_mstb
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Ultimate Recovery (EUR) Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) in Thousand Stock Tank Barrels (MSTB)
attributes.description: Estimated ultimate recovery of natural gas liquids from the well or reservoir aggregate over its entire economic life, measured in thousand stock tank barrels.

attributes.name: eur_oil_mstb
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Ultimate Recovery (EUR) Oil in Thousand Stock Tank Barrels (MSTB)
attributes.description: Estimated ultimate recovery of oil from the well or reservoir aggregate over its entire economic life, measured in thousand stock tank barrels. Key output of decline curve analysis used for reserves booking.

attributes.name: forecast_end_date
attributes.description: The date at which the decline curve forecast terminates, typically when production reaches the economic limit rate or the well reaches its abandonment date.

attributes.name: forecast_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which the decline curve forecast begins. Typically the first production date or the date of the most recent production data used to calibrate the curve.

attributes.name: ip_gas_mcfd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Initial Production (IP) Gas Rate in Thousand Cubic Feet per Day (MCFD)
attributes.description: Initial gas production rate at the start of the decline curve forecast period, measured in thousand cubic feet per day.

attributes.name: ip_ngl_bopd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Initial Production (IP) Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) Rate in Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD)
attributes.description: Initial natural gas liquids production rate at the start of the decline curve forecast period, measured in barrels per day.

attributes.name: ip_oil_bopd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Initial Production (IP) Oil Rate in Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD)
attributes.description: Initial oil production rate at the start of the decline curve forecast period, measured in barrels of oil per day. Critical parameter for EUR estimation.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this decline curve analysis record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: prms_reserves_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Petroleum Resources Management System (PRMS) Reserves Category
attributes.description: SPE-PRMS reserves classification category. 1P represents proved reserves, 2P represents proved plus probable, and 3P represents proved plus probable plus possible reserves.

attributes.name: production_history_months
attributes.description: Number of months of historical production data used to calibrate the decline curve model. Longer history typically improves forecast reliability.

attributes.name: r_squared_fit_quality
attributes.description: Statistical measure of how well the decline curve model fits the historical production data, ranging from 0 to 1. Higher values indicate better fit quality.

attributes.name: remaining_reserves_gas_mmcf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Remaining Reserves Gas in Million Cubic Feet (MMCF)
attributes.description: Remaining gas reserves calculated as EUR minus cumulative production, measured in million cubic feet.

attributes.name: remaining_reserves_ngl_mstb
attributes.business_glossary_term: Remaining Reserves Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) in Thousand Stock Tank Barrels (MSTB)
attributes.description: Remaining natural gas liquids reserves calculated as EUR minus cumulative production, measured in thousand stock tank barrels.

attributes.name: remaining_reserves_oil_mstb
attributes.business_glossary_term: Remaining Reserves Oil in Thousand Stock Tank Barrels (MSTB)
attributes.description: Remaining oil reserves calculated as EUR minus cumulative production, measured in thousand stock tank barrels. Used for SEC and SPE-PRMS reserves classification.

attributes.name: sec_reserves_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Reserves Category
attributes.description: SEC reserves classification. PDP is Proved Developed Producing, PDNP is Proved Developed Non-Producing, and PUD is Proved Undeveloped. Used for financial reporting and disclosure.

attributes.name: terminal_decline_rate
attributes.description: Final decline rate at which the well or reservoir is assumed to decline for the remainder of its economic life. Used in modified hyperbolic models to transition from hyperbolic to exponential decline.

products.name: daily_production

Includes allocation method (test-based, meter-based, proportional), run ticket references, choke size, tubing and casing pressures, GOR, WOR, and uptime hours. Sourced from Avocet Production Operations and OSIsoft PI System historian. Serves as the SSOT for daily well-level production volumes and is the primary input for SEC reserves reporting and regulatory production filings to BSEE and state agencies.

attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Gas Volume (Thousand Cubic Feet per Day - MCFD)

attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 14 - Natural Gas Fluids Measurement

attributes.name: gross_oil_volume_bbl
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Oil Volume (Barrels of Oil Per Day - BOPD)
attributes.description: Total gross oil production volume in barrels for the production date before any deductions for royalties, working interest, or shrinkage. Measured at standard conditions (60°F, 14.7 psia).
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 12 - Calculation of Petroleum Quantities

attributes.name: gross_water_volume_bbl
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Water Volume (Barrels of Water Per Day - BWPD)
attributes.description: Total gross water production volume in barrels for the production date. Includes produced formation water and any injected water returned to surface.

attributes.name: net_oil_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Net oil production volume in barrels after applying working interest, net revenue interest, and any applicable deductions. Represents the company's entitlement share.

attributes.name: ngl_volume_bbl

attributes.name: oil_gravity_api

attributes.name: facility_metered_oil_volume_bbl
attributes.business_glossary_term: Facility Metered Oil Volume in Barrels (BBL)
attributes.description: The total oil volume measured at the facility level before allocation to individual wells. Used as the basis for allocation calculations and variance reconciliation.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 12 - Calculation of Petroleum Quantities

attributes.name: factor
attributes.description: The calculated proportion or ratio used to allocate facility production to this well. Expressed as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.235 represents 23.5% of facility production).

attributes.name: gas_allocation_variance_mcf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gas Allocation Variance in Thousand Cubic Feet (MCF)
attributes.description: The difference between facility metered gas volume and the sum of all allocated gas volumes to wells. Represents unallocated or over-allocated volumes requiring reconciliation.

attributes.name: gas_oil_ratio
attributes.description: The ratio of gas production to oil production, expressed as cubic feet of gas per barrel of oil. Key reservoir performance indicator used for decline curve analysis and reservoir management.

attributes.name: gross_gas_volume_mcf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Gas Volume in Thousand Cubic Feet (MCF)
attributes.description: Total allocated natural gas production volume for the well before interest deductions, measured in thousand cubic feet. Represents 100% working interest volume.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 14 - Natural Gas Fluids Measurement

attributes.name: gross_ngl_volume_bbl
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) Volume in Barrels (BBL)
attributes.description: Total allocated natural gas liquids production volume for the well before interest deductions, measured in barrels. Includes condensate, propane, butane, and natural gasoline.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 14 - Natural Gas Fluids Measurement

attributes.name: gross_oil_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Total allocated oil production volume for the well before interest deductions, measured in barrels. Represents 100% working interest volume.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 12 - Calculation of Petroleum Quantities

attributes.name: gross_water_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Total allocated water production volume for the well before interest deductions, measured in barrels. Used for water-oil ratio (WOR) analysis and disposal tracking.
attributes.references: API RP 45 - Recommended Practice for Analysis of Oilfield Waters

attributes.name: jib_posting_date
attributes.description: The date when this allocation was posted to the Joint Interest Billing system for partner invoicing. Links production volumes to revenue distribution and partner settlements.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this allocation record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit trail. Updated whenever any field in the record changes.

attributes.name: net_gas_volume_mcf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Gas Volume in Thousand Cubic Feet (MCF)
attributes.description: Net allocated gas production volume after applying working interest decimal. Calculated as gross_gas_volume_mcf multiplied by working_interest_decimal. Used for partner revenue distribution.

attributes.name: net_ngl_volume_bbl
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) Volume in Barrels (BBL)
attributes.description: Net allocated NGL production volume after applying working interest decimal. Calculated as gross_ngl_volume_bbl multiplied by working_interest_decimal. Used for partner revenue distribution.

attributes.name: net_oil_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Net allocated oil production volume after applying working interest decimal. Calculated as gross_oil_volume_bbl multiplied by working_interest_decimal. Used for partner revenue distribution.

attributes.name: net_revenue_interest_decimal
attributes.description: The ownership percentage representing the net revenue interest share after royalty and overriding royalty deductions. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.60 represents 60% NRI). Used for revenue distribution calculations.

attributes.name: oil_allocation_variance_bbl
attributes.description: The difference between facility metered oil volume and the sum of all allocated oil volumes to wells. Represents unallocated or over-allocated volumes requiring reconciliation.

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The ending date of the production allocation period. Defines the time window for which volumes are allocated.

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The beginning date of the production allocation period. Typically daily or monthly allocation cycles.

attributes.name: production_month
attributes.description: The calendar month for which production is allocated, expressed in YYYY-MM format. Used for monthly production reporting and trend analysis.

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date when allocation variances were reconciled and the allocation was finalized. Used for audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: reconciliation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of variance causes and reconciliation actions taken. Documents meter calibration issues, well downtime, measurement errors, or allocation method adjustments.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of the variance reconciliation process. Indicates whether allocation variances have been investigated and resolved. Critical for audit trail and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation record must be included in regulatory production reports to BSEE, state agencies, or SEC reserves disclosure. True if regulatory reporting is required.

attributes.name: run_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the allocation calculation was executed. Used for audit trail and to track allocation process timing.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The system of record that originated this allocation data. Avocet Production Operations for daily allocation, OSIsoft PI for real-time data, SCADA for facility meters, manual entry for adjustments, or third-party for operator-provided data.

attributes.name: total_boe
attributes.description: Total production expressed in barrels of oil equivalent. Calculated by converting gas and NGL volumes to oil equivalent and summing with oil volumes. Used for standardized production reporting.

attributes.name: water_oil_ratio
attributes.description: The ratio of water production to oil production, expressed as barrels of water per barrel of oil. Key indicator of reservoir water breakthrough and well performance decline.

attributes.name: working_interest_decimal
attributes.description: The ownership percentage representing the working interest share for this allocation record. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.75 represents 75% WI). Used to calculate net volumes from gross volumes.

products.name: monthly_production
products.description: Authoritative monthly production record aggregated and validated at the well and facility level for regulatory reporting. Stores certified monthly volumes of oil (BOPD average and total BBL), gas (MMCFD average and total MCF), water, and NGL by well and facility. Includes regulatory submission status, state agency report ID, BSEE submission reference, and certification sign-off. Distinct from daily_production in that monthly records are the legally certified volumes submitted to BSEE, state oil and gas commissions, and used for SEC reserves disclosure.
products.reference: BSEE OGOR (Oil and Gas Operations Report), State Production Reports

attributes.description: Identifier of the production facility or battery where production is aggregated and measured.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Report identifier or confirmation number assigned by the state oil and gas commission upon submission of the monthly production report for onshore operations.
attributes.references: State Oil and Gas Commission Reporting Standards

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservoir.zone. Business justification: Monthly regulatory filings and PRMS reserves reconciliation require zone-level production attribution. State and federal regulators (BSEE, RRC) require production reported by producing zone, making th

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to allocate production volumes to the well or facility. Indicates whether volumes are directly measured or allocated from facility totals.

attributes.name: api_well_number
attributes.description: Standardized API well number assigned by regulatory authority for unique well identification in production reporting.
attributes.references: API Bulletin D12A - API Well Number Standard

attributes.name: boe_total
attributes.description: Total production expressed in barrels of oil equivalent (BOE), converting gas and NGL volumes to oil-equivalent barrels using standard conversion factors (typically 6 MCF = 1 BOE).

attributes.name: bsee_submission_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement (BSEE) Submission Reference
attributes.description: Reference number or confirmation code assigned by BSEE upon successful submission of the monthly production report for offshore operations.

attributes.name: certification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the monthly production record was certified and approved for regulatory submission.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls for Production Reporting

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Status of the monthly production record in the certification and regulatory submission workflow. Indicates whether volumes have been validated and submitted.

attributes.name: certified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the production engineer or authorized personnel who certified the monthly production volumes as accurate and complete.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls for Production Reporting

attributes.name: condensate_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Total volume of condensate produced during the month, measured in barrels (BBL). Condensate is liquid hydrocarbon recovered from gas wells.
attributes.references: State Oil and Gas Commission Reporting Standards

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Source system or method from which the monthly production data was extracted. Indicates data lineage and quality assurance level.

attributes.name: downtime_hours
attributes.description: Total hours of non-productive time (NPT) during the month due to equipment failure, maintenance, or operational issues.

attributes.name: flared_gas_volume_mcf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Flared Gas Volume in Thousand Cubic Feet (MCF)
attributes.description: Volume of natural gas flared during the month due to operational constraints or safety requirements, measured in thousand cubic feet (MCF).

attributes.name: fuel_gas_volume_mcf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fuel Gas Volume in Thousand Cubic Feet (MCF)
attributes.description: Volume of natural gas consumed as fuel for lease operations and equipment during the month, measured in thousand cubic feet (MCF).

attributes.name: gas_mcfd_average
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gas Thousand Cubic Feet per Day (MCFD) Average
attributes.description: Average daily gas production rate for the month, calculated as total gas volume divided by the number of production days. Expressed in MCFD.

attributes.name: gas_volume_mcf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gas Volume in Thousand Cubic Feet (MCF)
attributes.description: Total volume of natural gas produced during the month, measured in thousand cubic feet (MCF). This is the certified volume submitted to regulatory agencies.

attributes.name: gor
attributes.description: Gas-oil ratio for the month, calculated as the ratio of gas volume (MCF) to oil volume (BBL). Indicates reservoir performance and production characteristics.

attributes.name: net_revenue_interest_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of net revenue interest after deducting royalties and overriding royalty interests. Represents the operators share of production revenue.

attributes.name: ngl_volume_bbl
attributes.business_glossary_term: Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) Volume in Barrels (BBL)
attributes.description: Total volume of natural gas liquids (NGL) extracted during the month, measured in barrels (BBL). Includes ethane, propane, butane, and natural gasoline.

attributes.name: oil_bopd_average
attributes.business_glossary_term: Oil Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD) Average
attributes.description: Average daily oil production rate for the month, calculated as total oil volume divided by the number of production days. Expressed in BOPD.

attributes.name: oil_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Total volume of crude oil produced during the month, measured in barrels (BBL). This is the certified volume submitted to regulatory agencies.

attributes.name: production_days
attributes.description: Number of days the well or facility was actively producing during the month. Used to calculate average daily rates and uptime.

attributes.name: production_month
attributes.description: The calendar month for which production volumes are reported, typically the first day of the month (YYYY-MM-01 format).

attributes.name: production_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the well or facility during the production month. Indicates whether the asset was actively producing or offline.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the monthly production record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the monthly production record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certified monthly production volumes were submitted to the regulatory agency (BSEE, state oil and gas commission).

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, explanations, or notes regarding the monthly production record, including operational issues or data quality concerns.

attributes.name: reporting_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Regulatory jurisdiction to which the monthly production report is submitted. Determines the applicable reporting requirements and agency.

attributes.name: reservoir_pressure_psi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reservoir Pressure in Pounds per Square Inch (PSI)
attributes.description: Average reservoir pressure during the production month, measured in pounds per square inch (PSI). Indicates reservoir energy and depletion status.

attributes.name: royalty_volume_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Royalty Volume in Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: Total production volume attributable to royalty interests, expressed in barrels of oil equivalent (BOE). Used for royalty payment calculation.

attributes.name: sales_gas_volume_mcf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sales Gas Volume in Thousand Cubic Feet (MCF)
attributes.description: Volume of natural gas sold or delivered to market during the month, measured in thousand cubic feet (MCF). Excludes flared, vented, and fuel gas.

attributes.name: vented_gas_volume_mcf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Vented Gas Volume in Thousand Cubic Feet (MCF)
attributes.description: Volume of natural gas vented during the month, measured in thousand cubic feet (MCF). Reported for environmental compliance and emissions tracking.

attributes.name: water_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Total volume of produced water during the month, measured in barrels (BBL). Includes formation water and injected water produced back.

attributes.name: wellhead_pressure_psi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Wellhead Pressure in Pounds per Square Inch (PSI)
attributes.description: Average wellhead flowing pressure during the production month, measured in pounds per square inch (PSI). Used for production optimization and decline analysis.
attributes.references: API RP 11AR - Recommended Practice for Care and Use of Subsurface Pumps

attributes.name: wor
attributes.description: Water-oil ratio for the month, calculated as the ratio of water volume (BBL) to oil volume (BBL). Indicates water breakthrough and reservoir depletion.

attributes.name: working_interest_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of working interest held by the operator in the well or facility for the production month. Used for revenue and cost allocation.

products.name: artificial_lift
products.description: Master record for artificial lift installations on producing wells. Captures lift type (ESP, rod pump, gas lift, PCP, jet pump, plunger lift), installation date, design parameters (pump depth, motor rating, frequency, gas injection rate), current operating parameters, run life history, and optimization targets. Tracks ESP run life (days), failure mode, and mean time between failures (MTBF). Supports artificial lift optimization workflows and production enhancement programs.

attributes.name: artificial_lift_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the artificial lift installation record. Primary key for the artificial lift master data product.

attributes.name: completion_design_id

Business justification: Artificial lift installations and repairs are capital/maintenance expenditures tracked via purchase orders. Links equipment to procurement for cost tracking, warranty management, and AFE reconciliatio

attributes.name: actual_rate_bopd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Actual Production Rate (BOPD - Barrels of Oil Per Day)
attributes.description: Current actual production rate in barrels of oil per day achieved by the artificial lift system. Updated from real-time production data via OSIsoft PI System integration.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special conditions, or historical context about the artificial lift installation. Used by field engineers and production technicians.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this artificial lift record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data governance and compliance.

attributes.name: design_rate_bopd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Design Production Rate (BOPD - Barrels of Oil Per Day)
attributes.description: Target production rate in barrels of oil per day that the artificial lift system was designed to achieve. Used for performance monitoring and optimization.

attributes.name: discharge_pressure_psi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Discharge Pressure (PSI - Pounds per Square Inch)
attributes.description: Pressure at the pump discharge in pounds per square inch. Used to calculate total dynamic head and system efficiency.
attributes.references: API RP 11S - Recommended Practice for Electric Submersible Pump Systems

attributes.name: failure_date
attributes.description: Date when the artificial lift system failed. Nullable for operating systems. Used to calculate mean time between failures and reliability metrics.

attributes.name: failure_mode
attributes.description: Description of the failure mode if the system has failed. Examples include motor failure, pump wear, electrical short, gas lock, rod parting. Used for failure analysis and MTBF tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Motor Failure|Pump Wear|Electrical Short|Gas Lock|Rod Parting|Tubing Leak|Cable Damage|Bearing Failure|Seal Failure — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: API RP 11S - Recommended Practice for Electric Submersible Pump Systems

attributes.name: gas_injection_rate_mcfd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gas Injection Rate (MCFD - Thousand Cubic Feet per Day)
attributes.description: Current gas injection rate for gas lift systems in thousand cubic feet per day. Null for non-gas-lift installations. Key optimization parameter for gas lift wells.
attributes.references: API RP 11V - Recommended Practice for Gas Lift

attributes.name: installation_cost_usd
attributes.description: Total capital expenditure for the artificial lift installation including equipment, labor, and services. Used for CAPEX tracking and economic analysis.

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the artificial lift system was installed and commissioned in the well. Marks the start of the run life tracking period.

attributes.name: installation_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the artificial lift installation. Externally-known unique code used in field operations and maintenance work orders.

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent maintenance activity performed on the artificial lift system. Used for preventive maintenance scheduling via Maximo integration.
attributes.references: API RP 11S - Recommended Practice for Electric Submersible Pump Systems

attributes.name: lift_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the artificial lift system. Tracks lifecycle state from installation through decommissioning.

attributes.name: lift_type
attributes.description: Type of artificial lift system installed. ESP = Electric Submersible Pump, PCP = Progressive Cavity Pump. Determines the operating characteristics and optimization parameters.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this artificial lift record was last updated. Audit trail for data lineage and change tracking.

attributes.name: motor_current_amps
attributes.description: Current draw of the ESP motor in amperes. Real-time parameter monitored via SCADA. Used for load analysis and efficiency calculations.
attributes.references: API RP 11S - Recommended Practice for Electric Submersible Pump Systems

attributes.name: motor_horsepower
attributes.description: Rated horsepower of the artificial lift motor. Applicable to ESP and rod pump systems. Determines power consumption and lifting capacity.
attributes.references: API RP 11S - Recommended Practice for Electric Submersible Pump Systems

attributes.name: motor_temperature_f
attributes.description: Current operating temperature of the ESP motor in degrees Fahrenheit. Monitored via downhole sensors. High temperature indicates potential motor failure risk.
attributes.references: API RP 11S - Recommended Practice for Electric Submersible Pump Systems

attributes.name: motor_voltage
attributes.description: Operating voltage of the ESP motor in volts. Standard values include 480V, 1000V, 2400V, 4160V. Critical for electrical system design and safety.
attributes.references: API RP 11S - Recommended Practice for Electric Submersible Pump Systems

attributes.name: next_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next preventive maintenance activity. Calculated based on run life, operating conditions, and maintenance strategy.
attributes.references: API RP 11S - Recommended Practice for Electric Submersible Pump Systems

attributes.name: operating_cost_per_day_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Operating Cost Per Day (United States Dollars)
attributes.description: Daily operating expense for the artificial lift system including power, maintenance, and monitoring. Used for lease operating expense tracking and economic optimization.

attributes.name: operating_frequency_hz
attributes.description: Current operating frequency of the variable speed drive in Hertz. Used to control ESP pump speed and production rate. Typical range 30-70 Hz.
attributes.references: API RP 11S - Recommended Practice for Electric Submersible Pump Systems

attributes.name: optimization_target
attributes.description: Primary optimization objective for this artificial lift installation. Drives automated control strategies in artificial lift optimization workflows.

attributes.name: power_consumption_kwh
attributes.description: Total electrical power consumption in kilowatt-hours. Used for operating expense tracking and energy efficiency analysis.
attributes.references: API RP 11S - Recommended Practice for Electric Submersible Pump Systems

attributes.name: pump_depth_ft
attributes.description: Measured depth in feet at which the pump is set in the wellbore. Critical design parameter for ESP and rod pump installations.
attributes.references: API RP 11AR - Recommended Practice for Care and Use of Subsurface Pumps

attributes.name: pump_intake_pressure_psi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pump Intake Pressure (PSI - Pounds per Square Inch)
attributes.description: Pressure at the pump intake in pounds per square inch. Critical operating parameter for ESP systems. Low intake pressure indicates potential gas lock or insufficient reservoir pressure.
attributes.references: API RP 11S - Recommended Practice for Electric Submersible Pump Systems

attributes.name: pump_stages
attributes.description: Number of stages in the ESP or PCP pump assembly. Determines total head capacity and lifting capability of the system.
attributes.references: API RP 11S - Recommended Practice for Electric Submersible Pump Systems

attributes.name: removal_date
attributes.description: Date when the artificial lift system was pulled from the well. Nullable for currently operating systems. Used to calculate run life duration.

attributes.name: run_life_days
attributes.description: Number of days the artificial lift system has been operating since installation. Calculated as current date minus installation date for active systems, or removal date minus installation date for pulled systems. Key metric for reliability analysis.

attributes.name: stroke_length_inches
attributes.description: Length of the pumping stroke in inches for rod pump systems. Typical values range from 30 to 300 inches. Determines displacement per stroke.
attributes.references: API RP 11L - Recommended Practice for Design Calculations for Sucker Rod Pumping Systems

attributes.name: strokes_per_minute
attributes.description: Current pumping speed in strokes per minute for rod pump systems. Used to calculate pump displacement and production rate.
attributes.references: API RP 11L - Recommended Practice for Design Calculations for Sucker Rod Pumping Systems

attributes.name: target_frequency_hz
attributes.description: Optimal target frequency for ESP operation based on reservoir conditions and production targets. Used in artificial lift optimization workflows.

attributes.name: target_gas_injection_rate_mcfd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Gas Injection Rate (MCFD - Thousand Cubic Feet per Day)
attributes.description: Optimal target gas injection rate for gas lift optimization. Used in production enhancement programs and nodal analysis.
attributes.references: API RP 11V - Recommended Practice for Gas Lift

attributes.name: work_order_number
attributes.description: Reference to the Maximo work order number for the installation or most recent maintenance activity. Links to CMMS for asset lifecycle management.

products.name: downtime_event
products.description: Transactional record capturing production downtime and deferment events at the well or facility level. Records downtime start and end timestamps, downtime category (planned maintenance, equipment failure, weather, regulatory, market curtailment, pipeline constraint), deferred volumes by phase (oil BBL, gas MCF, NGL BBL), responsible party, and corrective action taken. Integrates with Maximo work orders for maintenance-related downtime. Supports NPT (Non-Productive Time) analysis and production efficiency reporting.

attributes.name: downtime_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the downtime event record. Primary key for the downtime_event product.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Downtime events have direct financial impact through deferred production (lost revenue) and must be tracked by cost center for variance analysis, production reporting, insurance claims, and performanc

attributes.name: eor_scheme_id

attributes.name: meter_ticket_reference
attributes.description: Reference number linking this run ticket to the corresponding meter ticket or LACT (Lease Automatic Custody Transfer) unit record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this run ticket record was last modified. Audit trail for record lifecycle and change tracking.

attributes.name: net_standard_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Volume of crude oil or condensate after deducting Basic Sediment and Water (BS&W) from Gross Standard Volume (GSV). This is the legally transferable volume used for sales and royalty calculations.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11 - Volume Correction Factors

attributes.name: observed_pressure_psi
attributes.description: Pressure of the crude oil or condensate at the time of measurement in pounds per square inch (PSI). Used for pressure correction calculations when applicable.

attributes.name: observed_temperature_f
attributes.description: Temperature of the crude oil or condensate at the time of measurement in degrees Fahrenheit. Used to calculate temperature correction factor.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11.1 - Temperature and Pressure Volume Correction

attributes.name: opening_gauge_feet
attributes.description: Tank gauge reading in feet at the start of the custody transfer measurement period. Used to calculate initial tank volume.

attributes.name: opening_gauge_inches
attributes.description: Tank gauge reading in inches at the start of the custody transfer measurement period. Provides fractional precision for opening volume calculation.

attributes.name: operator_signature
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the operator representative who authorized and signed the run ticket for custody transfer.

attributes.name: pricing_point
attributes.description: Geographic or contractual location where pricing is determined for this custody transfer (e.g., wellhead, pipeline inlet, refinery gate).

attributes.name: purchaser_signature
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the purchaser representative who acknowledged and signed the run ticket for custody transfer acceptance.

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date when the run ticket was reconciled and finalized for revenue accounting and royalty distribution.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, exceptions, or special conditions related to this custody transfer run ticket.

attributes.name: run_ticket_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the custody transfer run ticket. Used for legal documentation and audit trails.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 18.2 - Custody Transfer Standard

attributes.name: run_ticket_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the run ticket in the custody transfer and settlement workflow.

attributes.name: seal_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the tamper-evident seal applied to the transport vehicle or container to ensure custody transfer integrity.

attributes.name: sulfur_content_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of sulfur content in the crude oil or condensate. Determines sweet vs. sour classification and affects pricing and refining requirements.

attributes.name: temperature_correction_factor
attributes.description: Correction factor applied to convert observed volume at measured temperature to standard volume at 60°F. Calculated per API MPMS Chapter 11.1.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11.1 - Temperature and Pressure Volume Correction

attributes.name: truck_number
attributes.description: Identification number of the transport truck or tanker used to haul the crude oil or condensate from the custody transfer point.

attributes.name: unit_price_per_bbl
attributes.description: Price per barrel of crude oil or condensate for this custody transfer. Used to calculate gross revenue.
