attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the custody transfer record was first created in the system, used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for tariff rates and financial settlements associated with the custody transfer.

attributes.name: draft_survey_result
attributes.description: Quantity determined by marine draft survey method (vessel displacement measurement), used as independent verification for cargo transfers, expressed in metric tons or barrels.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 17.2 - Marine Cargo Measurement

attributes.name: gross_observed_volume
attributes.description: Total volume of product measured at observed temperature and pressure conditions before any corrections, expressed in barrels or cubic meters.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 12 - Calculation of Petroleum Quantities

attributes.name: gross_standard_volume
attributes.description: Total volume of product corrected to standard temperature (60°F or 15°C) and pressure conditions, including all impurities, expressed in barrels or cubic meters.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 12 - Calculation of Petroleum Quantities

attributes.name: independent_inspector_company
attributes.description: Name of the third-party inspection company that performed independent verification of quantity and quality (e.g., SGS, Intertek, Bureau Veritas).

attributes.name: inspection_certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the independent inspection certificate issued by the third-party inspector, required for customs clearance and payment release.

attributes.name: inspection_date
attributes.description: Date on which the independent inspection was performed, may differ from transfer date for pre-shipment or post-discharge inspections.

attributes.name: inspection_type
attributes.description: Type of independent inspection performed (quantity verification, quality analysis, draft survey for marine cargo, ullage survey for tank measurement, or combined).

attributes.name: inspector_name
attributes.description: Full name of the certified inspector who performed the custody transfer verification, used for accountability and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: jib_allocation_status
attributes.description: Status of the custody transfer in the joint interest billing process, tracking allocation to working interest owners and billing completion.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the custody transfer record was last updated, used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: meter_ticket_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the meter run ticket or gauge sheet documenting the physical measurement, used for audit and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: net_standard_volume
attributes.description: Volume of product corrected to standard conditions and adjusted for impurities (BS&W deducted), representing the saleable quantity for revenue calculation.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 12 - Calculation of Petroleum Quantities

attributes.name: observed_pressure
attributes.description: Pressure of the product at the time of measurement, used for volume correction to standard conditions, expressed in PSI or kPa.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11.2.1 - Compressibility Factors for Hydrocarbons

attributes.name: observed_temperature
attributes.description: Temperature of the product at the time of measurement, used for volume correction to standard conditions, expressed in degrees Fahrenheit or Celsius.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11.1 - Volume Correction Factors

attributes.name: pressure_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for pressure (pounds per square inch, kilopascals, or bar).

attributes.name: quality_claim_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a quality dispute or claim has been filed regarding this custody transfer, triggering investigation and potential financial adjustment.

attributes.name: quantity_variance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a significant variance exists between transferor and transferee measurements, requiring reconciliation per custody transfer agreement tolerance limits.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 12 - Calculation of Petroleum Quantities

attributes.name: royalty_calculation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this custody transfer triggers royalty payment obligations to mineral rights owners or government entities.

attributes.name: seal_numbers
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of tamper-evident seal identifiers applied to measurement equipment, valves, or cargo hatches to ensure measurement integrity.

attributes.name: seal_verification_status
attributes.description: Status of seal integrity verification at the time of custody transfer, critical for detecting tampering or measurement disputes.

attributes.name: sulfur_content_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of sulfur by weight in the product, critical for quality specification, pricing differentials, and environmental compliance.
attributes.references: ASTM D4294 - Sulfur in Petroleum Products

attributes.name: tariff_rate
attributes.description: Transportation or handling fee per unit of volume for the custody transfer, expressed in currency per barrel or per cubic meter, subject to FERC regulation for interstate pipelines.

attributes.name: temperature_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for temperature (Fahrenheit or Celsius).

attributes.name: transfer_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the custody transfer occurred, used for daily production allocation and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: transfer_reference_number
attributes.description: External business identifier for the custody transfer transaction, used for cross-party reconciliation and audit trails.

attributes.name: transfer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the custody transfer transaction, governing revenue recognition and JIB processing.

attributes.name: transfer_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when custody transfer was completed and title passed between parties, critical for JIB and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: volume_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for volume quantities (barrels, cubic meters, gallons, thousand cubic feet, million cubic feet).

products.name: vessel
products.description: Master data entity for tankers, LNG carriers, LPG vessels, and FSOs/FPSOs used in petroleum product transportation. Captures IMO number, vessel name, vessel type (VLCC, Suezmax, Aframax, LNG carrier, LPG carrier, product tanker), flag state, deadweight tonnage (DWT), cargo capacity (BBL or CBM), year built, classification society, P&I club, vetting status (SIRE/CDI inspection date and result), last dry-dock date, owner, operator, and commercial manager. Supports vessel vetting and chartering operations.

attributes.name: vessel_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the vessel. Primary key for the vessel master data entity.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.carrier. Business justification: A vessel is operated by a carrier (shipping company). vessel currently has operator_company (STRING) which is a denormalized string reference to the operating company. Replacing this with carrier_id F

attributes.name: emergency_response_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.emergency_response_plan. Business justification: Vessels maintain shipboard oil pollution emergency plans (SOPEP). Vessel references current plan for IMO compliance and port state control inspections.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fixed_asset. Business justification: Owned/leased vessels are capitalized fixed assets requiring depreciation tracking, asset retirement obligations, impairment testing, and balance sheet reporting per GAAP/IFRS. SEC reserve reporting an

attributes.name: safety_data_sheet_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.safety_data_sheet. Business justification: Vessels carrying petroleum products must have the applicable SDS on board per SOLAS/MARPOL requirements. The SDS governs emergency response procedures, cargo handling, and port state control inspectio

attributes.name: beam_m
attributes.description: Maximum width of the vessel measured in meters at the widest point. Critical dimension for canal transit (Panama Canal beam limit 49m for Panamax, 55m for Neo-Panamax), port berth allocation, and lock compatibility.
attributes.references: International Convention on Tonnage Measurement of Ships 1969

attributes.name: cargo_capacity_bbl
attributes.description: Total cargo carrying capacity measured in barrels of oil equivalent. Used for crude oil and refined product tankers. One barrel equals 42 US gallons or approximately 159 liters. Critical for cargo planning, nomination scheduling, and freight calculations.
attributes.references: American Petroleum Institute (API) Standard Barrel Definition

attributes.name: cargo_capacity_cbm
attributes.description: Total cargo carrying capacity measured in cubic meters. Primary capacity metric for LNG carriers, LPG carriers, and chemical tankers where volume is more relevant than weight. Used for cargo planning and commercial negotiations.

attributes.name: cargo_heating_capability
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vessel is equipped with cargo heating coils to maintain or raise the temperature of heavy crude oils, fuel oils, or bitumen that solidify at ambient temperatures. Essential for high-viscosity cargoes that require heating for pumping and discharge.
attributes.references: International Convention for the Prevention of Pollution from Ships (MARPOL)

attributes.name: cargo_tank_count
attributes.description: Number of separate cargo tanks on the vessel. Typical crude tankers have 8-16 center tanks plus wing tanks. Multiple tanks enable cargo segregation for different crude grades, ballast management, and stability control. LNG carriers typically have 4-5 membrane or spherical tanks.
attributes.references: International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS)

attributes.name: class_notation
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code assigned by the classification society indicating the vessel's design standards, construction quality, and operational capabilities. Examples include +1A1 (Lloyd's Register highest class), +A1 (ABS highest class), and additional notations for ice class, dynamic positioning, or special cargo handling.
attributes.references: International Association of Classification Societies (IACS) Unified Requirements

attributes.name: classification_society
attributes.description: Independent organization that establishes and maintains technical standards for the construction and operation of ships. Conducts surveys and inspections to verify compliance. Major societies include Lloyd's Register (LR), American Bureau of Shipping (ABS), Det Norske Veritas (DNV), Bureau Veritas (BV), and Nippon Kaiji Kyokai (ClassNK). Required for insurance and port entry.

attributes.name: commercial_manager
attributes.description: Company responsible for chartering, voyage planning, freight negotiations, and commercial operations. Handles fixture negotiations, laytime calculations, demurrage claims, and customer relationships. May be the owner, operator, or a specialized commercial management firm.
attributes.references: Baltic and International Maritime Council (BIMCO) Ship Management Agreements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp indicating when this vessel record was first created in the master data system. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and change tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: crude_oil_washing_system
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vessel is equipped with a crude oil washing system that uses the cargo itself to clean tank walls during discharge, reducing sludge and improving cargo outturn. Mandatory for crude tankers over 20,000 DWT under MARPOL Annex I.
attributes.references: MARPOL Annex I Regulation 13 - Crude Oil Washing

attributes.name: deadweight_tonnage
attributes.description: Maximum weight in metric tons that the vessel can safely carry, including cargo, fuel, fresh water, ballast water, provisions, passengers, and crew. Key metric for chartering decisions and freight rate calculations. Measured at summer load line in saltwater.

attributes.name: draft_m
attributes.description: Vertical distance in meters between the waterline and the bottom of the hull (keel) when the vessel is fully loaded. Determines port accessibility, channel depth requirements, and loading limits. Suez Canal maximum draft is 20.1m, Panama Canal is 15.2m.

attributes.name: flag_state
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the nation under whose laws the vessel is registered. Determines applicable maritime regulations, safety standards, labor laws, and taxation. Common flags include LBR (Liberia), PAN (Panama), MHL (Marshall Islands), SGP (Singapore), USA (United States).
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 Country Codes, United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS)

attributes.name: fuel_consumption_mt_per_day
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fuel Consumption in Metric Tons per Day
attributes.description: Average daily fuel consumption in metric tons at service speed under normal laden conditions. Critical for voyage cost estimation, bunker planning, and carbon emissions calculations. Typical VLCC consumes 60-80 MT/day, Aframax 35-45 MT/day.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) Ship Energy Efficiency Management Plan (SEEMP)

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: Primary fuel used for main propulsion. Options include Heavy Fuel Oil (HFO/IFO380), Marine Gas Oil (MGO), Low Sulfur Fuel Oil (LSFO), Very Low Sulfur Fuel Oil (VLSFO 0.5%), Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG), and dual-fuel configurations. Critical for emissions compliance with IMO 2020 sulfur cap regulations and Emission Control Area (ECA) requirements.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) MARPOL Annex VI - Sulfur Regulations

attributes.name: gross_tonnage
attributes.description: Measure of the overall internal volume of the vessel expressed in register tons (100 cubic feet). Used for regulatory compliance, port fees, canal tolls, and insurance premiums. Calculated according to the International Convention on Tonnage Measurement of Ships 1969.
attributes.references: International Convention on Tonnage Measurement of Ships 1969

attributes.name: hull_type
attributes.description: Structural design of the vessel's hull. Double Hull construction features two complete layers of watertight hull surface providing enhanced protection against oil spills in case of collision or grounding. Required for all new tankers under MARPOL regulations since 1996. Single Hull vessels are being phased out globally.
attributes.references: MARPOL Annex I Regulation 13G, Oil Pollution Act of 1990 (OPA 90)

attributes.name: ice_class
attributes.description: Notation indicating the vessel's capability to operate in ice-covered waters. Classifications range from basic ice strengthening to polar class for year-round Arctic operations. Examples include 1A Super (Finnish-Swedish Ice Class), PC1-PC7 (Polar Class), and IACS Polar Class. Critical for operations in northern Russia, Alaska, and Canadian Arctic.
attributes.references: International Association of Classification Societies (IACS) Unified Requirements for Polar Ships

attributes.name: imo_number
attributes.description: Unique seven-digit ship identification number assigned by the International Maritime Organization. Permanent identifier that remains unchanged through changes of ownership, flag, or name. Required for vessels over 100 gross tonnage engaged in international voyages.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) Ship Identification Number Scheme

attributes.name: inert_gas_system
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vessel is equipped with an inert gas system that replaces oxygen in cargo tanks with inert gas (typically nitrogen or scrubbed exhaust gas) to prevent explosive atmospheres. Mandatory for crude oil tankers over 20,000 DWT under SOLAS regulations.
attributes.references: International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS) Chapter II-2

attributes.name: last_drydock_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent drydocking when the vessel was taken out of water for hull inspection, cleaning, painting, and underwater repairs. Classification societies require drydocking at intervals not exceeding 5 years for hull surveys. Recent drydocking is a positive vetting indicator.
attributes.references: International Association of Classification Societies (IACS) Unified Requirements

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp indicating when this vessel record was most recently updated. Tracks changes to vessel attributes such as ownership, operator, vetting status, or operational status. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: last_sire_inspection_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Last Ship Inspection Report (SIRE) Inspection Date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent SIRE inspection conducted by an OCIMF-accredited inspector. SIRE inspections assess vessel condition, safety management systems, crew competence, and operational procedures. Inspections are valid for 6 months; vessels require re-inspection for continued employment by major charterers.
attributes.references: Oil Companies International Marine Forum (OCIMF) SIRE Programme

attributes.name: length_overall_m
attributes.description: Maximum length of the vessel measured in meters from the foremost point of the bow to the aftermost point of the stern. Used to determine canal transit eligibility (Suez, Panama), port berth compatibility, and pilotage requirements.
attributes.references: International Convention on Tonnage Measurement of Ships 1969

attributes.name: main_engine_type
attributes.description: Manufacturer and model designation of the primary propulsion engine. Common types include MAN B&W two-stroke diesel, Wärtsilä medium-speed diesel, and steam turbines for older LNG carriers. Impacts fuel consumption, maintenance costs, and emissions profile.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) MARPOL Annex VI

attributes.name: net_tonnage
attributes.description: Measure of the usable cargo volume of the vessel, calculated by subtracting non-cargo spaces from gross tonnage. Used for port dues, pilotage fees, and regulatory assessments. Represents the earning capacity of the vessel.
attributes.references: International Convention on Tonnage Measurement of Ships 1969

attributes.name: next_special_survey_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the next comprehensive classification society survey must be completed. Special surveys are conducted every 5 years and involve detailed inspection of hull structure, machinery, safety equipment, and cargo systems. Vessels cannot trade beyond the special survey due date without survey completion.
attributes.references: International Association of Classification Societies (IACS) Unified Requirements

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the vessel. In Service indicates active trading. Laid Up indicates temporary withdrawal from service due to market conditions. Under Repair indicates scheduled or unscheduled maintenance. Drydocked indicates the vessel is in drydock for survey or repairs. Scrapped indicates the vessel has been sold for demolition.

attributes.name: owner_company
attributes.description: Legal entity that holds title to the vessel. May be a single-ship company (special purpose vehicle) for financing purposes, a shipping company, or an integrated oil company. Owner is responsible for capital expenditures, major repairs, and vessel disposal decisions.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) Ship Registration Requirements

attributes.name: propulsion_power_kw
attributes.description: Maximum continuous rated power output of the main propulsion engine measured in kilowatts. Determines vessel speed capability, fuel consumption rate, and Energy Efficiency Design Index (EEDI) calculations for IMO emissions compliance.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) MARPOL Annex VI - EEDI Regulations

attributes.name: protection_indemnity_club
attributes.description: Mutual insurance association providing liability coverage for shipowners, including third-party claims for pollution, cargo damage, crew injury, collision, and wreck removal. Major P&I clubs include Gard, Skuld, UK P&I Club, and American Club. Membership is a key vetting criterion.
attributes.references: International Group of Protection and Indemnity Clubs

attributes.name: segregated_ballast_tanks
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vessel has dedicated ballast tanks that are completely separated from cargo oil and fuel oil systems. Prevents contamination of ballast water with oil and reduces operational oil pollution. Required for tankers over 20,000 DWT under MARPOL Annex I.
attributes.references: MARPOL Annex I Regulation 13 - Segregated Ballast Tanks

attributes.name: service_speed_knots
attributes.description: Normal operating speed of the vessel measured in nautical miles per hour (knots) under typical laden conditions with 85% engine power. Used for voyage planning, ETA calculations, and charter party speed warranties. One knot equals 1.852 kilometers per hour.
attributes.references: Baltic and International Maritime Council (BIMCO) Charter Party Terms

attributes.name: shipyard
attributes.description: Name of the shipbuilding facility where the vessel was constructed. Provides insight into build quality, design standards, and potential sister vessels. Major shipyards include Hyundai Heavy Industries, Samsung Heavy Industries, Daewoo Shipbuilding, and COSCO Shipyard.

attributes.name: sire_inspection_result
attributes.description: Overall outcome of the most recent SIRE inspection. Acceptable indicates no significant deficiencies. Acceptable with Observations indicates minor issues that do not prevent employment. Unacceptable indicates serious deficiencies requiring immediate rectification before the vessel can be chartered.
attributes.references: Oil Companies International Marine Forum (OCIMF) SIRE Programme

attributes.name: vessel_name
attributes.description: Official registered name of the vessel as recorded with the flag state maritime authority. Used for operational identification, chartering documentation, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: International Convention on Tonnage Measurement of Ships

attributes.name: vessel_type
attributes.description: Classification of vessel by design and cargo capacity. VLCC (Very Large Crude Carrier) for 200,000+ DWT crude oil transport, Suezmax for 120,000-200,000 DWT, Aframax for 80,000-120,000 DWT, LNG Carrier for liquefied natural gas, LPG Carrier for liquefied petroleum gas, FPSO (Floating Production Storage and Offloading) for offshore production and storage, FSO (Floating Storage and Offloading) for storage only, Product Tanker for refined petroleum products. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: VLCC|Suezmax|Aframax|Panamax|Handymax|LNG Carrier|LPG Carrier|Product Tanker|Chemical Tanker|FPSO|FSO|Shuttle Tanker — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: American Petroleum Institute (API) Marine Transportation Standards

attributes.name: vetting_status
attributes.description: Current approval status based on the most recent Ship Inspection Report (SIRE) or Chemical Distribution Institute (CDI) inspection. Major oil companies and charterers maintain approved vessel lists based on vetting results. Approved status is required for employment by most major charterers.
attributes.references: Oil Companies International Marine Forum (OCIMF) SIRE Programme

attributes.name: year_built
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the vessel was constructed and delivered from the shipyard. Critical for assessing vessel age, remaining economic life, vetting eligibility, insurance premiums, and compliance with age-restricted port regulations. Many ports and charterers impose age limits (typically 15-20 years for crude tankers, 25 years for product tankers).
attributes.references: International Association of Classification Societies (IACS) Standards

products.name: voyage
products.description: Transactional record representing a vessel's complete commercial and operational journey from fixture to settlement. Captures voyage number, vessel ID, charter party terms (charter type, fixture date, charterer, shipowner, freight rate basis — Worldscale or lump sum, governing law, payment terms), laycan, port call sequence (load/discharge/bunker ports with ETA, ATA, NOR tendered, berthing, operations commencement/completion, departure, port agent, PDA, port state control results), commencement and completion of loading/discharge, total laytime used per port, demurrage or despatch hours and rates, demurrage claim details (claim reference, claim amount, claim status — draft/submitted/disputed/agreed/settled, counterparty, dispute reason, settlement date), freight rate, voyage status, and voyage P&L. Serves as the single lifecycle record integrating charter party terms, port calls, laytime statements, demurrage claims, and freight invoicing.
products.reference: Charter Party Voyage Record / Laytime Statement

attributes.name: voyage_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the voyage record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cargo_nomination_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.cargo_nomination. Business justification: A voyage executes a cargo nomination. Marine operations teams track laycan compliance, demurrage, and freight settlement against the originating nomination. This link is essential for voyage P&L repor

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.carrier. Business justification: A voyage is operated by a carrier (shipping company or vessel operator). voyage has charter_party_reference (STRING) but no FK to the carrier master entity. Adding carrier_id normalizes the carrier re

attributes.name: counterparty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_counterparty. Business justification: Voyages are executed for a specific cargo buyer/charterer counterparty. Required for freight invoicing, demurrage claim issuance, voyage P&L reporting, and charter party management. A voyage P&L repor

attributes.name: crude_grade_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.crude_grade. Business justification: Voyages carrying crude reference a specific grade for freight rate calculation (grade-specific freight differentials), laytime calculation, and commercial settlement. Voyage P&L reporting and demurrag

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Voyage costs and revenues post to specific GL accounts for financial statement preparation, freight expense recognition, and demurrage/despatch accounting.

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.joa. Business justification: Voyages carrying JV crude/LNG require JOA reference for demurrage cost allocation to partners, freight cost sharing, and partner cargo tracking. Drives JIB billing for voyage-related costs and partner

attributes.name: lifting_entitlement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.lifting_entitlement. Business justification: A voyage transports a partner's equity crude cargo against their lifting entitlement. Linking voyage to lifting_entitlement enables the commercial/venture team to confirm entitlement fulfillment per v

attributes.name: loading_terminal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.terminal. Business justification: A voyage begins at a loading terminal where cargo is taken on board. Linking voyage to the loading terminal enables port charge calculation, berth scheduling, laytime tracking, and terminal throughput

attributes.name: nomination_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.nomination. Business justification: Voyages are chartered to fulfill specific customer cargo nominations in oil-and-gas. The nomination drives laycan, vessel assignment, and loading port. Used in voyage management, demurrage settlement,

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Voyages generate profit/loss that must be tracked by profit center for crude marketing performance, segment reporting, and voyage economics analysis.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Voyages trigger customs declarations and export filings. Voyage records link to the regulatory filing for audit trail, ensuring all international voyages are properly reported to customs authorities a

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.sales_order. Business justification: Voyages execute sales order deliveries (especially spot cargoes and FOB sales). Critical for delivery performance tracking, demurrage/despatch allocation to sales transactions, customer-specific freig

attributes.name: shipping_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.shipping_schedule. Business justification: A voyage is the execution of a planned vessel movement within a shipping schedule. Linking voyage to shipping_schedule establishes the plan-to-execution hierarchy: shipping_schedule (master plan) -> v

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: Master bill of lading number issued for the cargo transported on this voyage. Primary shipping document and title of goods.
attributes.references: Bill of Lading, International Maritime Standards

attributes.name: bunker_consumption_mt
attributes.description: Total bunker fuel consumed during the voyage, expressed in metric tons. Includes all fuel types (HFO, MGO, VLSFO, etc.).

attributes.name: bunker_cost
attributes.description: Total cost of bunker fuel consumed during the voyage. Expressed in freight currency. Major component of voyage costs.

attributes.name: canal_fees
attributes.description: Total fees paid for canal transits (e.g., Suez Canal, Panama Canal) during the voyage. Expressed in freight currency.

attributes.name: cargo_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of cargo loaded for this voyage. Unit of measure is specified in cargo_quantity_uom.

attributes.name: cargo_quantity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for cargo quantity. BBL = Barrels, MT = Metric Tons, M3 = Cubic Meters, MMBTU = Million British Thermal Units, GAL = Gallons.
attributes.references: API Standards, International System of Units

attributes.name: charter_party_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the charter party agreement governing this voyage. Links to contract management system.

attributes.name: charter_type
attributes.description: Type of charter party agreement governing this voyage. Voyage charter is for a single voyage, time charter is for a period, bareboat charter transfers operational control, contract of affreightment is for multiple voyages, and spot is an ad-hoc arrangement.

attributes.name: commencement_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when the voyage officially commenced, typically when the vessel departed the first load port or when loading operations began.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when the voyage was completed, typically when discharge operations finished at the final discharge port and the vessel was released.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this voyage record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: demurrage_amount
attributes.description: Total demurrage amount payable by the charterer, calculated from demurrage hours and rate. Expressed in freight currency.

attributes.name: demurrage_claim_amount
attributes.description: Total amount claimed in the demurrage claim, which may differ from the calculated demurrage_amount due to negotiations or disputes. Expressed in freight currency.

attributes.name: demurrage_claim_reference
attributes.description: Unique reference number for the demurrage claim submitted by the shipowner to the charterer.

attributes.name: demurrage_claim_status
attributes.description: Current status of the demurrage claim in the settlement process. Tracks progression from draft through to final settlement or withdrawal.

attributes.name: demurrage_dispute_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for dispute if the demurrage claim is contested by the charterer. Includes details of disagreements on laytime calculations, exceptions, or force majeure events.

attributes.name: demurrage_hours
attributes.description: Total demurrage hours incurred when laytime used exceeds laytime allowed. Demurrage is a penalty paid by the charterer for exceeding allowed time.

attributes.name: demurrage_rate_per_day
attributes.description: Agreed daily rate for demurrage charges, expressed in the freight currency. Used to calculate total demurrage amount.

attributes.name: demurrage_settlement_date
attributes.description: Date when the demurrage claim was finally settled and payment was made or agreed.

attributes.name: despatch_amount
attributes.description: Total despatch amount payable by the shipowner to the charterer, calculated from despatch hours and rate. Expressed in freight currency.

attributes.name: despatch_hours
attributes.description: Total despatch hours earned when laytime used is less than laytime allowed. Despatch is a bonus paid by the shipowner to the charterer for saving time.

attributes.name: despatch_rate_per_day
attributes.description: Agreed daily rate for despatch payments, typically half the demurrage rate. Expressed in the freight currency.

attributes.name: fixture_date
attributes.description: Date when the charter party agreement was fixed and agreed between the charterer and shipowner.

attributes.name: freight_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the freight rate and voyage financial amounts.

attributes.name: freight_rate
attributes.description: The agreed freight rate for the voyage. Interpretation depends on freight_rate_basis (e.g., Worldscale points, lump sum amount, or per-unit rate).

attributes.name: freight_rate_basis
attributes.description: Basis on which freight is calculated. Worldscale is a standard tanker rate index, lump sum is a fixed amount for the voyage, per-unit rates are based on cargo volume or weight.

attributes.name: governing_law
attributes.description: The legal jurisdiction and law governing the charter party agreement (e.g., English Law, New York Law).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this voyage record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: laycan_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the laycan window. If the vessel does not arrive by this date, the charterer may have the right to cancel the charter.

attributes.name: laycan_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the laycan (laydays and canceling) window. The earliest date the vessel is expected to arrive at the load port.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Terms and conditions for freight payment, including timing, method, and any advance or retention clauses.

attributes.name: port_charges_total
attributes.description: Total port charges incurred across all port calls during the voyage, including port dues, pilotage, tugs, and agency fees. Expressed in freight currency.

attributes.name: profit_loss
attributes.description: Net profit or loss for the voyage, calculated as freight revenue minus voyage costs (bunker, port charges, canal fees, demurrage/despatch net). Expressed in freight currency. Business-confidential financial metric.

attributes.name: total_laytime_allowed_hours
attributes.description: Total laytime (loading and discharge time) allowed under the charter party terms, expressed in hours. Laytime is the time allowed for cargo operations.

attributes.name: total_laytime_used_hours
attributes.description: Total laytime actually used across all load and discharge ports, expressed in hours. Calculated from port call records.

attributes.name: voyage_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the voyage, typically assigned by the commercial or operations team. Used for external communication and documentation.

attributes.name: voyage_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the voyage. Tracks the voyage lifecycle from planning through completion or cancellation.

products.name: terminal
products.description: Master data entity for storage and loading/discharge terminals including marine terminals, pipeline injection points, truck loading racks, and rail terminals, with daily storage inventory tracking at tank level. Captures terminal ID, terminal name, terminal type (marine, pipeline, truck rack, rail), location (latitude/longitude), country and state, operator, storage capacity (BBL or CBM), number of berths or loading arms, maximum vessel size (DWT), product types handled, throughput capacity (BOPD), USCG facility number, EPA RMP registration, operational status, and periodic tank-level inventory positions (inventory date, tank ID, product type and grade, opening inventory, receipts, deliveries, closing inventory, tank capacity, ullage, water bottom, temperature, API gravity, inventory status). Serves as the SSOT for terminal identity, terminal infrastructure, and storage position across logistics and supply chain. Supports supply chain balancing, custody reconciliation, and working capital management.
products.reference: USCG Marine Terminal / EPA RMP Facility

attributes.name: terminal_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the terminal. Primary key for the terminal entity.

attributes.name: asset_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.facility. Business justification: Terminals are physical facilities requiring asset management. Links terminal infrastructure to asset register for maintenance planning, integrity management, turnaround scheduling, asset retirement ob

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Terminals are operational facilities with associated costs (labor, utilities, maintenance) that must be tracked by cost center for budget management and operational expense control.

attributes.name: emission_source_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.emission_source. Business justification: Terminals are emission sources (loading racks, storage tanks). Terminal references primary emission source for GHG reporting (EPA GHGRP) and air permit compliance.

attributes.name: lease_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.lease. Business justification: Terminal facilities are built on land parcels governed by leases. O&G land departments track which lease covers a terminal's footprint for delay rental payments, lease compliance, HBP status, and land

attributes.name: operating_license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.operating_license. Business justification: Terminals operate under specific operating licenses issued by state/federal agencies. Compliance teams track license status per terminal for renewal management and regulatory inspections. Real-world o

attributes.name: operator_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.operator. Business justification: Terminal records carry operator_name as a plain denormalized text attribute. Linking to land.operator (the canonical operator registry) supports regulatory reporting, license tracking, and operator pe

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Terminals require multiple permits (air quality, water discharge, SPCC, operating license). Compliance teams track primary permit per terminal for renewal management and inspection scheduling. Real-wo

attributes.name: primary_petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Terminals typically have primary product specialization affecting tariff rates, storage design, safety protocols, and operational procedures; FK enables terminal classification, tariff determination,

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Terminals generate throughput revenue and incur costs, requiring profit center assignment for P&L tracking, segment reporting, and asset profitability analysis.

attributes.name: quality_spec_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.quality_spec. Business justification: Terminals enforce specific quality specifications for product receipt and delivery. Terminal operators reference the applicable quality spec to accept or reject incoming cargoes, ensuring pipeline/exp

attributes.name: surface_use_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.surface_use_agreement. Business justification: Terminal sites require surface use agreements with surface owners governing access, compensation, and reclamation obligations. O&G land departments maintain SUA records for terminal sites; linking ter

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the terminal facility location.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for additional location details such as building number or suite.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the terminal facility is located.

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the terminal facility was commissioned and began commercial operations.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code identifying the country where the terminal is located.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the terminal record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: custody_transfer_metering
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal has certified custody transfer metering systems for accurate measurement and allocation of product volumes during ownership transfer.

attributes.name: environmental_permit_number
attributes.description: Primary environmental operating permit number issued by EPA or state environmental agency authorizing terminal operations.

attributes.name: epa_rmp_registration
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Risk Management Plan (RMP) Registration
attributes.description: EPA Risk Management Plan registration number for facilities handling threshold quantities of regulated substances under the Clean Air Act Section 112(r).
attributes.references: 40 CFR Part 68 - Chemical Accident Prevention Provisions

attributes.name: hse_incident_count_ytd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Incident Count Year-to-Date (YTD)
attributes.description: Total count of reportable HSE incidents at the terminal facility in the current calendar year, used for safety performance tracking.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904 - Recording and Reporting Occupational Injuries and Illnesses

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent regulatory or internal safety inspection of the terminal facility and storage tanks.
attributes.references: API Standard 653 - Tank Inspection, Repair, Alteration, and Reconstruction

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the terminal location in decimal degrees format for GIS mapping and logistics planning.
attributes.references: ISO 6709 - Standard Representation of Geographic Point Location

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the terminal location in decimal degrees format for GIS mapping and logistics planning.
attributes.references: ISO 6709 - Standard Representation of Geographic Point Location

attributes.name: maximum_draft_meters
attributes.description: Maximum vessel draft in meters that can be safely accommodated at the marine terminal berth, critical for vessel acceptance and scheduling. Null for non-marine terminals.

attributes.name: maximum_vessel_size_dwt
attributes.description: Maximum deadweight tonnage (DWT) of vessels that can be accommodated at the marine terminal, used for vessel scheduling and FPSO lifting planning. Null for non-marine terminals.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the terminal record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next required regulatory or internal safety inspection of the terminal facility.
attributes.references: API Standard 653 - Tank Inspection, Repair, Alteration, and Reconstruction

attributes.name: number_of_berths
attributes.description: Number of vessel berths or docking positions available at marine terminals for loading and discharge operations. Null for non-marine terminals.
attributes.references: OCIMF - Oil Companies International Marine Forum Standards

attributes.name: number_of_loading_arms
attributes.description: Total count of loading arms or loading bays available for product transfer operations at the terminal, applicable to marine, truck rack, and rail terminals.
attributes.references: API RP 2003 - Protection Against Ignitions Arising Out of Static, Lightning, and Stray Currents

attributes.name: number_of_tanks
attributes.description: Total count of storage tanks at the terminal facility used for inventory management and capacity planning.
attributes.references: API Standard 653 - Tank Inspection, Repair, Alteration, and Reconstruction

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the terminal facility indicating availability for loading, discharge, and storage operations.
attributes.references: API RP 2001 - Fire Protection in Refineries

attributes.name: osha_psm_covered
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Process Safety Management (PSM) Covered
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal is subject to OSHA Process Safety Management requirements due to handling threshold quantities of highly hazardous chemicals.
attributes.references: 29 CFR 1910.119 - Process Safety Management of Highly Hazardous Chemicals

attributes.name: owner_name
attributes.description: Name of the legal owner of the terminal facility, which may differ from the operator in joint venture or leased arrangements.

attributes.name: pipeline_system_connection
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the pipeline system(s) connected to the terminal for product receipt or delivery, used for nomination and scheduling coordination.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the terminal facility address.

products.name: vessel_schedule_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the operational assignment between a shipping schedule and a vessel. It captures the specific assignment of a vessel to execute liftings within a consolidated shipping schedule for a given planning horizon. Each record links one shipping schedule to one vessel with attributes that exist only in the context of this assignment, including assignment dates, vessel role, planned loading dates, planned volumes, and assignment status.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas marine logistics, a shipping schedule is a consolidated master plan covering multiple vessel movements across a planning horizon (monthly/quarterly), and each vessel can participate in multiple shipping schedules over time. The business actively manages vessel schedule assignments as operational records with specific assignment dates, vessel roles, planned loading dates, planned volumes, and assignment statuses. The explicit presence of number_of_vessels_assigned on shipping_schedule confirms that schedules routinely involve multiple vessels, and vessels are reused across different schedules.

attributes.name: vessel_schedule_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this vessel schedule assignment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: shipping_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to logistics.shipping_schedule. Links this assignment to the parent shipping schedule.

attributes.name: vessel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to logistics.vessel. Links this assignment to the assigned vessel.

attributes.name: assigned_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the marine logistics planner or scheduler who made this vessel assignment decision.

attributes.name: assignment_date
attributes.description: Date when this vessel was assigned to the shipping schedule by the marine logistics planner. Tracks when the assignment decision was made.

attributes.name: assignment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing specific considerations, constraints, or special instructions for this vessel assignment (e.g., cargo compatibility, port restrictions, weather considerations).

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this vessel assignment. Values: proposed (initial planning), confirmed (vessel committed), in_progress (loading underway), completed (lifting finished), cancelled (assignment cancelled), substituted (vessel replaced).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this vessel schedule assignment record was first created. Audit trail.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this vessel schedule assignment record was last updated. Audit trail for tracking changes to assignments.

attributes.name: laycan_end_date
attributes.description: Latest date of the laytime cancelling date range (laycan) by which the vessel must arrive at the loading port. Failure to arrive within laycan may allow charterer to cancel.

attributes.name: laycan_start_date
attributes.description: Earliest date of the laytime cancelling date range (laycan) during which the vessel must arrive at the loading port. Part of charter party terms.

attributes.name: planned_loading_date
attributes.description: Planned date when this vessel is scheduled to commence loading operations for this shipping schedule. Critical for berth planning and terminal coordination.

attributes.name: planned_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Planned cargo volume in barrels that this vessel is assigned to lift under this shipping schedule. Used for capacity planning and entitlement allocation.

attributes.name: vessel_role
attributes.description: Role of the vessel in this shipping schedule assignment. Values: primary_lifter (main vessel for scheduled liftings), backup_vessel (contingency vessel), spot_charter (short-term charter), term_charter (long-term charter agreement).

products.name: schedule_port_call
products.description: This association product represents the operational port call event between a shipping schedule and a terminal. It captures the planned vessel arrival, departure, berth assignment, and volume for each terminal included in a multi-port shipping schedule. Each record links one shipping schedule to one terminal with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific port call within the schedule.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas marine logistics, a shipping schedule is a consolidated master plan that encompasses multiple port calls across different terminals during a planning horizon (monthly or quarterly). Each shipping schedule includes planned vessel movements to multiple terminals for cargo liftings, and each terminal hosts multiple shipping schedules over time. The business actively manages schedule port calls as operational planning entities with specific arrival/departure dates, berth assignments, and planned volumes for each terminal visit within a schedule.

attributes.name: schedule_port_call_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this schedule port call. Primary key.

attributes.name: shipping_schedule_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Schedule Port Call - Shipping Schedule Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the parent shipping schedule that governs this port call

attributes.name: terminal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the terminal where this port call will occur

attributes.name: berth_assignment
attributes.description: Specific berth or loading position assigned at the terminal for this port call (e.g., Berth 3, North Dock)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this schedule port call record was first created in the system

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this schedule port call record was last modified

attributes.name: planned_arrival_date
attributes.description: Planned date and time when the vessel is scheduled to arrive at this terminal for loading or discharge operations

attributes.name: planned_departure_date
attributes.description: Planned date and time when the vessel is scheduled to depart from this terminal after completing cargo operations

attributes.name: planned_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Planned cargo volume in barrels to be loaded or discharged at this terminal during this port call

attributes.name: port_call_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential order of this port call within the shipping schedule (1 for first port, 2 for second, etc.)

attributes.name: port_call_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this port call indicating its execution state

attributes.name: vat_registration_number

Required for cross-border petroleum product invoicing, import/export documentation, and indirect tax compliance in international oil and gas operations.
attributes.references: IFRS/GAAP Indirect Tax Standards; EU VAT Directive; SAP S/4HANA Tax Number Fields

attributes.name: working_interest_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this counterparty is eligible to hold a Working Interest (WI) in oil and gas joint ventures and Production Sharing Agreements (PSAs). Drives counterparty qualification for JOA participation, AFE approval workflows, and Joint Interest Billing (JIB) in SAP Joint Venture Accounting.
attributes.references: SAP Joint Venture Accounting; Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) Standards; BOEM Working Interest Regulations; COPAS JIB Procedures

products.name: account
products.description: Commercial account record representing an active or historical business relationship between Oil Gas and a counterparty. Captures account number, account tier (strategic, preferred, standard), account status (active, suspended, closed), assigned commercial territory, primary sales channel, account open/close dates, account manager assignment, credit limit, payment terms code, billing currency, and account classification (spot buyer, term offtake, tolling, exchange, bunkering). Links counterparty identity to commercial, billing, and logistics operations. Supports temporal status tracking for SOX audit compliance.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the commercial account record in the Oil Gas enterprise data platform. Primary key for the account entity in the customer domain Silver layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Account Master

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Customer accounts must be assigned to legal entities (company codes) for financial consolidation, regulatory reporting (SEC, IFRS), and tax compliance. Core master data relationship in oil & gas multi

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Customer accounts in oil & gas track operational costs (LOE, G&A allocation) to cost centers for budgeting, variance analysis, and management reporting. Essential for account-level profitability and c

attributes.name: parent_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent account in the account hierarchy, enabling multi-level corporate group structures (e.g., subsidiary accounts rolled up to a parent holding company). Supports consolidated credit exposure management and group-level reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Account Hierarchy; IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Accounts are assigned to profit centers for segment P&L reporting, revenue recognition, and business unit performance tracking. Critical for management accounting and segment reporting under IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: royalty_owner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.royalty_owner. Business justification: Accounts established for royalty owners who purchase products/services or sell their production. Connects commercial relationship management (credit, pricing, contracts) to legal ownership records for

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: In oil & gas, the same legal entity often acts as both customer and vendor (JV partners, integrated majors, service companies). Business process: consolidated counterparty management, unified credit/s

attributes.name: venture_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.partner. Business justification: JV partners frequently purchase their equity crude through customer accounts. Enables integrated partner-customer management for equity offtake sales, consolidated credit exposure tracking, and partne

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: Legal or trade name of the counterparty associated with this commercial account, as registered in the SAP customer master. Used for contract documents, billing, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier assigned to the commercial account. Used in invoices, Joint Interest Billing (JIB) statements, and counterparty correspondence. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA SD customer account master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; COPAS Joint Interest Billing Standards

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the commercial account. Drives eligibility for order placement, credit extension, and billing. Supports SOX audit compliance through temporal status tracking. Values: active (fully operational), suspended (temporarily blocked), closed (permanently terminated), pending (awaiting KYC/credit approval), under_review (compliance or credit review in progress).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Section 404

attributes.name: account_tier
attributes.description: Commercial segmentation tier classifying the account by strategic importance and revenue contribution. Strategic accounts receive dedicated account managers and priority service. Preferred accounts receive enhanced terms. Standard accounts operate under default commercial terms.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Classification; API RP 100 Commercial Practices

attributes.name: billing_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which invoices and financial transactions are denominated for this account (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Drives foreign exchange conversion in SAP FI and financial reporting under IFRS/GAAP.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS/GAAP Foreign Currency Translation; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: classification
attributes.description: Commercial relationship type defining the nature of the offtake or supply arrangement. Spot buyer: single-transaction purchases at market price. Term offtake: long-term volume commitment contract. Tolling: processing fee arrangement where counterparty owns feedstock. Exchange: product swap arrangement between counterparties. Bunkering: marine fuel supply account.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Management; FERC Natural Gas Tariff Classifications

attributes.name: close_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the commercial account was formally closed or terminated. Null for active accounts. Required for SOX temporal status tracking and revenue recognition cutoff under IFRS 15.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; IFRS 15; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: commercial_territory
attributes.description: Geographic or organizational sales territory to which this account is assigned for commercial management, quota allocation, and revenue attribution. Aligns with SAP SD sales organization and territory hierarchy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Territory Management

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the counterparty's primary registered business address. Used for sanctions screening, regulatory jurisdiction determination, and export control compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; OFAC Export Controls; BOEM Offshore Jurisdiction

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the account record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Conforms to ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for data lineage, audit trail, and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ISO 8601; SAP S/4HANA Audit Log

attributes.name: credit_block_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is currently blocked from new order processing due to credit limit breach, overdue invoices, or credit review. True = account is credit-blocked and orders require credit manager release in SAP SD.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/FI Credit Management; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding credit exposure in the billing currency approved for this account by the credit risk function. Enforced at order entry in SAP SD credit management. Reviewed periodically based on counterparty credit rating and payment history.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: External or internal credit rating assigned to the counterparty, reflecting their creditworthiness and default risk (e.g., AAA, BBB+, BB-, internal risk grades). Sourced from rating agencies (Moody's, S&P, Fitch) or internal credit assessment. Drives credit limit setting and collateral requirements.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; SEC Financial Disclosure

attributes.name: credit_rating_agency
attributes.description: Source of the credit rating assigned to this account's counterparty. Identifies whether the rating is from an external agency (Moody's, S&P, Fitch, DBRS) or derived from an internal credit scoring model.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; SEC Financial Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: credit_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled or last-completed date for periodic credit limit and rating review for this account. Ensures credit exposure remains aligned with counterparty financial health. Managed through SAP FI credit management workflow.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IFRS 9; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: distribution_channel_code
attributes.description: SAP SD distribution channel code classifying how products reach this account (e.g., wholesale, direct, retail, export). Used for pricing determination, revenue reporting, and sales analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Distribution Channel Configuration

attributes.name: dunning_procedure_code
attributes.description: SAP FI dunning procedure key assigned to this account, defining the escalation schedule and notice levels for overdue invoice collection. Governs accounts receivable collections workflow.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Dunning Configuration; COPAS Accounting Standards

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) code defining the delivery obligations, risk transfer point, and cost allocation between Oil Gas and the counterparty for product deliveries under this account. Critical for logistics, insurance, and revenue recognition. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: is_intercompany
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account represents an intercompany transaction counterparty (i.e., another legal entity within the Oil Gas corporate group). True = intercompany account subject to transfer pricing and intercompany elimination in consolidation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Intercompany Processing; IFRS 10; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: is_jv_partner
attributes.description: Indicates whether the counterparty is also a Joint Venture (JV) partner under a Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) or Production Sharing Agreement (PSA). True = counterparty has working interest (WI) participation. Drives Joint Interest Billing (JIB) processing in SAP JVA.
attributes.references: SAP Joint Venture Accounting (JVA); COPAS JIB Standards; JOA/PSA Agreements

attributes.name: kyc_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current KYC compliance documentation for this account expires and must be renewed. Null if KYC has no fixed expiry. Triggers automated renewal workflow in compliance management systems.
attributes.references: FATF Anti-Money Laundering Guidelines; OFAC Sanctions Compliance

attributes.name: kyc_status
attributes.description: Current status of the Know Your Customer (KYC) compliance verification for this account's counterparty. Approved: all KYC documentation verified and current. Pending: verification in progress. Expired: KYC documentation has lapsed and requires renewal. Rejected: counterparty failed KYC screening.
attributes.references: FATF Anti-Money Laundering Guidelines; OFAC Sanctions Compliance; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: open_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the commercial account was formally opened and activated in the system of record. Marks the effective start of the business relationship. Used for tenure analysis and SOX audit trails.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: SAP payment terms key defining the due date calculation, early payment discount schedule, and cash discount conditions applicable to this account (e.g., NT30, NT60, 2/10NET30). Governs accounts receivable aging and cash flow forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms; COPAS Accounting Standards; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: preferred_delivery_mode
attributes.description: Primary logistics mode preferred by the counterparty for product delivery. Drives transportation planning, scheduling, and logistics cost allocation. Relevant for crude oil, refined products, LNG, and NGL deliveries.
attributes.references: PHMSA Pipeline Safety Regulations; FERC Transportation Tariffs; SAP S/4HANA SD Shipping

attributes.name: price_list_type
attributes.description: SAP SD pricing condition type or price list category applicable to this account, determining the base pricing structure (e.g., WTI-linked, Brent-linked, fixed price, formula-based). Drives pricing determination in sales order processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Conditions; WTI/Brent Benchmark Pricing; FERC Tariff

attributes.name: product_segment
attributes.description: Primary petroleum product segment associated with this commercial account. Defines the commodity category for which the account is established. Crude oil, refined products (gasoline, diesel, jet fuel), Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG), Natural Gas Liquids (NGL), Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG), petrochemicals, or lubricants. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: crude_oil|refined_products|LNG|NGL|LPG|petrochemicals|lubricants — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: API Product Classification; FERC Commodity Definitions; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Classification

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Geographic region code classifying the account's counterparty location for commercial territory management, regulatory reporting, and market analytics (e.g., USGC, NWEUR, MENA, APAC).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Region Configuration; OPEC Regional Reporting

attributes.name: sales_channel
attributes.description: Primary commercial channel through which product is sold or delivered to this account. Direct: bilateral contract. Broker: intermediary-facilitated. Exchange: commodity exchange platform. Pipeline: pipeline tariff-based delivery. Marine: tanker or vessel-based delivery. Retail: downstream retail network.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Distribution Channel; FERC Tariff Regulations

attributes.name: sales_org_code
attributes.description: SAP SD sales organization code to which this account is assigned. Defines the legal entity responsible for the sale, the applicable pricing conditions, and the revenue booking entity for financial consolidation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Organization Structure; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: sanctions_screened
attributes.description: Indicates whether the counterparty associated with this account has been screened against applicable sanctions lists (OFAC SDN, EU Consolidated List, UN Sanctions). True = screened and cleared. False = not yet screened or screening pending.
attributes.references: OFAC Sanctions Regulations; EU Sanctions Compliance; FATF Guidelines

attributes.name: status_change_date
attributes.description: Date on which the account status was last changed (e.g., from active to suspended, or from pending to active). Critical for SOX audit compliance and temporal status tracking in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Audit Trail; SAP S/4HANA SD Change Management

attributes.name: status_change_reason
attributes.description: Business reason code or description explaining the most recent account status change (e.g., credit limit breach, KYC expiry, counterparty request, sanctions flag, commercial closure). Supports audit trail and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA SD Change Management; OFAC Compliance

attributes.name: tax_classification_code
attributes.description: Tax classification assigned to this account in SAP FI/SD, determining applicable VAT, excise duty, and withholding tax treatment for transactions. Varies by counterparty jurisdiction and product type.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Management; IFRS/GAAP Tax Accounting; EPA Excise Tax Regulations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the account record in the enterprise data platform. Conforms to ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture, incremental processing, and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ISO 8601; SAP S/4HANA Audit Log

attributes.name: vat_registration_number
attributes.description: Value Added Tax (VAT) or equivalent indirect tax registration number of the counterparty. Required for tax invoice compliance, cross-border transaction reporting, and VAT reclaim processing.
attributes.references: IFRS/GAAP Tax Reporting; EU VAT Directive; SAP S/4HANA FI Tax

attributes.name: volume_commitment_bopd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Volume Commitment in Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD)
attributes.description: Contracted minimum or nominated daily volume commitment for this account expressed in Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD). Applicable for term offtake accounts. Used for production planning, logistics scheduling, and take-or-pay obligation tracking.
attributes.references: API Measurement Standards; FERC Gas Tariff Volume Commitments; SAP S/4HANA SD Contracts

products.name: contact
products.description: Individual contact person associated with a counterparty or account, including name, title, role (commercial, technical, legal, HSE liaison), department, direct phone, email, preferred communication channel, language preference, authority level (signatory, approver, operational), and active status. Supports relationship management for traders, procurement officers, operations contacts, and executive sponsors across IOC, NOC, and industrial customer organizations.

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the individual contact person record within the Oil Gas customer domain. Serves as the primary key for all downstream joins and relationship resolution.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 11179 Data Element Naming and Definition Standards

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent counterparty or customer account (IOC, NOC, refiner, trader, industrial consumer) to which this contact belongs. Supports account hierarchy and relationship management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Business Partner Contact Assignment

attributes.name: counterparty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_counterparty. Business justification: Contacts can be associated directly with counterparties (not just through accounts). This supports scenarios where a contact represents the counterparty entity itself. The organization_name on contact

attributes.name: approval_limit_usd
attributes.description: Maximum monetary value in US Dollars that this contact is authorized to approve for transactions, AFEs (Authorization for Expenditure), purchase orders, or contract amendments on behalf of their organization. Critical for COPAS AFE management and SOX financial controls.
attributes.references: COPAS — Authorization for Expenditure (AFE) approval thresholds; SOX Section 302/404 financial authorization controls; SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchasing authorization limits

attributes.name: assistant_name
attributes.description: Name of the executive assistant or administrative contact who manages scheduling and correspondence on behalf of this contact. Used for executive-level relationship management with senior IOC, NOC, and industrial customer representatives.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Contact Person Assistant field; CRM relationship management best practices

attributes.name: assistant_phone
attributes.description: Phone number for the executive assistant or administrative contact. Used to schedule meetings and route communications for senior counterparty representatives who delegate correspondence management.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; ITU-T E.164; SAP S/4HANA SD — Assistant Phone field

attributes.name: authority_level
attributes.description: Indicates the contractual and operational authority level of the contact: signatory (authorized to execute contracts/AFEs), approver (can approve transactions up to defined limits), operational (day-to-day operational decisions), informational (receives communications only). Critical for AFE authorization, JIB approvals, and contract execution workflows.
attributes.references: COPAS — Authorization for Expenditure (AFE) signatory requirements; SOX Section 302/404 authorization controls; JOA counterparty authority definitions

attributes.name: contact_role
attributes.description: Functional role classification of the contact in the context of the Oil Gas business relationship. Determines which communications, documents, and workflows are routed to this individual. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: commercial|technical|legal|hse_liaison|financial|executive|operational|procurement|regulatory — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: API RP 100; JOA (Joint Operating Agreement) counterparty role definitions; SAP S/4HANA SD Contact Function

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the contact record. Active contacts are eligible for communications and workflow routing. Inactive or terminated contacts are retained for audit and historical reference but excluded from active routing. Supports KYC refresh and relationship management processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA BP — Partner Status; GDPR Article 17 right to erasure vs. retention obligations; SOX audit trail requirements

attributes.name: contact_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contact's relationship type to the account: primary (main point of contact), secondary (backup), emergency (24/7 incident response), billing (JIB and invoice recipient), technical (operations and engineering). Supports structured relationship management across IOC, NOC, and industrial customer organizations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Contact Person Function; COPAS JIB billing contact requirements

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code representing the country where the contact is primarily based or operates. Used for jurisdictional compliance, KYC screening, sanctions screening, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; OFAC sanctions screening requirements; FATF KYC guidelines; SEC disclosure requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contact record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the audit trail creation anchor for SOX compliance and data governance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — audit trail requirements; ISO 8601; GDPR Article 30 records of processing activities

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Organizational department or business unit of the contact within their counterparty organization (e.g., Trading, Procurement, Legal, HSE, Operations, Finance, Executive). Supports routing of commercial, technical, and legal communications.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA BP — Department field; COPAS organizational classification

attributes.name: direct_phone
