attributes.description: Most recent date on which the counterparty was screened against OFAC, EU, and UN sanctions lists. Sanctions screening must be refreshed at defined intervals and upon any material change in counterparty ownership or jurisdiction.
attributes.references: OFAC Compliance Framework; EU Consolidated Sanctions List; UN Security Council Sanctions; Internal Sanctions Screening Policy

attributes.name: source_system_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier of this KYC record in the originating compliance management system (e.g., Enablon HSE Management or dedicated KYC platform). Enables traceability from the Silver layer back to the operational system of record for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: Internal Data Lineage and Audit Policy; SOX Section 404; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: trading_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the counterparty is currently eligible for crude oil, natural gas, LNG, NGL, or refined product trading based on the current KYC status, sanctions screening results, AML risk rating, and document collection completeness. Set to false when KYC is expired, rejected, or sanctions match is confirmed.
attributes.references: OFAC Compliance Framework; FATF Recommendation 10; Internal Trading Counterparty Eligibility Policy

attributes.name: ubo_count
attributes.description: Number of ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) identified and disclosed for this counterparty. A UBO is any natural person holding 25% or more direct or indirect ownership or control. Used to assess ownership complexity and completeness of beneficial ownership disclosure.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 24; FinCEN Customer Due Diligence Rule 31 CFR 1010.230; EU AMLD4 Article 30

attributes.name: un_sanctions_screening_result
attributes.description: Result of screening the counterparty against the United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions list. Applies globally to all counterparties regardless of jurisdiction. A confirmed match prohibits all transactions under international law.
attributes.references: UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List; UN Charter Article 41; Internal Sanctions Compliance Policy

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this KYC record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Updated on every status change, review completion, sanctions screening refresh, or document update. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NIST Cybersecurity Framework; Internal Data Governance Audit Policy

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the KYC verification process was completed and the counterparty's identity and documentation were confirmed by the compliance team. Marks the start of the KYC validity period.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 10; FinCEN Customer Due Diligence Rule; OFAC Compliance Framework

attributes.name: waiver_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the compliance waiver expires when waiver_flag is true. After this date, trading eligibility is automatically suspended until full KYC compliance is restored. Null when no waiver is in effect.
attributes.references: Internal KYC Waiver Policy; FATF Risk-Based Approach Guidance

attributes.name: waiver_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal compliance waiver has been granted for this KYC record, allowing temporary trading eligibility despite incomplete documentation or pending review. Waivers require senior compliance authority approval and are time-limited.
attributes.references: Internal KYC Waiver Policy; FATF Risk-Based Approach Guidance; SOX Section 302

products.name: nomination
products.description: Customer delivery nomination record capturing the formal request by a customer to lift or receive a cargo or pipeline volume under a term contract or spot sale. Includes nomination reference, nomination date, requested delivery window (laycan), delivery point, product grade, nominated volume (BBL, MT, MMBTU), vessel name and IMO number (if applicable), loading/discharge port, nomination status (submitted, confirmed, amended, cancelled, expired), confirming trader, and amendment history reference. Core operational record linking customer demand to logistics scheduling, vessel chartering, and terminal operations.

attributes.name: nomination_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate identifier for the customer delivery nomination record. Primary key for the nomination entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: A nomination is a formal customer delivery request — it must be tied to the commercial account making the request. nomination currently has delivery_point_id, petroleum_product_id, and operational fie

attributes.name: block_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to exploration.block. Business justification: In PSA and concession regimes, crude lifting nominations must reference the producing block for production allocation, government reporting, and royalty calculation. Nomination scheduling and entitlem

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Nomination processing, scheduling coordination, and pipeline/terminal operations costs are allocated to logistics/operations cost centers for operational cost tracking and efficiency analysis.

attributes.name: delivery_point_id
attributes.description: Reference to the nominated delivery point (terminal, pipeline custody transfer point, or discharge port) where the product is to be received by the customer.
attributes.references: API RP 17V; PHMSA Pipeline Safety Regulations

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.joa. Business justification: JOA partners nominate equity crude liftings per JOA lifting procedures and nomination cycles. Required for JOA-compliant nomination workflow, operator approval process, partner lifting coordination, a

attributes.name: lease_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.lease. Business justification: Crude oil nominations are tied to specific lease production entitlements based on working interest and NRI. Essential for offtake scheduling, entitlement verification, and ensuring liftings match owne

attributes.name: nominating_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.partner. Business justification: Nominations represent partner equity holders requesting their entitlement share under PSA/JOA. Business requires tracking which venture partner is nominating (distinct from the commercial account buye

attributes.name: parent_nomination_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original nomination record from which this amended nomination was derived. Null for original nominations; populated for all amendment versions to maintain the amendment history chain.

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Nominations specify which petroleum product (crude grade, diesel, gasoline, propane, LNG) is being nominated for lifting or delivery. Core supply chain operation requiring product master data for spec

attributes.name: psa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.psa. Business justification: PSA contractors nominate cost recovery and profit oil liftings per PSA terms. Essential for PSA entitlement lifting execution, contractor nomination procedures, government approval workflow, and fisca

attributes.name: supply_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.contract. Business justification: Crude oil nominations frequently reference master supply or framework contracts that establish pricing formulas, quality specifications, and delivery terms. Essential for contract compliance verificat

attributes.name: actual_volume_lifted
attributes.description: The actual quantity of product loaded or delivered as measured at the custody transfer point, expressed in the same unit of measure as nominated_volume. Populated post-lifting from terminal or metering records.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 12 — Calculation of Petroleum Quantities; PHMSA Measurement Standards

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: The total number of amendments applied to this nomination since original submission. A value of zero indicates the nomination has not been amended. Used to track nomination stability and customer behavior patterns.

attributes.name: amendment_reason
attributes.description: Categorized reason code for the most recent amendment to this nomination. Supports analysis of nomination instability drivers and commercial risk patterns. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: volume_change|vessel_substitution|laycan_change|product_change|delivery_point_change|customer_request — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_date
attributes.description: The date on the bill of lading issued at the load port upon completion of cargo loading. Serves as the pricing date for Dated Brent and other spot-referenced cargoes and triggers revenue recognition.
attributes.references: INCOTERMS 2020; IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers; API MPMS Chapter 17

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for nomination cancellation when nomination_status is 'cancelled'. Captures commercial, operational, or force majeure circumstances leading to cancellation.
attributes.references: Oil Gas Internal Nomination Procedures; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards

attributes.name: confirmation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the nomination was formally confirmed by the Oil Gas commercial/trading desk. Marks the transition from submitted to confirmed status and triggers downstream logistics scheduling.
attributes.references: Oil Gas Internal Nomination Procedures; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the nomination record was first created in the system. Audit trail field capturing the initial record creation event for data lineage and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404 — Internal Controls; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: delivery_terms
attributes.description: The INCOTERMS 2020 delivery basis governing risk transfer and cost allocation between Oil Gas and the customer. Determines whether Oil Gas arranges freight (CIF/CFR) or the customer nominates the vessel (FOB). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FOB|CIF|CFR|DES|DAP|FCA|EXW — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: INCOTERMS 2020 — International Chamber of Commerce; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards

attributes.name: destination_country
attributes.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the final destination country for the cargo. Required for export licensing, OFAC/sanctions compliance screening, and country-of-destination reporting to regulatory bodies.
attributes.references: OFAC Sanctions Regulations; U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR); BSEE Export Reporting

attributes.name: discharge_port
attributes.description: The UN/LOCODE five-character code identifying the port or terminal where the cargo is to be discharged and delivered to the customer. Applicable for CIF, DES, and DAP delivery terms.

attributes.name: imo_number
attributes.description: The International Maritime Organization (IMO) unique seven-digit vessel identification number prefixed with 'IMO'. Permanent vessel identifier used for vetting, sanctions screening, and port state control compliance.
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.1078(28) — Ship Identification Number Scheme; SOLAS Chapter XI-1 Regulation 3

attributes.name: kyc_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer's KYC documentation has been verified and is current at the time of nomination submission. Supports AML compliance and counterparty due diligence requirements.
attributes.references: FATF AML/CFT Recommendations; SOX Section 302/404; Oil Gas KYC Policy

attributes.name: laycan_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the laycan window — the latest date by which the vessel must arrive and tender NOR. If the vessel arrives after this date, the charterer has the right to cancel the charter party.
attributes.references: INCOTERMS 2020; Charterparty Standard Terms; BIMCO Voyage Charter Clauses

attributes.name: laycan_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the laycan (laydays cancelling) window — the earliest date the vessel may arrive at the loading or discharge port and tender Notice of Readiness (NOR) under the charter party terms.
attributes.references: INCOTERMS 2020; Charterparty Standard Terms; BIMCO Voyage Charter Clauses

attributes.name: lifting_program_month
attributes.description: The calendar month (YYYY-MM format) of the monthly lifting program to which this nomination belongs. Used to reconcile nominations against the monthly crude lifting schedule and production allocation.
attributes.references: Avocet Production Operations; Oil Gas Monthly Lifting Program Procedures

attributes.name: loading_port
attributes.description: The UN/LOCODE five-character code identifying the port or terminal from which the cargo is to be loaded onto the vessel. Applicable for FOB and similar delivery terms where Oil Gas is the seller at the load port.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE Port Code Standard; BIMCO Port Definitions

attributes.name: nominated_volume
attributes.description: The quantity of product formally requested by the customer in the nomination. Expressed in the unit of measure specified by the volume_uom field (BBL, MT, or MMBTU depending on product type and contract terms).
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 12 — Calculation of Petroleum Quantities; SPE PRMS

attributes.name: nomination_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the customer formally submitted the nomination request. Represents the principal business event date for the nomination lifecycle.
attributes.references: Oil Gas Internal Nomination Procedures; Avocet Production Operations

attributes.name: nomination_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the nomination. Tracks progression from initial customer submission through commercial confirmation, amendment, cancellation, or expiry without fulfillment.
attributes.references: Oil Gas Internal Nomination Procedures; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: nomination_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nomination by commercial basis and delivery mode. Distinguishes between term contract liftings, spot sale cargoes, pipeline nominations, and product exchange arrangements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: term_contract|spot_sale|pipeline|cargo|exchange — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; FERC Natural Gas Pipeline Regulations

attributes.name: pipeline_nomination_cycle
attributes.description: For pipeline gas nominations, the NAESB/FERC nomination cycle in which this nomination was submitted (Timely, Evening, Intraday 1, 2, or 3). Null for marine cargo nominations.
attributes.references: NAESB WGQ Business Practice Standards; FERC Order 587 — Gas Pipeline Nomination Standards

attributes.name: price_currency
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the price differential and any fixed price components are denominated (typically USD for international crude and LNG trades).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: price_differential
attributes.description: The contractual premium or discount (in USD per BBL or USD per MMBTU) applied to the benchmark pricing basis for this specific nomination. Reflects quality, location, and timing adjustments negotiated in the contract.
attributes.references: COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: pricing_basis
attributes.description: The benchmark price index against which the nominated cargo will be priced per the contract terms (e.g., Dated Brent, WTI Cushing, Platts Dubai, NYMEX Natural Gas). Drives price calculation at bill of lading date or delivery. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: dated_brent|wti_cushing|platts_dubai|argus_sour|nymex_ng|ice_brent — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Platts Price Assessment Methodology; Argus Media Pricing Standards; FERC Market Transparency Rules

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference number assigned to the nomination, used in communications with the customer, terminal operators, and logistics teams. Follows the NOM- prefix convention.
attributes.references: Oil Gas Internal Nomination Procedures; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The specific delivery date requested by the customer within the laycan window, or the target pipeline delivery date for non-vessel nominations. Used for scheduling and logistics planning.
attributes.references: Oil Gas Internal Nomination Procedures; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: sanctions_screened
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer, vessel, and destination country have been screened against OFAC, UN, EU, and UK sanctions lists prior to nomination confirmation. Must be True before confirmation_timestamp is populated.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List Compliance; UN Security Council Sanctions; EU Sanctions Regulations; UK OFSI Sanctions

attributes.name: shipper_code
attributes.description: The FERC-assigned or pipeline operator-assigned code identifying the shipper of record for pipeline nominations. Required for FERC-regulated interstate pipeline capacity scheduling and balancing.
attributes.references: FERC Order 636 — Pipeline Restructuring; PHMSA Pipeline Safety Regulations

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this nomination record originated. Supports data lineage tracking in the Silver Layer lakehouse. SAP_SD for SAP Sales and Distribution, AVOCET for Avocet Production Operations, ETRM for Energy Trading and Risk Management system.
attributes.references: Oil Gas Data Governance Policy; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Standards

attributes.name: tolerance_max_pct
attributes.description: The maximum allowable percentage above the nominated volume that may be delivered without requiring a separate nomination amendment. Expressed as a positive percentage (e.g., 5.00 for 5% over).
attributes.references: INCOTERMS 2020; Standard Crude Oil Sale and Purchase Agreement Terms

attributes.name: tolerance_min_pct
attributes.description: The minimum allowable percentage below the nominated volume that the customer may accept at delivery without triggering a contract shortfall or take-or-pay obligation. Expressed as a negative percentage (e.g., -5.00 for 5% under).
attributes.references: INCOTERMS 2020; Standard Crude Oil Sale and Purchase Agreement Terms

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the nomination record was most recently modified. Updated on every status change, amendment, or data correction to support audit trail and change tracking requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404 — Internal Controls; Oil Gas Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: vessel_name
attributes.description: The name of the tanker or LNG carrier nominated by the customer or charterer to lift the cargo. Populated for marine cargo nominations; null for pipeline nominations.
attributes.references: IMO Ship Identification Standards; BIMCO Vessel Nomination Clauses

attributes.name: vessel_vetting_status
attributes.description: The outcome of the vessel vetting process conducted against OCIMF SIRE or CDI inspection records. Approved vessels are cleared for loading; rejected vessels must be substituted; conditional approvals require additional review.
attributes.references: OCIMF SIRE Programme; CDI Marine Inspection Standards; BSEE Offshore Safety Regulations

attributes.name: volume_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Volume in Barrels of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: Nominated volume converted to Barrels of Oil Equivalent (BOE) for cross-commodity comparison, portfolio reporting, and SEC reserves disclosure alignment. Conversion factors applied per API/SPE standards.
attributes.references: API MPMS; SPE PRMS Reserves Classification; SEC Regulation S-X Rule 4-10

attributes.name: volume_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure in which the nominated volume is expressed. BBL (barrels) for crude and liquid products, MT (metric tonnes) for LNG and bulk cargoes, MMBTU for natural gas, MCF/MMCF for pipeline gas volumes, M3 for metric volume reporting.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11 — Physical Properties; FERC Gas Measurement Standards

products.name: customer_lifting_schedule
products.description: Planned and actual lifting schedule for a customer account against a term offtake agreement or spot sale, capturing lifting number, scheduled lifting date, actual lifting date, product, volume entitlement (BBL or MT), actual lifted volume, terminal or loading port, vessel, bill of lading number, lifting status (scheduled, in-progress, completed, deferred), and variance from plan. Supports production allocation, inventory management, and revenue recognition for crude oil and LNG liftings.

attributes.name: customer_lifting_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each lifting schedule record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for the lifting_schedule data product. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — represents a discrete planned/actual cargo lifting event with a full lifecycle.
attributes.references: COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: customer_lifting_schedule tracks planned and actual liftings for a customer account against a term offtake agreement. Despite being explicitly described as a customer-facing schedule, it has no direct

attributes.name: block_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to exploration.block. Business justification: Lifting schedules are organized by producing block for production allocation, overlift/underlift tracking, and government reporting. Block-level lifting data is required for JOA cash calls and PSA cos

attributes.name: certificate_of_quality_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.certificate_of_quality. Business justification: Each actual cargo lifting requires a certificate of quality issued at loading for custody transfer. Essential for contractual compliance verification, customs clearance documentation, payment settleme

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Lifting operations (terminal handling, vessel coordination, demurrage) incur direct costs allocated to operational cost centers for crude marketing cost control and margin analysis.

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.joa. Business justification: Equity crude liftings are governed by JOA terms including lifting procedures, nomination deadlines, and entitlement calculations. Essential for JOA-compliant lifting program execution, partner entitle

attributes.name: lease_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.lease. Business justification: Lifting schedules execute lease-specific production entitlements for equity crude offtake. Core to revenue realization, entitlement balancing, and ensuring each partner lifts their entitled share per

attributes.name: lifting_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.partner. Business justification: Lifting schedules track actual cargo liftings by entitled venture partners. Business requires partner-level lifting records for overlift/underlift reconciliation, imbalance settlement, and JIB reporti

attributes.name: loading_delivery_point_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.delivery_point. Business justification: Loading port should be a FK to delivery_point (which represents terminals/ports). This replaces the loading_port_name and loading_country_code strings with a proper relational link. Note: labeled as l

attributes.name: nomination_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.nomination. Business justification: A lifting schedule is typically created FROM a customer nomination. This parent-child relationship links the planned schedule to the originating nomination request. The FK may be NULL initially if the

attributes.name: offtake_entitlement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.offtake_entitlement. Business justification: A customer lifting schedule is executed against a specific offtake entitlement — the entitlement defines the volume, product, and terms that the lifting schedule fulfills. The description explicitly s

attributes.name: primary_customer_crude_grade_id
attributes.description: Reference to the hydrocarbon product being lifted (e.g., crude oil grade, LNG, NGL, condensate). Links to the product master for grade specifications, quality parameters, and pricing basis.
attributes.references: API MPMS; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; Avocet Production Operations

attributes.name: production_forecast_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservoir.production_forecast. Business justification: Customer lifting schedules are operationally derived from reservoir production forecasts — schedulers allocate cargo liftings against forecast production volumes. This link supports the monthly liftin

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Crude liftings generate revenue recognized at field/asset level profit centers for upstream P&L reporting, production entitlement accounting, and field-level economics (netback analysis).

attributes.name: psa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.psa. Business justification: PSA contracts govern cost recovery oil and profit oil lifting entitlements and schedules. Required for PSA entitlement calculation, contractor share determination, government take allocation, and fisc

attributes.name: supply_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.contract. Business justification: Lifting schedules execute under supply or processing contracts that govern crude grades, delivery windows, and pricing mechanisms. Required for contract performance tracking, demurrage calculations, a

attributes.name: terminal_id
attributes.description: Reference to the terminal or loading port facility from which the cargo is lifted. Determines applicable measurement procedures, custody transfer protocols, and port authority requirements.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 17 — Marine Measurement; BSEE offshore terminal regulations; SAP S/4HANA Plant/Storage Location

attributes.name: vessel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the nominated vessel (tanker, LNG carrier, or FPSO shuttle tanker) assigned to perform the lifting. Links to vessel master for IMO number, capacity, and flag state details.
attributes.references: IMO vessel identification standards; PHMSA maritime regulations; SAP S/4HANA Transportation Management

attributes.name: actual_lifted_volume
attributes.description: Actual volume of hydrocarbon product lifted at the terminal as measured by the custody transfer metering system, expressed in the unit defined by volume_unit. Populated upon completion of loading and issuance of the bill of lading. Null until lifting is completed.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 17 — Marine Measurement; ISO 91; Avocet Production Operations — actual lifted volume

attributes.name: actual_lifting_date
attributes.description: Actual calendar date on which the cargo lifting commenced at the terminal or loading port. Compared against scheduled_lifting_date to compute lifting variance and assess operational performance. Null until lifting is in-progress or completed.
attributes.references: Avocet Production Operations — actual lifting date; API MPMS Chapter 17

attributes.name: api_gravity
attributes.description: API gravity of the crude oil or condensate cargo as measured at the loading terminal, expressed in degrees API. Determines crude quality classification (light, medium, heavy), pricing differential, and refinery yield optimization. Not applicable for LNG/gas liftings.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 9 — Density Determination; API gravity scale (API RP 11B); Platts crude quality assessments

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_date
attributes.description: Date on which the bill of lading was issued, representing the official date of title transfer and the revenue recognition date under IFRS 15 / US GAAP for FOB cargo sales. Null until lifting is completed and B/L is issued.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; SEC reserves disclosure; SAP S/4HANA SD Billing

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: Official bill of lading number issued by the vessel master or terminal operator upon completion of cargo loading. Serves as the primary legal document for title transfer, revenue recognition, and customs/export documentation. Critical for IFRS 15 revenue recognition trigger.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 — Revenue Recognition at point of title transfer; API MPMS Chapter 17; UCP 600 documentary credit rules

attributes.name: bs_w_percentage
attributes.description: Basic sediment and water content of the crude oil cargo expressed as a weight or volume percentage, as determined by the custody transfer measurement at the loading terminal. Deducted from gross standard volume to arrive at net standard volume for invoicing.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 10 — Sediment and Water Determination; ASTM D4007; API RP 45

attributes.name: cargo_reference_number
attributes.description: Unique cargo reference number assigned by the seller or trading desk for internal tracking of this specific cargo parcel. Used for cross-referencing with trading systems, back-office settlement, and cargo documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Order; Avocet Production Operations — cargo reference; COPAS cargo tracking

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lifting schedule record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA audit log

attributes.name: deferral_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for deferring a scheduled lifting (e.g., vessel unavailability, force majeure, terminal maintenance, buyer request, weather conditions). Populated only when lifting_status is 'deferred'. Used for operational analysis and contractual force majeure documentation.
attributes.references: Avocet Production Operations — deferral tracking; standard SPA force majeure provisions; BSEE incident reporting

attributes.name: demurrage_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether demurrage charges are applicable for this lifting due to vessel detention beyond the agreed laytime at the loading terminal. True when actual time on berth exceeds the allowed laytime per the charter party or sale agreement.
attributes.references: Standard crude oil SPA demurrage provisions; Incoterms 2020; PHMSA maritime cargo regulations

attributes.name: demurrage_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours of demurrage incurred by the vessel at the loading terminal beyond the agreed laytime, as calculated from the Notice of Readiness (NOR) and Statement of Facts. Used to calculate demurrage charges payable under the charter party.
attributes.references: Standard crude oil SPA laytime and demurrage clauses; Incoterms 2020; BIMCO laytime definitions

attributes.name: entitlement_volume
attributes.description: Contractual volume entitlement for this lifting as specified in the term offtake agreement or spot sale nomination, expressed in the unit defined by volume_unit (BBL or MT). Represents the buyer's right to lift under the agreement for this lifting window. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER QUANTITATIVE_RESULT category.
attributes.references: COPAS PASC; SAP S/4HANA SD Quantity Contract; Avocet Production Operations — entitlement volume

attributes.name: gross_observed_volume
attributes.description: Total volume of the cargo as measured at observed temperature and pressure conditions at the loading terminal, before correction to standard conditions. Expressed in the unit defined by volume_unit. Used in custody transfer calculations per API MPMS.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11 — Physical Properties; API MPMS Chapter 12 — Calculation of Petroleum Quantities; ISO 91

attributes.name: gross_standard_volume
attributes.description: Volume of the cargo corrected to standard conditions (60°F / 15°C at 1 atm) using volume correction factors per API MPMS Chapter 11. The primary billing and revenue recognition volume for crude oil custody transfers.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11 — Volume Correction Factors (VCF); API MPMS Chapter 12; ISO 91 petroleum measurement

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) code defining the point of title transfer, risk transfer, and cost allocation between seller and buyer for this cargo lifting. FOB (Free on Board) is most common for crude oil liftings; CIF/CFR for delivered cargoes.
attributes.references: Incoterms 2020 (ICC); IFRS 15 — performance obligation and title transfer; SAP S/4HANA SD Incoterms

attributes.name: laycan_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the laycan window — the latest date by which the nominated vessel must arrive at the loading port. If the vessel arrives after this date, the seller may have the right to cancel the cargo. Critical for demurrage and laytime calculations.
attributes.references: Incoterms 2020; standard crude oil SPA terms; PHMSA maritime cargo regulations

attributes.name: laycan_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the laycan (laydays cancelling) window — the earliest date the nominated vessel may arrive at the loading port to commence lifting operations. Defines the contractual arrival window for the vessel under the cargo sale terms.
attributes.references: Incoterms 2020 FOB/CIF terms; API MPMS Chapter 17; standard crude oil sale and purchase agreement (SPA) terms

attributes.name: lifting_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the lifting event, typically assigned by the terminal operator or production operator. Used for cross-referencing with counterparty documents, bill of lading, and cargo tracking systems. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category.
attributes.references: API RP 19C; Avocet Production Operations — cargo lifting reference; SAP S/4HANA SD Delivery Document

attributes.name: lifting_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number of this lifting within the contract year or agreement period (e.g., 1st lifting, 2nd lifting). Used for tracking cumulative entitlement consumption, scheduling periodic liftings under annual offtake agreements, and partner allocation reporting.
attributes.references: Avocet Production Operations — lifting sequence; COPAS annual lifting schedule

attributes.name: lifting_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the lifting event in its operational lifecycle. Drives production allocation, revenue recognition triggers, and inventory management. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER LIFECYCLE_STATUS category.
attributes.references: Avocet Production Operations — lifting status workflow; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: lifting_tolerance_pct
attributes.description: Contractual tolerance percentage (e.g., ±5%) applied to the entitlement volume within which the actual lifted volume is considered compliant with the offtake agreement. Volumes outside this tolerance may trigger over/under-lift balancing obligations.
attributes.references: COPAS over/under-lift accounting; JOA lifting tolerance provisions; SAP Joint Venture Accounting

attributes.name: net_standard_volume
attributes.description: Gross standard volume minus the volume of sediment, water, and free water (BS&W deductions) at standard conditions. Represents the net merchantable hydrocarbon volume for invoicing, revenue recognition, and production allocation reporting.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 10 — Sediment and Water; API MPMS Chapter 12; COPAS production allocation standards

attributes.name: nomination_deadline
attributes.description: Contractual deadline by which the buyer must nominate the lifting vessel to the seller or terminal operator. Failure to nominate by this date may result in forfeiture of the lifting entitlement or deferral under the offtake agreement terms.
attributes.references: Standard crude oil SPA nomination provisions; Avocet Production Operations — nomination management

attributes.name: over_under_lift_status
attributes.description: Classification of the lifting outcome relative to entitlement: over_lift (actual > entitlement + tolerance), under_lift (actual < entitlement - tolerance), balanced (within tolerance), or pending (lifting not yet completed). Drives JOA partner balancing and make-up lifting obligations.
attributes.references: COPAS over/under-lift accounting standards; SAP Joint Venture Accounting — partner balancing; JOA lifting provisions

attributes.name: price_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the cargo price and invoice are denominated (e.g., USD for US Dollar, EUR for Euro). Most international crude oil and LNG trades are denominated in USD.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates; SAP S/4HANA FI currency configuration

attributes.name: price_differential
attributes.description: Contractual premium or discount applied to the reference pricing basis for this cargo, expressed in USD per BBL or USD per MT. Reflects crude quality differentials, location adjustments, and commercial negotiation outcomes. Confidential commercial term.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 variable consideration; SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Conditions; Platts differential assessments

attributes.name: pricing_basis
attributes.description: Reference price benchmark against which the cargo price is calculated (e.g., Dated Brent, WTI, Dubai/Oman, Platts Oman, JKM for LNG). Determines the pricing formula applied for revenue recognition and invoice generation. attributes.name: offtake_entitlement_id

attributes.description: Classification of the governing commercial agreement type under which this entitlement is established. attributes.name: balancing_method
attributes.description: Method used to resolve overlift/underlift imbalances between JOA partners at period end. Cash settlement involves monetary payment; in-kind involves physical volume make-up; carry-forward defers the imbalance to the next period; deemed-sold treats the imbalance as a notional sale.
attributes.references: COPAS Model Form Accounting Procedure; SAP Joint Venture Accounting; IFRS 15

attributes.name: collateral_type
attributes.description: Type of financial security instrument required from the customer to support credit exposure under this entitlement. Determined by credit rating and exposure level. Letter of credit and bank guarantees are standard instruments in international crude oil and LNG trading.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; UCP 600 (ICC); IFRS 9; Basel III

attributes.name: cost_recovery_volume
attributes.description: Volume of cost oil or cost gas allocated to the contractor party for recovery of capital and operating expenditures under a Production Sharing Agreement (PSA). Expressed in the entitlement unit of measure. Applicable only to PSA-governed entitlements.
attributes.references: PSA Industry Standard; SPE-PRMS; IFRS 6; COPAS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this offtake entitlement record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the audit trail creation anchor for SOX compliance and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: Maximum credit exposure approved for this customer under this offtake entitlement, expressed in the transaction currency. Enforced during cargo nomination and lifting authorization workflows to manage counterparty credit risk.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; COPAS; IFRS 9 Credit Risk; Basel III

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: External or internal credit rating assigned to the customer counterparty (e.g., S&P: AAA, AA+, BBB-; Moody's: Aaa, Baa1; or internal rating code). Used in credit risk assessment and determination of collateral or letter of credit requirements for lifting authorization.
attributes.references: S&P Global Ratings; Moody's; Fitch; IFRS 9; Basel III; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: cumulative_lifted_volume
attributes.description: Total volume actually lifted by the customer against this entitlement from the period start date through the most recent reconciliation date. Expressed in the entitlement unit of measure. Used to compute remaining entitlement and overlift/underlift position.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which monetary values (entitlement value, overlift/underlift value, settlement amounts) are denominated. Typically USD for international crude and LNG transactions.

attributes.name: delivery_mode
attributes.description: Mode of transportation used to deliver lifted volumes from the production source to the delivery point. Determines applicable logistics, demurrage, and PHMSA/FERC regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: entitled_volume
attributes.description: Total contractual volume the customer is entitled to lift during the entitlement period, expressed in the designated unit of measure (BBL, MT, or MMBTU). Represents the gross entitlement before any adjustments for overlift/underlift carry-forward.
attributes.references: SPE-PRMS; PSA/JOA Industry Standard; COPAS Model Form

attributes.name: entitlement_number

attributes.references: SAP Joint Venture Accounting; COPAS Model Form Accounting Procedure

attributes.name: entitlement_period_end
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the entitlement period. Nullable for open-ended or evergreen offtake arrangements. Defines the closing boundary of the lifting window. Used in overlift/underlift position calculations and period-end reconciliation.

attributes.name: entitlement_period_start
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the entitlement period during which the customer is contractually authorized to lift volumes. Defines the opening boundary of the lifting window under the term offtake agreement or PSA schedule.

attributes.name: entitlement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the offtake entitlement. Drives operational eligibility for scheduling lifts and triggers credit/compliance checks. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|suspended|terminated|pending|expired|cancelled — promote to reference product if additional states are required]

attributes.name: equity_share_pct
attributes.description: The customer's equity entitlement percentage, which may differ from Working Interest (WI) due to PSA cost recovery provisions, carried interest arrangements, or government back-in rights. Used in PSA lifting schedule calculations to determine the contractor's equity oil/gas share.
attributes.references: PSA Industry Standard; SPE-PRMS; IFRS 6; SEC Regulation S-X Rule 4-10

attributes.name: imbalance_tolerance_volume
attributes.description: Maximum allowable overlift or underlift volume before formal balancing or cash settlement is triggered. Expressed in the entitlement unit of measure. Contractually defined in the JOA or offtake agreement to accommodate operational variability in cargo sizes.
attributes.references: COPAS Model Form Accounting Procedure; JOA Industry Standard

attributes.name: incoterms_code

Governs title transfer, insurance obligations, and freight cost allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FOB|CIF|CFR|DES|DAP|FCA|EXW|DDP|CPT|CIP — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Incoterms 2020 (ICC); COPAS; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: jib_code
attributes.description: Joint Interest Billing (JIB) code used to allocate costs and revenues to the correct partner account in the joint venture accounting system. Enables accurate partner billing and cost recovery tracking in SAP Joint Venture Accounting per COPAS standards.
attributes.references: SAP Joint Venture Accounting; COPAS Model Form Accounting Procedure

attributes.name: kyc_verified

attributes.name: last_reconciliation_date

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this offtake entitlement record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: lifting_schedule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the lifting schedule cadence governing when the customer may nominate and execute lifts against this entitlement. Drives operational planning in Avocet Production Operations and cargo scheduling systems.

attributes.name: net_revenue_interest_pct
attributes.description: The Net Revenue Interest (NRI) percentage representing the customer's share of production revenue after deducting royalties, overriding royalty interests (ORRI), and other burdens. Distinct from WI as it reflects the net economic interest after all encumbrances.
attributes.references: COPAS; Quorum Land System; SEC Regulation S-X Rule 4-10; SPE-PRMS

attributes.name: nomination_deadline_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days prior to the scheduled lifting date by which the customer must submit a formal volume nomination. Contractually defined in the offtake agreement and used to trigger operational readiness workflows.
attributes.references: JOA/PSA Industry Standard; Avocet Production Operations

attributes.name: overlift_underlift_value
attributes.description: Monetary value of the overlift or underlift position, calculated by applying the applicable pricing formula to the overlift/underlift volume. Used for cash settlement or in-kind balancing between JOA partners. Expressed in the transaction currency.
attributes.references: COPAS Model Form Accounting Procedure; SAP Joint Venture Accounting; IFRS 15

attributes.name: overlift_underlift_volume
attributes.description: Net overlift (positive) or underlift (negative) position of the customer relative to their entitlement as of the last reconciliation date. Expressed in the entitlement unit of measure. A positive value indicates the customer has lifted more than their entitlement (overlift); negative indicates underlift. Critical for JOA partner balancing and cash settlement calculations.
attributes.references: COPAS Model Form Accounting Procedure; SAP Joint Venture Accounting; SPE-PRMS

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Contractual payment terms governing settlement of invoices for lifted volumes (e.g., Net 30 days from Bill of Lading date, prepayment, letter of credit at sight). Defined in the offtake agreement and enforced in SAP S/4HANA SD billing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; COPAS; IFRS 15; Incoterms 2020

attributes.name: price_differential
attributes.description: Quality or location differential applied to the benchmark price to arrive at the actual transaction price for lifted volumes. Expressed in the transaction currency per unit of measure (e.g., USD/BBL). May be positive (premium) or negative (discount) relative to the benchmark.
attributes.references: API MPMS; COPAS; Platts; Argus Media

attributes.name: pricing_basis
attributes.description: The benchmark or pricing formula basis used to value lifted volumes under this entitlement (e.g., WTI, Brent, Dubai Fateh, Henry Hub for gas, JKM for LNG). Determines the reference price index applied in overlift/underlift cash settlement calculations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WTI|Brent|Dubai|ANSI|Henry_Hub|JKM|NBP|formula|Platts_dated — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC; Platts; Argus Media; COPAS; IFRS 9

attributes.name: profit_oil_volume
attributes.description: Volume of profit oil or profit gas allocated to the contractor party after cost recovery under a Production Sharing Agreement (PSA). Represents the contractor's share of production above the cost recovery tranche, split per the PSA profit-sharing formula.

attributes.name: remaining_entitlement_volume
attributes.description: Residual volume the customer is still entitled to lift within the current entitlement period, calculated as entitled volume minus cumulative lifted volume. Stored as a business-tracked field updated at each reconciliation cycle rather than computed on-the-fly, supporting operational scheduling decisions.

attributes.name: royalty_rate_pct
attributes.description: The applicable royalty rate percentage deducted from gross production entitlement before computing the customer's net lifting volume. Includes government royalties, lessor royalties, and overriding royalty interests (ORRI) as applicable under the governing lease or PSA.
attributes.references: BOEM; BSEE; Quorum Land System; COPAS; ONRR Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: sanctions_screened
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer and associated entities have been screened against applicable sanctions lists (OFAC SDN, EU Consolidated List, UN Sanctions) as part of the counterparty compliance process. Required for regulatory compliance in international crude and LNG trading.
attributes.references: OFAC; EU Sanctions Regulation; UN Security Council Resolutions; SOX

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit in which entitlement volumes are expressed and tracked. BBL (barrels) for crude oil and condensate, MT (metric tonnes) for LNG/LPG, MMBTU for gas, MCF/MMCF for gas volumes. Governs all volume calculations within this entitlement record.

attributes.name: working_interest_pct
attributes.description: The customer's Working Interest (WI) percentage in the joint venture or production sharing agreement, expressed as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.250000 = 25%). Drives the proportional entitlement calculation from gross field production.
attributes.references: SPE-PRMS; JOA Industry Standard; COPAS; SEC Regulation S-X Rule 4-10

products.name: customer_term_contract
products.description: This association product represents the commercial contract between account and petroleum_product. It captures product-specific supply agreements that define contracted volumes, pricing mechanisms, delivery obligations, and quality specifications. Each record links one account to one petroleum_product with contractual terms that exist only in the context of this commercial relationship. Supports multi-product supply agreements where a single counterparty holds multiple product-specific contracts.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas commercial operations, accounts (counterparties) routinely hold multiple simultaneous term contracts for different petroleum products (crude grades, refined products, LNG, petrochemicals), and each petroleum product is sold to multiple accounts under separate contractual terms. The detection reasoning explicitly identifies term_contract as the junction entity with product-specific attributes: contracted volumes, pricing formulas, differentials, delivery terms, and quality tolerances. This is a classic operational M:N relationship where the contract itself is a managed business entity.

attributes.name: sulfur_content_percent

products.name: quality_spec

Captures parameter name, minimum/maximum/target values, test method (ASTM, EN, IP standard number), and applicable market or contract context. Typical parameters include API gravity range, sulfur content (wt%), RON/MON for gasolines, cetane number for diesel, flash point, viscosity, cloud/pour/freeze point, smoke point for jet fuel, and H2S limits. Each spec record links to petroleum_product and serves as the reference for pass/fail determination in quality_test_result.

attributes.name: analysis_date
attributes.description: Date when the laboratory assay analysis was performed. Critical for tracking assay currency and determining which assay to use for refinery planning.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11 - Physical Properties Data

attributes.name: api_gravity
attributes.description: API gravity of the crude oil or condensate measured at 60°F. Key quality indicator inversely related to density. Light crudes have higher API gravity (>31.1°), heavy crudes lower (<22.3°).
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11.1 - Volume Correction Factors

attributes.name: aromatics_content_vol_pct
attributes.description: Total aromatic hydrocarbon content as volume percent. Aromatics affect octane number in gasoline, cetane number in diesel, and smoke point in jet fuel.
attributes.references: ASTM D1319 - Hydrocarbon Types in Liquid Petroleum Products by Fluorescent Indicator Adsorption

attributes.name: asphaltene_content_wt_pct
attributes.description: Asphaltene content as weight percent. High asphaltene content affects crude stability, blending compatibility, and processing difficulty in heavy oil upgrading.
attributes.references: ASTM D6560 - Determination of Asphaltenes in Crude Petroleum

attributes.name: assay_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the assay record. Validated and approved assays are used for refinery linear programming (LP) models and crude evaluation.

attributes.name: carbon_residue_wt_pct
attributes.description: Conradson Carbon Residue as weight percent. Indicates coke-forming tendency of the crude, particularly important for vacuum residue processing and coking unit feed evaluation.
attributes.references: ASTM D189 - Conradson Carbon Residue of Petroleum Products

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this assay record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: diesel_yield_vol_pct
attributes.description: Volume percent yield of diesel fraction (520-650°F) from distillation. Diesel fraction is processed into automotive diesel, heating oil, and marine fuel.
attributes.references: ASTM D86 - Distillation of Petroleum Products at Atmospheric Pressure

attributes.name: distillation_method
attributes.description: Laboratory distillation method used to generate the yield curve. ASTM D86 is atmospheric batch distillation; TBP (True Boiling Point) uses ASTM D2892 (atmospheric) and D5236 (vacuum) for detailed fractionation.
attributes.references: ASTM D86, ASTM D2892, ASTM D5236

attributes.name: flash_point_f
attributes.description: Lowest temperature at which vapors above the crude will ignite when exposed to an ignition source. Critical safety parameter for storage and transportation classification.
attributes.references: ASTM D93 - Flash Point by Pensky-Martens Closed Cup Tester

attributes.name: gross_heating_value_btu_per_lb
attributes.description: Gross heating value (higher heating value) in British Thermal Units per pound. Used for energy content calculations and fuel value assessment.
attributes.references: ASTM D240 - Heat of Combustion of Liquid Hydrocarbon Fuels by Bomb Calorimeter

attributes.name: h2s_content_ppm
attributes.description: Hydrogen sulfide content in parts per million. H2S is highly toxic and corrosive. Crudes with >100 ppm H2S require special handling and safety protocols.
attributes.references: ASTM D5705 - Measurement of Hydrogen Sulfide in the Vapor Phase Above Residual Fuel Oils

attributes.name: hydrogen_content_wt_pct
attributes.description: Hydrogen content as weight percent. Higher hydrogen content indicates more paraffinic character and better refining yields. Used in hydrogen balance calculations.
attributes.references: ASTM D5291 - Instrumental Determination of Carbon, Hydrogen, and Nitrogen

attributes.name: iron_content_ppm
attributes.description: Iron metal content in parts per million. Elevated iron indicates contamination from pipelines, storage tanks, or production equipment.
attributes.references: ASTM D5863 - Determination of Nickel, Vanadium, Iron, and Sodium in Crude Oils

attributes.name: kerosene_yield_vol_pct
attributes.description: Volume percent yield of kerosene fraction (380-520°F) from distillation. Kerosene is used for jet fuel and heating oil production.
attributes.references: ASTM D86 - Distillation of Petroleum Products at Atmospheric Pressure

attributes.name: mercaptan_sulfur_ppm
attributes.description: Mercaptan sulfur content in parts per million. Mercaptans are odorous sulfur compounds that must be removed or converted in refining to meet product specifications.
attributes.references: ASTM D3227 - Mercaptan Sulfur in Gasoline, Kerosene, Aviation Turbine, and Distillate Fuels

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this assay record was last modified. Tracks updates to assay data as new analyses are performed or corrections are made.

attributes.name: naphtha_yield_vol_pct
attributes.description: Volume percent yield of naphtha fraction (IBP-380°F) from ASTM D86 or True Boiling Point (TBP) distillation. Naphtha is feedstock for gasoline blending and petrochemical reforming.
attributes.references: ASTM D86 - Distillation of Petroleum Products at Atmospheric Pressure

attributes.name: nickel_content_ppm
attributes.description: Nickel metal content in parts per million. Nickel and vanadium are catalyst poisons in FCC and hydrocracking units, concentrated in heavy residue fractions.
attributes.references: ASTM D5863 - Determination of Nickel, Vanadium, Iron, and Sodium in Crude Oils

attributes.name: nitrogen_content_ppm
attributes.description: Total nitrogen content in parts per million. Nitrogen compounds poison catalysts in fluid catalytic cracking (FCC) and hydrotreating units.
attributes.references: ASTM D4629 - Trace Nitrogen in Liquid Petroleum Hydrocarbons

attributes.name: olefins_content_vol_pct
attributes.description: Olefin (unsaturated hydrocarbon) content as volume percent. Olefins are typically low in crude oil but increase in thermally cracked products. Affect stability and gum formation.
attributes.references: ASTM D1319 - Hydrocarbon Types in Liquid Petroleum Products by Fluorescent Indicator Adsorption

attributes.name: pour_point_f
attributes.description: Lowest temperature at which the crude oil will pour or flow under prescribed conditions. Critical for pipeline transportation and storage in cold climates.
attributes.references: ASTM D97 - Pour Point of Petroleum Products

attributes.name: reid_vapor_pressure_psi
attributes.description: Reid Vapor Pressure measured in pounds per square inch at 100°F. Indicates volatility and light-end content. Important for safety and environmental compliance.
attributes.references: ASTM D323 - Vapor Pressure of Petroleum Products (Reid Method)

attributes.name: residue_yield_vol_pct
attributes.description: Volume percent yield of vacuum residue (1050°F+). Residue is processed in coking, visbreaking, or deasphalting units, or used as fuel oil or asphalt feedstock.
attributes.references: ASTM D1160 - Distillation of Petroleum Products at Reduced Pressure

attributes.name: salt_content_ptb
attributes.description: Salt content expressed as pounds per thousand barrels (PTB). High salt content causes corrosion in crude distillation unit (CDU) overhead systems and requires desalting.
attributes.references: ASTM D3230 - Salts in Crude Oil (Electrometric Method)

attributes.name: saturates_content_vol_pct
attributes.description: Saturated hydrocarbon (paraffins and naphthenes) content as volume percent. Saturates are desirable for diesel cetane number and lube oil base stocks.
attributes.references: ASTM D1319 - Hydrocarbon Types in Liquid Petroleum Products by Fluorescent Indicator Adsorption

attributes.name: specific_gravity
attributes.description: Specific gravity of the crude relative to water at standard conditions (60°F/60°F). Used in volume-to-mass conversions and refinery yield calculations.
attributes.references: ASTM D4052 - Density and Relative Density of Liquids

attributes.name: sulfur_content_wt_pct
attributes.description: Total sulfur content of the whole crude expressed as weight percent. Critical for classifying crude as sweet (<0.5%) or sour (>0.5%) and determining hydrodesulfurization (HDS) requirements.
attributes.references: ASTM D4294 - Sulfur in Petroleum Products by Energy Dispersive X-ray Fluorescence

attributes.name: tan_mg_koh_per_g
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Acid Number (TAN) in mg KOH/g
attributes.description: Total Acid Number representing naphthenic acid content, measured in milligrams of potassium hydroxide per gram of sample. High TAN crudes (>0.5) cause corrosion in refinery equipment.
attributes.references: ASTM D664 - Acid Number of Petroleum Products by Potentiometric Titration

attributes.name: uopk_characterization_factor
attributes.business_glossary_term: Universal Oil Products (UOP) K Characterization Factor
attributes.description: UOP K characterization factor calculated from boiling point and specific gravity. Indicates paraffinic (K>12), naphthenic (K=11-12), or aromatic (K<11) character of the crude.

attributes.name: vanadium_content_ppm
attributes.description: Vanadium metal content in parts per million. High vanadium content (>50 ppm) requires special catalyst formulations and impacts refinery economics.
attributes.references: ASTM D5863 - Determination of Nickel, Vanadium, Iron, and Sodium in Crude Oils

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier for this assay record. Multiple assays may exist for the same crude grade over time as new laboratory analyses are performed or field conditions change.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11 - Physical Properties Data

attributes.name: vgo_yield_vol_pct
attributes.description: Volume percent yield of vacuum gas oil fraction (650-1050°F). VGO is feedstock for fluid catalytic cracking (FCC) and hydrocracking units to produce gasoline and diesel.
attributes.references: ASTM D1160 - Distillation of Petroleum Products at Reduced Pressure

attributes.name: viscosity_at_100f_cst
attributes.description: Kinematic viscosity measured at 100°F in centistokes. Affects pumping requirements, pipeline pressure drop calculations, and refinery processing.
attributes.references: ASTM D445 - Kinematic Viscosity of Transparent and Opaque Liquids

attributes.name: viscosity_at_210f_cst
attributes.description: Kinematic viscosity measured at 210°F in centistokes. Used with 100°F viscosity to calculate viscosity index and temperature-viscosity relationships.
attributes.references: ASTM D445 - Kinematic Viscosity of Transparent and Opaque Liquids

attributes.name: water_content_vol_pct
attributes.description: Water and sediment content as volume percent. Affects custody transfer measurements and must be removed before refining to prevent equipment damage.
attributes.references: ASTM D4007 - Water and Sediment in Crude Oil by Centrifuge Method

attributes.name: wax_content_wt_pct
attributes.description: Paraffin wax content as weight percent. High wax content affects pour point, pipeline flow, and requires dewaxing in lube oil production.
attributes.references: ASTM D721 - Oil Content of Petroleum Waxes

products.name: refined_product
products.description: Master entity for finished refined petroleum products including motor gasoline (MOGAS), aviation gasoline (AVGAS), jet fuel (Jet A, Jet A-1), diesel (ULSD, HSFO), marine fuel oil (VLSFO, HSFO), LPG, naphtha, kerosene, bitumen, and lubricant base oils. Captures product grade, specification standard, blending component flag, export/domestic classification, and applicable excise/duty category.

attributes.name: refined_product_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the refined petroleum product. Primary key for the refined product master entity.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Refined products are manufactured and sold by legal entities for excise duty compliance, customs reporting (harmonized tariff codes), environmental regulations, and financial statement preparation. Es

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Refined products incur production costs (refining, blending, quality control, packaging) allocated to cost centers for product costing, margin analysis, and operational performance tracking in downstr

attributes.name: finance_afe_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_afe. Business justification: Refined products result from capital projects (new refining units, upgrading facilities, blending systems) authorized via AFEs. Links product output to capital investment for asset capitalization and

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.joa. Business justification: Refineries may be operated under JOAs in joint venture arrangements. Tracking which JOA operates the refinery producing specific refined products is required for cost allocation, partner billing (JIB)

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Refined products (gasoline, diesel, jet fuel) are managed by downstream profit centers for margin analysis, crack spread tracking, and refinery performance measurement.

attributes.name: quality_spec_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.quality_spec. Business justification: refined_product has a denormalized STRING column `specification_standard` (e.g., EN 590, ASTM D975, DEF STAN 91-091) that references the applicable quality specification. quality_spec is the authorita

attributes.name: api_gravity
attributes.description: API gravity measurement of the refined product, indicating density relative to water. Higher values indicate lighter products. Measured in degrees API.

attributes.name: aromatics_content_percent
attributes.description: Total aromatics content as percentage by volume. Affects combustion characteristics and emissions. Regulated in many jurisdictions for environmental compliance.

attributes.name: ash_content_percent
attributes.description: Ash content as percentage by mass, representing inorganic residue after combustion. Important for fuel oils and indicates potential for deposit formation.

attributes.name: benzene_content_percent
attributes.description: Benzene content as percentage by volume. Regulated for environmental and health reasons, particularly in gasoline products. EPA Tier 3 limits benzene to 0.62% annual average.

attributes.name: blending_component_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this product is a blending component (True) used to create finished products, or a finished product itself (False). Blending components include reformate, alkylate, MTBE, ethanol.

attributes.name: carbon_residue_percent
attributes.description: Carbon residue (Conradson or Ramsbottom method) as percentage by mass, indicating tendency to form carbonaceous deposits. Relevant for heavier fuel products.

attributes.name: cetane_number
attributes.description: Cetane number for diesel products, measuring ignition quality and combustion performance. Higher values indicate better ignition characteristics. Typical range 40-60.

attributes.name: cold_filter_plugging_point_celsius
attributes.description: Cold Filter Plugging Point (CFPP) in degrees Celsius, the lowest temperature at which diesel fuel will pass through a standardized filter. Critical for cold weather operability.

attributes.name: color_astm
attributes.business_glossary_term: American Society for Testing and Materials (ASTM) Color
attributes.description: ASTM color designation of the product (e.g., ASTM D1500 scale 0.5-8.0 for petroleum products, or Saybolt color for lighter products). Indicates product purity and quality.

attributes.name: copper_strip_corrosion
attributes.description: Copper strip corrosion test result (e.g., 1a, 1b, 2a), indicating corrosiveness of the product to copper and copper alloys. Important for fuel system compatibility.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this product record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: density_kg_per_m3
attributes.description: Density of the refined product measured in kilograms per cubic meter (kg/m³) at standard temperature (15°C). Used for volume-to-mass conversions and custody transfer.

attributes.name: distillation_range_celsius
attributes.description: Distillation temperature range in degrees Celsius (e.g., 150-250°C), indicating the boiling point distribution of hydrocarbon components. Defines volatility characteristics.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this product specification became effective and available for commercial transactions. Used for managing specification changes and product transitions.

attributes.name: excise_duty_category
attributes.description: Excise duty or tax category code applicable to this product under relevant tax jurisdictions. Determines applicable excise rates and reporting requirements.
attributes.references: IRS Regulations, Local Tax Authority Guidelines

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this product specification expires or is superseded. Null for products with indefinite availability. Used for managing product lifecycle and specification transitions.

attributes.name: export_domestic_classification
attributes.description: Classification indicating whether the product is sold domestically, exported internationally, or both. Affects pricing, taxation, and regulatory compliance requirements.

attributes.name: flash_point_celsius
attributes.description: Flash point temperature in degrees Celsius, the lowest temperature at which vapors ignite when exposed to an ignition source. Critical safety and transportation classification parameter.

attributes.name: freeze_point_celsius
attributes.description: Freeze point temperature in degrees Celsius, particularly relevant for jet fuel. The temperature at which hydrocarbon crystals form, affecting fuel flow and filter plugging.

attributes.name: harmonized_tariff_code
attributes.description: Harmonized System tariff classification code (6-10 digits) for international trade and customs purposes. Used for import/export documentation and duty calculation.

attributes.name: hazard_class
attributes.description: Hazard classification for transportation and storage (e.g., Class 3 Flammable Liquids). Determines handling, storage, and transportation requirements.
attributes.references: PHMSA Hazardous Materials Regulations, IMDG Code

attributes.name: heating_value_mj_per_kg
attributes.description: Net (lower) heating value of the product in megajoules per kilogram (MJ/kg), representing energy content. Used for energy balance calculations and pricing.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this product record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: lubricity_microns
attributes.description: Lubricity measurement in microns (wear scar diameter at 60°C), indicating lubricating properties of diesel fuel. Critical for fuel injection system protection, especially in ULSD.

attributes.name: olefins_content_percent
attributes.description: Olefins content as percentage by volume. Influences gasoline stability and emissions. Subject to regulatory limits in some markets.

attributes.name: oxygenate_content_percent
attributes.description: Oxygenate content (ethanol, MTBE, ETBE) as percentage by volume. Mandated in many jurisdictions for emissions reduction. Affects fuel properties and compatibility.
attributes.references: EPA Renewable Fuel Standard, ASTM D4815

attributes.name: packing_group
attributes.description: UN packing group classification (I=high danger, II=medium danger, III=low danger) indicating degree of hazard for transportation purposes.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: pour_point_celsius
attributes.description: Pour point temperature in degrees Celsius, the lowest temperature at which the product will flow. Critical for cold weather operability and storage.

attributes.name: product_grade
attributes.description: Specific grade or quality designation of the refined product (e.g., Premium, Regular, Ultra Low Sulfur, High Sulfur, Grade A-1, ISO 8217 RMG380). Defines quality tier within product type.

attributes.name: product_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the refined product in the catalog. ACTIVE=currently produced and sold, INACTIVE=temporarily not available, DISCONTINUED=permanently removed from catalog, PENDING_APPROVAL=awaiting regulatory or commercial approval, RESTRICTED=limited availability or special authorization required.

attributes.name: ron_rating
attributes.description: Research Octane Number rating for gasoline products, measuring resistance to engine knocking. Applicable to MOGAS and AVGAS products. Typical range 87-100.

attributes.name: sediment_content_percent
attributes.description: Sediment and particulate content as percentage by mass. Indicates product cleanliness and potential for filter plugging and equipment wear.

attributes.name: smoke_point_mm
attributes.description: Smoke point measurement in millimeters for jet fuel and kerosene, indicating burning quality and tendency to produce smoke. Higher values indicate cleaner combustion.

attributes.name: sulfur_content_ppm
attributes.description: Sulfur content of the refined product measured in parts per million (ppm). Critical for environmental compliance and product classification (e.g., ULSD typically <15 ppm).
attributes.references: EPA Tier 3 Standards, EN 590, ASTM D2622

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: UN number for hazardous materials classification and transportation (e.g., UN1203 for gasoline, UN1202 for diesel). Required for shipping documentation and safety compliance.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: vapor_pressure_kpa
attributes.description: Reid Vapor Pressure (RVP) measured in kilopascals (kPa), indicating volatility and evaporation tendency. Critical for gasoline products and environmental compliance.

attributes.name: viscosity_cst
attributes.description: Kinematic viscosity of the product measured in centistokes (cSt) at a specified temperature. Indicates flow characteristics, particularly important for fuel oils and lubricants.

attributes.name: water_content_ppm
attributes.description: Water content measured in parts per million (ppm). Excessive water can cause corrosion, microbial growth, and operational issues. Critical quality parameter for all refined products.

products.name: ngl_stream
products.description: Master catalog for Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) streams and fractions including ethane, propane, normal butane, isobutane, natural gasoline (C5+), and mixed NGL. Captures stream composition (mol%), heating value, vapor pressure (RVP), shrinkage factor, fractionation train origin, and applicable NGL pricing index (Mont Belvieu, Conway). Used by gas processing, petrochemical feedstock planning, and revenue allocation.

attributes.name: ngl_stream_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the NGL stream record. Primary key for the NGL stream master catalog.

attributes.name: asset_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the gas processing facility or plant where the NGL stream originates.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: NGL streams are managed by legal entities for regulatory compliance (customs tariff codes, UN numbers), tax reporting, trade settlement, and financial consolidation in midstream operations.

attributes.name: contract_id

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fractionation train or gas processing facility where this NGL stream is produced.

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.joa. Business justification: NGL streams from joint venture gas processing plants are governed by JOAs. Business process: NGL fractionation cost allocation, product split calculations among partners, partner entitlement by NGL co

attributes.name: lease_id

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
