attributes.name: pricing_benchmark_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.pricing_benchmark. Business justification: ngl_stream has a denormalized STRING column `pricing_index` that references the pricing benchmark used for NGL pricing (e.g., Mont Belvieu propane index, Conway ethane index). Replacing it with pricin

attributes.name: primary_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: NGL streams may be sourced from specific vendors (gas processors, fractionators) for supply agreements. Enables sourcing strategy, supply reliability tracking, and vendor relationship management for N

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: NGL streams (ethane, propane, butane) are revenue-generating products managed by midstream profit centers for product margin tracking and fractionation economics.

attributes.name: autoignition_temperature_fahrenheit
attributes.description: Autoignition temperature of the NGL stream in degrees Fahrenheit, used for fire safety and process design.
attributes.references: ASTM E659 - Standard Test Method for Autoignition Temperature of Chemicals

attributes.name: component_type
attributes.description: Primary NGL component classification identifying the dominant hydrocarbon fraction in the stream. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ethane|propane|normal_butane|isobutane|natural_gasoline|mixed_ngl|pentanes_plus — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this NGL stream record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customs_tariff_code
attributes.description: Harmonized System tariff code for the NGL stream used in international trade and customs declarations.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this NGL stream specification became effective in the product catalog and operational systems.

attributes.name: ethane_mol_percent
attributes.description: Mole percentage of ethane (C2H6) in the NGL stream composition, critical for petrochemical feedstock specifications.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this NGL stream specification expires or is scheduled for decommissioning. Null for active indefinite streams.

attributes.name: flash_point_fahrenheit
attributes.description: Flash point temperature of the NGL stream in degrees Fahrenheit, critical for safety and handling procedures.
attributes.references: ASTM D56 - Standard Test Method for Flash Point by Tag Closed Cup Tester

attributes.name: fuel_blending_approved_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this NGL stream is approved for blending into motor fuels or heating fuels.

attributes.name: h2s_content_ppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hydrogen Sulfide (H2S) Content in Parts Per Million (PPM)
attributes.description: Hydrogen sulfide content in the NGL stream measured in parts per million, critical for safety and product quality specifications.

attributes.name: hazard_classification
attributes.description: Hazard classification code for the NGL stream per DOT/PHMSA regulations for transportation and handling safety.
attributes.references: Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration (PHMSA) 49 CFR Part 172

attributes.name: heating_value_btu_per_gallon
attributes.business_glossary_term: Heating Value in British Thermal Units (BTU) per Gallon
attributes.description: Gross heating value of the NGL stream measured in BTU per gallon, used for energy content specification and pricing adjustments.

attributes.name: isobutane_mol_percent
attributes.description: Mole percentage of isobutane (i-C4H10) in the NGL stream composition, important for alkylation feedstock and blending operations.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this NGL stream record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: last_quality_test_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent laboratory quality test performed on this NGL stream to verify composition and specifications.
attributes.references: Gas Processors Association (GPA) Quality Assurance Standards

attributes.name: mercury_content_ppb
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mercury Content in Parts Per Billion (PPB)
attributes.description: Mercury content in the NGL stream measured in parts per billion, important for equipment protection and environmental compliance.
attributes.references: ASTM D6350 - Standard Test Method for Mercury in Petroleum and Petroleum Products

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified this NGL stream record, used for audit trail and data governance.

attributes.name: normal_butane_mol_percent
attributes.description: Mole percentage of normal butane (n-C4H10) in the NGL stream composition.

attributes.name: pentanes_plus_mol_percent
attributes.description: Mole percentage of pentanes and heavier hydrocarbons (C5+) in the NGL stream, also known as natural gasoline component.

attributes.name: petrochemical_feedstock_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this NGL stream is designated for use as petrochemical feedstock (ethylene cracking, alkylation, etc.).

attributes.name: pricing_basis
attributes.description: Pricing methodology used for commercial transactions of this NGL stream.

attributes.name: product_grade
attributes.description: Quality grade or specification designation for the NGL stream (e.g., HD-5 Propane, Commercial Propane, Polymer Grade Propylene).

attributes.name: propane_mol_percent
attributes.description: Mole percentage of propane (C3H8) in the NGL stream composition.

attributes.name: purity_percent
attributes.description: Purity percentage of the primary component in the NGL stream, critical for petrochemical feedstock and product specifications.

attributes.name: regulatory_product_code
attributes.description: Regulatory product classification code assigned by governing bodies (EPA, FERC, state agencies) for compliance reporting and tracking.
attributes.references: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Product Classification Standards

attributes.name: shrinkage_factor_percent

attributes.description: Percentage shrinkage factor representing the volume loss during NGL extraction from raw natural gas, used for production allocation and revenue calculations.
attributes.references: Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies (COPAS) Guidelines

attributes.name: specific_gravity
attributes.description: Specific gravity of the NGL stream relative to water at 60°F, used for volume-to-mass conversions and custody transfer calculations.
attributes.references: ASTM D1657 - Standard Test Method for Density or Relative Density of Light Hydrocarbons

attributes.name: specification_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional specification details, quality variances, seasonal adjustments, or special handling instructions for the NGL stream.

attributes.name: storage_classification
attributes.description: Storage method classification for the NGL stream based on its physical properties and handling requirements.
attributes.references: National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) 58 - Liquefied Petroleum Gas Code

attributes.name: stream_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the NGL stream used across operations, typically assigned by the gas processing facility or fractionation plant.

attributes.name: stream_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the NGL stream or fraction (e.g., Ethane Product, Propane Mix, C5+ Natural Gasoline).

attributes.name: stream_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the NGL stream in the product catalog and production operations.

attributes.name: sulfur_content_ppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sulfur Content in Parts Per Million (PPM)
attributes.description: Total sulfur content in the NGL stream measured in parts per million, important for product quality and environmental compliance.
attributes.references: ASTM D5623 - Standard Test Method for Sulfur Compounds in Light Petroleum Liquids

attributes.name: transportation_mode
attributes.description: Primary transportation mode used for moving this NGL stream from the processing facility to downstream markets or storage.
attributes.references: Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration (PHMSA) Regulations

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: United Nations identification number for the NGL stream used in international transportation and hazardous materials documentation.
attributes.references: United Nations Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: vapor_pressure_psi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reid Vapor Pressure (RVP) in Pounds per Square Inch (PSI)
attributes.description: Reid Vapor Pressure of the NGL stream measured in PSI at 100°F, critical for transportation safety and product specifications.
attributes.references: ASTM D323 - Standard Test Method for Vapor Pressure

attributes.name: water_content_ppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Water Content in Parts Per Million (PPM)

products.name: pricing_benchmark

domains.name: commercial
domains.description: Manages upstream and downstream commercial deal-making including term contracts, spot trades, price negotiations, offtake agreements, crude oil marketing, refined product sales, NGL/LNG trading, and petrochemical distribution. Owns trading positions, price differentials, hedging instruments, sales orders, pricing agreements, volume commitments, and commodity marketing aligned with OPEC quota management and WTI/Brent benchmark pricing. Supports revenue recognition and commercial performance tracking. Integrates with SAP SD and trading platforms.

Captures contract type (supply, offtake, purchase, exchange), delivery basis (FOB, CIF, DES), tenure, volume commitments and minimum volume obligations (MVO), pricing basis (WTI, Brent, Platts), delivery schedule, counterparty, amendment history, and contract status. Includes contractual volume commitment tracking with tolerance bands, deficiency payment rates, and cumulative delivery performance. Serves as the SSOT for all term-based commercial obligations across upstream and downstream operations.

attributes.description: The delta-adjusted volume of the position, accounting for the price sensitivity of options and other non-linear instruments. For physical and futures positions, delta is 1.0; for options, delta ranges from 0 to 1. Used for aggregated risk reporting.

attributes.name: financial_hedge_volume
attributes.description: The net volume of financial hedging instruments (futures, swaps, options) contributing to the position. Used to assess the degree of hedging and residual exposure.

attributes.description: The ratio of financial hedge volume to physical volume, expressed as a percentage. Indicates the degree to which the physical position is hedged. A ratio of 100% indicates full hedging; below 100% indicates under-hedging; above 100% indicates over-hedging.

attributes.name: instrument_type
attributes.description: The type of trading instrument contributing to the position (e.g., physical trade, futures contract, swap, option, forward contract). Used to segment risk by instrument class.

attributes.name: last_valuation_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the position was last revalued and mark-to-market calculations were performed. Used for audit trail and data freshness verification.

attributes.name: mark_to_market_value
attributes.description: The current fair value of the net position calculated by multiplying the net volume by the current market price. Represents the unrealized gain or loss on the position.

attributes.name: market_price
attributes.description: The current market price or spot price of the commodity at the position date, used for mark-to-market valuation. Sourced from benchmark indices or market data providers.

attributes.name: net_volume
attributes.description: The net open volume of the commodity position after netting all long and short physical trades, term contracts, and financial hedges. Positive for long positions, negative for short positions.

attributes.description: The unit of measure for pricing (e.g., USD per barrel, USD per MMBTU, USD per metric ton). Defines the denominator for the average price.

attributes.name: stress_test_scenario

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: valuation_method

attributes.name: value_at_risk
attributes.description: The estimated maximum potential loss on the position over a specified time horizon (typically 1 day or 10 days) at a given confidence level (typically 95% or 99%). Calculated using historical simulation, variance-covariance, or Monte Carlo methods.

attributes.name: api_gravity

attributes.name: approval_authority

attributes.name: approved_date

attributes.name: balance_volume_uom

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: entitlement_volume_uom
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the equity entitlement volume. Common units include BBL (barrels) for crude oil, BOE (barrel of oil equivalent), MMBTU (million British thermal units), MCF (thousand cubic feet), or MMCF (million cubic feet) for natural gas.

attributes.name: equity_entitlement_volume
attributes.description: The total volume of crude oil or natural gas the partner is entitled to lift during this program period, calculated based on their net revenue interest and the field production allocation.

attributes.name: estimated_lifting_value
attributes.description: The estimated total commercial value of the crude oil or natural gas to be lifted under this program, calculated based on entitlement volume, benchmark price, and price differential.

attributes.name: lifting_month
attributes.description: The calendar month for which this lifting program applies, formatted as YYYY-MM. Used for monthly lifting schedule coordination.

attributes.name: lifting_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the lifting period covered by this program, typically the last day of a calendar month or quarter.
attributes.references: Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies (COPAS) Guidelines

attributes.name: lifting_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the lifting period covered by this program, typically the first day of a calendar month or quarter.
attributes.references: Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies (COPAS) Guidelines

attributes.name: lifting_quarter
attributes.description: The calendar quarter for which this lifting program applies (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4). Used for quarterly lifting schedule coordination.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this lifting program record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: net_balance_volume
attributes.description: The net cumulative lifting balance for the partner, calculated as underlift balance minus overlift balance. A positive value indicates underlift, a negative value indicates overlift.

attributes.name: opec_quota_impact_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) Quota Impact Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lifting program is subject to OPEC production quota restrictions. True if the field production is constrained by OPEC quota management.
attributes.references: Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) Quota Framework

attributes.name: overlift_balance_volume
attributes.description: The cumulative volume by which the partner has lifted more than their equity entitlement in prior periods. A positive overlift balance indicates the partner must reduce future liftings or compensate other partners.

attributes.name: price_differential
attributes.description: The premium or discount applied to the benchmark price for this specific crude grade or delivery point, expressed in currency per barrel or per unit. Used to calculate the actual lifting price.

attributes.name: pricing_benchmark
attributes.description: The market benchmark index used for pricing the crude oil or natural gas lifted under this program. Common benchmarks include WTI (West Texas Intermediate), Brent, Dubai for crude oil, and Henry Hub or JKM (Japan Korea Marker) for natural gas.

attributes.name: program_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional operational notes, special instructions, or comments related to this lifting program. May include coordination details, exceptions, or partner-specific requirements.

attributes.name: program_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the lifting program, typically formatted as LP- followed by numeric sequence. Used for external communication and operational reference.

attributes.name: program_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the lifting program. Draft indicates planning phase, approved indicates authorization received, active indicates execution in progress, completed indicates all liftings fulfilled, cancelled indicates program terminated, suspended indicates temporary hold.

attributes.name: scheduled_lifting_end_date
attributes.description: The planned date when the partner will complete lifting their equity crude oil or natural gas under this program.

attributes.name: scheduled_lifting_start_date
attributes.description: The planned date when the partner will begin lifting their equity crude oil or natural gas under this program.

attributes.name: sulfur_content_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of sulfur content in the crude oil being lifted. Low sulfur content (sweet crude) is more valuable than high sulfur content (sour crude).

attributes.name: terminal_allocation_slot
attributes.description: The specific time slot or berth allocation assigned to the partner for loading operations at the terminal. Used for coordinating vessel scheduling and avoiding conflicts.
attributes.references: Terminal Scheduling and Slot Management Standards

attributes.name: underlift_balance_volume
attributes.description: The cumulative volume by which the partner has lifted less than their equity entitlement in prior periods. A positive underlift balance indicates the partner is owed additional volume in future liftings.

products.name: marketing_deal
products.description: Master record for crude oil and petroleum product marketing deals negotiated by the commercial marketing team, covering equity crude marketing, third-party trading, and product exchange arrangements. Captures deal type (crude marketing, product marketing, exchange, buy-back), commodity, origin field or refinery, destination market, counterparty, volume, pricing basis and realized differential, marketing margin, deal status (negotiating, confirmed, executing, closed), trader responsible, and deal approval chain. Supports commercial performance tracking, marketing revenue attribution, and trader performance benchmarking.

attributes.name: marketing_deal_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the marketing deal record. Primary key for the marketing deal entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Marketing deals executed with customer accounts for margin tracking and performance reporting. Required for account-level profitability analysis, marketing margin attribution, and customer relationshi

attributes.name: basin_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to exploration.basin. Business justification: Marketing deals for crude are structured by basin of origin (e.g., West African basin deals, North Sea basin deals) because basin determines crude quality, logistics, and benchmark pricing. Basin-leve

attributes.name: credit_limit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.credit_limit. Business justification: Marketing deals are executed within the credit limit framework for the counterparty. Before a marketing deal is approved, the counterparty's available credit limit is checked. This FK links the market

attributes.name: delivery_point_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific physical location where commodity delivery will occur, such as a pipeline interconnect, marine terminal, storage facility, or refinery gate.

attributes.name: field_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.field. Business justification: marketing_deal.origin_field_code is a denormalized text reference to production.field. Marketing deals originate from specific fields' production. Replacing with a proper FK enables field-level market

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.joa. Business justification: Marketing deals monetize JV equity crude per partner entitlements. Links deal to JOA for working interest allocation, lifting rights verification, and underlift/overlift impact on partner balances.

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Marketing deals involving petroleum products require permits for handling, transportation, or export. Permit compliance check during deal structuring is essential to ensure regulatory authorization fo

attributes.name: pipeline_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.pipeline_segment. Business justification: Marketing deals for gas or crude specify the pipeline delivery infrastructure. Transportation cost allocation, capacity utilization reporting, and deal P&L attribution require linking the marketing de

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Marketing deal revenue and margins must be allocated to profit centers for business unit performance measurement and strategic portfolio decisions.

attributes.name: psa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.psa. Business justification: Marketing deals for PSA contractor/government crude. Links deal to PSA for profit oil entitlement, cost recovery status, and compliance with domestic market obligation and export license requirements.

attributes.name: approval_authority_level
attributes.description: Organizational level required to approve the marketing deal based on deal value, risk exposure, or strategic importance. Trader for routine deals; desk head for moderate deals; VP Commercial for large deals; CFO for very large deals; board for strategic transactions.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the marketing deal received final approval from the designated authority. Required before deal execution can commence.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual who provided final approval for the marketing deal. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: benchmark_price
attributes.description: Reference price from the selected pricing basis at the time of deal execution or settlement. Expressed in currency per unit (e.g., USD per barrel for crude oil, USD per MMBtu for natural gas).

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: Organizational business unit responsible for the marketing deal. Typically aligns with upstream (E&P), midstream (pipelines, storage), or downstream (refining, marketing) divisions.

attributes.name: confirmation_date
attributes.description: Date when the marketing deal terms were confirmed and agreed upon by both parties. Marks the transition from negotiating to confirmed status.

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference to the master term contract or framework agreement under which this marketing deal is executed, if applicable. Null for standalone spot deals.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the marketing deal record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: deal_end_date
attributes.description: Date when commodity delivery or performance under the marketing deal is scheduled to complete. Marks the end of the execution phase.

attributes.name: deal_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, special terms, or operational notes related to the marketing deal. Used for trader handoff, audit trail, and institutional knowledge capture.

attributes.name: deal_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the marketing deal, formatted as MD-YYYYNNNN where YYYY is year and NNNN is sequence number. Used for communication with counterparties and internal tracking.

attributes.name: deal_start_date
attributes.description: Date when commodity delivery or performance under the marketing deal begins. Marks the start of the execution phase.

attributes.name: deal_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the marketing deal. Negotiating indicates terms are being discussed; confirmed indicates agreement reached; executing indicates active delivery; closed indicates completed; cancelled indicates terminated before completion; suspended indicates temporarily halted.

attributes.name: deal_type
attributes.description: Classification of the marketing deal by transaction structure. Crude marketing covers equity crude sales; product marketing covers refined product sales; exchange covers product swaps; buy-back covers temporary sales with repurchase obligation; NGL marketing covers natural gas liquids sales; LNG marketing covers liquefied natural gas sales.

attributes.name: destination_market
attributes.description: Geographic market or region where the commodity will be delivered or consumed. Examples include US Gulf Coast, Northwest Europe, Asia Pacific, or specific trading hubs like Rotterdam or Singapore.

attributes.name: hedging_instrument_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the marketing deal is paired with a financial hedging instrument (futures, swaps, options) to mitigate price risk. True if hedged; false if unhedged spot exposure.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: Standard trade terms defining the responsibilities of buyer and seller for transportation, insurance, and risk transfer. FOB is Free on Board; CIF is Cost Insurance and Freight; CFR is Cost and Freight; DES is Delivered Ex Ship; DAP is Delivered at Place; EXW is Ex Works.

attributes.name: marketing_margin
attributes.description: Gross profit margin earned on the marketing deal, calculated as the difference between realized sales price and acquisition or production cost, multiplied by volume. Expressed in the deal currency. Business-confidential metric used for trader performance evaluation.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the individual who last modified the marketing deal record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the marketing deal record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: negotiation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when commercial negotiations for the marketing deal were initiated. Used for tracking deal cycle time and trader efficiency.

attributes.name: opec_quota_impact_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) Quota Impact Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the marketing deal involves crude oil production subject to OPEC production quota management. True if the deal impacts quota compliance; false otherwise. Relevant for NOCs and IOCs operating in OPEC member countries.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days after delivery or invoice date within which payment is due. Common terms include 30, 60, or 90 days. Used for cash flow forecasting and credit risk management.

attributes.name: price_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the pricing and settlement of the deal. Most oil and gas transactions are denominated in USD, but regional deals may use EUR, GBP, JPY, or other currencies.

attributes.name: price_differential
attributes.description: Premium or discount applied to the benchmark price to arrive at the realized transaction price. Reflects quality adjustments, location basis, and market conditions. Positive values indicate premium; negative values indicate discount.

attributes.name: price_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the pricing. Per_bbl is per barrel for crude and refined products; per_mmbtu is per million British thermal units for natural gas; per_mt is per metric ton for petrochemicals; per_gallon is per gallon for retail products.

attributes.name: pricing_basis
attributes.description: Benchmark or pricing mechanism used to determine the deal price. WTI is West Texas Intermediate crude; Brent is North Sea crude; Dubai and Oman are Middle East crudes; Henry Hub is US natural gas; JKM is Japan Korea Marker for LNG; fixed indicates a set price; formula indicates a custom calculation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: wti|brent|dubai|oman|henry_hub|jkm|fixed|formula — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: realized_price
attributes.description: Final transaction price per unit achieved in the marketing deal, calculated as benchmark price plus price differential. This is the actual price at which the commodity was sold or purchased.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the marketing deal is subject to mandatory regulatory reporting requirements (e.g., FERC for natural gas, CFTC for derivatives, SEC for material transactions). True if reporting required; false otherwise.

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_status
attributes.description: Result of screening the counterparty and transaction against international sanctions lists (OFAC, UN, EU). Cleared indicates no sanctions concerns; pending indicates screening in progress; flagged indicates potential match requiring review; blocked indicates prohibited transaction.

attributes.name: total_deal_value
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the marketing deal, calculated as volume quantity multiplied by realized price. Represents the gross revenue or cost associated with the transaction. Expressed in the deal currency.

attributes.name: trading_book
attributes.description: Internal trading desk or book to which the marketing deal is assigned. Used for P&L attribution, risk management, and organizational reporting. Examples include Crude Trading, Products Trading, NGL Trading, International Marketing.

attributes.name: volume_quantity
attributes.description: Total volume of commodity covered by the marketing deal. Measured in barrels for crude oil and refined products, cubic feet or cubic meters for natural gas, or metric tons for petrochemicals.

attributes.name: volume_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the volume quantity. BBL is barrels, MMBBL is million barrels, MCF is thousand cubic feet, MMCF is million cubic feet, BCF is billion cubic feet, MT is metric tons, KMT is thousand metric tons. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BBL|MMBBL|MCF|MMCF|BCF|MT|KMT — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: credit_limit
products.description: Master record managing the commercial credit limits assigned to each trading counterparty, defining the maximum financial exposure the company is willing to accept. Captures counterparty reference, approved credit limit amount, currency, credit limit type (unsecured, letter of credit, parent guarantee), utilization amount, available headroom, review date, approving authority, and credit limit status. Supports pre-trade credit checking and commercial risk controls.
products.reference: ISDA Credit Support Annex (CSA) / Basel III Credit Risk Framework

attributes.name: credit_limit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the credit limit record. Primary key for the credit limit master data.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_regulatory_filing. Business justification: Credit limits for counterparties require regulatory filings for credit risk reporting and sanctions compliance. Quarterly credit exposure reporting to regulators and sanctions screening documentation

attributes.name: venture_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.partner. Business justification: Credit limits for JV partners in commercial crude transactions. Links credit limit to partner for partner-specific credit terms, netting agreement impact, and credit risk management in JV equity crude

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credit limit was formally approved by the designated authority. Used for audit trail and compliance verification.

attributes.name: approved_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum financial exposure the company is willing to accept from this counterparty, expressed in the limit currency. Represents the ceiling for outstanding receivables and open trade positions.

attributes.name: approving_authority
attributes.description: Name or title of the individual or committee that approved this credit limit. Reflects delegation of authority based on limit size and counterparty risk rating.

attributes.name: available_amount
attributes.description: Remaining credit headroom available for new transactions, calculated as approved limit minus utilized amount. Used for pre-trade credit checks.

attributes.name: breach_count
attributes.description: Number of times this credit limit has been exceeded. Triggers escalation and potential limit suspension.

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: Business unit or trading desk responsible for managing this credit relationship. Typically aligned with commodity type (crude, NGL, LNG, refined products).

attributes.name: collateral_amount
attributes.description: Value of collateral or credit support posted by the counterparty to secure this limit. Null for unsecured limits.

attributes.name: collateral_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the collateral or credit support. May differ from the limit currency.

attributes.name: collateral_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credit limit requires cash collateral, letter of credit, or other credit support. True for secured limits, false for unsecured.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the individual who created this credit limit record. Supports audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this credit limit record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: credit_manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the credit risk manager responsible for monitoring this counterparty relationship and limit utilization.

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: Current credit rating assigned to the counterparty by the specified rating agency or internal credit team. Influences limit size and collateral requirements.

attributes.name: credit_rating_agency
attributes.description: External rating agency whose assessment was used in the credit limit determination. Internal indicates proprietary credit scoring; none indicates unrated counterparty.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this credit limit becomes active and available for trading operations. Aligns with credit approval and documentation completion.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this credit limit expires and must be renewed or replaced. Null for evergreen limits subject to periodic review.

attributes.name: guarantor_credit_rating
attributes.description: Credit rating of the guarantor entity. Must be equal to or better than the counterparty rating to provide credit enhancement.

attributes.name: guarantor_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the parent company or third party providing the credit guarantee. Null if no guarantee is in place.

attributes.name: kyc_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current KYC documentation expires and must be refreshed. Triggers compliance workflow.

attributes.name: kyc_status
attributes.description: Status of the counterparty KYC due diligence process. Approved status is required before credit limit activation.

attributes.name: last_breach_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent credit limit breach. Used for risk reporting and counterparty performance tracking.

attributes.name: last_utilization_check_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent credit utilization calculation. Updated by real-time pre-trade credit checking system.

attributes.name: limit_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the credit limit is denominated. Typically USD for international crude oil and LNG trading.

attributes.name: limit_reference_number
attributes.description: External business identifier for the credit limit assignment, used in credit approval documentation and commercial correspondence.

attributes.name: limit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the credit limit. Active limits are available for pre-trade credit checking; suspended or revoked limits block new trading activity.

attributes.name: limit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the credit support mechanism backing this limit. Unsecured limits rely on counterparty creditworthiness; secured limits require collateral or third-party guarantees.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the individual who last modified this credit limit record. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this credit limit record. Updated on any field change.

attributes.name: netting_agreement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a master netting agreement is in place, allowing offsetting of payables and receivables to reduce net credit exposure.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special conditions, or exceptions related to this credit limit. Used for audit trail and knowledge transfer.

attributes.name: parent_guarantee_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credit limit is backed by a parent company guarantee. Common for subsidiaries of major IOCs and NOCs.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic credit review. Triggers reassessment of counterparty creditworthiness and limit adequacy.

attributes.name: review_frequency_months
attributes.description: Number of months between mandatory credit reviews. Typically 12 months for investment-grade counterparties, 6 months for sub-investment grade.

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent sanctions screening. Must be refreshed periodically per compliance policy.

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_status
attributes.description: Result of screening the counterparty against OFAC, EU, and UN sanctions lists. Flagged status blocks credit limit activation.

attributes.name: utilized_amount
attributes.description: Current amount of credit exposure consumed by outstanding invoices, open trades, and unsettled transactions. Updated in real-time by the trading and billing systems.

attributes.name: benchmark_index

attributes.name: confidentiality_level

attributes.name: hedging_strategy

attributes.name: is_active

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: last_valuation_timestamp

attributes.name: market

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: performance_mtd_percent

attributes.name: performance_qtd_percent
attributes.description: QTD performance as a percentage.

attributes.name: performance_ytd_percent
attributes.description: YTD performance as a percentage.

attributes.name: portfolio_code
attributes.description: Business code used to identify the portfolio externally.

attributes.name: portfolio_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the portfolio's purpose and scope.

attributes.name: portfolio_name
attributes.description: Human readable name of the portfolio.

attributes.name: portfolio_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the portfolio.

attributes.name: portfolio_type
attributes.description: Category of portfolio based on its primary purpose.

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Primary geographic region of the portfolio's assets.

attributes.name: regulatory_status
attributes.description: Compliance status of the portfolio with relevant regulations.

attributes.name: reporting_category
attributes.description: Category of reporting applicable to the portfolio.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Risk rating assigned to the portfolio based on exposure and volatility.

attributes.name: total_market_value

domains.name: revenue
domains.description: Manages revenue recognition, invoicing, payment processing, accounts receivable, JIB (Joint Interest Billing) statements, royalty payments, tariff charges, and cash application for crude oil sales, refined product sales, and petrochemical revenues. Owns invoice data, payment terms, revenue allocation, credit notes, and dispute resolution. Supports COPAS-compliant billing procedures, IFRS/GAAP revenue recognition standards (successful-efforts and full-cost methods), and SOX compliance. Integrates with SAP FI/SD.

products.name: invoice
products.description: Core billing document representing a formal demand for payment issued to customers (IOCs, NOCs, refiners, traders, industrial consumers) for crude oil sales, refined product sales, LNG/LPG/NGL deliveries, and petrochemical revenues. Captures invoice number, date, due date, billing period, type (commercial, intercompany, JIB, royalty, tariff), currency, total amount, tax amount, discount amount, payment terms (net days, early payment discount, late interest rate), status (draft, issued, disputed, paid, cancelled), and COPAS billing method indicator. SSOT for all outbound billing documents in the revenue domain.

attributes.name: invoice_type

Tariff invoices are for pipeline transportation or storage fees. Intercompany invoices are for internal cross-entity transactions. Service invoices are for technical or operational services rendered.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Payments are posted to GL via journal entries for cash accounting. Cash application reconciliation and bank statement matching require tracing payment to its GL posting document.

attributes.name: lease_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.lease. Business justification: Payments for oil & gas revenue must be traceable to the lease/property for lease-level cash reconciliation, revenue accounting by property, and audit trail. Critical for property-level financial repor

attributes.name: offtake_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.offtake_agreement. Business justification: Payments settle offtake agreement invoices. Required for offtake payment tracking, partner cash distribution verification, and production sharing agreement (PSA) cash settlement reconciliation in join

attributes.name: payer_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_counterparty. Business justification: Payments often received from counterparty treasury (not account-specific), especially in JV/PSA contexts where one entity pays for multiple accounts. Cash application and counterparty-level reconcilia

attributes.name: payer_venture_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.partner. Business justification: Cash receipts from JV partners must track the paying partner for partner netting, cash call reconciliation, and default monitoring. Essential for JV cash management and partner credit risk assessment.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Payments for regulatory fees, filing fees, and PSA government take must reference the specific regulatory filing. Essential for government payment reconciliation and audit compliance.

attributes.name: royalty_owner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.royalty_owner. Business justification: Direct payments to royalty owners require owner tracking for suspense clearing, escheatment management, and 1099 tax reporting - essential for royalty payment operations.

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.sales_order. Business justification: Payments settle sales order invoices. Required for sales order payment tracking, order closure verification, and customer payment terms compliance monitoring in oil & gas order-to-cash processes.

attributes.name: spot_trade_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.spot_trade. Business justification: Payments settle spot trade invoices. Essential for spot trade settlement tracking, trade date vs settlement date reconciliation, and counterparty payment performance monitoring in oil & gas spot marke

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The total monetary value of the payment received, expressed in the payment currency. Represents the gross cash receipt before allocation or application to invoices.

attributes.name: application_method
attributes.description: The method used to allocate the payment to open receivable items. Automatic application uses matching rules, manual requires user intervention, partial allows split allocation, and residual handles remaining balances.

attributes.name: applied_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the payment amount that has been successfully allocated and applied to open receivable items or invoices. Represents cleared receivables.

attributes.name: bank_statement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment appeared on the bank statement. Used for bank reconciliation and cash position reporting.

attributes.name: bank_statement_reference
attributes.description: The transaction reference or line item identifier from the bank statement corresponding to this payment. Enables automated bank reconciliation.

attributes.name: business_unit_code
attributes.description: The business unit or operating segment (Exploration and Production (E&P), Refining, Petrochemicals, Marketing) to which the payment is attributed. Supports segment reporting under IFRS 8.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The interface or system through which the payment was received and recorded. Distinguishes between bank portal integration, lockbox processing, manual data entry, Electronic Data Interchange (EDI), or Application Programming Interface (API) integration.

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: The check number when payment method is check. Used for tracking and reconciliation of paper-based payments.

attributes.name: clearing_reference
attributes.description: The accounting document number or clearing identifier generated when the payment is applied to invoices and receivables are cleared in the financial system.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The cost center or organizational unit to which the payment is attributed for management accounting and profitability analysis. Relevant for joint venture and production sharing agreement (PSA) cost allocation.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The user identifier or system account that created the payment record. Audit trail for accountability and Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the payment record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the currency in which the payment was received. Critical for multi-currency settlement of international crude oil, Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG), and petrochemical transactions.

attributes.name: discount_taken
attributes.description: The early payment discount amount claimed by the customer and deducted from the invoice amount. Reflects payment terms incentives for prompt settlement.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payment is associated with a disputed invoice or receivable item. True when customer has raised a billing dispute or short payment claim.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Textual description of the reason for payment dispute or short payment. Captures customer claims regarding pricing, volume, quality, or contractual terms.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert the payment amount from the payment currency to the company's functional currency. Used for multi-currency accounting and reporting.

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: The payment amount converted to the company's functional currency using the exchange rate. Used for consolidated financial reporting and accounting entries.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The general ledger account code to which the payment is posted. Typically a cash or bank account in the chart of accounts.

attributes.name: jib_netting_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the Joint Interest Billing (JIB) netting transaction when payment is settled through partner netting arrangements. Common in joint venture operations under Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) structures.

attributes.name: lockbox_batch_code
attributes.description: The batch identifier assigned by the lockbox service provider for payments processed through lockbox arrangements. Used for bulk payment reconciliation.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: The user identifier or system account that last modified the payment record. Audit trail for accountability and Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the payment record was last modified. Audit trail for change tracking and Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance.

attributes.name: overpayment_amount
attributes.description: The excess amount when the payment received exceeds the invoice amount due. May result from customer error, advance payment, or multi-invoice settlement.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment was received or recorded in the system. Represents the business event date for cash receipt recognition.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The financial instrument or mechanism used to remit payment. Includes wire transfer, Automated Clearing House (ACH), check, letter of credit, netting arrangements for Joint Interest Billing (JIB), and electronic funds transfer (EFT).

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment. Received indicates initial recording, cleared indicates successful application, bounced indicates failed bank processing, reversed indicates cancellation, pending indicates awaiting clearance, and reconciled indicates bank statement matching completed.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting period date on which the payment transaction was posted to the general ledger. May differ from payment_date due to period-end cutoffs and accounting calendar rules.

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: The profit center responsible for the revenue associated with this payment. Used for segment reporting and business unit performance analysis.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of bank reconciliation for this payment. Unreconciled indicates no bank statement match, reconciled indicates successful matching, exception indicates discrepancies requiring investigation, and pending_review indicates awaiting manual review.

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number or transaction identifier provided by the payer or payment processor. Used for reconciliation and traceability across banking systems.

attributes.name: remittance_advice
attributes.description: Textual information provided by the payer detailing which invoices or accounts the payment is intended to settle. Critical for accurate cash application and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: short_payment_amount
attributes.description: The shortfall amount when the payment received is less than the invoice amount due, excluding authorized discounts. May indicate disputes or payment errors.

attributes.name: tolerance
attributes.description: The acceptable variance threshold for payment matching. Small differences within tolerance are automatically cleared without manual intervention.

attributes.name: unapplied_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the payment amount that remains unallocated to specific invoices. May represent overpayments, advance payments, or payments pending manual allocation.

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The effective date on which funds become available for use, as determined by the banking institution. May differ from payment_date due to clearing cycles.

attributes.name: wire_transfer_reference
attributes.description: The unique reference number assigned by the bank for wire transfer payments. Critical for tracing international crude oil and Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) payments.

products.name: receivable

Captures AR document number, customer account, original invoice reference, original amount, outstanding balance, aging bucket (current, 30/60/90/90+ days), due date, credit terms, dunning level, dunning date, dunning method, dispute flag, dispute reason, write-off flag, write-off amount, collection status, and legal referral date. Supports SOX-compliant AR aging reporting, IFRS 9 expected credit loss provisioning, and COPAS-compliant collections procedures.

attributes.name: receivable_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the accounts receivable record. Primary key for the receivable ledger entry.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: asset_facility_id

attributes.name: commercial_term_contract_id

Essential for contract AR management, take-or-pay enforcement, deficiency payment tracking, and contract-level credit exposure mon

Credit committees review counterparty-level receivables for l

attributes.description: Reference to the customer account that owes this receivable. Links to the customer master data for billing and collections.

attributes.name: debtor_venture_partner_id

attributes.name: jib_statement_id

attributes.name: lease_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.lease. Business justification: Receivables must be tracked by lease/property for lease-level AR aging, collection management, and property-level financial reporting. Standard practice in oil & gas revenue accounting to manage recei

attributes.name: lifting_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.lifting_program. Business justification: Lifting programs generate receivables for partner billings and entitlement settlements. Essential for joint venture AR tracking, equity entitlement billing, and overlift/underlift receivable managemen

attributes.name: marketing_deal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.marketing_deal. Business justification: Marketing deals generate receivables for product sales and marketing margin realization. Required for marketing AR tracking, deal profitability analysis, and downstream revenue accounting in oil & gas

attributes.name: offtake_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.offtake_agreement. Business justification: Offtake agreements create receivables for entitlement lifting and take-or-pay obligations. Required for offtake AR tracking, partner billing, underlift/overlift settlement, and production sharing agre

attributes.name: pipeline_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.pipeline_segment. Business justification: Pipeline tariff AR tracking: FERC-regulated pipeline operators track receivables by pipeline segment for tariff revenue collections, shipper credit risk management, and segment-level revenue reporting

attributes.name: pricing_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.pricing_agreement. Business justification: Pricing agreements govern receivable payment terms, retroactive pricing adjustments, and escalation clauses. Required for AR valuation, expected credit loss calculation, and pricing dispute resolution

attributes.name: production_well_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.production_well. Business justification: O&G accounts receivable are tracked at the well level for working interest owner billing (JIB) and royalty owner statements. Well-level AR aging reports and collection tracking are standard O&G accoun

attributes.name: regulatory_penalty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_penalty. Business justification: Unpaid regulatory penalties are tracked as receivables (when company assesses penalties to JV partners) or payables. Links penalty assessment to collections process for joint venture penalty allocatio

attributes.name: royalty_owner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.royalty_owner. Business justification: Receivables from royalty owners for cost recoveries, JIB billings, or overpayment recoupment need owner tracking for collections, aging analysis, and credit management.

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.sales_order. Business justification: Receivables track outstanding amounts from sales orders for AR aging, credit management, and collection activities. Required for order-to-cash cycle tracking and customer credit risk assessment in oil

attributes.name: spot_trade_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.spot_trade. Business justification: Spot trades generate receivables for trade settlement. Essential for spot market AR management, trade credit risk monitoring, and reconciliation of trade confirmations to cash receipts in oil & gas tr

attributes.name: trade_confirmation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.trade_confirmation. Business justification: Trade confirmations generate receivables upon confirmation. Essential for confirmed trade AR tracking, counterparty credit exposure monitoring, and reconciliation of trade confirmations to invoices an

attributes.name: well_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.well_asset. Business justification: Well-level AR aging and collections management: O&G revenue accountants track receivables at the well level for JIB billing, non-operated well revenue collections, and well-level cash flow reporting.

attributes.name: aging_bucket
attributes.description: Classification of the receivable based on days past due. Current = not yet due; 30/60/90/90+ days = days overdue. Used for aging reports, expected credit loss provisioning, and SOX compliance reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Expected Credit Loss Model, SOX Section 404 Internal Controls, COPAS Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: ar_document_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the AR document. External reference number used in SAP FI-AR module for tracking and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Document Management, COPAS Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: ar_type
attributes.description: Classification of the receivable by business transaction type. Trade receivables are from product sales; JIB receivables are from joint interest billing; royalty receivables are from mineral rights payments; tariff receivables are from pipeline and transportation charges; service receivables are from technical services.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: collection_status
attributes.description: Current state of the receivable in the collections workflow. Open = normal AR; in_collection = active collection efforts; payment_plan = customer on installment agreement; legal_referral = sent to legal counsel; written_off = deemed uncollectible; closed = fully paid.
attributes.references: COPAS Credit and Collections Standards, IFRS 9 Derecognition

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Cost center that originated the billable activity. Used for cost allocation and internal charging.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center Accounting, COPAS Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the receivable record was first created in the AR ledger. Used for audit trail and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls, SAP FI-AR Audit Trail

attributes.name: credit_risk_rating
attributes.description: Internal credit risk classification of the customer at the time of receivable creation. Used for expected credit loss provisioning and credit limit management.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Expected Credit Loss Model, Basel III Credit Risk Framework

attributes.name: credit_terms
attributes.description: Payment terms agreed with the customer, expressed in standard notation (e.g., Net 30, 2/10 Net 30, Net 45). Defines the payment period and any early payment discounts.
attributes.references: COPAS Credit and Collections Standards, SAP FI Customer Master

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the receivable amount. Supports multi-currency operations for international crude oil, refined product, and petrochemical sales.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes, IFRS IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: Number of days the receivable is overdue, calculated as current date minus due date. Negative values indicate payment is not yet due. Used for precise aging analysis and collection prioritization.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Expected Credit Loss Model, COPAS Credit and Collections Standards

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: Date the customer formally raised the dispute. Used to track dispute aging and resolution cycle time.
attributes.references: COPAS Dispute Resolution Procedures, SAP FI-AR Dispute Management

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has disputed this receivable. True if the customer has raised a billing dispute; false otherwise. Disputed receivables are excluded from aggressive collection actions.
attributes.references: COPAS Dispute Resolution Procedures, SAP FI-AR Dispute Management

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the customer's dispute reason. Captures the nature of the billing disagreement for resolution tracking and root cause analysis.
attributes.references: COPAS Dispute Resolution Procedures, SAP FI-AR Dispute Management

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which payment is contractually due. Calculated from invoice date plus credit terms. Used for aging bucket classification and dunning trigger.
attributes.references: COPAS Credit and Collections Standards, SAP FI-AR Payment Terms

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: Escalation level of collection notices sent to the customer. Typically ranges from 0 (no dunning) to 3+ (final notice before legal action). Increments with each dunning cycle.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Dunning Configuration, COPAS Credit and Collections Standards

attributes.name: dunning_method
attributes.description: Communication channel used for the last dunning notice. Tracks how collection notices are delivered to the customer.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Dunning Configuration, COPAS Credit and Collections Standards

attributes.name: expected_credit_loss_amount
attributes.description: Provision amount for expected credit loss calculated per IFRS 9 ECL model. Based on probability of default, loss given default, and exposure at default. Used for financial reporting and reserve adequacy.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Expected Credit Loss Model, GAAP ASC 326 Current Expected Credit Losses

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year when the receivable was created. Typically 1-12 for monthly periods. Used for monthly financial close and reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements, GAAP ASC 205 Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the receivable was created. Used for period-based financial reporting and year-over-year analysis.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements, GAAP ASC 205 Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code for the receivable. Maps to the chart of accounts for financial statement reporting and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements, GAAP ASC 210 Balance Sheet, SOX Section 404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: last_dunning_date
attributes.description: Date the most recent dunning notice was sent to the customer. Used to schedule the next dunning cycle and track collection activity.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Dunning Management, COPAS Credit and Collections Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the receivable record was last updated. Tracks changes to balance, status, or other attributes for audit trail and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls, SAP FI-AR Audit Trail

attributes.name: last_payment_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the most recent payment applied to this receivable. Used for payment tracking and cash application analysis.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Payment Processing, COPAS Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent payment applied to this receivable. Used to track payment activity and customer payment behavior.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Payment Processing, COPAS Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: legal_referral_date
attributes.description: Date the receivable was referred to legal counsel for collection action. Indicates escalation to litigation or formal legal demand.
attributes.references: COPAS Credit and Collections Standards, SAP FI-AR Legal Collections

attributes.name: original_amount
attributes.description: The original invoiced amount when the receivable was first created. Represents the total amount owed before any payments, credits, or adjustments.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Financial Instruments, GAAP ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Current unpaid balance remaining on the receivable after applying payments, credits, and adjustments. Used for aging analysis and expected credit loss provisioning.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Expected Credit Loss Model, GAAP ASC 326 Current Expected Credit Losses

attributes.name: payment_plan_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer is on an installment payment plan for this receivable. True if payment plan is active; false otherwise.
attributes.references: COPAS Credit and Collections Standards, SAP FI-AR Payment Plans

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: Profit center responsible for the revenue and receivable. Used for internal management reporting and profitability analysis.
attributes.references: SAP CO Profit Center Accounting, COPAS Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: Date revenue was recognized for this receivable per IFRS 15 or GAAP ASC 606 revenue recognition standards. May differ from invoice date based on performance obligation satisfaction.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers, GAAP ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: write_off_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the receivable that has been written off as uncollectible. May be partial or full write-off. Impacts bad debt expense and expected credit loss reserves.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Expected Credit Loss Model, GAAP ASC 326 Current Expected Credit Losses

attributes.name: write_off_date
attributes.description: Date the receivable was written off. Used for financial reporting and audit trail. Write-offs must be approved per SOX internal control requirements.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Derecognition, SOX Section 404 Internal Controls, COPAS Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: write_off_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this receivable has been written off as uncollectible. True if written off; false otherwise. Write-offs require management approval and are reported for SOX compliance.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Derecognition, GAAP ASC 326 Credit Losses, SOX Section 404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: write_off_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for the write-off. Common reasons include customer bankruptcy, uncollectible after legal action, small balance administrative write-off, or disputed amount settlement.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls, COPAS Accounting Guidelines

products.name: cash_application

Supports automated cash application workflows integrated with SAP FI bank statement processing and lockbox operations.

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the incoming payment that is being applied to receivables. Links to the payment transaction that triggered this cash application event.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_penalty. Business justification: Cash receipts are applied against regulatory penalty invoices (EPA fines, state penalties, NOVs). Cash application teams match incoming payments to penalty assessments, track partial payments, and rec

attributes.description: Code representing the payment terms applicable to this cash application. Determines discount eligibility and due date calculations.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.royalty_owner. Business justification: Cash applications may apply to royalty owner payments for suspense clearing, requiring owner tracking for proper payment reconciliation and suspense account resolution.

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.sales_order. Business justification: Cash applied to sales order invoices for payment matching and order closure. Required for order-to-cash reconciliation, sales order payment status tracking, and customer payment behavior analysis in o

attributes.name: spot_trade_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.spot_trade. Business justification: Cash applied to spot trade invoices for trade settlement. Essential for spot market cash reconciliation, trade settlement date compliance, and counterparty payment performance tracking in oil & gas tr

attributes.name: application_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment was applied to the receivable item. Represents the business event date for revenue recognition and accounts receivable aging.

attributes.name: application_method
attributes.description: Method by which the payment was applied to the receivable. Automatic indicates system-matched application, manual indicates user intervention, partial indicates split application, lockbox indicates bank lockbox processing, electronic indicates EDI or API-based application.

attributes.name: application_number
attributes.description: Business-readable unique identifier for the cash application transaction. Used for tracking and reference in financial reporting and audit trails.

attributes.name: application_status
attributes.description: Current status of the cash application. Matched indicates full application to invoice, partially matched indicates partial application, unmatched indicates payment received but not yet applied, on-account indicates payment held for future application, reversed indicates application has been reversed, pending indicates awaiting approval or processing.

attributes.name: application_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the cash application was processed in the system. Used for audit trail and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: applied_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount from the payment that was successfully applied to the receivable item. Represents the portion of the payment allocated to this specific invoice or receivable.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the cash application was approved, if approval workflow is required. Used for audit trail and process compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: bank_statement_line_code
attributes.description: Reference to the specific line item on the bank statement from which this payment originated. Links cash application to bank reconciliation processes.

attributes.name: business_unit_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the business unit or operating segment to which this cash application belongs. Used for segment reporting and revenue allocation.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: SAP FI clearing document number generated when the payment is matched and cleared against the open receivable item. Used for financial reconciliation and audit.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center code associated with the revenue or receivable being cleared. Used for internal cost allocation and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the cash application record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cash application amounts. Indicates the currency in which the payment was received and applied.

attributes.name: days_to_pay
attributes.description: Number of days between invoice date and payment application date. Used for customer payment behavior analysis and DSO calculations.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Early payment discount amount granted to the customer as part of this cash application. Reflects payment terms incentives for prompt payment.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payment or invoice is under dispute. True if there is an active dispute affecting this cash application, false otherwise.

attributes.name: dispute_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for payment dispute if dispute flag is true. Used for dispute tracking and resolution workflow.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Original due date of the invoice to which payment is being applied. Used to calculate days sales outstanding and aging analysis.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign exchange rate applied when converting payment currency to functional currency. Used for multi-currency cash application and financial reporting.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: estimated_price

attributes.name: estimated_volume

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the accrual record was last updated or modified. Tracks the most recent change to the record.

attributes.name: net_revenue_interest_percentage
