attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, NACHA Operating Rules

attributes.name: primary_phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact telephone number for the royalty owner. Used for payment inquiries, division order questions, and ownership verification.

attributes.name: suspended_payment_balance
attributes.description: Dollar amount of royalty payments currently held in suspense due to missing documentation, address issues, or ownership disputes. Released when issues are resolved.

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for suspending royalty payments to the owner. Examples include missing tax forms, invalid address, ownership dispute, deceased without estate documentation, or regulatory hold.

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: Tax identification number for the royalty owner. May be Social Security Number (SSN) for individuals, Employer Identification Number (EIN) for entities, or Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) for foreign entities. Used for IRS 1099 reporting and tax withholding compliance.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 515, IRS Form W-9, IRS Form W-8BEN

attributes.name: tax_treaty_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for tax treaty application. Used to determine reduced withholding rates for foreign royalty owners under bilateral tax treaties.

attributes.name: w8_form_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the IRS Form W-8. W-8 forms are generally valid for three years from signing. After expiration, default 30% withholding applies until new form is received.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-8BEN Instructions, IRS Publication 515

attributes.name: w8_form_received_date
attributes.description: Date the IRS Form W-8BEN or W-8BEN-E (Certificate of Foreign Status) was received from the foreign royalty owner. Required for non-US persons to claim tax treaty benefits and reduced withholding rates.

attributes.name: w9_form_received_date
attributes.description: Date the IRS Form W-9 (Request for Taxpayer Identification Number and Certification) was received from the royalty owner. Required for US persons to certify TIN and avoid backup withholding.

products.name: division_order
products.description: Authoritative document establishing the decimal interest each owner holds in production from a specific well or lease for revenue distribution purposes. Captures well/lease reference, owner reference, interest type (WI, NRI, ORRI, royalty), decimal interest fraction, effective date, termination date, division order status (active, suspended, pending title), and title opinion reference. Division orders are the legal basis for all royalty and working interest payments. Integrates with Quorum Land System division order module.

attributes.name: division_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the division order record. Primary key for the division order entity.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Division Order Standards

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Division orders drive revenue and royalty expense allocation in joint interest billing. Each division order needs G/L account mapping to post owner-specific revenue shares and royalty expenses correct

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.joa. Business justification: Division orders allocate revenue under JOA cost recovery and distribution rules. JOA reference enables revenue deck reconciliation to JIB statements and partner entitlement verification for joint vent

attributes.name: lease_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.lease. Business justification: A division order establishes the decimal interest each owner holds in production from a specific lease or well. While division_order already references tract_id and pooling_unit_id, it lacks a direct

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Division orders allocate revenue by specific product type (oil vs gas vs NGL) with different pricing and tax treatment. Required for accurate royalty payment calculations. Business process: monthly re

attributes.name: pooling_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pooled unit or communitization agreement under which production is allocated across multiple leases. Applicable for unitized operations where production is shared across participating leases.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Unit Accounting Standards

attributes.name: previous_division_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the prior division order record that this division order supersedes. Used to maintain historical chain of ownership and interest changes. Nullable for initial division orders.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Division Order History Standards

attributes.name: royalty_owner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the royalty owner, working interest partner, or overriding royalty interest holder who receives revenue distribution. Links to the owner master data containing contact and payment information.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Owner Master File Standards

attributes.name: tract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific tract or land parcel within the lease from which production is allocated. Used for multi-tract leases where different owners may have interests in different tracts.
attributes.references: Bureau of Land Management (BLM) - Land Tract Identification Standards

attributes.name: venture_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.partner. Business justification: Division orders are issued to venture partners for their share of production revenue. Venture_partner_id enables partner-level revenue allocation, payment processing, and 1099 reporting for joint vent

attributes.name: well_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.well_asset. Business justification: Division orders are well-specific legal documents establishing each owner's decimal interest for a specific well. O&G land administration prepares division orders per well; linking division_order dire

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: The method by which production and revenue are allocated to this division order. Well indicates allocation based on individual well production. Lease indicates allocation across all wells on the lease. Unit indicates allocation based on unit participation. Tract indicates allocation to specific land tract. Proportionate indicates allocation based on decimal interest across multiple sources.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Allocation Method Standards

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the division order was approved by the land department, legal counsel, or revenue accounting team. Represents formal authorization to begin revenue distribution under this division order.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Division Order Approval Process

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the person who approved the division order. Typically a land manager, revenue accountant, or legal counsel with authority to authorize revenue distribution.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) - Financial Controls and Approval Authority

attributes.name: backup_withholding_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether backup withholding is required for this owner due to missing or incorrect Tax Identification Number (TIN). True when backup withholding applies, false otherwise. Backup withholding rate is typically 24% per IRS regulations.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Service (IRS) - Backup Withholding Requirements

attributes.name: cost_bearing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interest holder is responsible for bearing their proportionate share of operating costs and capital expenditures. True for working interest owners, false for royalty and overriding royalty interest holders who receive revenue net of costs.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Cost Allocation Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this division order record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) - Record Retention and Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: decimal_interest
attributes.description: The precise decimal fraction representing the owner's proportionate share of production revenue or costs. Expressed as a decimal value (e.g., 0.125 for 12.5% interest). This is the authoritative value used for all revenue distribution calculations and royalty payments.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Decimal Interest Calculation Standards

attributes.name: division_order_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the division order, typically formatted as DO- prefix followed by alphanumeric code. Used for external reference and communication with royalty owners and working interest partners.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Division Order Standards

attributes.name: division_order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the division order. Active indicates revenue distribution is occurring. Suspended indicates temporary hold on payments due to title issues or disputes. Pending Title indicates awaiting title opinion clearance. Terminated indicates division order is no longer in effect. Draft indicates division order is being prepared. Under Review indicates legal or accounting review in progress.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Division Order Status Classification

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this division order becomes legally binding and revenue distribution begins. Typically aligned with first production date, title opinion date, or ownership transfer date.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Division Order Effective Date Standards

attributes.name: gross_acres
attributes.description: The total acreage of the lease or tract from which the owner's interest is derived. Used in net acres calculation and reserve allocation.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Reserves Allocation Standards

attributes.name: interest_calculation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate the decimal interest for this division order. Net Acres indicates calculation based on net acreage ownership. Proportionate Share indicates calculation based on lease or unit participation. Unit Formula indicates calculation per unit operating agreement. Custom indicates special calculation per lease terms or legal requirements.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Interest Calculation Standards

attributes.name: interest_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ownership interest type. WI (Working Interest) represents operational ownership and cost-bearing interest. NRI (Net Revenue Interest) represents the net share of production revenue after royalties. ORRI (Overriding Royalty Interest) represents a carved-out interest from working interest. Royalty represents landowner mineral rights interest. Mineral Interest represents subsurface mineral ownership. Leasehold Interest represents the lessee's interest in the lease.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Interest Type Classification

attributes.name: minimum_payment_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum dollar amount that must accumulate before a revenue payment is issued to the owner. Amounts below this threshold are carried forward to the next payment period. Typically set to reduce administrative costs for small interest holders.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Payment Threshold Standards

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user identifier or system account that last modified this division order record. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) - Record Retention and Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this division order record was last modified. Updated whenever any field in the record is changed. Used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) - Record Retention and Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: net_acres
attributes.description: The owner's net acreage interest calculated as gross acres multiplied by decimal interest. Represents the effective acreage ownership for revenue and reserve allocation purposes.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Reserves Allocation Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional information, special instructions, or clarifications regarding the division order. May include details about title issues, ownership complexities, payment instructions, or historical context.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Division Order Documentation Standards

attributes.name: owner_signature_date
attributes.description: The date on which the owner signed and returned the division order document. Used to track owner acknowledgment and agreement to the stated interest and terms. Nullable if owner signature is not required or not yet received.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Division Order Execution Standards

attributes.name: owner_signature_received_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a signed division order has been received from the owner. True when signed document is on file, false when signature is pending or not required. Some jurisdictions allow payment without signature after a statutory waiting period.
attributes.references: State Division Order Statutes - Signature Requirements

attributes.name: participating_area_acres
attributes.description: The acreage within the unit or lease that is allocated to this division order for production sharing purposes. Used in unit allocation calculations to determine proportionate share of unit production.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Unit Allocation Standards

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method by which revenue payments are distributed to the owner. ACH (Automated Clearing House) for electronic bank transfers, Wire Transfer for same-day electronic payments, Check for paper check mailing, Direct Deposit for recurring electronic deposits.
attributes.references: NACHA (National Automated Clearing House Association) - Payment Standards

attributes.name: percentage_interest
attributes.description: The owner's interest expressed as a percentage (e.g., 12.5000 for 12.5%). Derived from decimal_interest for reporting and display purposes. Stored separately for business user convenience.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Interest Reporting Standards

attributes.name: revenue_deck
attributes.description: The revenue distribution deck or payment group to which this division order is assigned. Used to batch and process revenue payments for owners with similar payment timing and processing requirements.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Revenue Distribution Standards

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number tracking changes to the division order. Incremented each time the division order is amended due to ownership changes, interest corrections, or title updates. Used for audit trail and historical tracking.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Division Order Amendment Standards

attributes.name: statutory_payment_date
attributes.description: The date after which payment may legally commence without owner signature, as defined by state division order statutes. Typically 120-180 days after division order is mailed to owner. Used to ensure compliance with state payment timing requirements.
attributes.references: State Division Order Statutes - Payment Timing Requirements

attributes.name: suspense_date
attributes.description: The date on which revenue payments were first placed in suspense. Used for aging analysis and regulatory compliance reporting of suspended funds.
attributes.references: State Unclaimed Property Laws - Suspense Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: suspense_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether revenue payments for this division order are currently held in suspense due to title defects, missing owner information, or legal disputes. True when payments are suspended, false when payments are being distributed normally.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Suspense Accounting Standards

attributes.name: suspense_reason
attributes.description: The business reason why revenue payments are held in suspense. Title Defect indicates unresolved ownership issues. Missing Tax ID indicates required tax documentation not provided. Address Unknown indicates inability to locate owner. Legal Dispute indicates litigation affecting ownership. Probate Pending indicates estate settlement in progress. Bankruptcy indicates owner in bankruptcy proceedings. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Title Defect|Missing Tax ID|Address Unknown|Legal Dispute|Probate Pending|Bankruptcy|Other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Suspense Reason Classification

attributes.name: tax_withholding_rate
attributes.description: The percentage rate at which federal or state income tax is withheld from revenue payments. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.24 for 24% withholding). Applied for non-resident owners or when required by tax regulations.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Service (IRS) - Withholding Tax Requirements

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which this division order ceases to be effective. Nullable for active, ongoing division orders. Populated when ownership changes, lease expires, or well is plugged and abandoned.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Division Order Termination Standards

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user identifier or system account that created this division order record. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) - Record Retention and Audit Trail Requirements

products.name: land_working_interest
products.description: Master record tracking ownership interests in a lease or well, including working interest (WI), overriding royalty interest (ORRI), and other non-royalty interests. For WI: captures the obligation to bear a proportionate share of exploration, development, and operating costs, WI owner (operator or non-operator), WI decimal fraction, NRI decimal fraction. For ORRI: captures non-cost-bearing interests carved from the working interest entitling the holder to a fraction of gross production revenue, ORRI holder, creation instrument, termination conditions (convertible, payout-based). Common attributes: interest type, decimal fraction, lease reference, well reference, effective date, assignment history reference, participation status, and current status. Supports JIB billing, AFE cost allocation, and interest chain-of-title tracking. Integrates with Quorum Land System.

attributes.name: land_working_interest_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the working interest record. Primary key for the working interest master data.

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.joa. Business justification: Working interest records reference the governing JOA for cost allocation, voting rights, and non-consent provisions. Joa_id links interest ownership to the operating agreement framework.

attributes.name: lease_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.lease. Business justification: A working interest record is fundamentally tied to a specific lease — it tracks WI, NRI, and ORRI ownership percentages for a given lease. Without a lease_id FK, land_working_interest is disconnected

attributes.name: pooling_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.pooling_unit. Business justification: Working interests can be defined at the pooling unit level (unitized interests) in addition to lease-level or well-level WI. When a lease is pooled into a unit, the WI is often redefined at the unit l

attributes.name: royalty_owner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party (operator or non-operator partner) who holds this working interest. Links to the joint venture partner or operator master record.

attributes.name: assignment_date
attributes.description: The date on which this working interest was assigned or transferred to the current owner. Used for chain-of-title tracking.

attributes.name: assignment_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the legal document that created or transferred this working interest. Used for title opinion and chain-of-title verification.

attributes.name: assignment_instrument_type
attributes.description: The type of legal instrument by which this working interest was created or transferred. Deed = mineral deed, Assignment = assignment of interest, Farmout = farmout agreement, Lease = oil and gas lease, PSA = Production Sharing Agreement, JOA = Joint Operating Agreement.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to this working interest. Used for operational context and exception handling.

attributes.name: conversion_trigger
attributes.description: The condition that triggers conversion of this interest to another type, if applicable. Payout = converts after payout, Time-Based = converts after a specified date, Production-Based = converts after cumulative production threshold, Event-Based = converts upon a specific event.

attributes.name: convertible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interest is convertible to another interest type (e.g., ORRI converts to WI after payout). True = convertible, False = not convertible.

attributes.name: cost_allocation_method
attributes.description: The method by which costs are allocated to this working interest. Proportionate = costs allocated by WI decimal, Non-Consent = non-consenting party penalty provisions apply, Penalty = penalty interest rate applies, Carried = costs borne by another party.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) Standards

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: The date on which this working interest record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: division_order_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this working interest is subject to division order processing for revenue distribution. True = division order applies, False = not subject to division order.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this working interest ownership becomes effective. Used for revenue and cost allocation calculations.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this working interest ownership expires or terminates, if applicable. Null for indefinite interests.

attributes.name: interest_number
attributes.description: Business identifier or reference number assigned to this working interest for tracking and reporting purposes. May be system-generated or externally assigned.

attributes.name: interest_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ownership interest type. WI = Working Interest (cost-bearing), ORRI = Overriding Royalty Interest (non-cost-bearing), NRI = Net Revenue Interest, RI = Royalty Interest, COPAS = COPAS-defined interest category.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, SPE Petroleum Resources Management System (PRMS)

attributes.name: jib_billing_code
attributes.description: The billing code used for Joint Interest Billing (JIB) cost allocation and invoicing for this working interest. Aligns with COPAS JIB standards.

attributes.name: land_working_interest_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the working interest record. Active = currently in effect, Inactive = not currently in effect, Suspended = temporarily suspended, Terminated = permanently ended, Pending = awaiting activation.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: The date on which this working interest record was last modified in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: nri_decimal
attributes.description: The decimal fraction representing the net revenue interest after deducting royalties, overriding royalties, and other burdens from the working interest. Represents the owner's share of revenue. Example: 0.1875 = 18.75% NRI.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, SEC Regulation S-X Rule 4-10

attributes.name: operator_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the interest owner is the designated operator of the lease or well. True = operator, False = non-operator partner.

attributes.name: orri_decimal
attributes.description: The decimal fraction representing the overriding royalty interest, if applicable. ORRI is a non-cost-bearing interest carved from the working interest. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: participation_status
attributes.description: Indicates the owner's participation status in operations and cost-bearing. Participating = actively bearing costs, Non-Participating = not bearing costs but retaining interest, Carried = costs borne by another party, Back-In = right to re-enter after payout, Farmed-Out = interest assigned to another party.
attributes.references: Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) Standards, COPAS Guidelines

attributes.name: payout_date
attributes.description: The date on which payout was achieved for this working interest, if applicable. Null if payout has not been reached or does not apply.

attributes.name: payout_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the working interest has reached payout (recovery of capital costs). Pre-Payout = costs not yet recovered, Post-Payout = costs recovered and interest may revert or change, Not-Applicable = payout provisions do not apply.

attributes.name: revenue_allocation_method
attributes.description: The method by which revenue is allocated to this working interest. Proportionate = revenue allocated by NRI decimal, Net = net of royalties and burdens, Gross = gross production share, Payout-Based = allocation changes after payout.

attributes.name: reversion_date
attributes.description: The date on which this working interest reverted or is scheduled to revert to another party, if applicable. Null if reversion has not occurred or does not apply.

attributes.name: reversion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this working interest is subject to reversion provisions (e.g., interest reverts to another party after payout or upon certain conditions). True = reversion applies, False = no reversion.

attributes.name: reversion_trigger
attributes.description: The condition that triggers reversion of this working interest, if applicable. Payout = reverts after payout, Time-Based = reverts after a specified date, Production-Based = reverts after cumulative production threshold, Event-Based = reverts upon a specific event.

attributes.name: royalty_decimal
attributes.description: The decimal fraction representing the landowner or mineral rights holder royalty interest burden on this working interest. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the source system from which this working interest record originated (e.g., Quorum Land System, SAP JV Accounting). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: suspense_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether revenue payments for this working interest are currently held in suspense due to title issues, missing documentation, or other administrative holds. True = in suspense, False = not in suspense.

attributes.name: suspense_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason revenue payments are held in suspense for this working interest, if applicable. Null if not in suspense.

attributes.name: termination_condition
attributes.description: Free-text description of the conditions under which this working interest terminates, if applicable. May reference payout, production thresholds, time limits, or other contractual provisions.

attributes.name: title_opinion_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the title opinion document that validates the chain-of-title for this working interest. Used for legal and compliance verification.

attributes.name: title_status
attributes.description: The current status of the title for this working interest. Clear = title is clear and marketable, Defective = title defects identified, Curative-Pending = curative work in progress, Disputed = title is under dispute.

attributes.name: wi_decimal
attributes.description: The decimal fraction representing the working interest ownership percentage. Represents the proportionate share of costs and gross production the owner is obligated to bear. Example: 0.25 = 25% WI.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, SEC Regulation S-X Rule 4-10

products.name: lease_acquisition
products.description: Transactional record capturing the business event of acquiring a new oil and gas lease, including negotiation details, bonus payment amount, per-acre bonus rate, broker/landman reference, acquisition date, prospect or play association, competitive bid status, and acquisition cost authorization. Tracks the full acquisition workflow from prospect identification through lease execution and recording. Supports CAPEX tracking for lease acquisition costs, acreage position building, and land department performance metrics.

attributes.name: lease_acquisition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the lease acquisition transaction. Primary key for the lease acquisition record.

attributes.name: afe_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.afe_budget. Business justification: Lease acquisitions are AFE line items (bonus, broker fees). Existing afe_number is denormalized; replace with FK to afe_budget for proper cost tracking and capital project linkage.

attributes.name: basin_id
attributes.description: FK to exploration.basin

attributes.name: broker_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Landmen and lease brokers are vendors providing acquisition services. Real procurement relationship for professional services. Role-prefixed to distinguish from lessor (not a vendor).

attributes.name: finance_afe_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_afe. Business justification: Lease acquisitions are capital projects requiring AFE authorization for budget control and JIB billing. The existing afe_number string should be replaced with proper FK to finance_afe for cost trackin

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.joa. Business justification: Lease acquisitions often occur within existing JOA frameworks. Joa_id tracks the governing agreement, enabling AFE allocation, partner consent tracking, and cost recovery under the JOA.

attributes.name: lease_id
attributes.description: Reference to the oil and gas lease that was acquired through this transaction. Links to the master lease record.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the lessor party record in the land system. Links to the mineral rights owner master data.

attributes.name: prospect_id
attributes.description: Reference to the exploration prospect or play that drove this lease acquisition. Links acquisition activity to upstream exploration strategy.

attributes.name: tract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.tract. Business justification: Lease acquisitions target specific tracts (land parcels). The acquisition record has county_name, state_code, gross_acres, net_acres that duplicate tract attributes. Adding tract_id FK normalizes thes

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date when the lease acquisition was executed and the lease rights were transferred to the company. Principal business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: acquisition_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the lease acquisition transaction. Externally-known reference number used in land department workflows and AFE tracking.

attributes.name: acquisition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the lease acquisition transaction. Tracks progression from initial prospect identification through final recording.

attributes.name: acquisition_type
attributes.description: Classification of the lease acquisition transaction type. Distinguishes between new lease acquisitions, extensions, renewals, assignments, and other acquisition methods.

attributes.name: bid_amount
attributes.description: Total bid amount submitted for competitive lease acquisitions. Null for non-competitive direct negotiations.

attributes.name: bonus_amount
attributes.description: Total upfront bonus payment made to the lessor for acquiring the lease rights. One-time payment at lease execution, typically expressed in total dollars.

attributes.name: bonus_per_acre
attributes.description: Bonus payment amount per gross acre. Key metric for evaluating acquisition cost competitiveness and land department performance.

attributes.name: broker_commission_amount
attributes.description: Commission paid to external broker for facilitating the lease acquisition. Null for direct acquisitions without broker involvement.

attributes.name: competitive_bid_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease was acquired through a competitive bidding process (true) or through direct negotiation (false). Relevant for federal and state lease sales.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the lease acquisition record was first created in the land system. Audit trail for data lineage and record creation tracking.

attributes.name: delay_rental_amount
attributes.description: Annual delay rental payment amount required to maintain the lease during the primary term without drilling. May be per-acre or total amount.

attributes.name: depth_rights_from_ft
attributes.description: Minimum depth in feet below surface for which mineral rights were acquired. Defines the top of the depth interval covered by the lease.

attributes.name: depth_rights_to_ft
attributes.description: Maximum depth in feet below surface for which mineral rights were acquired. Defines the bottom of the depth interval covered by the lease. Null indicates rights to all depths.

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date when the lease agreement was signed by all parties. Distinct from acquisition date, which may be the effective date specified in the lease.

attributes.name: formation_target
attributes.description: Primary geologic formation or reservoir target for the lease acquisition. Identifies the stratigraphic interval of interest for exploration and development.

attributes.name: lease_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the lease primary term expires if production has not commenced. Critical date for lease expiry management and drilling obligation tracking.
attributes.references: Quorum Land System - Lease Expiry Tracking

attributes.name: negotiation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when lease acquisition negotiations commenced with the lessor. Tracks the duration of the acquisition workflow from initial contact to execution.

attributes.name: net_revenue_interest_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of net revenue interest acquired in the lease. Represents the company's share of production revenue after royalty and overriding royalty deductions.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional details about the lease acquisition, including special terms, negotiation history, or unique conditions.

attributes.name: primary_term_years
attributes.description: Duration of the lease primary term in years. Period during which the lease remains valid without production, typically 3-5 years for oil and gas leases.

attributes.name: pugh_clause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease contains a Pugh clause that releases unproductive acreage at the end of the primary term. Important for lease retention and acreage management.

attributes.name: recording_date
attributes.description: Date when the lease was officially recorded in the county or parish land records. Establishes legal priority and public notice.

attributes.name: recording_reference
attributes.description: Official recording reference number or book and page citation from the county land records. Enables retrieval of the recorded lease document.

attributes.name: royalty_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of production revenue reserved for the lessor as royalty. Standard royalty burden negotiated in the lease agreement.

attributes.name: surface_use_agreement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a separate surface use agreement was negotiated with the surface owner. Relevant when mineral and surface rights are severed.
attributes.references: Quorum Land System - Surface Rights Management

attributes.name: title_opinion_date
attributes.description: Date when the title opinion was issued certifying the lessor's ownership of mineral rights. Critical for validating lease enforceability.

attributes.name: total_acquisition_cost

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the lease acquisition record was last modified. Audit trail for data lineage and change tracking.

attributes.name: working_interest_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of working interest acquired in the lease. Represents the company's share of costs and production before royalty deductions.

products.name: lease_expiry
products.description: Tracks lease expiration events, extension actions, and held-by-production (HBP) status for all active leases. Captures primary term expiration date, extension option terms, delay rental due dates, rental amounts, HBP well references, continuous drilling clause requirements, Pugh clause applicability, and expiry action taken (renewed, released, extended, HBP confirmed). Critical for acreage management and avoiding inadvertent lease expirations. Supports automated expiry alert workflows.
products.reference: Quorum Land System — Lease Expiry Management

attributes.name: lease_expiry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the lease expiry event record.

attributes.name: lease_id
attributes.description: Reference to the lease agreement that is subject to expiry tracking.

attributes.name: production_well_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.production_well. Business justification: HBP (held-by-production) lease status is determined by whether a specific well is producing. lease_expiry tracks hbp_well_api_number as a plain denormalized attribute — replacing with FK to production

attributes.name: well_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the well that is holding the lease by production. Null if lease is not HBP or if multiple wells hold the lease.

attributes.name: acreage_at_risk
attributes.description: The total acreage (gross or net) that is at risk of being lost if the lease expires without renewal, extension, or HBP confirmation.

attributes.name: alert_notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which an automated alert notification was sent to stakeholders regarding the upcoming lease expiry.

attributes.name: alert_notification_recipient
attributes.description: The email address or user identifier of the recipient(s) who received the expiry alert notification.

attributes.name: continuous_drilling_clause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease contains a continuous drilling clause requiring ongoing drilling activity to maintain the lease.

attributes.name: continuous_drilling_deadline
attributes.description: The deadline by which the next well must be spudded to satisfy the continuous drilling clause requirements. Null if no continuous drilling clause applies.

attributes.name: delay_rental_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount of delay rental payment required per acre or per lease to extend the primary term.

attributes.name: delay_rental_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the delay rental amount (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP).

attributes.name: delay_rental_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which delay rental payment must be made to extend the lease for another year during the primary term.

attributes.name: estimated_reserves_at_risk_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Reserves At Risk Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: The estimated proved or probable reserves (in barrels of oil equivalent) that could be lost if the lease expires without being held by production or extended.

attributes.name: expiry_action_date
attributes.description: The date on which the expiry action was taken or is scheduled to be taken.

attributes.name: expiry_action_responsible_party
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the land professional or team responsible for managing the expiry action.

attributes.name: expiry_action_taken
attributes.description: The action taken or planned in response to the lease expiry event: renewed (new lease executed), released (lease terminated), extended (option exercised), HBP confirmed (held by production), under review, or pending decision.

attributes.name: expiry_event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the type of expiry event being tracked: primary term expiration, extension period expiration, option deadline, continuous drilling clause deadline, or Pugh clause partial release.

attributes.name: expiry_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context, decisions, or special circumstances related to the lease expiry event.

attributes.name: extension_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which an extension period expires if an extension option has been exercised. Null if no extension is in effect.

attributes.name: extension_option_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lessee has an option to extend the lease term beyond the primary term expiry.

attributes.name: extension_option_exercise_deadline
attributes.description: The deadline by which the lessee must exercise the extension option to extend the lease term. Null if no extension option exists.

attributes.name: extension_option_payment_amount
attributes.description: The payment amount required to exercise the extension option, typically expressed per acre or as a lump sum.

attributes.name: extension_option_term_years
attributes.description: The number of years by which the lease can be extended if the extension option is exercised. Null if no extension option exists.

attributes.name: hbp_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease is currently held by production, meaning it has producing wells that keep the lease valid beyond the primary term.
attributes.references: Oil and Gas Lease Law - HBP Doctrine

attributes.name: hbp_verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which HBP status was last verified through production records or well test data.

attributes.name: lease_bonus_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the lease bonus amount (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP).

attributes.name: lease_bonus_paid
attributes.description: The total lease bonus amount paid at lease acquisition, representing the sunk cost at risk if the lease is allowed to expire.

attributes.name: net_revenue_interest_at_risk
attributes.description: The net revenue interest percentage that is at risk of being lost if the lease expires, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.75 for 75%).

attributes.name: primary_term_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the primary term of the lease expires, after which the lease must be held by production or extended to remain valid.

attributes.name: pugh_clause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease contains a Pugh clause that allows partial release of non-producing acreage at the end of the primary term.

attributes.name: pugh_clause_release_date
attributes.description: The date on which non-producing acreage is scheduled to be released under the Pugh clause provisions. Null if no Pugh clause or no release pending.

attributes.name: pugh_clause_type
attributes.description: Specifies the type of Pugh clause: horizontal (acreage-based), vertical (depth-based), both, or none if no Pugh clause exists.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this lease expiry record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this expiry tracking record: active (monitoring ongoing), resolved (action completed), cancelled (no longer applicable), or archived (historical record).

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this lease expiry record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the required regulatory filing was submitted or is scheduled to be submitted. Null if no filing is required.
attributes.references: BOEM / State Oil and Gas Commission Regulations

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a regulatory filing or notification is required with state or federal agencies upon lease expiry or release.
attributes.references: BOEM / State Oil and Gas Commission Regulations

attributes.name: working_interest_at_risk
attributes.description: The working interest percentage that is at risk of being lost if the lease expires, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.875 for 87.5%).

products.name: delay_rental
products.description: Transactional record for delay rental payments made to lessors to maintain a lease in force during the primary term before drilling commences. Captures rental due date, rental amount, payment date, payment method, lessor payee, lease reference, rental period covered, and payment confirmation status. Delay rentals are a contractual obligation — missed payments can result in lease termination. Integrates with accounts payable for payment processing.

attributes.name: delay_rental_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the delay rental payment transaction. Primary key for the delay rental record.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Reference to the operating company responsible for making the delay rental payment on behalf of working interest owners.

attributes.name: gl_account_id

attributes.name: lease_id
attributes.description: Reference to the oil and gas lease agreement for which this delay rental payment is made. Links to the lease master record.

attributes.name: royalty_owner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mineral rights owner or lessor who receives the delay rental payment. Links to the party master record.

attributes.name: acreage_covered
attributes.description: The total number of acres covered by this delay rental payment. May differ from total lease acreage if partial acreage is being held.

attributes.name: afe_number
attributes.description: The AFE number under which this delay rental payment is authorized and budgeted. Links the payment to capital or operating budget approval.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the delay rental payment was approved for processing by the authorized approver or land department.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The accounting cost center or business unit code to which this delay rental expense is charged for financial reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this delay rental payment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: drilling_commenced_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether drilling operations have commenced on the lease. Once drilling begins, delay rental obligations typically cease.

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after the rental due date during which payment can still be made without lease termination, as specified in the lease agreement.

attributes.name: jib_statement_number
attributes.description: The JIB statement number if this delay rental payment is being billed to non-operating working interest partners for their proportionate share.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this delay rental payment record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: late_payment_penalty_amount
attributes.description: Additional penalty amount assessed for delay rental payments made after the due date, if specified in the lease agreement.

attributes.name: lease_primary_term_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the lease is currently in its primary term. Delay rentals are only applicable during the primary term before drilling commences.

attributes.name: lease_termination_risk_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that the delay rental payment is overdue and the lease is at risk of automatic termination per lease terms.

attributes.name: payee_name
attributes.description: The legal name of the lessor or designated payee receiving the delay rental payment. May differ from lessor if payment is assigned.

attributes.name: payment_confirmation_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the payment has been successfully delivered and cleared with the lessor or financial institution.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the delay rental payment was made or is scheduled to be made. Critical for determining lease continuation compliance.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The financial instrument or mechanism used to make the delay rental payment to the lessor.

attributes.name: payment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the delay rental payment, including special circumstances, disputes, or payment arrangements.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number from the payment system (check number, wire confirmation, ACH trace number) that confirms the payment transaction.

attributes.name: rental_amount
attributes.description: The total monetary amount of the delay rental payment due to the lessor. Typically calculated as dollars per acre per year as specified in the lease agreement.

attributes.name: rental_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the delay rental payment amount. Typically USD for United States operations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USD|CAD|GBP|EUR|MXN|BRL|AUD — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: rental_due_date
attributes.description: The contractual date by which the delay rental payment must be made to maintain the lease in force. Missing this date can result in automatic lease termination per lease terms.

attributes.name: rental_payment_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the delay rental payment transaction. Used for external reference and tracking in accounts payable systems.

attributes.name: rental_period_end_date
attributes.description: The ending date of the lease period covered by this delay rental payment. Defines the coverage window for the rental obligation.

attributes.name: rental_period_start_date
attributes.description: The beginning date of the lease period covered by this delay rental payment. Typically aligns with the lease anniversary date.

attributes.name: rental_rate_per_acre
attributes.description: The contractual delay rental rate per acre as specified in the lease agreement. Used to calculate the total rental amount based on leased acreage.

attributes.name: rental_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the delay rental payment. Tracks whether the payment obligation has been fulfilled, is pending, or has issues.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system from which this delay rental record originated (e.g., Quorum Land System, SAP, custom land management system).

attributes.name: working_interest_decimal
attributes.description: The working interest ownership percentage (expressed as decimal) responsible for this delay rental payment. Used when multiple working interest owners share rental obligations.

products.name: surface_use_agreement
products.description: Master record for all surface access agreements including surface use agreements (SUAs) and right-of-way (ROW) easements. For SUAs: covers agreements with surface owners to permit access for drilling, facility installation, and operations. For ROWs: covers pipeline, road, and utility easements granting passage across surface tracts. Common attributes: agreement type (SUA, pipeline ROW, road ROW, utility ROW), grantor/surface owner, tract reference, permitted activities, compensation terms (one-time payment, annual rental, damage payments, per-rod rate), term (fixed or perpetual), easement dimensions (width, length for ROW), reclamation obligations, restricted areas, regulatory filing reference, and agreement status. Distinct from mineral lease — surface rights and mineral rights may be severed. Required for regulatory permitting, HSE compliance, and pipeline operations.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the surface use agreement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: afe_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.afe_budget. Business justification: Surface damages and easement compensation are AFE costs charged to drilling/facility projects. Standard upstream cost allocation for surface rights acquisition tied to capital budgets.

attributes.name: lease_id

attributes.name: primary_surface_grantor_party_id
attributes.description: FK to land.party

attributes.name: tract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the surface tract or parcel covered by this agreement. Links to the land tract master record.

attributes.name: vendor_id

attributes.name: access_restrictions

attributes.name: agreement_type

Surface Use Agreement (SUA) covers drilling and facility operations; Pipeline ROW, Road ROW, and Utility ROW cover linear easements; Access Easement covers general access rights; Temporary Workspace covers short-term construction areas.
attributes.references: API RP 51R - Onshore Oil and Gas Recommended Practice for Land Management

attributes.name: annual_rental_amount
attributes.description: Annual recurring rental payment to the grantor. Applicable when compensation type is annual rental. Null for one-time or per-rod compensation.

attributes.name: compensation_amount

attributes.name: compensation_currency

attributes.name: compensation_type
attributes.description: Method by which the grantor is compensated for surface access. One-time payment: lump sum at signing; Annual rental: recurring annual fee; Per-rod rate: payment per linear rod of easement; Damage payment: compensation for crop or property damage; No compensation: granted without payment.
attributes.references: Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies (COPAS) - Joint Interest Billing Standards

attributes.name: country_code

attributes.name: county

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: damage_payment_terms

attributes.name: easement_length_ft

attributes.name: easement_width_ft

attributes.name: expiration_date

domains.name: venture
domains.description: Manages joint operating agreements (JOA), production sharing agreements (PSA), farm-in/farm-out arrangements, and partner relationships. Owns partner equity positions, working interest registers, AFE approvals, joint interest billing (JIB), cost recovery tracking, profit oil/gas splits, partner netting, and cash call management. Supports COPAS accounting standards and SEC partner disclosure. Integrates with SAP Joint Venture Accounting.

products.name: joa
products.description: Master record for Joint Operating Agreements governing co-ownership and operational responsibilities among working interest partners for a specific asset, block, or contract area. Captures JOA type, effective/expiry dates, governing law, operator designation, non-operator rights, voting thresholds for ordinary and special resolutions, default and forfeiture provisions, COPAS accounting election (2005/2019), overhead rate method, and amendment history. Serves as the foundational legal instrument linking all joint venture cost sharing, revenue allocation, AFE approvals, and partner governance in the venture domain.
products.reference: Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) — AAPL Model Form 610

attributes.name: cash_call_frequency

attributes.name: confidentiality_provision

attributes.name: copas_election

attributes.name: default_provision

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_method

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: expiry_date

attributes.name: governing_law

attributes.name: hse_standard

attributes.name: insurance_requirement

attributes.name: interest_rate_late_payment_pct

attributes.name: last_amendment_date

attributes.name: overhead_rate_value

attributes.name: payment_terms_days

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: transfer_restriction

attributes.name: voting_threshold_ordinary_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of working interest votes required to approve ordinary resolutions and routine operational decisions under the Joint Operating Agreement.

attributes.name: voting_threshold_special_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of working interest votes required to approve special resolutions, major capital expenditures, or strategic decisions under the Joint Operating Agreement.

attributes.name: created_by
