products.name: psa
products.description: Master record for Production Sharing Agreements (or Production Sharing Contracts) between a host government or National Oil Company and one or more international/independent E&P partners. Captures PSA type, contract area, effective/expiry dates, cost recovery ceiling percentage, profit oil/gas split tiers (R-factor or production-based), royalty rates, signature bonus, state participation percentage, relinquishment schedule, minimum work obligations, stabilization clauses, ring-fencing rules, and governing jurisdiction. SSOT for all PSA-level entitlement, cost recovery, and profit split calculations.

attributes.name: psa_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Production Sharing Agreement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: operating_license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.operating_license. Business justification: PSAs reference specific licensed contract areas and must comply with operating license terms, production capacity limits, and regulatory conditions. License number is typically cited in PSA documentat

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: PSAs are fiscal regimes that map to profit centers for segment reporting and regulatory disclosure. Required for international upstream operations to track contractor vs government entitlements by con

attributes.name: psa_operator_partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the partner entity designated as the operator for this PSA. The operator manages day-to-day operations and is typically the largest working interest holder.

attributes.name: psa_venture_partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the National Oil Company or host government entity that is the counterparty to this PSA.

attributes.name: arbitration_forum
attributes.description: Designated arbitration body or forum for dispute resolution (e.g., International Chamber of Commerce, London Court of International Arbitration, UNCITRAL). Specifies the mechanism for resolving contractual disputes.

attributes.name: contract_area
attributes.description: Geographic description or block designation of the exploration and production area covered by this PSA. May reference offshore blocks, onshore concessions, or field names.
attributes.references: BOEM (Bureau of Ocean Energy Management) - Lease Area Standards

attributes.name: contractor_profit_share_percent
attributes.description: Base percentage of profit oil/gas allocated to contractors after cost recovery. Used when profit_oil_split_method is fixed_percentage. For tiered or R-factor methods, this represents the initial or minimum contractor share.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - PSA Accounting Standards

attributes.name: cost_recovery_carryforward_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether unrecovered costs from prior periods may be carried forward to future periods for recovery. True means contractors can accumulate cost pools; False means costs not recovered in a period are forfeited.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - PSA Accounting Standards

attributes.name: cost_recovery_ceiling_percent
attributes.description: Maximum percentage of gross production (in value terms) that contractors may recover as cost oil/gas in any given period. Typical range is 40-80%. Prevents excessive cost recovery in high-production periods.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - PSA Accounting Standards

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this PSA record in the system. Used for audit and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PSA record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which financial terms (bonuses, expenditure commitments, cost recovery) are denominated. Typically USD for international PSAs.

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Method used to depreciate capital expenditures for cost recovery purposes. Unit of production ties depreciation to actual production volumes. Immediate expensing allows full cost recovery in the period incurred.
attributes.references: IFRS 6 - Exploration for and Evaluation of Mineral Resources / COPAS Standards

attributes.name: development_period_years
attributes.description: Duration in years allocated for the development and production phase. May be extended based on field life and economic production thresholds.

attributes.name: domestic_market_obligation_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of contractor entitlement that must be sold to the domestic market at a regulated or discounted price. Common in PSAs to ensure host country energy security. Also known as DMO.
attributes.references: Host Government Energy Policy / OPEC Guidelines

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the PSA terms become binding and cost recovery and entitlement calculations commence. May differ from signature date pending government approvals.

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_standard
attributes.description: Reference to the environmental, health, and safety (EHS) standards and regulations that contractors must comply with under this PSA. May reference host country regulations, international standards (ISO 14001), or lender requirements (Equator Principles).
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management / EPA Standards / Host Country EHS Regulations

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the PSA contract term ends, unless extended by mutual agreement or automatic extension clauses. Nullable for contracts with indefinite terms subject to production thresholds.

attributes.name: exploration_period_years
attributes.description: Duration in years allocated for the exploration phase under the PSA. During this period, contractors conduct seismic surveys, drilling, and appraisal activities.

attributes.name: governing_law_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Legal jurisdiction and governing law that applies to the interpretation and enforcement of the PSA. Typically the host country law, but may reference international arbitration frameworks.

attributes.name: government_profit_share_percent
attributes.description: Base percentage of profit oil/gas allocated to the host government after cost recovery. Used when profit_oil_split_method is fixed_percentage. For tiered or R-factor methods, this represents the initial or maximum government share.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - PSA Accounting Standards

attributes.name: host_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the host government or jurisdiction where the PSA is executed.

attributes.name: local_content_requirement_percent
attributes.description: Minimum percentage of goods, services, and workforce that must be sourced locally from the host country. Used to promote local economic development and employment.

attributes.name: minimum_expenditure_commitment
attributes.description: Minimum capital expenditure (CAPEX) amount that contractors must invest during the exploration period to satisfy work obligations. Expressed in USD. Non-compliance may trigger penalties or contract termination.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - PSA Accounting Standards

attributes.name: minimum_work_obligation
attributes.description: Description of the minimum exploration and appraisal work commitments (e.g., seismic surveys, number of wells to be drilled) that contractors must complete during the exploration period. Failure to meet obligations may result in penalties or relinquishment.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this PSA record. Used for audit and accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PSA record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: production_bonus_amount
attributes.description: Payment amount due to the host government when the production_bonus_threshold_bopd is achieved. May be recoverable as cost oil depending on PSA terms. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - PSA Accounting Standards

attributes.name: production_bonus_threshold_bopd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Production Bonus Threshold Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD)
attributes.description: Daily production threshold in barrels of oil per day (BOPD) or barrel of oil equivalent (BOE) that triggers a production bonus payment to the host government. Multiple tiers may exist; this represents the first or primary threshold.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - PSA Accounting Standards

attributes.name: profit_oil_split_method
attributes.description: Methodology used to determine the split of profit oil/gas between the host government and contractors. R-factor is cumulative revenue divided by cumulative costs. Production tier is based on daily or cumulative production volumes. Sliding scale adjusts split based on field profitability.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - PSA Accounting Standards

attributes.name: psa_name
attributes.description: The business name or title of the PSA, typically referencing the contract area or field name.

attributes.name: psa_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique contract number or identifier assigned to this PSA by the host government or National Oil Company (NOC). Used for legal reference and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: psa_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the PSA. Active indicates the contract is in force and production/cost recovery is occurring. Suspended or force majeure indicates temporary halt. Terminated or expired indicates contract end. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|negotiation|executed|active|suspended|force_majeure|terminated|expired — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: relinquishment_schedule
attributes.description: Description of the phased relinquishment of contract area that contractors must return to the host government over the exploration and development periods. Typically expressed as percentage of area to be relinquished at specific milestones.
attributes.references: BOEM (Bureau of Ocean Energy Management) - Lease Relinquishment Standards

attributes.name: ring_fencing_rule
attributes.description: Defines whether cost recovery and profit calculations are performed at the contract level (all fields aggregated), field level (each field independent), or block level. Ring fencing prevents cross-subsidization of costs between profitable and unprofitable areas.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - PSA Accounting Standards

attributes.name: royalty_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of gross production paid to the host government as royalty before cost recovery and profit split. Typically ranges from 5-20%. Royalty is deducted from gross production before calculating cost oil and profit oil.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - PSA Accounting Standards

attributes.name: signature_bonus_amount
attributes.description: One-time upfront payment made by contractors to the host government upon signing the PSA. Typically non-recoverable as cost oil. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - PSA Accounting Standards

attributes.name: signature_date
attributes.description: The date on which the PSA was formally signed by all parties. Used for legal and audit purposes.

attributes.name: stabilization_clause
attributes.description: Legal provision that protects contractors from adverse changes in host government fiscal or regulatory terms during the PSA term. Describes the scope and duration of fiscal stability guarantees.

attributes.name: state_participation_percent
attributes.description: Percentage equity participation by the host government or NOC in the contractor group. State participation entitles the government to a share of contractor entitlement and obligates them to fund their proportionate share of costs. Also known as carried interest if the state does not fund costs.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - PSA Accounting Standards

attributes.name: training_and_technology_transfer_obligation
attributes.description: Description of contractor obligations to provide training, capacity building, and technology transfer to host country nationals and institutions. May include scholarship programs, technical training, and knowledge sharing.

products.name: partner
products.description: Master record for each legal entity participating in a joint venture, JOA, or PSA. Captures partner legal name, entity type (IOC, NOC, independent, government), country of incorporation, API partner code, SAP vendor/partner number, contact details, credit rating, and partner classification. Prefixed 'venture_' to avoid collision with the customer domain's counterparty records. SSOT for partner identity within the venture domain.

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Primary key for partner

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Operating partners and major non-operators are legal entities with company codes for intercompany JIB settlements, netting transactions, and consolidated financial reporting. Required for intercompany

attributes.name: primary_regulatory_authority_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_authority. Business justification: Partners must register with and report to regulatory authorities in their primary jurisdiction of operation. Used for tracking partner compliance status, KYC requirements, and regulatory standing. Ess

attributes.name: annual_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Most recent annual revenue of the partner organization in the specified currency. Used for partner financial strength assessment and credit risk evaluation.

attributes.name: annual_revenue_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the annual revenue amount.

attributes.name: api_partner_code
attributes.description: Standardized partner identifier assigned by the American Petroleum Institute for industry-wide partner identification and data exchange.

attributes.name: classification
attributes.description: Functional role of the partner in joint venture operations. Operator manages day-to-day operations; non-operator holds interest but does not operate; working interest owner bears proportionate costs; royalty owner receives revenue without cost burden; overriding royalty owner holds carved-out interest; area of mutual interest indicates exploration partnership.

attributes.name: country_of_incorporation
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the jurisdiction where the partner entity is legally incorporated.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this partner master record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding balance allowed for the partner before requiring prepayment or additional security under joint interest billing terms.

attributes.name: credit_limit_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the credit limit amount.

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: External credit rating assigned by a recognized rating agency (e.g., Moodys, S&P, Fitch). Used for partner risk assessment, cash call management, and default provisions in JOA.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines; JOA Model Form

attributes.name: default_interest_rate_percent
attributes.description: Annual interest rate applied to overdue balances when partner fails to remit payment within payment terms, as specified in the JOA.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines; JOA Model Form

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit unique identifier assigned by Dun & Bradstreet for business entity identification and credit assessment.

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the partner organization. IOC = International Oil Company, NOC = National Oil Company, independent = independent producer, government = government entity, private_equity = financial investor, service_company = oilfield service provider.

attributes.name: is_government_entity
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the partner is a government or state-owned entity. True = government entity; False = private entity. Used for PSA compliance and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: is_operator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this partner serves as the operator for any joint venture properties. True = partner is an operator; False = partner is non-operator only.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines; JOA Model Form

attributes.name: kyc_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent Know Your Customer due diligence process was completed for this partner, including identity verification, beneficial ownership disclosure, and sanctions screening.
attributes.references: Financial Action Task Force (FATF) Recommendations; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: kyc_review_due_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Know Your Customer (KYC) Review Due Date
attributes.description: Date when the next periodic KYC review is required for this partner to maintain compliance with anti-money laundering and sanctions regulations.
attributes.references: Financial Action Task Force (FATF) Recommendations; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this partner master record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the partner entity as registered with the governing jurisdiction. Used for contract execution, regulatory filings, and SEC partner disclosure.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K Item 102; COPAS MFR-2

attributes.name: partner_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the partner relationship. Active = participating in operations; inactive = no current participation; suspended = temporarily restricted; defaulted = failed to meet payment obligations; withdrawn = exited joint venture.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines; JOA Model Form

attributes.name: partnership_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the partner exited all joint venture relationships with the company, either through sale of interest, withdrawal, or termination. Null for active partners.

attributes.name: partnership_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the partner first entered into a joint venture, JOA, or PSA relationship with the company. Used for partner tenure analysis and relationship management.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Standard number of days allowed for partner to remit payment after joint interest billing invoice date, as defined in the JOA or PSA.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines; JOA Model Form

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary business contact for operational correspondence, AFE distribution, and joint interest billing communications.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact for joint venture operations, AFE approvals, and partner communications.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Telephone number of the primary business contact for urgent operational matters and partner coordination.

attributes.name: registered_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the partners registered legal address as filed with the incorporation jurisdiction.

attributes.name: registered_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the partners registered legal address (suite, floor, building name).

attributes.name: registered_city
attributes.description: City of the partners registered legal address.

attributes.name: registered_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the partners registered legal address.

attributes.name: registered_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the partners registered legal address.

attributes.name: registered_state_province

attributes.name: wi_percentage

SSOT for AFE lifecycle management.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: AFEs for drilling, completion, and facility operations require permits (APD, air quality, water discharge, ROW). Linking AFE to permit enables tracking of permit compliance for authorized work program

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.project. Business justification: Venture AFEs represent work authorizations that are organized under capital projects for multi-year program tracking. Finance.project is the master project hierarchy. Standard project accounting integ

attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the legal entity acting as operator for this AFE. The operator is responsible for executing the work program and billing partners per their working interest.

attributes.name: actual_cost_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative actual expenditure incurred against this AFE as of the last accounting period close. Used to monitor spending against the approved budget and trigger variance reporting.

attributes.name: afe_number
attributes.description: The externally-known business identifier for the AFE, typically formatted per operator standards and shared with Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) partners for approval and billing reference.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, JOA Standard Form

attributes.name: afe_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the AFE. Draft indicates initial preparation; Submitted indicates sent to partners for approval; Approved indicates partner consent received; In Progress indicates work has commenced; Completed indicates work finished; Closed indicates final accounting reconciliation complete. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Draft|Submitted|Approved|Rejected|In Progress|Completed|Closed|Cancelled — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: afe_type
attributes.description: Classification of the AFE by expenditure category. CAPEX represents capital expenditure for long-term assets; OPEX represents operating expenditure for ongoing operations; Drilling, Workover, Facility, and Seismic represent specific work program types.

attributes.name: approval_deadline_date
attributes.description: The date by which partners must respond with approval or objection per the JOA approval process. Silence after this date may constitute deemed approval depending on JOA terms.

attributes.name: approval_threshold_amount
attributes.description: The monetary threshold defined in the JOA above which partner approval is required for this AFE. AFEs below this threshold may be approved by the operator without explicit partner consent.

attributes.name: authorization_level
attributes.description: The organizational approval level required for this AFE based on its size and risk profile. Higher-value or higher-risk AFEs require escalation to senior management or board approval.

attributes.name: billing_method
attributes.description: The method by which partners will be billed for this AFE. Actual indicates billing based on actual costs incurred; Estimate indicates billing based on the approved estimate; Turnkey indicates a fixed-price arrangement.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, clarifications, or special instructions related to this AFE. Used for communication between operator and partners.

attributes.name: contingency_amount
attributes.description: Additional budget allowance added to the operator estimate to cover unforeseen costs, typically expressed as a percentage of the base estimate and included in the total AFE authorization.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this AFE record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for audit trail and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this AFE (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR, CAD).

attributes.name: final_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the AFE received final approval from all required partners or was deemed approved per JOA terms, authorizing the operator to commence work.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the individual who last modified this AFE record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this AFE record was last modified in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: non_consent_election_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether any partner elected to go non-consent on this AFE per JOA provisions, forfeiting their working interest in the project in exchange for avoiding the expenditure.

attributes.name: operator_estimate_amount
attributes.description: The operator's estimated total cost for the work program before contingency, expressed in the AFE currency. This is the base cost estimate submitted to partners for approval.

attributes.name: overhead_rate_percent
attributes.description: The percentage rate applied to direct costs to recover indirect costs and overhead per the JOA and COPAS accounting procedures. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 5.00 for 5%).
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, JOA Standard Form

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: Operator's assessment of the technical, operational, or financial risk associated with this AFE work program. Used for partner evaluation and internal risk management.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the AFE was formally submitted to JOA partners for review and approval. Starts the approval clock per JOA terms.

attributes.name: supplemental_afe_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supplemental Authorization for Expenditure (AFE) Required Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether a supplemental AFE is required due to cost overruns exceeding the approved contingency or scope changes requiring additional partner approval.
attributes.references: JOA Standard Form, COPAS Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: total_approved_amount
attributes.description: The final authorized expenditure limit approved by JOA partners, including operator estimate plus contingency. This is the spending authority granted to the operator for the work program.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The difference between actual cost to date and the total approved amount. Positive variance indicates overspend; negative variance indicates underspend. Material variances may require supplemental AFE approval.

attributes.name: work_start_date

Adding venture_working_interest_id links the approval to the

attributes.name: approval_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to the formal approval document, email, or correspondence submitted by the partner. Enables retrieval of source documentation for audit and dispute resolution purposes.

attributes.description: Current status of the partner's response to the AFE. attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the partner's approval response was received or recorded in the system. Provides audit trail for time-sensitive consent tracking and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines - Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: approved_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount approved by the partner for this AFE, expressed in the AFE's functional currency. May differ from the requested amount if partner approves a reduced scope or applies a cap. Null if status is rejected or pending.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines - AFE Approval Tracking

attributes.name: approved_amount_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the approved amount (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Ensures proper currency handling in multi-currency joint venture environments.

attributes.name: cash_call_issued_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a cash call has been issued to this partner for their share of the approved AFE. True if cash call issued; false otherwise. Links AFE approval to downstream billing processes.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines - Cash Call Management

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional comments, notes, or clarifications provided by the partner or operator regarding the approval decision. May include context for conditional approvals, clarifications on scope, or internal notes for tracking purposes.

attributes.name: conditions_attached
attributes.description: Specific conditions, modifications, or stipulations attached by the partner to their conditional approval. May include cost caps, scope changes, milestone requirements, or additional reporting obligations. Null if approval is unconditional or status is rejected/pending.
attributes.references: Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) - Conditional Consent Provisions

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp indicating when this AFE approval record was first created in the joint venture accounting system. Provides audit trail for record lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: SOX - Internal Controls and Audit Trail

attributes.name: deemed_consent_applied
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether deemed consent provisions were applied to this partner due to failure to respond within the JOA-mandated timeframe. True if deemed consent was invoked; false otherwise. Deemed consent treats non-response as approval per JOA terms.
attributes.references: Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) - Deemed Consent Provisions

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: Current escalation status for non-responsive partners. Tracks the progression of follow-up actions taken by the operator to obtain partner response, from initial reminders through deemed consent application or legal review.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp indicating when this AFE approval record was last updated or modified. Tracks changes to approval status, amounts, or conditions over time for audit and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: SOX - Internal Controls and Audit Trail

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who last modified this AFE approval record. Provides accountability and audit trail for data changes in the joint venture accounting system.
attributes.references: SOX - Internal Controls and Audit Trail

attributes.name: non_consent_election
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the partner formally elected non-consent status for this AFE per JOA non-consent provisions. True if partner elected non-consent; false otherwise. Non-consenting partners forfeit participation rights but avoid cost exposure, subject to JOA penalty provisions.

attributes.name: partner_share_amount
attributes.description: The calculated monetary amount representing this partner's proportionate share of the total AFE cost based on their working interest percentage. Used for joint interest billing (JIB) and cash call preparation.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines - Joint Interest Billing

attributes.name: rejection_category
attributes.description: Standardized classification of the rejection reason for reporting and trend analysis. Enables operator to identify common objection patterns and improve AFE quality.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation provided by the partner for rejecting the AFE or electing non-consent. May include technical concerns, cost objections, strategic misalignment, or procedural issues. Null if status is approved or pending.

attributes.name: response_due_date
attributes.description: The deadline date by which the partner must submit their approval or rejection response per JOA provisions. Used to track overdue responses and trigger escalation procedures for non-responsive partners.

attributes.name: response_overdue_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the partner's response is overdue based on the response due date. True if current date exceeds due date and status is still pending; false otherwise. Triggers escalation and deemed-consent evaluation per JOA.
attributes.references: Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) - Deemed Consent Provisions

attributes.name: voting_threshold_met
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the cumulative working interest of all approving partners (including this approval) meets or exceeds the JOA-mandated voting threshold for this AFE type. True if threshold is met; false otherwise. Calculated field updated as approvals are received.

products.name: jib_statement
products.description: Joint Interest Billing (JIB) statement issued by the operator to non-operating partners for their proportionate share of joint account costs. Captures billing period, statement date, total joint costs, each partner's WI allocation, prior period adjustments, overhead charges, and SAP JVA document reference. Conforms to COPAS billing standards. SSOT for partner cost billing in the venture domain.

attributes.name: jib_statement_id
attributes.description: Primary key for jib_statement

attributes.name: asset_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific facility to which the costs in this Joint Interest Billing statement are attributed, if applicable.

attributes.name: block_id

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.contract. Business justification: JIB statements often allocate costs under specific master contracts (drilling services, facility operations). COPAS audits require contract traceability for rate validation and overhead allocation. Cr

attributes.name: joa_id

attributes.name: operator_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.operator. Business justification: JIB statements are issued by operator to non-operators under JOA terms. Operator reference critical for billing reconciliation, dispute resolution, and COPAS audit compliance in joint venture accounti

attributes.name: operator_partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the operating partner issuing this Joint Interest Billing statement.

attributes.name: pipeline_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.pipeline_segment. Business justification: JIB statements are issued for jointly-owned pipeline infrastructure operations. jib_statement has asset_facility_id and well_asset_id but no pipeline_segment_id. Pipeline-specific JIB statements for t

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.psa. Business justification: JIB statements can be issued under PSA arrangements as well as JOAs, particularly for cost recovery billing between contractor parties. jib_statement has joa_id but no psa_id. Adding psa_id (nullable)

attributes.name: well_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific well asset to which the costs in this Joint Interest Billing statement are attributed, if applicable.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Joint Interest Billing statement was approved by the operator or designated authority for issuance to non-operating partners.

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the billing period covered by this Joint Interest Billing statement.

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the billing period covered by this Joint Interest Billing statement.

attributes.name: copas_billing_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies (COPAS) Billing Code
attributes.description: The standardized COPAS billing code that classifies the type of costs included in this Joint Interest Billing statement according to COPAS accounting standards.

attributes.name: cost_category
attributes.description: The primary category of costs covered by this Joint Interest Billing statement, indicating the nature of the joint account expenditures. attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this Joint Interest Billing statement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the Joint Interest Billing statement amounts are denominated.

attributes.name: dispute_amount
attributes.description: The total amount under dispute by non-operating partners, if any disputes have been raised against this Joint Interest Billing statement.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any non-operating partner has raised a dispute regarding the costs or allocations in this Joint Interest Billing statement.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: A description of the reason for any dispute raised by non-operating partners regarding this Joint Interest Billing statement.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user or system identifier that last modified this Joint Interest Billing statement record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this Joint Interest Billing statement record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: netting_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this Joint Interest Billing statement is eligible for partner netting, where offsetting receivables and payables between partners can be netted to reduce cash movements.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which non-operating partners are required to remit payment for their proportionate share of the billed costs.

attributes.name: payment_received_date
attributes.description: The date on which full payment was received from all non-operating partners for this Joint Interest Billing statement.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: The number of days from the statement date within which payment is due, as specified in the Joint Operating Agreement.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or explanations provided by the operator regarding this Joint Interest Billing statement, including special circumstances or clarifications.

attributes.name: sap_jva_document_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP Joint Venture Accounting (JVA) Document Number
attributes.description: The document number in SAP Joint Venture Accounting system that corresponds to this Joint Interest Billing statement for integration and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: statement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Joint Interest Billing statement was issued by the operator to the non-operating partners.

attributes.name: statement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique statement number assigned by the operator for tracking and reference purposes.

attributes.name: statement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the Joint Interest Billing statement in the billing and payment workflow.

attributes.name: statement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the Joint Interest Billing statement indicating whether it is an original billing, a revision, a supplemental charge, a final statement, or an adjustment.

attributes.name: total_joint_account_costs
attributes.description: The total costs incurred on the joint account during the billing period before allocation to individual partners based on their working interest.

attributes.name: total_overhead_charges
attributes.description: The total overhead charges applied by the operator for administrative and management services as permitted under the Joint Operating Agreement.

attributes.name: total_prior_period_adjustments
attributes.description: The net total of adjustments related to prior billing periods, including corrections, credits, and additional charges identified after the original billing.

attributes.name: total_statement_amount
attributes.description: The total amount billed in this Joint Interest Billing statement, calculated as the sum of joint account costs, overhead charges, and prior period adjustments.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user or system identifier that created this Joint Interest Billing statement record.

products.name: jib_line
products.description: Individual cost line item within a JIB statement, representing a specific cost category charged to the joint account. Captures cost category (drilling, completion, production, overhead, G&A), AFE reference, cost description, gross amount, partner WI percentage, partner net amount, and COPAS overhead rate applied. Enables granular cost transparency and partner dispute resolution at the line-item level.
products.reference: JIB Line Item — COPAS Accounting Procedure

attributes.name: jib_line_id
attributes.description: Primary key for jib_line

attributes.name: afe_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.afe_budget. Business justification: JIB line items must reference AFE budgets for cost recovery validation, budget variance tracking, and partner billing accuracy. Critical for COPAS-compliant joint venture accounting and audit trails.

attributes.name: asset_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facility (production platform, processing plant, pipeline, storage terminal) to which this cost is allocated. Supports facility-level cost tracking and asset management.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.contract. Business justification: Individual JIB line items must reference the governing contract for COPAS audit compliance. Auditors trace every charged item back to contract terms to validate rates, overhead allocation, and cost re

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Individual JIB line items are allocated to cost centers for internal management reporting and overhead allocation. Improves query performance for cost center variance analysis vs going through journal

attributes.name: jib_statement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent JIB statement that contains this line item. Links the line to the header-level billing document issued to joint venture partners.

attributes.name: journal_entry_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry_line. Business justification: Individual JIB line items map to journal entry lines for detailed GL account posting, cost center allocation, and audit trail from JV billing to financial statements. Required for COPAS billing reconc

attributes.name: lease_id
attributes.description: Reference to the lease or concession area to which this cost is allocated. Enables lease-level profitability analysis and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific joint venture partner being billed for this line item. Each JIB statement may have multiple line items for different partners based on their working interest.

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: JIB line items for product-related costs (storage, handling, quality testing, blending) require product linkage. Business process: Product-specific cost allocation in JIBs, partner billing for product

attributes.name: pipeline_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.pipeline_segment. Business justification: JIB lines itemize costs for jointly-owned pipeline operations (inspection, pigging, cathodic protection). jib_line has asset_facility_id and well_asset_id but no pipeline_segment_id. Pipeline-specific

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Individual JIB line items trace to specific purchase orders for three-way match (PO-GR-Invoice) validation before costs can be billed to joint account. Required for COPAS compliance and partner audit

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or service provider who performed the work or supplied the goods. Enables tracking of vendor performance and cost analysis by supplier.

attributes.name: venture_afe_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.venture_afe. Business justification: Individual JIB line items represent specific cost categories charged to partners, often authorized by a specific AFE. jib_line has afe_budget_id (cross-domain procurement) but no FK to venture.venture

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: JIB line items are charged to WBS elements for project cost tracking and AFE budget monitoring. Standard project accounting requirement for capital vs operating cost classification.

attributes.name: well_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific well to which this cost is allocated. Enables well-level cost tracking and economic analysis for drilling and production operations.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of any adjustment made to the original charge due to dispute resolution, correction, or revision. Positive values represent additional charges; negative values represent credits.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for any adjustment made to the line item. Provides audit trail for billing corrections and dispute resolutions.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date this charge was approved for billing to partners. Used for audit trail and compliance with internal control procedures.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Internal approval status of this charge before billing to partners. Values include pending approval (PENDING), approved for billing (APPROVED), rejected (REJECTED), or requires additional review (REQUIRES_REVIEW).

attributes.name: cost_category_code
attributes.description: Classification of the cost type according to COPAS standards. Categories include drilling (DRILL), completion (COMPL), production (PROD), facilities (FACIL), geological and geophysical (GEOL), land and lease (LAND), overhead (OVHD), general and administrative (GA), plug and abandonment (PLUG), workover (WORKOV), seismic (SEISMIC), and other (OTHER). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DRILL|COMPL|PROD|FACIL|GEOL|LAND|OVHD|GA|PLUG|WORKOV|SEISMIC|OTHER — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cost_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the specific cost or service being charged. Provides transparency to joint venture partners regarding the nature of the expenditure.

attributes.name: cost_recovery_limit_percentage
attributes.description: Maximum percentage of production revenue that can be used for cost recovery in a given period under PSA terms. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.5000 for 50% cost recovery limit).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this JIB line record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction. Supports multi-currency joint ventures and enables proper foreign exchange accounting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USD|CAD|GBP|EUR|NOK|BRL|MXN|AUD — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: Date the partner formally disputed this charge. Used to track dispute aging and ensure timely resolution per JOA terms.
attributes.references: Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) - Dispute Resolution Procedures

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Partner's stated reason for disputing this charge. Provides context for dispute resolution and helps identify systemic billing issues.
attributes.references: Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) - Dispute Resolution Procedures

attributes.name: dispute_status
attributes.description: Current status of any partner dispute regarding this line item. Values include undisputed (UNDISPUTED), disputed by partner (DISPUTED), under operator review (UNDER_REVIEW), dispute resolved (RESOLVED), or amount adjusted (ADJUSTED).
attributes.references: Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) - Dispute Resolution Procedures

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which this cost is posted in the operator's financial system. Enables integration with enterprise accounting and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module - Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total cost amount before allocation to partners. Represents 100% of the cost incurred by the operator on behalf of the joint venture.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date the vendor invoice was issued. Used for aging analysis and payment term calculations in joint venture accounting.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The vendor's invoice number for this charge. Provides traceability to source documentation for audit and dispute resolution purposes.

attributes.name: is_capital_expenditure
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this cost is classified as capital expenditure (CAPEX) or operating expenditure (OPEX). Critical for financial reporting, tax treatment, and reserve calculations.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-X - Oil and Gas Accounting

attributes.name: is_recoverable
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this cost is recoverable under a Production Sharing Agreement (PSA) or similar fiscal regime. Determines whether the cost can be recovered from production revenue before profit sharing.

attributes.name: is_tangible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is a tangible cost (equipment, materials) or intangible cost (drilling, geological services). Affects depreciation treatment and tax deductibility under full cost or successful efforts accounting.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-X - Oil and Gas Accounting

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the JIB statement for ordering and reference purposes. Enables partners to reference specific charges in dispute resolution.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this JIB line record was last modified. Enables change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: overhead_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of overhead charged on this line item, calculated by applying the overhead rate to the base cost. Represents operator compensation for administrative and indirect costs.

attributes.name: overhead_rate_percentage
attributes.description: COPAS-approved overhead rate applied to this cost category. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0500 for 5%). Compensates the operator for indirect costs of managing joint venture operations.

attributes.name: partner_net_amount
attributes.description: The partner's share of the cost calculated by applying their working interest percentage to the gross amount. This is the amount the partner owes for this line item.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the partner must pay this charge per JOA payment terms. Used for aging analysis and late payment interest calculations.

attributes.name: payment_received_date
attributes.description: Date the operator received payment from the partner for this line item. Used for cash flow tracking and reconciliation.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current payment status of this line item from the partner. Values include unpaid (UNPAID), partially paid (PARTIALLY_PAID), fully paid (PAID), overdue (OVERDUE), or written off as uncollectible (WRITTEN_OFF).

attributes.name: service_period_end_date
attributes.description: Ending date of the period during which the service was performed or goods were delivered. Used for matching costs to production periods and reserve calculations.

attributes.name: service_period_start_date
attributes.description: Beginning date of the period during which the service was performed or goods were delivered. Enables period-based cost allocation and accrual accounting.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: Project work breakdown structure element for capital project tracking. Links JIB costs to specific phases or deliverables within major capital projects.

attributes.name: working_interest_percentage
attributes.description: The partner's working interest percentage used to calculate their share of this cost. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2500 for 25%). Reflects the partner's obligation to bear costs under the JOA.

products.name: cash_call
products.description: Cash call notice issued by the operator to non-operating partners requesting advance funding for upcoming joint account expenditures under a JOA. Captures cash call number, billing period, total call amount, per-partner WI-based allocation, due date, operator bank account details, currency, payment instructions, and individual partner payment status. After merging cash_call_payment: also tracks each partner's actual payment response including payment date, amount received, payment method, bank reference, exchange rate, and reconciliation status against the called amount. Enables identification of underpayments, overpayments, and late payments triggering default interest under JOA provisions. Managed within SAP Joint Venture Accounting.

attributes.description: Reference to the joint operating agreement under which this cash call is issued.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id

attributes.name: approved_timestamp

attributes.description: End date of the billing period for which the cash call covers anticipated joint account expenditures.

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the billing period for which the cash call covers anticipated joint account expenditures.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the cash call was cancelled, such as AFE revision, project delay, or partner dispute.

attributes.name: cancelled_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the operator personnel who cancelled the cash call, if applicable.

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the cash call was cancelled by the operator, if applicable.

attributes.name: cash_call_number
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the cash call notice, typically assigned by the operator's joint venture accounting system.

attributes.name: cash_call_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cash call: draft (prepared but not issued), issued (sent to partners), partially_paid (some partners paid), fully_paid (all partners paid), overdue (past due date with unpaid balances), cancelled (withdrawn by operator).

attributes.name: expenditure_category

attributes.name: modified_by

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the cash call record was last modified in the joint venture accounting system.

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: operator_bank_account_number

attributes.name: operator_bank_name

attributes.name: total_call_amount

attributes.description: The bank transaction reference, wire transfer number, or check number associated with this payment. Used for bank reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: called_amount
attributes.description: The original amount requested from this partner in the cash call, in the cash call currency. Used to calculate payment variance and reconciliation status.

attributes.name: called_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the cash call amount was originally denominated. Used for variance calculation when payment currency differs.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cash call payment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: days_late
attributes.description: The number of calendar days between the cash call due date and the payment date. Used to calculate default interest charges. Null or zero if payment was on time.

attributes.name: default_interest_amount
attributes.description: The interest charge assessed on late or underpaid amounts per the Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) default interest rate. Calculated based on days late and variance amount.

attributes.name: default_interest_rate
attributes.description: The annual interest rate applied to late or underpaid amounts, as specified in the Joint Operating Agreement (JOA). Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0850 for 8.5 percent).

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: The reason provided by the partner for disputing the cash call or paying a different amount. Used to track and resolve billing disputes per JOA dispute resolution procedures.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which a payment dispute was resolved between the operator and partner. Null if no dispute exists or dispute is still open.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert payment amount to called currency for reconciliation. Rate is payment_currency per unit of called_currency. Null if currencies match.

attributes.name: gl_document_number
attributes.description: The general ledger document or journal entry number associated with this payment posting. Links cash call payment to financial accounting records.

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which this payment was posted to the operators general ledger. Used for financial period assignment and accounting close processes.

attributes.name: late_payment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payment was received after the due date specified in the cash call. True triggers default interest calculation per JOA terms.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user identifier or name of the person who last modified this payment record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cash call payment record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: netting_amount
attributes.description: The amount offset through partner netting arrangements. Reduces the cash payment required from the partner. Null if no netting was applied.

attributes.name: netting_applied_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether partner netting was applied to offset this payment against amounts owed by the operator to the partner. True when payment is reduced by bilateral netting.

attributes.name: paying_bank_name
attributes.description: The name of the financial institution from which the payment originated. Used for reconciliation and partner payment pattern analysis.

attributes.name: payment_amount
attributes.description: The actual monetary amount received from the partner in the payment currency. May differ from the called amount due to underpayment, overpayment, or currency fluctuations.

attributes.name: payment_amount_base_currency
attributes.description: The payment amount converted to the operators base reporting currency using the exchange rate. Used for consolidated financial reporting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: payment_confirmation_sent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the operator sent payment confirmation or receipt acknowledgment to the partner. Used for partner communication tracking.

attributes.name: payment_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the payment was received. May differ from the cash call currency if partner pays in alternate currency.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the partner payment was received by the operator. Used to calculate late payment interest per Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) terms.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The financial instrument or mechanism used by the partner to remit payment. Offset indicates payment via partner netting or cost recovery allocation.

attributes.name: payment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding this payment. May include partner explanations for variances, dispute details, or special payment arrangements.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: External payment reference number or transaction identifier provided by the paying partner or their bank. Used for reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: receiving_bank_account
attributes.description: The operators bank account number into which this payment was deposited. Used to reconcile bank statements with cash call collections.

attributes.name: reconciled_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the joint venture accountant who performed the reconciliation. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment was reconciled against the cash call and variance was resolved or accepted. Null if reconciliation is still pending.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the payment reconciliation against the called amount. Underpaid and overpaid statuses trigger follow-up actions per JOA terms. Disputed indicates partner has challenged the cash call.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The difference between called amount and payment amount in base currency. Positive indicates overpayment, negative indicates underpayment. Triggers default interest calculation if negative.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user identifier or name of the person who created this payment record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

Supports profit oil/gas split calculation and SEC cost recovery disclosure. One record per PSA per cost category per period.

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (YYYY-MM format) for which this cost recovery position is reported. Aligns with monthly joint interest billing cycles.

attributes.name: afe_number
attributes.description: The AFE number authorizing the costs incurred in this period. Links cost recovery to approved capital and operating budgets.

attributes.name: audit_date
attributes.description: The date when this cost recovery record was last audited or reviewed by the government or joint venture partners.

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: The current audit or approval status of this cost recovery record. Tracks lifecycle from draft submission through government audit and final approval.

attributes.name: ceiling_limit
attributes.description: The maximum amount of cost oil/gas that can be allocated to cost recovery in the period, expressed as a percentage of total production value per PSA terms.

attributes.name: ceiling_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of total production value allocated to cost recovery per PSA contract terms (e.g., 50%, 60%, 70%). Varies by contract and field maturity.

attributes.name: ceiling_utilized
attributes.description: The actual amount of cost recovery ceiling utilized in the period. May be less than the limit if unrecovered costs are lower than the ceiling.

attributes.name: contractor_share_percentage
attributes.description: The contractors participating interest percentage in the PSA. Used to calculate contractor entitlement to cost recovery.

attributes.name: cost_category
attributes.description: Classification of the recoverable cost type under the PSA. Determines recovery priority and ceiling rules per contract terms.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, SEC Regulation S-X Rule 4-10

attributes.name: cost_subcategory
attributes.description: Detailed subcategory within the cost category for granular tracking (e.g., seismic acquisition, drilling, facilities, workover, LOE).

attributes.name: costs_incurred_period
attributes.description: Total costs incurred during the current accounting period for this cost category under the PSA. Represents new recoverable costs added to the pool.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, SEC Regulation S-X Rule 4-10

attributes.name: costs_recovered_period
attributes.description: Total costs recovered during the current accounting period from cost oil/gas allocation per PSA terms. Reduces the unrecovered cost balance.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, SEC Regulation S-X Rule 4-10

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost recovery record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which cost recovery amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: depreciation_amount_period
attributes.description: The depreciation expense allocated to cost recovery in the current period for capital assets under the PSA.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, SEC Regulation S-X Rule 4-10

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: The depreciation method applied to capital costs for cost recovery purposes under the PSA. May differ from book depreciation.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, SEC Regulation S-X Rule 4-10

attributes.name: dispute_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount under dispute if the dispute flag is true. Represents costs challenged by government or partners.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost recovery record is under dispute by the government or joint venture partners. True if disputed, false otherwise.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: The reason or description of the dispute if the dispute flag is true. Documents the basis for cost recovery challenge.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate applied to convert local currency costs to the PSA reporting currency for the accounting period.

attributes.name: government_share_percentage
attributes.description: The host government or national oil company participating interest percentage in the PSA. Used to calculate government entitlement to profit oil/gas after cost recovery.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost recovery record was last updated. Audit trail for record changes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding this cost recovery record. Used to document special circumstances, adjustments, or clarifications.

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the accounting period covered by this cost recovery record.

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the accounting period covered by this cost recovery record.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: The priority order for recovering this cost category when multiple categories compete for limited cost oil/gas (1=highest priority). Typically operating costs recover before development costs.

attributes.name: production_tier
attributes.description: The production volume tier or R-factor tier that determines the profit oil/gas split percentage in the current period per PSA sliding scale terms.

attributes.name: profit_oil_split_contractor
attributes.description: The contractors share of profit oil/gas after cost recovery, expressed as a percentage. May vary by production tier or R-factor per PSA terms.

attributes.name: profit_oil_split_government
attributes.description: The governments share of profit oil/gas after cost recovery, expressed as a percentage. May vary by production tier or R-factor per PSA terms.

attributes.name: r_factor
attributes.description: The cumulative revenue-to-cost ratio used to determine profit oil/gas split tiers in some PSAs. Calculated as cumulative revenue divided by cumulative costs.

attributes.name: ring_fencing_entity
attributes.description: The specific field, block, or contract identifier to which this cost recovery record is ring-fenced per PSA terms.

attributes.name: ring_fencing_rule
attributes.description: The ring-fencing methodology applied to cost recovery under the PSA. Determines whether costs can be pooled across fields, blocks, or contracts.

attributes.name: sec_disclosure_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Disclosure Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost recovery record is included in SEC reserves disclosure and financial reporting. True if disclosed, false otherwise.

attributes.name: unrecovered_cost_balance_closing
attributes.description: The cumulative unrecovered cost balance at the end of the accounting period. Calculated as opening balance plus costs incurred minus costs recovered.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, SEC Regulation S-X Rule 4-10

attributes.name: unrecovered_cost_balance_opening
attributes.description: The cumulative unrecovered cost balance at the beginning of the accounting period. Carried forward from prior period closing balance.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, SEC Regulation S-X Rule 4-10

attributes.name: uplift_amount_period
attributes.description: The uplift or interest amount accrued on unrecovered costs during the current period. Added to costs incurred for recovery calculation.

attributes.name: uplift_rate
attributes.description: The annual uplift or interest rate applied to unrecovered costs per PSA terms, expressed as a percentage. Compensates contractor for delayed cost recovery.

SSOT for PSA profit entitlement.

attributes.name: net_revenue_interest_percentage

attributes.name: opening_imbalance_volume_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Opening Imbalance Volume in Barrels of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: The cumulative imbalance position at the start of this entitlement period, before this lifting transaction is applied.

attributes.name: pricing_basis
attributes.description: The pricing benchmark or index used to determine the reference price, such as West Texas Intermediate (WTI), Brent, or Henry Hub for natural gas.

attributes.name: quality_adjustment_volume_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Quality Adjustment Volume in Barrels of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: Volume adjustment applied due to product quality variance from specification, expressed in BOE. Can be positive or negative.

attributes.name: quality_specification_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lifted product met the contractual quality specifications. True if specifications were met, False if not.

attributes.name: reference_price_per_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reference Price per Barrels of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: The reference price per BOE used to value the imbalance position, typically based on the contract pricing mechanism or market index.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special conditions related to this lifting entitlement transaction.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the imbalance was settled or is scheduled to be settled. Null if settlement is pending.

attributes.name: settlement_election
attributes.description: The partners election for how they wish to settle their entitlement: in-kind (take physical product) or in-value (receive cash equivalent).

attributes.name: settlement_method
attributes.description: The method by which the imbalance will be settled: in-kind (physical volume adjustment), in-value (cash settlement), cash-out (immediate cash payment), or carry-forward (deferred to future period).

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: The current status of the imbalance settlement process: pending (not yet initiated), in-progress (settlement underway), settled (completed), or disputed (under review).

attributes.name: transportation_mode
attributes.description: The mode of transportation used for the lifting: pipeline, tanker, truck, rail, or barge.

attributes.name: working_interest_percentage
attributes.description: The partners Working Interest (WI) percentage in the field or well at the time of this lifting, used to calculate entitlement.

products.name: overlift_underlift
products.description: Tracks cumulative overlift and underlift imbalance positions per partner per JOA/PSA asset. Captures opening balance, current period lifting variance, cumulative imbalance volume (BOE), imbalance value at reference price, settlement method (cash or in-kind), and settlement status. Enables equalization calculations and supports partner dispute resolution for production imbalances.

attributes.description: Reference to the joint venture partner who holds this overlift or underlift position.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservoir.reservoir. Business justification: Overlift/underlift imbalances arise from production of specific reservoirs; reservoir-level attribution is required for production-allocation accounting and partner-settlement calculations. Domain exp
