attributes.name: well_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the producing asset (field, platform, or facility) where the imbalance occurred.

attributes.name: actual_lifted_volume_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Actual Lifted Volume Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: The actual volume of production in barrels of oil equivalent that the partner physically lifted or took delivery of during the current period.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval status of the imbalance calculation: draft (under preparation), pending approval (submitted for partner review), approved (accepted by all parties), or rejected (disputed or requiring revision).

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the person or system that approved the imbalance calculation.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the imbalance calculation was approved by the authorized party.

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate the imbalance: entitlement-based (PSA cost recovery and profit oil), working interest-based (JOA proportional share), PSA formula (specific contractual formula), or custom (bespoke calculation per agreement).

attributes.name: closing_balance_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Closing Balance Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: The cumulative overlift or underlift imbalance volume in barrels of oil equivalent at the end of the reporting period, calculated as opening balance plus current period variance.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments regarding the imbalance position, settlement arrangements, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this imbalance record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: current_period_variance_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current Period Variance Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: The difference between actual lifted volume and entitled volume for the current period in barrels of oil equivalent. Positive values indicate overlift; negative values indicate underlift.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the imbalance position is currently under dispute by one or more partners.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for the dispute, if applicable, such as disagreement on entitled volumes, pricing methodology, or measurement accuracy.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the dispute was resolved and the imbalance position was agreed upon by all parties.

attributes.name: entitled_volume_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Entitled Volume Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: The volume of production in barrels of oil equivalent that the partner is entitled to lift during the current period based on their working interest or PSA entitlement.

attributes.name: imbalance_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the reporting period for which this imbalance position is calculated.

attributes.name: imbalance_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the reporting period for which this imbalance position is calculated.

attributes.name: imbalance_status
attributes.description: The current status of the imbalance position: overlift (partner lifted more than entitled), underlift (partner lifted less than entitled), balanced (no imbalance), pending settlement (awaiting equalization), settled (equalized), or disputed (under partner dispute resolution).

attributes.name: imbalance_value_usd
attributes.description: The monetary value of the closing imbalance position in United States Dollars, calculated as closing balance multiplied by reference price.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this imbalance record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: nri_percentage
attributes.description: The partners net revenue interest percentage in the asset at the time of the imbalance calculation, representing the share of production revenue after royalties and burdens.

attributes.name: opening_balance_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Opening Balance Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: The cumulative overlift or underlift imbalance volume in barrels of oil equivalent at the beginning of the reporting period. Positive values indicate overlift; negative values indicate underlift.

attributes.name: price_index_reference
attributes.description: The market price index or benchmark used to determine the reference price for valuing the imbalance, such as WTI, Brent, Henry Hub, or a contractual formula.

attributes.name: reference_price_per_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reference Price Per Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: The reference price per barrel of oil equivalent used to value the imbalance position, typically based on market index prices such as WTI or Brent.

attributes.name: settlement_completion_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the imbalance position was fully settled or equalized.

attributes.name: settlement_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the imbalance position must be settled or equalized according to the JOA or PSA terms.

attributes.name: settlement_method
attributes.description: The method by which the imbalance will be settled: in-kind (through future production adjustments), cash (monetary settlement), hybrid (combination of in-kind and cash), or not applicable (no settlement required).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system from which this imbalance record was extracted, typically SAP Joint Venture Accounting or Avocet Production Operations.

attributes.name: tolerance_threshold_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tolerance Threshold Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: The maximum allowable imbalance volume in barrels of oil equivalent before settlement is required, as defined in the JOA or PSA.

attributes.name: tolerance_threshold_percentage
attributes.description: The maximum allowable imbalance as a percentage of entitled volume before settlement is required, as defined in the JOA or PSA.

attributes.name: working_interest_percentage
attributes.description: The partners working interest percentage in the asset at the time of the imbalance calculation, used to determine entitled volumes.

products.name: jv_budget
products.description: Annual and multi-year joint venture work program and budget (WP&B) approved by the operating committee for a JOA or PSA. Captures budget year, work program description, total gross budget, operator share, non-operator shares by WI, CAPEX/OPEX split, AFE references, budget revision number, and operating committee approval date. Distinct from the corporate finance budget — this is the joint account budget owned by the venture domain.

attributes.name: afe_reference_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of AFE numbers associated with this budget, linking the budget to specific authorizations for expenditure that detail individual projects or work scopes within the overall work program.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the operating committee chairperson or authorized representative who formally approved the budget on behalf of the joint venture partners.

attributes.name: budget_end_date

attributes.name: budget_start_date

attributes.name: budget_status

attributes.name: budget_type
attributes.description: Classification of the budget by planning horizon and purpose: annual (standard yearly budget), multi-year (long-term capital program), supplemental (mid-year adjustment), emergency (unplanned urgent expenditure), or AFE-specific (tied to a single Authorization for Expenditure).

attributes.name: budget_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year for which this budget applies, expressed as a four-digit year (e.g., 2024). For multi-year budgets, this represents the starting year.

attributes.name: capex_budget_usd
attributes.description: Portion of the total gross budget allocated to capital expenditures, including drilling, completion, facility construction, and major equipment purchases that will be capitalized per accounting standards.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, clarifications, or special conditions related to the budget, including operating committee feedback, partner concerns, or execution constraints.

attributes.name: completion_budget_usd
attributes.description: Portion of the total budget allocated to well completion activities, including perforation, stimulation, fracturing, wellhead installation, and initial production equipment.

attributes.name: contingency_amount_usd
attributes.description: Absolute dollar amount of contingency reserve included in the total budget, providing a buffer for cost overruns or unplanned expenditures.

attributes.name: contingency_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the total budget allocated as contingency reserve for unforeseen costs, scope changes, or risk mitigation, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 10.00 for 10%).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this budget record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the budget amounts. While amounts are stored in USD, this field documents the original currency if the budget was prepared in a different currency and converted. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USD|CAD|GBP|EUR|AUD|NOK|BRL|MXN — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: drilling_budget_usd
attributes.description: Portion of the total budget allocated specifically to drilling operations, including rig costs, drilling fluids, casing, cementing, and directional drilling services.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied to convert the original budget currency to USD, if applicable. Rate is expressed as units of original currency per 1 USD.

attributes.name: facilities_budget_usd
attributes.description: Portion of the total budget allocated to production facilities, including construction, expansion, or upgrade of processing plants, pipelines, storage tanks, and surface equipment.

attributes.name: hse_budget_usd
attributes.description: Portion of the total budget allocated to health, safety, and environmental programs, including safety training, environmental monitoring, spill prevention, and regulatory compliance activities.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this budget record was last modified, supporting audit trail and change tracking requirements.

attributes.name: non_operator_share_usd
attributes.description: The aggregate allocated share of all non-operating partners in the total budget, representing the combined financial obligation of all non-operators for the work program.

attributes.name: operating_committee_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the operating committee formally approved this budget, authorizing the operator to proceed with the work program and incur expenditures.

attributes.name: operator_share_usd
attributes.description: The operator's allocated share of the total budget based on their working interest percentage, representing the operator's financial obligation for the work program.

attributes.name: operator_wi_pct
attributes.description: The operator's working interest percentage in the joint venture, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 45.00 for 45%). Used to calculate the operator's share of costs and revenues.

attributes.name: opex_budget_usd
attributes.description: Portion of the total gross budget allocated to operating expenditures, including lease operating expenses, production costs, routine maintenance, and day-to-day operational activities that will be expensed in the current period.

attributes.name: overhead_allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to allocate operator overhead costs to the joint venture budget: fixed rate (flat fee), percentage (of direct costs), actual cost (pass-through), or COPAS standard (per COPAS accounting guidelines).

attributes.name: overhead_budget_usd
attributes.description: Total budgeted amount for operator overhead charges included in the work program budget, covering administrative, technical, and support services provided by the operator.

attributes.name: overhead_rate_pct
attributes.description: Overhead rate applied to direct costs to calculate operator overhead charges, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 15.00 for 15%). Applicable when overhead allocation method is percentage-based.

attributes.name: production_operations_budget_usd
attributes.description: Portion of the total budget allocated to ongoing production operations, including well servicing, artificial lift, chemical treatments, and routine production maintenance.

attributes.name: revision_date
attributes.description: Date when the current revision of the budget was created or amended. For the original budget, this is the initial submission date.

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number tracking amendments to the original budget. Initial approved budget is revision 0; subsequent amendments increment this counter.

attributes.name: revision_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the budget was revised, documenting the business justification for amendments such as scope changes, cost overruns, new opportunities, or regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this budget record originated, typically SAP Joint Venture Accounting or another joint venture management system.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this budget record in the source system, enabling traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse and operational systems.

attributes.name: total_gross_budget_usd
attributes.description: Total authorized budget amount in US dollars for the joint venture work program before allocation to partners. Represents 100% of the budgeted expenditure across all working interest owners.

attributes.name: work_program_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the planned work program activities covered by this budget, including drilling operations, production optimization, facility maintenance, and other joint venture activities.

products.name: operating_committee
products.description: Master record for the Operating Committee (OpCom) established under each JOA, representing the governance body of partner representatives with voting rights over joint operations. Captures committee name, associated JOA, meeting frequency, quorum requirements, voting threshold for ordinary vs. special resolutions, and current chairperson. SSOT for JOA governance structure.
products.reference: Operating Committee — JOA / AIPN Model Form

attributes.name: operating_committee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Operating Committee record. Primary key.

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Joint Operating Agreement under which this Operating Committee is established. Links the committee to its governing JOA.

attributes.name: primary_quaternary_operating_partner_id
attributes.description: FK to venture.partner

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.psa. Business justification: Operating Committees can be established under PSA contracts as well as JOAs to govern joint decision-making. operating_committee has joa_id but no psa_id. Adding psa_id (nullable) covers PSA-based ope

attributes.name: tertiary_operating_chairperson_party_venture_partner_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tertiary Operating Chairperson Party Venture Partner Id
attributes.description: FK to venture.partner

attributes.name: afe_approval_authority_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Operating Committee Authorization for Expenditure (AFE) Approval Authority USD
attributes.description: The maximum dollar amount of an AFE that the Operating Committee can approve without requiring additional partner consent or escalation. Expressed in US dollars.

attributes.name: chairperson_rotation_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the chairperson role rotates among partner representatives. Annual means yearly rotation; biennial means every two years; fixed means the chairperson does not rotate; rotating means rotation occurs but on an irregular schedule.

attributes.name: committee_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used to identify the Operating Committee in internal systems and reporting. Facilitates quick reference and system integration.

attributes.name: committee_name
attributes.description: The official name of the Operating Committee as designated in the JOA. Typically includes the asset or field name for identification.

attributes.name: confidentiality_requirement
attributes.description: Indicates whether Operating Committee proceedings, minutes, and decisions are subject to confidentiality obligations under the JOA. True means confidentiality is required; false means no specific confidentiality obligation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this Operating Committee record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: decision_authority_scope
attributes.description: A textual description of the scope of decision-making authority granted to the Operating Committee under the JOA. Defines what types of operational, financial, and strategic decisions the committee can make.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_method
attributes.description: The primary method specified in the JOA for resolving disputes that arise within the Operating Committee. Arbitration involves binding third-party arbitration; mediation involves facilitated negotiation; litigation involves court proceedings; expert determination involves a technical expert's binding decision.

attributes.name: dissolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Operating Committee was formally dissolved or disbanded. Null for active committees. Marks the end of the committee's governance authority.

attributes.name: establishment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Operating Committee was formally established under the JOA. Marks the beginning of the committee's governance authority.

attributes.name: governing_law
attributes.description: The jurisdiction and legal framework under which the Operating Committee operates and resolves disputes. Typically aligns with the JOA's governing law.

attributes.name: last_meeting_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent Operating Committee meeting. Used to track meeting cadence and governance activity.

attributes.name: meeting_frequency
attributes.description: The scheduled frequency at which the Operating Committee convenes for regular meetings as stipulated in the JOA. As-needed indicates meetings are called on an ad-hoc basis.

attributes.name: meeting_location
attributes.description: The primary physical or virtual location where Operating Committee meetings are held. May include city, office address, or virtual meeting platform details.

attributes.name: minutes_retention_years
attributes.description: The number of years that meeting minutes and committee records must be retained for audit, compliance, and legal purposes. Aligns with regulatory and contractual requirements.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this Operating Committee record. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this Operating Committee record was last modified in the system. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_meeting_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Operating Committee Next Scheduled Meeting Date
attributes.description: The date of the next scheduled Operating Committee meeting. Facilitates planning and ensures partners are aware of upcoming governance events.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for capturing additional context, special provisions, or operational notes related to the Operating Committee that do not fit into structured fields.

attributes.name: notice_period_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Operating Committee Meeting Notice Period Days
attributes.description: The minimum number of days advance notice required before a scheduled Operating Committee meeting. Ensures all partners have adequate time to prepare and attend.

attributes.name: operating_committee_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the Operating Committee. Active committees are currently governing joint operations; inactive committees are temporarily not meeting; suspended committees have paused governance due to disputes or force majeure; dissolved committees have been permanently disbanded.

attributes.name: proxy_voting_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether partner representatives are permitted to vote by proxy if they cannot attend a meeting in person. True means proxy voting is allowed; false means representatives must attend to vote.

attributes.name: quorum_requirement_pct
attributes.description: The minimum percentage of working interest or voting rights that must be represented at a meeting for the committee to conduct official business and make binding decisions. Expressed as a percentage of total working interest.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system from which this Operating Committee record originated. Typically SAP Joint Venture Accounting or a contract management system. Supports data lineage and integration traceability.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this Operating Committee record in the source system. Enables cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: total_member_count
attributes.description: The total number of partner representatives who are members of the Operating Committee. Each JOA partner typically appoints one or more representatives.

attributes.name: virtual_meeting_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether Operating Committee meetings may be conducted virtually via teleconference or video conference. True means virtual meetings are permitted; false means in-person attendance is required.

attributes.name: voting_basis
attributes.description: The method by which votes are weighted in committee decisions. Working interest means votes are proportional to each party's working interest percentage; one vote per party means each partner has equal voting power regardless of interest; hybrid combines both methods for different decision types.

attributes.name: voting_threshold_ordinary_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Operating Committee Voting Threshold for Ordinary Resolutions Percentage
attributes.description: The minimum percentage of affirmative votes required to pass ordinary resolutions or routine operational decisions. Typically expressed as a percentage of working interest represented at the meeting.

attributes.name: voting_threshold_special_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Operating Committee Voting Threshold for Special Resolutions Percentage
attributes.description: The minimum percentage of affirmative votes required to pass special resolutions involving major decisions such as large capital expenditures, changes to the JOA, or operator replacement. Typically higher than ordinary resolution threshold.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this Operating Committee record. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

products.name: operating_committee_member
products.description: This association product represents the membership relationship between partners and operating committees in joint venture governance. It captures each partner's representation on an Operating Committee, including their voting rights, role, and tenure. Each record links one partner to one operating committee with attributes that exist only in the context of this membership relationship. This is a foundational governance concept in JOA (Joint Operating Agreement) structures, where working interest owners are entitled to committee representation.. Existence Justification: In JOA governance structures, operating committees are composed of representatives from multiple working interest partners, and each partner typically participates on multiple operating committees across their portfolio of joint ventures. This is a foundational governance relationship in oil and gas joint operations: the business actively manages committee memberships, tracks voting rights proportional to working interest, assigns roles (chairperson, member, alternate), and maintains historical records of representation for audit and compliance purposes.

domains.name: hse
domains.description: Manages Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) compliance including incident reporting, permit-to-work (PTW), SIMOPS coordination, LDAR programs, NORM handling, H2S monitoring, GHG and ESG emissions tracking, spill reporting, environmental monitoring, and audit findings. Supports OSHA, EPA, BSEE, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 regulatory compliance. Integrates with Enablon HSE Management for audit and compliance workflows.

products.name: incident
products.description: Unified HSE event register serving as the single master record for all health, safety, and environmental events including safety observations, near-misses, first-aid cases, recordable injuries, illnesses, fatalities, spills, fires, explosions, process safety events (API RP 754 Tier 1/2), and behavioral observations. Captures event type, severity classification (OSHA recordable, lost-time, fatality, PSE tier), API RP 754 process safety indicator classification, location, date/time, initial description, H2S exposure flag, NORM involvement, loss of primary containment (LOPC) details, observer/reporter identity, immediate actions taken, and regulatory notification requirements. Supports behavior-based safety (BBS) programs, leading/lagging indicator tracking, and BSEE/OSHA incident reporting. Integrates with Enablon HSE Management incident reporting module. Serves as the SSOT for all HSE event data across the enterprise.

attributes.name: findings_summary

attributes.name: human_factors_analysis

attributes.name: immediate_cause_description

attributes.name: investigation_closure_date

attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management

attributes.name: investigation_completion_date

attributes.name: investigation_cost_usd

attributes.name: investigation_number

attributes.name: investigation_priority

attributes.name: investigation_report_url

attributes.name: investigation_start_date

attributes.name: investigation_status

attributes.name: investigation_team_members

attributes.name: investigation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the investigation depth and scope. Determines the rigor and methodology applied based on incident severity and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: BSEE Incident Investigation and Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: lessons_learned

attributes.name: management_review_date
attributes.description: The date when the investigation findings were formally reviewed by management. Used to track governance and oversight compliance.

attributes.name: management_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investigation findings require formal review and approval by senior management or executive leadership.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who last modified this investigation record. Supports audit trail and data governance.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this investigation record was last updated. Audit trail field for tracking changes.

attributes.name: procedural_deficiencies
attributes.description: Documentation of any inadequate, missing, or poorly followed procedures, work instructions, or operating guidelines identified during the investigation.

attributes.name: rca_methodology
attributes.description: The structured root cause analysis methodology applied during the investigation. Common methods include TapRoot, Bow-Tie, 5-Why, Fishbone (Ishikawa), Fault Tree Analysis, and Barrier Analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: taproot|bow_tie|five_why|fishbone|fault_tree|barrier_analysis|change_analysis|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: API RP 754 Process Safety Performance Indicators

attributes.name: recommendations_summary
attributes.description: Summary of all recommendations made by the investigation team to prevent recurrence. Links to detailed corrective and preventive action records.

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investigation findings require formal notification to regulatory authorities such as OSHA, BSEE, EPA, or state agencies.

attributes.name: regulatory_report_submitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required regulatory investigation report has been submitted to the appropriate authorities.

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the fundamental or systemic root causes identified through the RCA methodology. Describes the underlying organizational, procedural, or systemic failures that allowed the incident to occur.

attributes.name: systemic_causes
attributes.description: Description of systemic or organizational causes such as inadequate management systems, insufficient training programs, poor safety culture, or deficient procedures that enabled the incident.

attributes.name: witness_count
attributes.description: Total number of witnesses interviewed during the investigation. Used to assess investigation thoroughness.

attributes.name: action_description

attributes.name: action_type
attributes.description: Classification of the action: corrective (addresses existing nonconformity), preventive (eliminates potential nonconformity), or improvement (enhances performance beyond compliance).

attributes.name: attachments_count

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: Business unit or operating division responsible for the corrective action (e.g., Upstream E&P, Downstream Refining, Midstream Transportation).

attributes.name: closed_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual who authorized closure of the corrective action, typically an HSE manager or supervisor.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date when the corrective action was formally closed in Enablon HSE Management after successful completion and effectiveness verification.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the corrective action was completed by the responsible party. Null if action is still open or in progress.

attributes.name: cost_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated cost in USD to implement the corrective action, including labor, materials, equipment, and contractor expenses.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: effectiveness_review_status

attributes.name: last_modified_by

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority classification for the corrective action based on risk severity, regulatory impact, and operational criticality.

attributes.name: recurrence_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this corrective action addresses a recurring issue that has been previously reported and actioned.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement
attributes.description: Citation of the specific regulatory requirement, standard clause, or permit condition that this corrective action addresses (e.g., OSHA 1910.119, EPA 40 CFR 112, ISO 45001 Clause 10.2).

attributes.name: responsible_party
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual, team, or organizational unit assigned ownership and accountability for completing the corrective action.

attributes.name: responsible_party_email
attributes.description: Email address of the responsible party for notification and escalation workflows.

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Description of the identified root cause(s) that this corrective action is designed to address, typically derived from incident investigation or audit analysis.

attributes.name: source_reference_code
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this corrective action to the originating event record (incident ID, audit finding ID, inspection ID, etc.) in Enablon HSE Management.

attributes.name: source_type
attributes.description: Type of originating event or activity that triggered the corrective action: incident investigation, audit finding, inspection deficiency, near-miss report, safety observation, or stakeholder complaint.

attributes.name: verification_date

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify that the corrective action was implemented as planned: document review, site inspection, audit, testing, direct observation, or stakeholder interview.

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual who verified the completion and effectiveness of the corrective action.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the individual who created the corrective action record.

products.name: permit_to_work
products.description: Permit-to-Work (PTW) master record authorizing specific high-risk work activities at oil and gas facilities. Captures permit type (hot work, confined space entry, electrical isolation, excavation, working at height, SIMOPS, cold work, radiography), issuing authority, performing authority, work location, valid date/time window, hazard identification summary, required isolations and energy sources, gas test results (LEL, O2, H2S, CO), PPE requirements, simultaneous permit conflicts checked, and permit status lifecycle (draft, issued, active, suspended, closed, cancelled). Links to risk assessment (JSA) and SIMOPS plan for concurrent operations coordination. Integrates with Enablon PTW module and supports OSHA-required safe work authorization procedures.

attributes.name: gas_test_h2s_ppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gas Test Hydrogen Sulfide (H2S) Parts Per Million

attributes.name: gas_test_oxygen_percent
attributes.description: Measured oxygen concentration from atmospheric gas testing. Must be between 19.5% and 23.5% for safe entry into confined spaces per OSHA standards.

attributes.name: gas_test_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the atmospheric gas testing was performed. Gas tests must be current and may require periodic re-testing during work execution.

attributes.name: hazard_identification_summary
attributes.description: Summary of identified hazards associated with the work activity. Derived from Job Safety Analysis (JSA) or risk assessment. Includes physical, chemical, biological, and environmental hazards.

attributes.name: isolation_requirements
attributes.description: Description of required isolations for energy sources, process fluids, and utilities. Includes lockout/tagout (LOTO) points, valve closures, and electrical disconnects.

attributes.name: issued_timestamp

attributes.name: jsa_reference_number

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: permit_number

attributes.name: permit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the permit. Draft permits are under preparation, issued permits are authorized but not yet active, active permits are in use, suspended permits are temporarily halted, closed permits are completed, and cancelled permits are voided.

attributes.name: permit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the permit based on the nature of high-risk work activity. Determines specific safety protocols and authorization requirements. SIMOPS refers to Simultaneous Operations coordination.

attributes.name: ppe_requirements
attributes.description: List of required Personal Protective Equipment for the work activity. May include hard hat, safety glasses, gloves, fire-resistant clothing, respirator, fall protection, and specialized equipment based on hazards.

attributes.name: rescue_plan_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the emergency rescue plan applicable to this work activity. Required for confined space entry and working at height permits.

attributes.name: simops_plan_reference

attributes.description: Number of fugitive emission components (valves, flanges, connectors, pumps, compressor seals) associated with this emission source that are monitored under the LDAR program. Used for leak rate estimation and inspection scheduling.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 60 Subpart VVa - Standards of Performance for Equipment Leaks of VOC in the Synthetic Organic Chemicals Manufacturing Industry

attributes.name: ldar_program_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Leak Detection and Repair (LDAR) Program Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this emission source (typically fugitive equipment components) is subject to a Leak Detection and Repair program under EPA NSPS, NESHAP, or state regulations.
attributes.references: EPA Method 21 - Determination of Volatile Organic Compound Leaks

attributes.name: monitoring_methodology
attributes.description: Method used to quantify emissions from this source. CEMS: Continuous Emission Monitoring System. PEMS: Predictive Emission Monitoring System. Fuel analysis: lab testing of fuel composition. Engineering calculation: equipment-specific algorithms. Emission factor: EPA AP-42 or industry factors. Mass balance: material input-output accounting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CEMS|PEMS|fuel_analysis|engineering_calculation|emission_factor|mass_balance|direct_measurement — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 75 - Continuous Emission Monitoring

attributes.name: neshap_subpart_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Emission Standards for Hazardous Air Pollutants (NESHAP) Subpart Applicable
attributes.description: EPA NESHAP subpart(s) applicable to this emission source for hazardous air pollutant (HAP) control. Examples: Subpart HH (oil and natural gas production), Subpart ZZZZ (stationary reciprocating internal combustion engines). Null if no NESHAP applies.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 63 - National Emission Standards for Hazardous Air Pollutants

attributes.name: norm_present
attributes.business_glossary_term: Naturally Occurring Radioactive Material (NORM) Present Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Naturally Occurring Radioactive Material (radium-226, radium-228) is present in scale, sludge, or waste streams from this emission source. Triggers special handling, disposal, and worker protection requirements.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 61 Subpart R - National Emission Standards for Radon Emissions From Phosphogypsum Stacks

attributes.name: nsps_subpart_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: New Source Performance Standards (NSPS) Subpart Applicable
attributes.description: EPA NSPS subpart(s) applicable to this emission source. Examples: Subpart OOOO (oil and gas well completions), Subpart OOOOa (new/modified sources), Subpart Dc (steam generating units). Null if no NSPS applies.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 60 - Standards of Performance for New Stationary Sources

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the emission source. Active: in regular operation. Standby: available but not operating. Idle: temporarily shut down. Maintenance: undergoing repair or inspection. Decommissioned: permanently retired. Planned: not yet commissioned.

attributes.name: permit_emission_limit
attributes.description: Maximum allowable emission rate or annual emission quantity specified in the air permit for this source. Used for compliance tracking and exceedance detection. Unit of measure specified in permit_emission_limit_unit.

attributes.name: permit_emission_limit_unit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Permit Emission Limit Unit of Measure (UOM)
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the permit emission limit. Must match the permit condition language.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 70 - State Operating Permit Programs

attributes.name: rated_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum design capacity or nameplate rating of the emission source. For combustion equipment: maximum heat input (MMBtu/hr) or power output (MW). For storage tanks: working capacity (bbl). For compressors: horsepower (HP).
attributes.references: API Standard 618 - Reciprocating Compressors for Petroleum, Chemical, and Gas Industry Services

attributes.name: rated_capacity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the rated capacity of the emission source. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MMBtu/hr|MW|HP|bbl|m3|scf/day|BOPD|MCFD — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: regulatory_threshold_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this emission source is subject to regulatory reporting thresholds (EPA Title V, GHG Mandatory Reporting Rule, state air permits). True if source meets or exceeds applicability thresholds.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 98 - Mandatory Greenhouse Gas Reporting

attributes.name: source_category
attributes.description: GHG Protocol source category for emissions inventory and ESG reporting. Aligns with Scope 1 direct emissions classification under ISO 14064-1.

attributes.name: source_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the emission source for identification and reporting purposes. Examples: Flare Stack 1A, Compressor Engine 3B, Storage Tank 402, Glycol Dehydrator Unit 5.

attributes.name: source_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the emission source, typically assigned by facility HSE team. Used in regulatory filings, permits, and internal tracking systems. Must be unique within the facility.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 98 - Mandatory Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Reporting

attributes.name: source_type
attributes.description: Classification of the emission source by emission mechanism. Combustion: engines, turbines, heaters, boilers. Venting: controlled release of gas. Flaring: combustion of waste gas. Fugitive: leaks from equipment. Process: chemical reactions. Storage: tank breathing losses. Loading: transfer operations. attributes.name: stack_diameter_meters
attributes.description: Inside diameter of the emission stack at the exit point in meters. Used for exit velocity calculation and dispersion modeling.

attributes.name: stack_height_meters

attributes.name: title_v_major_source
attributes.description: Indicates whether this emission source contributes to the facility being classified as a Title V major source under the Clean Air Act (potential to emit 100 tons/year of any criteria pollutant or 10/25 tons/year of HAPs).
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 70 - State Operating Permit Programs

attributes.name: capa_target_date

attributes.name: closure_date

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: discovery_date
attributes.description: Date the violation was first identified, whether through regulatory inspection, internal audit, self-disclosure, or monitoring system alert. Distinct from the date the NOV was formally issued. Critical for calculating response timelines and regulatory reporting deadlines.

attributes.name: discovery_source

attributes.name: end_date

attributes.name: ghg_related

attributes.name: issuing_authority_type

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: Geographic or regulatory jurisdiction in which the violation occurred and is being adjudicated (e.g., US state code such as TX, LA, AK, or country code such as USA, GBR, NGA). Supports multi-jurisdictional compliance reporting and OPEC quota compliance tracking.
attributes.references: EPA; BSEE; BOEM; FERC; PHMSA; OPEC; ISO 3166

attributes.name: nov_issue_date

attributes.name: nov_number
attributes.description: Externally assigned Notice of Violation (NOV) number or citation reference issued by the regulatory authority. Serves as the official government-assigned identifier for the violation. Used for regulatory correspondence and closure documentation.
attributes.references: EPA; BSEE; OSHA; PHMSA; FERC; BOEM Enforcement Procedures

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Gross monetary penalty assessed by the regulatory authority for the violation, in the currency specified by penalty_currency. Null if no monetary penalty has been assessed. Used for financial exposure tracking, CAPEX/OPEX impact analysis, and SEC disclosure assessment.

attributes.name: penalty_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the assessed penalty amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency operations for international regulatory jurisdictions.

attributes.name: penalty_paid_date
attributes.description: Date the monetary penalty was paid in full or the final installment was remitted to the regulatory authority. Null if payment has not been completed. Used for financial reconciliation in SAP S/4HANA FI module.

attributes.name: penalty_payment_status

attributes.name: regulation_cited

attributes.name: effectiveness_review_notes

attributes.name: effectiveness_review_status

attributes.name: esg_category

attributes.name: estimated_cost_usd

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: priority_level

attributes.name: regulatory_authority

attributes.name: regulatory_citation

attributes.name: regulatory_deadline_date

attributes.name: responsible_party_name

attributes.name: root_cause_category

attributes.name: root_cause_description

attributes.description: Timestamp when this certification record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; ISO 14001:2015; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the certification fee amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, SAR). Supports multi-currency financial reporting for multinational operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS/GAAP; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: enablon_cert_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier for this certification record in the Enablon HSE Management system, enabling traceability between the enterprise data platform and the operational HSE system of record.
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management System; ISO 14001:2015; ISO 45001:2018

attributes.name: esg_reporting_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Social and Governance (ESG) Reporting Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is referenced in or supports the company's Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) reporting disclosures (e.g., ISO 14001 certification cited in ESG report, GHG verification certifications).
attributes.references: ESG Reporting Frameworks; GRI Standards; TCFD Recommendations; SEC Climate Disclosure Rules

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification expires and is no longer valid unless renewed. Null for certifications with no defined expiry (e.g., certain SOX attestations). Used to drive renewal workflows and compliance calendar alerts.
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015; ISO 45001:2018; BSEE SEMS Rule; API Standards; PHMSA 49 CFR Part 195

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: The fee paid to the certifying body for the initial certification or most recent renewal audit, expressed in the currency defined by currency_code. Used for OPEX budgeting and cost tracking.
attributes.references: COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: ghg_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is related to Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions verification, carbon accounting, or climate-related compliance (e.g., ISO 14064 GHG verification, EPA GHG Reporting Program certifications).
attributes.references: ISO 14064:2018; EPA 40 CFR Part 98 GHG Reporting; ESG Reporting Frameworks

attributes.name: hse_classification
attributes.description: Classifies the certification by its Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) domain. 'environmental' for ISO 14001 and EPA-related certifications; 'occupational_health_safety' for ISO 45001 and OSHA certifications; 'process_safety' for API RP 750/OSHA PSM certifications; 'combined_hse' for integrated management system certifications; 'not_applicable' for financial or non-HSE certifications.
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015; ISO 45001:2018; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119; API RP 750; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certifying body formally issued or granted the certification. Represents the start of the certification's validity period.
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015; ISO 45001:2018; API Standards; BSEE SEMS Rule

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent surveillance, recertification, or assessment audit conducted by the certifying body against this certification standard.
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015; ISO 45001:2018; BSEE SEMS Rule; API Standards; ISO/IEC 17021-1:2015

attributes.name: major_nonconformance_count
attributes.description: Number of major nonconformances identified during the most recent certification audit. Major nonconformances typically require resolution before the certificate can be issued or maintained.

attributes.name: next_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the next planned surveillance or recertification audit scheduled by the certifying body. Used to drive compliance calendar planning and resource allocation.
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015; ISO 45001:2018; BSEE SEMS Rule; ISO/IEC 17021-1:2015

attributes.name: nonconformance_count
attributes.description: Number of nonconformances or findings identified during the most recent certification audit. Major and minor nonconformances must be resolved before or after certification issuance per certifying body requirements.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17021-1:2015; ISO 14001:2015; ISO 45001:2018; BSEE SEMS Rule

attributes.name: offshore_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification applies to offshore operations (True) or onshore operations (False). Offshore certifications are subject to BSEE/BOEM jurisdiction and additional regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250; BOEM 30 CFR Part 550; API RP 75

attributes.name: operator_qualification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is an Operator Qualification (OQ) certification for pipeline operations personnel, as required by PHMSA regulations for covered tasks on pipeline facilities.
attributes.references: PHMSA 49 CFR Part 192 Subpart N; PHMSA 49 CFR Part 195 Subpart G; API RP 1161

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certification or evidence of certification was submitted to the relevant regulatory authority. Null if regulatory_submission_required is False or submission has not yet occurred.
attributes.references: BSEE SEMS Rule 30 CFR Part 250; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 302/906; SEC Form 10-K

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification or evidence of its maintenance must be formally submitted to a regulatory authority (e.g., BSEE SEMS certification submission, SEC SOX certifications filed with annual reports).
attributes.references: BSEE SEMS Rule 30 CFR Part 250; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 302/906; SEC Form 10-K

attributes.name: renewal_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the renewal application or re-certification audit must be initiated or completed to maintain continuous certification coverage. Typically set ahead of the expiration date based on certifying body requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015; ISO 45001:2018; API Standards; BSEE SEMS Rule

attributes.name: renewal_status
attributes.description: Current status of the renewal process for this certification. 'not_required' for certifications that do not expire; 'pending' when renewal has not yet been initiated; 'in_progress' when the renewal audit or application is underway; 'submitted' when the renewal application has been filed; 'approved' when renewal is confirmed; 'rejected' when renewal was denied.
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015; ISO 45001:2018; BSEE SEMS Rule; API Standards

attributes.name: scope_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the organizational scope, geographic boundaries, operational activities, and processes covered by the certification (e.g., 'Offshore drilling operations in Gulf of Mexico including platforms A, B, C', 'Refinery crude distillation and hydrodesulfurization units at Baytown facility').
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015 Clause 4.3; ISO 45001:2018 Clause 4.3; BSEE SEMS Rule 30 CFR Part 250 Subpart S

attributes.name: sems_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Safety and Environmental Management System (SEMS) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is associated with the BSEE Safety and Environmental Management System (SEMS) program applicable to offshore oil and gas operations on the U.S. Outer Continental Shelf.
attributes.references: BSEE SEMS Rule 30 CFR Part 250 Subpart S; API RP 75

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is directly associated with a Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) internal control requirement, such as CEO/CFO Section 302 or Section 906 certifications, or certifications supporting SOX financial reporting controls.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 302; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 906; SEC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: standard
attributes.description: The specific standard, regulation, or framework against which the certification is issued (e.g., ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018, ISO 55001:2014, API RP 75, BSEE SEMS, SOX Section 302, PHMSA OQ, OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119).
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015; ISO 45001:2018; ISO 55001:2014; API RP 75; BSEE 30 CFR Part 250; Sarbanes-Oxley Act; PHMSA 49 CFR Part 195; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119

attributes.name: state_province_code
attributes.description: State or province code where the certification applies, using ISO 3166-2 subdivision codes (e.g., US-TX for Texas, US-LA for Louisiana). Relevant for state-level regulatory certifications.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2; EPA State Programs; OSHA State Plans

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the certification (e.g., 'ISO 14001:2015 Environmental Management System Certification', 'BSEE Safety and Environmental Management System Certification', 'SOX CEO/CFO Section 302 Certification').
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015; ISO 45001:2018; BSEE SEMS Rule; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 302/906

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certification record was most recently modified in the enterprise data platform. Supports change tracking and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; ISO 14001:2015; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: parent_regulatory_authority_id

attributes.name: abbreviation

attributes.name: active_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the authority.

attributes.name: address

attributes.name: authority_type

attributes.name: compliance_scope

attributes.name: contact_email

attributes.name: data_submission_method

attributes.name: jurisdiction

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: regulatory_authority_name
