domains.name: procurement
domains.description: Manages the full source-to-pay lifecycle including vendor qualification, sourcing, contract administration, purchase orders, EPC and FEED contractor management, materials management, and spend analytics for drilling services, oilfield equipment, refinery catalysts, and maintenance materials. Supports CAPEX project procurement, rig contracts, AFE budget control, and service agreements. Integrates with SAP MM/PS modules aligned with COPAS material procurement standards.

products.name: vendor
products.description: Master record for all vendors, suppliers, and service providers in the oil and gas procurement ecosystem, including drilling contractors, oilfield equipment suppliers, EPC firms, FEED contractors, catalyst suppliers, and maintenance material vendors. Captures vendor legal name, registration number, country of incorporation, vendor type (contractor, supplier, service provider), business category (drilling services, oilfield equipment, refinery chemicals, MRO), tax identification, DUNS number, SAP vendor master number, payment terms, currency, bank details, preferred contact, qualification status, blacklist flag, COPAS-compliant vendor classification, and active/inactive status. Serves as the SSOT for vendor identity within the procurement domain.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor record. Primary key.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether the vendor is currently active and available for new procurement activities.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the vendor's registered business address, typically containing street number and street name.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the vendor's registered business address for additional address details such as suite, building, or floor number.

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: Vendor's bank account number for electronic funds transfer and payment processing.
attributes.references: PCI DSS, SAP FI Bank Master Data

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution where the vendor maintains their primary business account for payment receipt.

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: Bank routing number, SWIFT code, or IBAN used for international and domestic wire transfers to the vendor.

attributes.name: blacklist_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor was added to the blacklist.

attributes.name: blacklist_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether the vendor is blacklisted or prohibited from doing business due to compliance violations, safety incidents, or contractual breaches.

attributes.name: blacklist_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the vendor was blacklisted, including reference to specific incidents, violations, or regulatory actions.

attributes.name: business_category
attributes.description: Detailed business category describing the vendor's primary goods or services: drilling services, oilfield equipment, refinery chemicals, catalysts, MRO (Maintenance Repair and Operations) materials, EPC services, FEED services, transportation, logistics, or other specialized categories. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: drilling_services|oilfield_equipment|refinery_chemicals|catalysts|mro_materials|epc_services|feed_services|transportation|logistics|consulting|inspection|testing|environmental_services — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the vendor's registered business address.

attributes.name: copas_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies (COPAS) Classification
attributes.description: COPAS-compliant vendor classification code used for joint interest billing and AFE (Authorization for Expenditure) cost allocation in joint ventures.

attributes.name: country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the vendor's registered business address.

attributes.name: country_of_incorporation
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the country where the vendor is legally incorporated or registered.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor record was first created in the procurement system.
attributes.references: SAP MM Vendor Master Audit Trail

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit DUNS number assigned by Dun & Bradstreet for vendor identification and credit assessment.

attributes.name: hse_rating
attributes.description: HSE (Health Safety and Environment) performance rating based on incident history, safety audits, and compliance with OSHA, EPA, and API standards.

attributes.name: insurance_certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate number for the vendor's liability insurance policy, required for contractor and service provider qualification.

attributes.name: insurance_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the vendor's current liability insurance coverage.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor record was last updated or modified.
attributes.references: SAP MM Vendor Master Audit Trail

attributes.name: last_purchase_order_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent purchase order issued to this vendor, used for vendor activity tracking and performance analysis.

attributes.name: minority_owned_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether the vendor is certified as a minority-owned business enterprise for diversity and inclusion reporting.

attributes.name: payment_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code representing the preferred or default currency for payments to this vendor.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms negotiated with the vendor, such as Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30, or other custom payment schedules.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the vendor's registered business address.

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether the vendor has preferred status based on performance, pricing, or strategic partnership agreements.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact person for procurement communications, purchase order confirmations, and vendor correspondence.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4, SAP MM Vendor Master

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact person at the vendor organization for procurement and operational communications.
attributes.references: SAP MM Vendor Master Contact Data

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the vendor contact, including country and area codes.

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor was last qualified or approved for procurement activities.

attributes.name: qualification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor's current qualification status expires and requires renewal or reassessment.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current qualification status of the vendor based on HSE (Health Safety and Environment) compliance, financial stability, technical capability, and past performance assessments.

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: Official business registration or incorporation number issued by the vendor's country of incorporation. Used for legal verification and compliance.

attributes.name: small_business_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether the vendor qualifies as a small business under applicable government or industry definitions.
attributes.references: SBA Size Standards, ESG Reporting Standards

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region of the vendor's registered business address.

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: Tax identification number or employer identification number (EIN) used for tax reporting and compliance in the vendor's jurisdiction.

attributes.name: vendor_code
attributes.description: External business identifier or vendor number used in procurement systems and purchase orders. Maps to SAP vendor master number.

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the vendor, supplier, or service provider as registered in their country of incorporation.

attributes.name: vendor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vendor based on their primary business relationship: contractor (drilling, construction), supplier (equipment, materials), service provider (maintenance, logistics), EPC (Engineering Procurement and Construction) firm, FEED (Front-End Engineering Design) contractor, or consultant.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Vendor's official website URL for reference and additional company information.

products.name: vendor_qualification
products.description: Qualification and pre-qualification assessment record for vendors seeking approval to supply goods or services to Oil Gas, including Approved Vendor List (AVL) status and commodity-level approval scope. Captures qualification reference number, vendor ID, qualification type (pre-qualification, full qualification, re-qualification), scope of supply (drilling services, EPC, catalyst supply, MRO), commodity category code, approved value limit (USD), qualification date, expiry date, qualification status (pending, approved, conditionally approved, rejected, expired, suspended), technical evaluation score, financial evaluation score, HSE evaluation score, QHSE certification references (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001), API certification numbers, evaluator name, approval authority, approval scope (global, regional, asset-specific), preferred vendor flag, strategic vendor flag, sole source flag, and disqualification reason. Supports COPAS and API vendor qualification standards and governs vendor selection eligibility for RFQ issuance and direct award decisions.
products.reference: API Recommended Practice for Vendor Qualification

attributes.name: vendor_qualification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor qualification record. Primary key for the vendor qualification entity.

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Vendor qualification scoped to specific petroleum product categories (crude supply, refined products, petrochemicals). Ensures vendors meet quality, compliance, and technical requirements for specific

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor entity being qualified. Links to the vendor master record in the procurement system.

attributes.name: api_certification_numbers
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of American Petroleum Institute (API) certification numbers held by the vendor. API certifications validate compliance with industry standards for equipment, materials, and services used in oil and gas operations. Examples include API Spec Q1, API Spec 6A, API Spec 5CT.

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: Name and title of the authorized individual who granted final approval for the vendor qualification. Typically a Procurement Manager, Supply Chain Director, or Vice President depending on qualification scope and value limit.
attributes.references: COPAS Vendor Management Standards, SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the approval authority officially approved the vendor qualification. May differ from qualification date if approval is backdated to evaluation completion.

attributes.name: approval_scope
attributes.description: Geographic or organizational scope of the vendor qualification. Global indicates qualification for all Oil Gas operations worldwide, regional indicates qualification for specific geographic regions (e.g., North America, Middle East), asset-specific indicates qualification for specific facilities or fields, and project-specific indicates qualification for a single Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) project.

attributes.name: approved_regions
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of geographic regions or countries where the vendor is qualified to operate. Uses three-letter ISO country codes (e.g., USA, SAU, NOR, BRA). Applicable when approval scope is regional or asset-specific.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Country Codes, COPAS Vendor Management Standards

attributes.name: approved_value_limit_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Approved Value Limit (United States Dollar - USD)
attributes.description: Maximum cumulative contract value in United States Dollars (USD) that the vendor is authorized to supply under this qualification. Used for Authorization for Expenditure (AFE) and Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) budget control. Null indicates no monetary limit.
attributes.references: COPAS AFE Standards, SAP MM Purchase Order Limits

attributes.name: avl_status
attributes.description: Current status of the vendor on the Approved Vendor List (AVL) for the qualified commodity category. Active indicates vendor is eligible for Request for Quotation (RFQ) issuance and direct awards, inactive indicates qualification expired or vendor requested removal, suspended indicates temporary hold due to performance or compliance issues, and pending removal indicates disqualification process underway.

attributes.name: background_check_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether background checks (corporate due diligence, sanctions screening, anti-corruption checks, beneficial ownership verification) have been completed for the vendor. True indicates background check completed and cleared, False indicates background check not completed or issues identified.
attributes.references: FCPA Compliance, OFAC Sanctions, UK Bribery Act

attributes.name: commodity_category_code
attributes.description: Standardized commodity classification code aligned with SAP Material Management (MM) material groups or UNSPSC codes. Defines the specific product or service category the vendor is qualified to supply.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Group, UNSPSC Classification

attributes.name: commodity_category_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the commodity category corresponding to the commodity category code. Examples include Drilling Services, Wellhead Equipment, Refinery Catalysts, Piping and Valves, or Instrumentation and Controls.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Group, UNSPSC Classification

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor qualification record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls, Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: disqualification_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation for vendor disqualification or qualification rejection. May include technical deficiencies, financial instability, Health Safety and Environment (HSE) violations, ethical breaches, contract performance failures, or regulatory non-compliance. Null if qualification is approved.

attributes.name: evaluator_email
attributes.description: Email address of the evaluator who conducted the vendor qualification assessment. Used for follow-up questions and audit trail.

attributes.name: evaluator_name
attributes.description: Full name of the procurement or technical specialist who conducted the vendor qualification evaluation. Provides accountability and contact for qualification questions.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the vendor qualification expires and requires renewal or re-qualification. Null indicates indefinite qualification subject to periodic review.

attributes.name: financial_evaluation_score
attributes.description: Numerical score representing the vendor's financial stability and creditworthiness assessment. Typically scored on a 0-100 scale based on financial statements, credit rating, liquidity ratios, debt-to-equity ratio, and payment history. Ensures vendor can fulfill long-term contracts.
attributes.references: COPAS Vendor Management Standards, GAAP Financial Analysis

attributes.name: hse_evaluation_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Evaluation Score
attributes.description: Numerical score representing the vendor's Health Safety and Environment (HSE) performance and compliance assessment. Typically scored on a 0-100 scale based on Total Recordable Incident Rate (TRIR), Lost Time Injury Frequency (LTIF), environmental compliance record, HSE management systems, and safety culture. Critical for high-risk operations such as drilling and Simultaneous Operations (SIMOPS).
attributes.references: OSHA Standards, API RP 75, ISO 45001, ISO 14001

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor's insurance coverage (general liability, professional indemnity, workers compensation, pollution liability) has been verified and meets Oil Gas requirements. True indicates insurance verified and adequate, False indicates insurance not verified or inadequate.
attributes.references: COPAS Vendor Management Standards, API RP 75

attributes.name: insurance_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the vendor's insurance coverage. Used to trigger insurance renewal verification and prevent engagement of vendors with lapsed coverage.

attributes.name: iso_14001_certification_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 14001 Certification Number
attributes.description: Certificate number for ISO 14001 Environmental Management System certification. Validates vendor's environmental management processes and compliance capability.

attributes.name: iso_45001_certification_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 45001 Certification Number
attributes.description: Certificate number for ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management System certification. Validates vendor's occupational health and safety management processes.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management System

attributes.name: iso_9001_certification_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 9001 Certification Number
attributes.description: Certificate number for ISO 9001 Quality Management System certification. Validates vendor's quality management processes and continuous improvement capability.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the individual who last modified the vendor qualification record. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls, Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor qualification record was last updated. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data freshness assessment.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls, Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review or re-qualification assessment of the vendor. Used to trigger re-qualification workflows and ensure ongoing vendor capability and compliance.

attributes.name: overall_qualification_score
attributes.description: Composite weighted score combining technical, financial, and Health Safety and Environment (HSE) evaluation scores. Used for vendor ranking and Approved Vendor List (AVL) prioritization. Typically scored on a 0-100 scale.

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has preferred vendor status for the qualified commodity category. Preferred vendors receive priority consideration in Request for Quotation (RFQ) processes and may have negotiated pricing agreements. True indicates preferred status, False indicates standard qualified vendor.

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the vendor qualification was officially approved and became effective. Represents the start of the qualification validity period.

attributes.name: qualification_reference_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the qualification record, used for external communication and tracking. Format: VQ-YYYYNNNN where YYYY is year and NNNN is sequence.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor qualification. Pending indicates submission received, under review indicates active evaluation, approved indicates full qualification granted, conditionally approved requires specific conditions to be met, rejected indicates disqualification, expired indicates qualification period ended, suspended indicates temporary hold, and withdrawn indicates vendor or company cancelled the qualification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|under review|approved|conditionally approved|rejected|expired|suspended|withdrawn — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: qualification_type
attributes.description: Type of qualification assessment being performed. Pre-qualification is initial screening, full qualification is comprehensive assessment, re-qualification is periodic renewal, conditional qualification requires remediation, and expedited qualification is fast-track for urgent needs.

attributes.name: reinstatement_date
attributes.description: Date on which a previously suspended vendor qualification was reinstated to active status after remediation of suspension issues. Null if qualification has never been suspended or has not been reinstated.

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_status
attributes.description: Result of sanctions screening against Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC), United Nations (UN), European Union (EU), and other sanctions lists. Cleared indicates no matches found, flagged indicates potential match requiring investigation, pending indicates screening in progress, and not screened indicates screening not yet performed.
attributes.references: OFAC Sanctions, UN Sanctions, EU Sanctions

attributes.name: scope_of_supply
attributes.description: Detailed description of the goods or services the vendor is qualified to provide. May include drilling services, Engineering Procurement and Construction (EPC), Front-End Engineering Design (FEED), catalyst supply, Maintenance Repair and Operations (MRO) materials, oilfield equipment, refinery equipment, petrochemical feedstocks, or specialized technical services.
attributes.references: API Standards, COPAS Vendor Management Standards

attributes.name: sole_source_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is the sole qualified source for the specified commodity category, typically due to proprietary technology, intellectual property rights, or unique capability. Sole source vendors may be exempt from competitive bidding requirements. True indicates sole source, False indicates competitive market.
attributes.references: COPAS Vendor Management Standards, Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR)

attributes.name: strategic_vendor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is designated as a strategic partner with long-term relationship agreements, joint development programs, or integrated supply chain arrangements. Strategic vendors typically support critical operations or provide unique capabilities. True indicates strategic status, False indicates transactional relationship.

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: Date on which the vendor qualification was suspended. Null if qualification has never been suspended.

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation for temporary suspension of vendor qualification. May include ongoing investigation of Health Safety and Environment (HSE) incident, quality non-conformance, contract dispute, financial concerns, or regulatory enforcement action. Null if qualification is not suspended.

attributes.name: technical_evaluation_score
attributes.description: Numerical score representing the vendor's technical capability assessment. Typically scored on a 0-100 scale based on technical expertise, equipment capability, process maturity, quality systems, and past performance. attributes.name: plant_code

attributes.name: storage_location

attributes.name: tax_amount

attributes.name: tax_code

attributes.description: Allowable percentage by which the vendor may under-deliver against the ordered quantity without requiring approval. Expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: unit_price

attributes.name: posting_date

attributes.name: valuation_type

products.name: contract
products.description: Master procurement contract or framework agreement governing the commercial relationship between Oil Gas and a vendor for supply of materials or services, including rig contracts with day-rate structures. Captures contract number, contract type (master supply agreement, blanket purchase agreement, rig contract, EPC contract, FEED contract, service agreement, rate agreement), vendor ID, contract title, effective date, expiry date, contract value (USD), currency, scope of work summary, payment terms, performance bond value, liquidated damages clause, price escalation mechanism, governing law, dispute resolution mechanism, contract status (draft, active, expired, terminated, suspended), SAP outline agreement number, and for rig contracts: rig name, rig type, day rate (USD/day), standby rate (USD/day), mobilization/demobilization fees, NPT penalty provisions, well program reference, operating area, and early termination clause. Includes milestone schedule for EPC/FEED contracts with milestone descriptions, planned/actual dates, payment percentages, and completion status. Distinct from JOA/PSA agreements owned by the venture domain.
products.reference: SAP MM Outline Agreement (EKKO contract type)

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the procurement contract record. Primary key.

attributes.name: afe_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.afe_budget. Business justification: Procurement contracts for CAPEX projects (drilling, completion, EPC, FEED) are executed against AFE budgets. This enables contract value validation against AFE approved budget, commitment tracking, an

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Contracts need default cost center for budget monitoring, commitment tracking, and organizational cost allocation. Essential for contract management and financial planning in oil & gas operations.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or contractor party to this procurement contract. Links to vendor master data in SAP MM.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Contracts for drilling rigs, completion services, and capital projects must link to WBS for commitment tracking and budget control. Critical for project-based contract management and AFE monitoring.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract was formally approved by authorized signatories. Distinct from effective date which is when the contract becomes binding.

attributes.name: contract_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the procurement contract by spend category. Drilling services for rig and well services, oilfield equipment for downhole and surface equipment, refinery catalysts for refining process materials, maintenance materials for MRO (Maintenance Repair and Operations), engineering services for FEED and design, construction services for EPC and facilities.
attributes.references: Procurement Category Management; COPAS Material Classification

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the procurement contract. Used in SAP MM outline agreements and vendor communications.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Management - Outline Agreement Number

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the procurement contract. Draft indicates contract under negotiation, active indicates contract in force, expired indicates contract past expiry date, terminated indicates early termination, suspended indicates temporary hold, pending_approval indicates awaiting authorization.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the procurement contract governing the commercial relationship. Master supply agreement for recurring materials, blanket purchase agreement for framework pricing, rig contract for drilling services with day-rate structures, EPC (Engineering Procurement and Construction) contract for capital projects, FEED (Front-End Engineering Design) contract for pre-project engineering, or service agreement for ongoing operational services.
attributes.references: COPAS Material Procurement Standards; SAP MM Contract Types

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this procurement contract record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for contract financial terms (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Used for multi-currency contract management and foreign exchange exposure tracking.

attributes.name: day_rate_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Day Rate (United States Dollar - USD per Day)
attributes.description: Daily operating rate charged by the drilling contractor when the rig is actively drilling, expressed in United States Dollars per day. Core commercial term for rig contracts. Nullable for non-rig contracts.
attributes.references: Drilling Contract Economics - Day Rate Definition

attributes.name: demobilization_fee_usd
attributes.description: One-time fee paid to the drilling contractor to move the rig away from the operating location at contract end, expressed in United States Dollars. Nullable for non-rig contracts.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_mechanism
attributes.description: Agreed method for resolving contractual disputes. Litigation involves court proceedings, arbitration involves binding third-party arbitrator (common in international contracts), mediation involves facilitated negotiation, expert determination involves technical expert decision.
attributes.references: Contract Law - Dispute Resolution; ICC Arbitration Rules

attributes.name: early_termination_clause
attributes.description: Description of conditions and penalties under which either party may terminate the contract before the expiry date. May include termination for convenience provisions with notice periods and termination fees.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract becomes legally binding and enforceable. Marks the start of the contract term.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract term ends and obligations cease unless renewed. Nullable for open-ended contracts or contracts with automatic renewal clauses.

attributes.name: governing_law
attributes.description: Jurisdiction and legal framework governing the interpretation and enforcement of the contract (e.g., 'State of Texas, USA', 'English Law', 'Norwegian Law'). Critical for international contracts.
attributes.references: International Contract Law - Choice of Law

attributes.name: hse_requirements
attributes.description: Summary of HSE (Health Safety and Environment) standards, certifications, and performance requirements that the vendor must meet. May reference API, OSHA, EPA, or company-specific HSE standards.
attributes.references: API Safety Standards; OSHA Regulations; EPA Environmental Standards

attributes.name: insurance_requirements
attributes.description: Description of insurance coverage types and minimum limits required from the vendor (e.g., general liability, professional indemnity, pollution liability). Critical for HSE (Health Safety and Environment) risk management.
attributes.references: Risk Management - Insurance Requirements; HSE Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this procurement contract record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: liquidated_damages_clause
attributes.description: Description of pre-agreed damages payable by vendor for specific breaches such as late delivery, non-performance, or failure to meet specifications. Common in EPC contracts for schedule delays.

attributes.name: mobilization_fee_usd
attributes.description: One-time fee paid to the drilling contractor to move the rig to the operating location at contract start, expressed in United States Dollars. Nullable for non-rig contracts.

attributes.name: npt_penalty_provisions
attributes.description: Description of penalties or rate reductions applied when the rig experiences non-productive time due to contractor-caused issues. NPT (Non-Productive Time) is a critical KPI in drilling operations. Nullable for non-rig contracts.
attributes.references: Drilling Operations - NPT Management; IADC Drilling Contract Standards

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Commercial payment conditions including payment schedule, net days, milestone-based payments, or progress billing terms (e.g., 'Net 30', '50% upfront / 50% on completion', 'Monthly arrears').
attributes.references: SAP FI Payment Terms; COPAS Joint Interest Billing

attributes.name: performance_bond_value_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Performance Bond Value (United States Dollar - USD)
attributes.description: Monetary value of the performance bond or guarantee required from the vendor to secure contract performance, expressed in United States Dollars. Common in EPC and rig contracts to mitigate non-performance risk.

attributes.name: price_escalation_mechanism
attributes.description: Formula or index used to adjust contract pricing over time (e.g., CPI-linked, oil price index, fixed annual percentage). Protects both parties from inflation or commodity price volatility.

attributes.name: renewal_option_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract includes an option for renewal or extension beyond the initial term. True if renewal option exists, False otherwise.

attributes.name: renewal_terms
attributes.description: Description of renewal or extension terms including notice period, pricing adjustments, and conditions. Nullable if renewal_option_flag is False.

attributes.name: sap_outline_agreement_number
attributes.description: SAP MM system identifier for the outline agreement (contract or scheduling agreement) linked to this procurement contract. Enables integration between contract management and procurement execution.

attributes.name: scope_of_work_summary
attributes.description: High-level description of the goods or services covered under this contract. For rig contracts, includes well program reference and operating area. For EPC contracts, includes project deliverables and specifications.

attributes.name: standby_rate_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Standby Rate (United States Dollar - USD per Day)
attributes.description: Reduced daily rate charged when the rig is on standby (not actively drilling but available), expressed in United States Dollars per day. Typically 50-80% of day rate. Nullable for non-rig contracts.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Descriptive title or name of the procurement contract summarizing its purpose and scope (e.g., 'Offshore Drilling Services - Gulf of Mexico 2024', 'Refinery Catalyst Supply Agreement').

attributes.name: value_usd
attributes.description: Total estimated or maximum monetary value of the contract in United States Dollars. For rig contracts, represents total estimated spend based on day rate and expected duration. For EPC/FEED contracts, represents total project value. Aligns with AFE (Authorization for Expenditure) budget control.
attributes.references: COPAS AFE Budget Standards; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: well_program_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the well program or drilling campaign that this rig contract supports. Links contract to operational drilling plans. Nullable for non-rig contracts.

products.name: afe_budget
products.description: Authorization for Expenditure (AFE) budget record controlling CAPEX procurement spend for drilling, completion, facility construction, and major maintenance projects. Captures AFE number, AFE title, AFE type (drilling, workover, facility, pipeline, turnaround), project number, WBS element, cost center, business unit, field or asset name, AFE status (proposed, approved, active, closed, cancelled), approved budget (USD), currency, approval date, approving authority, budget breakdown by cost category (drilling services, tubulars, completion equipment, EPC, FEED), committed spend to date, actual spend to date, and remaining budget. Integrates with SAP PS and COPAS AFE accounting standards.

attributes.name: afe_budget_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the AFE budget record. Primary key for the AFE budget entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: AFE budgets require cost center assignment for organizational cost tracking, reporting hierarchy, and operational vs. capital classification. Standard financial structure for oil & gas capital project

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: AFE budgets link to WBS for project structure, capital tracking, and asset capitalization. Standard project accounting requirement for drilling and completion programs in oil & gas.

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the AFE project work was completed and the AFE was closed for final cost reconciliation.

attributes.name: actual_spend
attributes.description: The cumulative amount of budget that has been actually spent (invoiced and paid or accrued) against this AFE. Represents realized expenditure.

attributes.name: afe_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique AFE number assigned to this authorization for expenditure. This is the business identifier used across joint venture partners and in COPAS joint interest billing.

attributes.name: afe_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the AFE: proposed (draft, awaiting approval), approved (authorized but not yet active), active (work in progress, spend occurring), closed (project complete, final reconciliation done), or cancelled (AFE withdrawn before completion).

attributes.name: afe_title
attributes.description: Descriptive title or name of the AFE project, summarizing the scope of work (e.g., 'Eagle Ford Well 123 Drilling and Completion', 'Refinery Turnaround 2024').

attributes.name: afe_type
attributes.description: Classification of the AFE by project type: drilling (new well), workover (well intervention), completion (well completion activities), facility (surface facility construction), pipeline (pipeline construction or expansion), turnaround (refinery or plant turnaround), or maintenance (major maintenance project). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: drilling|workover|completion|facility|pipeline|turnaround|maintenance — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the AFE was formally approved by the approving authority, granting spending authorization.

attributes.name: approved_budget_amount
attributes.description: The total authorized budget amount for this AFE in the specified currency. This is the spending authority granted by the approving authority and represents the CAPEX or OPEX ceiling for the project.

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: The fixed asset class or category for CAPEX AFEs, used for depreciation calculation and asset accounting (e.g., 'Producing Wells', 'Gathering Systems', 'Processing Facilities', 'Refining Units').
attributes.references: IFRS/GAAP Oil and Gas Accounting Standards

attributes.name: budget_variance
attributes.description: The variance between approved budget and actual spend, expressed as a monetary amount. Positive values indicate under-budget, negative values indicate over-budget.

attributes.name: budget_variance_percentage
attributes.description: The variance between approved budget and actual spend, expressed as a percentage of the approved budget. Used for performance monitoring and variance analysis.

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: The business unit or operating division responsible for this AFE (e.g., Upstream E&P, Midstream, Downstream Refining, Petrochemicals).

attributes.name: capex_opex_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) or Operating Expenditure (OPEX) Classification
attributes.description: Classification of the AFE spend as either CAPEX (capital expenditure for asset acquisition or improvement) or OPEX (operating expenditure for routine operations and maintenance). Determines accounting treatment and depreciation.
attributes.references: IFRS/GAAP Oil and Gas Accounting Standards

attributes.name: committed_spend
attributes.description: The cumulative amount of budget that has been committed through purchase orders, contracts, and service agreements, but not yet invoiced or paid. Represents encumbered funds.

attributes.name: completion_equipment_budget
attributes.description: Budget allocation for well completion equipment including packers, subsurface safety valves, wellheads, Christmas trees, and artificial lift equipment. Part of the AFE cost category breakdown.

attributes.name: contingency_budget
attributes.description: The contingency or reserve amount included in the approved budget to cover unforeseen costs, risks, or scope changes. Typically expressed as a percentage of the base budget.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this AFE budget record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the approved budget amount (e.g., USD for US Dollars, CAD for Canadian Dollars). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USD|CAD|EUR|GBP|AUD|BRL|MXN — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: The depreciation method to be applied to CAPEX assets created by this AFE: straight_line (equal annual depreciation), units_of_production (depreciation based on production volumes), or declining_balance (accelerated depreciation).
attributes.references: IFRS/GAAP Oil and Gas Accounting Standards

attributes.name: drilling_services_budget
attributes.description: Budget allocation for drilling services including rig contracts, directional drilling, MWD/LWD services, and drilling fluids. Part of the AFE cost category breakdown.

attributes.name: epc_budget
attributes.description: Budget allocation for EPC contractor services covering engineering, procurement, and construction activities for facility projects. Part of the AFE cost category breakdown.

attributes.name: estimated_completion_date
attributes.description: The planned or estimated date for completion of the AFE project work and final cost reconciliation.

attributes.name: feed_budget
attributes.description: Budget allocation for FEED contractor services covering conceptual and detailed engineering design work prior to EPC execution. Part of the AFE cost category breakdown.

attributes.name: field_name
attributes.description: The name of the oil or gas field, asset, or facility where the AFE work will be performed (e.g., 'Permian Basin Block 45', 'Port Arthur Refinery').

attributes.name: jib_billing_code
attributes.description: The COPAS JIB billing code used for joint interest billing and cost allocation to non-operating partners. Determines how costs are categorized and billed in joint venture accounting.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who last modified this AFE budget record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this AFE budget record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: net_afe_amount
attributes.description: The company's net share of the AFE budget based on its working interest. Calculated as approved_budget_amount multiplied by working_interest percentage.

attributes.name: operator_name
attributes.description: The name of the operating company responsible for executing the AFE work. In joint venture operations, this is the company designated as operator under the JOA.

attributes.name: project_number
attributes.description: The project identifier from the ERP system (e.g., SAP PS project number) that this AFE is associated with for capital project tracking and financial integration.

attributes.name: remaining_budget
attributes.description: The amount of approved budget that remains available for future commitments and spending. Calculated as approved_budget_amount minus committed_spend minus actual_spend.

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: The revision or amendment number for this AFE. AFEs may be revised to adjust budget, scope, or timing. Original AFE is revision 0, subsequent revisions increment this counter.

attributes.name: tubulars_budget
attributes.description: Budget allocation for tubular goods including casing, tubing, drill pipe, and related materials. Part of the AFE cost category breakdown.

attributes.name: working_interest
attributes.description: The company's working interest percentage in the project or property covered by this AFE. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.3500 for 35% WI). Determines the company's share of AFE costs.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who created this AFE budget record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: vendor_invoice
products.description: Vendor invoice submitted for payment against a purchase order or service entry sheet, subject to three-way match verification (PO, GR/SES, invoice). Captures invoice number (vendor), SAP invoice document number, invoice date, vendor ID, PO reference, SES reference, invoice amount (USD), tax amount, total payable amount, currency, payment due date, payment terms, invoice status (received, under verification, approved, blocked, paid, disputed), three-way match status, blocking reason, and invoice receipt date. Distinct from revenue invoices owned by the revenue domain. Supports COPAS joint interest billing and AP processing.

attributes.name: vendor_invoice_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor invoice record in the lakehouse. Primary key.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.contract. Business justification: In oil and gas procurement, vendor invoices — particularly for day-rate drilling contracts, EPC contracts, and service agreements — are often submitted directly against a master contract rather than a

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the cost center to which this invoice amount is allocated for OPEX tracking and financial reporting.

attributes.name: drilling_afe_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the AFE budget authorization under which this invoice expenditure is charged. Critical for CAPEX project cost control and joint venture cost allocation.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the GL account to which this invoice is posted for financial accounting and reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the goods receipt document confirming material delivery. Used for three-way match verification when materials are procured.

attributes.name: joint_venture_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the joint venture or production sharing agreement under which this invoice cost is allocated. Used for partner billing and revenue distribution.

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Invoicing for petroleum product purchases requires product reference for pricing benchmarks, quality adjustments, and accounting classification. Critical for commodity trading settlements and financia

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the purchase order against which this invoice is submitted. Used for three-way match verification.

attributes.name: refinery_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to refining.refinery. Business justification: Vendor invoices must be allocated to specific refineries for site-level cost accounting, JIB billing, and accounts payable reporting. vendor_invoice.plant_code is a denormalized refinery reference. A

attributes.name: service_entry_sheet_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the service entry sheet confirming service completion. Used for three-way match verification when services are procured.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Service Entry Sheet

attributes.name: terminal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.terminal. Business justification: Terminal operators invoice shippers for storage fees, throughput tariffs, demurrage, and ancillary services. Direct terminal-to-invoice link required for tariff reconciliation, JIB allocation, PSA cos

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor who submitted this invoice. Links to the vendor master record.

attributes.name: voyage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.voyage. Business justification: Vendor invoices for voyage-related services (bunkers, port charges, canal fees, crew costs) must link to voyages for P&L calculation and charter party settlement. Real business process: voyage cost ac

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.work_order. Business justification: Vendor invoices for maintenance and repair work reference the work order for three-way match validation (WO→SES→Invoice). This link enables maintenance cost accrual accuracy, invoice dispute resolutio

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was approved for payment. Used for processing time analysis and internal control monitoring.

attributes.name: blocking_reason
attributes.description: The reason the invoice is blocked from payment if invoice_status is blocked. Examples include price variance, quantity variance, missing documentation, or vendor hold.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Payment Block Codes

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The SAP company code representing the legal entity that is liable for this invoice payment. Used for multi-entity financial consolidation and reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this invoice record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the invoice is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The discount amount applied to this invoice in the invoice currency. May include early payment discounts, volume discounts, or negotiated rebates.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate applied to convert the invoice currency to the company's functional currency (USD) at the time of posting. Used for multi-currency consolidation.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year to which this invoice is assigned based on the posting date. Used for monthly financial reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this invoice is assigned based on the posting date. Used for financial period reporting and year-end closing.

attributes.name: freight_amount
attributes.description: The freight or shipping charges included in this invoice in the invoice currency. Separately tracked for cost analysis and allocation.

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: The total payable amount converted to the company's functional currency (USD) using the exchange rate. Used for consolidated financial reporting.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date the vendor issued the invoice. Used to calculate payment due date and aging analysis.

attributes.name: invoice_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the goods or services covered by this invoice. Provides additional context for invoice verification and audit purposes.

attributes.name: invoice_gross_amount
attributes.description: The gross invoice amount before taxes and adjustments, in the invoice currency. Represents the base charge for goods or services.

attributes.name: invoice_receipt_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was received by the accounts payable department. Used for processing time tracking and internal SLA monitoring.

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: The current processing status of the invoice in the accounts payable workflow. Tracks the invoice from receipt through payment or dispute resolution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: received|under_verification|approved|blocked|paid|disputed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: The type of invoice document. Standard invoices are for completed goods or services; credit memos reduce amounts owed; debit memos increase amounts; prepayment and down payment invoices are for advance payments.

attributes.name: jib_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this invoice is subject to joint interest billing and cost allocation among joint venture partners per COPAS standards.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this invoice record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date payment was made to the vendor. Used for cash flow reporting and vendor payment performance tracking.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment is due to the vendor per the agreed payment terms. Used for cash flow planning and vendor relationship management.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method by which payment will be or was made to the vendor (e.g., ACH, wire transfer, check, credit card, electronic funds transfer).

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: The reference number of the payment transaction (e.g., check number, wire confirmation number, ACH trace number) once payment has been executed.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: The agreed payment terms for this invoice (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30). Defines the payment schedule and any early payment discounts available.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was posted to the general ledger in SAP. Used for financial period assignment and reporting.

attributes.name: sap_invoice_document_number
attributes.description: The internal SAP document number assigned to this invoice upon posting in SAP S/4HANA FI. Used for internal tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The total tax amount charged on this invoice in the invoice currency. Includes sales tax, VAT, GST, or other applicable taxes.

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.description: The result of the three-way match verification comparing the invoice against the purchase order and goods receipt or service entry sheet. Critical control for payment authorization.

attributes.name: total_payable_amount
attributes.description: The total amount payable to the vendor in the invoice currency. Calculated as gross amount plus tax minus discounts plus freight and other charges.

attributes.name: vendor_invoice_number
attributes.description: The invoice number assigned by the vendor. This is the external invoice identifier printed on the vendor's invoice document.

products.name: vendor_performance
products.description: Periodic vendor performance evaluation record assessing a vendor's delivery, quality, HSE, and commercial performance against contracted KPIs. Captures evaluation ID, vendor ID, contract reference, evaluation period (from/to dates), evaluation type (quarterly, annual, project completion), on-time delivery rate (%), quality acceptance rate (%), HSE incident count, HSE score, commercial compliance score, overall performance rating (excellent, satisfactory, marginal, unsatisfactory), evaluator name, evaluation date, corrective action required flag, corrective action plan reference, and performance trend (improving, stable, declining). Feeds vendor qualification renewal decisions.
products.reference: API RP for Contractor Performance Management

attributes.name: vendor_performance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor performance evaluation record.

attributes.name: audit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.audit. Business justification: Vendor performance evaluations incorporate HSE audit findings as a key input to HSE scores and overall ratings. Audit results (findings count, compliance rating, corrective actions) directly feed vend

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the contract under which this performance evaluation is conducted. May reference master service agreements, purchase orders, or project-specific contracts.

attributes.name: incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.incident. Business justification: Vendor performance evaluations must incorporate HSE incident history caused by or involving the vendor. Incidents directly impact HSE scores, qualification status, and contract renewal decisions. This

attributes.name: refinery_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to refining.refinery. Business justification: Vendor performance evaluations are conducted per operating site in multi-refinery companies. A refinery-scoped vendor scorecard enables site-specific supplier management decisions, local procurement s

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor being evaluated. Links to the vendor master record in procurement system.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the vendor performance evaluation was formally approved by procurement management.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval status of the performance evaluation. Indicates whether the evaluation has been reviewed and approved by procurement management.

attributes.name: approved_by_name
attributes.description: Name of the procurement manager or authorized approver who reviewed and approved the vendor performance evaluation.

attributes.name: commercial_compliance_score
attributes.description: Score reflecting adherence to commercial terms including invoicing accuracy, payment terms compliance, contract change order management, and administrative responsiveness. Typically scored 0-100.

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the corrective action plan document issued to the vendor. Links to formal improvement plan tracking system.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether corrective action is required from the vendor to address performance deficiencies identified during the evaluation.

attributes.name: cost_competitiveness_score
attributes.description: Score reflecting vendor pricing competitiveness relative to market benchmarks and peer vendors. Typically scored 0-100.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor performance evaluation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: defect_count
attributes.description: Total number of quality defects, non-conformances, or rejections recorded against vendor deliveries during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: evaluation_comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments providing qualitative context, notable achievements, specific concerns, or recommendations for vendor performance improvement.

attributes.name: evaluation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the performance evaluation was completed and finalized.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the performance evaluation period. Defines the close of the measurement window for vendor KPIs.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the performance evaluation period. Defines the beginning of the measurement window for vendor KPIs.

attributes.name: evaluation_type
attributes.description: Type or frequency of the performance evaluation. Indicates whether this is a routine periodic review or event-driven assessment.

attributes.name: evaluator_name
attributes.description: Name of the procurement or project professional who conducted the vendor performance evaluation.

attributes.name: hse_incident_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Incident Count
attributes.description: Total number of HSE incidents (recordable injuries, near misses, environmental releases, safety violations) attributed to the vendor during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: hse_score
attributes.description: Composite HSE performance score based on incident frequency, severity, compliance with safety procedures, and proactive safety culture. Typically scored 0-100.
attributes.references: API RP 75 Safety Management, OSHA VPP

attributes.name: invoice_accuracy_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of vendor invoices submitted without errors, discrepancies, or disputes requiring correction. Measures commercial process quality.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor performance evaluation record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: late_delivery_count
attributes.description: Total number of purchase orders or milestones delivered after the scheduled due date during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: next_evaluation_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic vendor performance evaluation. Used to trigger evaluation workflow and ensure continuous vendor monitoring.

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of deliveries or milestones completed on or before the scheduled date during the evaluation period. Key performance indicator for schedule adherence.

attributes.name: overall_performance_rating
attributes.description: Summary performance rating assigned to the vendor based on weighted evaluation of delivery, quality, HSE, and commercial compliance. Drives vendor qualification status and future sourcing decisions.

attributes.name: performance_trend
attributes.description: Directional trend of vendor performance compared to prior evaluation periods. Indicates whether performance is improving, stable, or declining over time.

attributes.name: quality_acceptance_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of delivered goods or services that passed quality inspection on first submission without rework or rejection. Measures conformance to specifications.

attributes.name: recommendation
attributes.description: Evaluator recommendation for future engagement with the vendor. Drives vendor qualification renewal and approved vendor list maintenance.

attributes.name: responsiveness_score
attributes.description: Score reflecting vendor responsiveness to inquiries, change requests, and issue resolution. Typically scored 0-100 based on turnaround time and communication quality.

attributes.name: sustainability_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Social and Governance (ESG) Sustainability Score
attributes.description: Score assessing vendor performance on environmental stewardship, social responsibility, and governance practices. Increasingly important for ESG reporting and responsible sourcing. Typically scored 0-100.

attributes.name: technical_capability_score
attributes.description: Score assessing vendor technical competence, innovation, and ability to meet complex specifications. Relevant for EPC, FEED, and specialized service contractors. Typically scored 0-100.

attributes.name: total_purchase_orders_evaluated
attributes.description: Total number of purchase orders or delivery events included in this evaluation period. Provides context for statistical significance of performance metrics.

attributes.name: total_value_evaluated_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Value Evaluated United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Total dollar value of goods and services procured from the vendor during the evaluation period, expressed in USD. Used to weight vendor importance in spend analytics.

attributes.name: vendor_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the vendor was formally notified of the performance evaluation results.

attributes.name: vendor_notified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has been formally notified of the evaluation results and any required corrective actions.

domains.name: finance
domains.description: Serves as the SSOT for enterprise financial management including general ledger, cost center accounting, CAPEX/OPEX budgeting, LOE tracking, DD&A calculations, AFE management, NPV/IRR project economics, EBITDA reporting, and financial statements. Owns chart of accounts, journal entries, cost centers, and financial planning. Supports IFRS/GAAP oil and gas accounting (successful efforts and full cost methods), SEC financial disclosure, and SOX compliance. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA FI/CO modules.

products.name: cost_center
products.description: Master record for all cost centers in the oil and gas enterprise, representing organizational units used to accumulate and track OPEX, LOE, and overhead costs. Captures cost center code, description, cost center type (production, drilling, G&A, exploration), responsible manager, company code, controlling area, profit center assignment, currency, valid-from/to dates, and hierarchical parent cost center. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA CO module as the primary cost object for expense allocation and internal reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cost center record. Primary key.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Cost Center Master Data

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Cost centers belong to legal entities. The existing company_code STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to company_code.company_code_id to enable legal entity-level cost center hierarchi

attributes.name: parent_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent cost center in the cost center hierarchy, enabling roll-up reporting and hierarchical cost allocation. Null for top-level cost centers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Cost Center Hierarchy

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the profit center to which this cost center is assigned for segment reporting and profitability analysis. Enables roll-up of costs to revenue-generating business units.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Profit Center Accounting

attributes.name: activity_type
attributes.description: The primary operational activity type associated with this cost center, used for activity-based costing and operational performance analysis in oil and gas operations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: drilling|completion|workover|production|maintenance|inspection|abandonment|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Activity-Based Costing

attributes.name: afe_number
attributes.description: The authorization for expenditure (AFE) number associated with this cost center, used to track approved capital or operating expenditures for drilling, completion, or facility projects. Common in upstream operations.
attributes.references: COPAS AFE Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA PS Module

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: The method used to allocate costs from this cost center to other cost objects or profit centers. Direct charge assigns costs directly. Activity-based uses cost drivers. Percentage uses fixed ratios. Headcount allocates by employee count. Area allocates by square footage. Volume allocates by production volume.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Cost Allocation

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: The approved annual operating budget (OPEX) or authorization for expenditure (AFE) amount allocated to this cost center for the current fiscal year, in the cost center's currency. Used for budget vs. actual variance analysis.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Budget Management

attributes.name: budget_year

attributes.name: business_area

attributes.references: SEC Oil and Gas Reporting Requirements; IFRS 8 Operating Segments

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: The SAP controlling area (CO) organizational unit that manages this cost center for internal management accounting, cost allocation, and profitability analysis. Multiple company codes may share a single controlling area.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Controlling Area Configuration

attributes.name: cost_center_category
attributes.description: Classification of the cost center by its cost behavior and allocation method. Direct cost centers accumulate costs directly attributable to production or projects. Indirect cost centers accumulate support costs that are allocated to direct cost centers. Overhead cost centers track general administrative expenses. Capital cost centers accumulate costs for capital projects (CAPEX).
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The externally-known unique alphanumeric code identifying the cost center in the enterprise chart of accounts and controlling area. Used as the business identifier in SAP CO module and all financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Cost Center Master Data; COPAS Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: cost_center_description
attributes.description: Extended free-text description providing additional context about the cost center's purpose, scope, and operational details beyond the standard name field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Cost Center Master Data

attributes.name: cost_center_name
attributes.description: The full descriptive name of the cost center, providing human-readable identification for financial reporting and management review.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Cost Center Master Data

attributes.name: cost_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost center. Active cost centers accept expense postings. Inactive cost centers are closed to new postings but retain historical data. Blocked cost centers are temporarily suspended. Pending closure cost centers are in the process of being decommissioned.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Cost Center Master Data

attributes.name: cost_center_type

Drilling cost centers accumulate well construction costs. Exploration cost centers capture prospect evaluation and seismic costs. Refining and petrochemical cost centers track processing plant operations. General administrative (G&A) cost centers accumulate corporate overhead.
