attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: cost_element_group
attributes.description: The primary cost element group or general ledger (GL) account category that this cost center typically posts to, enabling standardized cost classification and reporting across the enterprise.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Cost Element Accounting; COPAS Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where this cost center is located, used for country-level regulatory reporting and tax compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Country Codes; SEC Oil and Gas Reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost center record was first created in the system, used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail Standards; SOX Compliance Requirements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which this cost center's expenses are recorded and reported. Typically matches the company code's local currency.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this cost center is subject to enhanced environmental compliance tracking and reporting requirements under EPA, BSEE, or other environmental regulations. True means enhanced tracking is required.
attributes.references: EPA Environmental Regulations; BSEE Offshore Safety Requirements

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: The functional discipline or department that this cost center supports, enabling cross-functional cost analysis and benchmarking across the enterprise. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: operations|maintenance|engineering|hse|finance|human_resources|information_technology|procurement|legal — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Functional Area Configuration

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: The geographic region or basin where this cost center operates, enabling regional cost benchmarking and geographic segment reporting for SEC and IFRS compliance.
attributes.references: SEC Oil and Gas Reporting Requirements; IFRS 8 Operating Segments

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: The depth level of this cost center in the organizational hierarchy, with 1 representing top-level cost centers and higher numbers representing deeper nesting. Used for hierarchical reporting and aggregation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Cost Center Hierarchy

attributes.name: lock_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this cost center is locked for posting. True means the cost center is locked and cannot accept new expense transactions. False means it is open for postings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Cost Center Master Data

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this cost center record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost center record was last modified in the system, used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail Standards; SOX Compliance Requirements

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this cost center is subject to Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) internal control testing and audit requirements. True means SOX controls apply.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The tax jurisdiction or authority under which this cost center operates, used for tax allocation, transfer pricing, and compliance with local tax regulations.
attributes.references: IFRS/GAAP Tax Accounting Standards; Local Tax Authority Regulations

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this cost center record becomes effective and can accept expense postings. Used for time-dependent cost center master data management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Cost Center Master Data

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this cost center record is effective. After this date, the cost center is closed to new postings. Null for cost centers with no planned closure date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Cost Center Master Data

attributes.name: working_interest_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of working interest (WI) that this cost center represents in a joint venture or lease, used to calculate the company's share of joint costs. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 35.50 for 35.50%).
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines; Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) Standards

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this cost center record in the system.

products.name: profit_center
products.description: Master record for profit centers representing autonomous business segments used for internal profitability reporting in oil and gas operations. Captures profit center code, description, profit center type (upstream E&P, refining, petrochemical, marketing), responsible manager, company code, controlling area, segment classification, currency, and hierarchy node. Supports segment reporting under IFRS 8 and internal management reporting by business unit. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA module.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the profit center record. Primary key.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Profit centers belong to legal entities. The existing company_code STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to company_code.company_code_id to enable legal entity-level profit center hiera

attributes.name: parent_profit_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent profit center in the organizational hierarchy, enabling multi-level profitability analysis and consolidation.

attributes.name: accounting_method
attributes.description: Oil and gas accounting method applied to this profit center: successful efforts (capitalizes only successful exploration costs) or full cost (capitalizes all exploration costs within a cost center).
attributes.references: IFRS 6 / GAAP ASC 932 Oil and Gas Accounting

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: Classification of the profit center's primary asset base: producing (generating revenue from proved developed producing reserves), non-producing (proved developed non-producing), development (under development), or exploration (exploratory activities).

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the business area for cross-company code reporting. Represents a separate area of operations or responsibilities within the organization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Business Area Structure

attributes.name: capex_budget_annual
attributes.description: Annual capital expenditure budget allocated to this profit center for asset development, facility construction, and major equipment purchases. Expressed in the profit center's local currency.
attributes.references: Oil and Gas Financial Planning Standards

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the controlling area (organizational unit in management accounting) under which this profit center operates. Controlling area represents the highest organizational unit for cost accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Controlling Area Structure

attributes.name: cost_center_group
attributes.description: Grouping classification for associated cost centers that roll up into this profit center for internal cost allocation and profitability analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the primary country of operations for this profit center.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who created this profit center record in the system.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this profit center record was first created in the enterprise system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the local currency in which the profit center's financial transactions are recorded and reported.

attributes.name: dd_and_a_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate depreciation, depletion, and amortization for assets within this profit center: unit-of-production (based on reserves), straight-line, or declining-balance.
attributes.references: IFRS 6 / GAAP ASC 932 Oil and Gas Accounting

attributes.name: environmental_classification
attributes.description: Environmental and operational classification of the profit center's assets: onshore, offshore shallow water, offshore deepwater, arctic, or unconventional (shale, oil sands, etc.).
attributes.references: Oil and Gas Operational Classification Standards

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Primary geographic region where the profit center operates, used for regional profitability analysis and segment reporting.
attributes.references: Oil and Gas Industry Geographic Segmentation

attributes.name: hierarchy_node
attributes.description: Position of this profit center within the organizational profit center hierarchy, enabling roll-up reporting and consolidation. Typically represented as a path or node identifier.

attributes.name: hse_tier
attributes.description: Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) risk tier classification for this profit center based on operational complexity, environmental sensitivity, and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: API RP 754 Process Safety Performance Indicators

attributes.name: joa_operator_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) specifying whether this profit center acts as the operator under Joint Operating Agreements (JOA) for joint venture operations.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who last modified this profit center record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this profit center record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: net_revenue_interest_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of net revenue interest retained by the company after deducting royalties and overriding royalty interests. Represents the actual revenue share from production.
attributes.references: Oil and Gas Joint Venture Accounting

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or contextual information about the profit center configuration and operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA Profit Center Master

attributes.name: opex_budget_annual
attributes.description: Annual operating expenditure budget allocated to this profit center for day-to-day operations, maintenance, and lease operating expenses (LOE). Expressed in the profit center's local currency.
attributes.references: Oil and Gas Financial Planning Standards

attributes.name: production_phase
attributes.description: Current production phase of the profit center's assets: primary recovery (natural reservoir pressure), secondary recovery (water or gas injection), tertiary enhanced oil recovery (EOR/IOR techniques), or depleted.

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the profit center within the controlling area. Used in financial reporting and internal management accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA Profit Center Master

attributes.name: profit_center_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the profit center representing the business segment or operational unit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA Profit Center Master

attributes.name: profit_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the profit center: active (operational and posting transactions), inactive (temporarily suspended), planned (future activation), or closed (permanently deactivated).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA Profit Center Master

attributes.name: profit_center_type
attributes.description: Classification of the profit center by primary business function: upstream exploration and production (E&P), midstream transportation and storage, downstream refining, downstream petrochemical manufacturing, marketing and sales, or corporate support.
attributes.references: Oil and Gas Industry Segment Classification

attributes.name: psa_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) specifying whether this profit center operates under a Production Sharing Agreement (PSA) with a host government or national oil company (NOC).

attributes.name: reserve_category
attributes.description: Primary reserves classification for assets managed by this profit center: 1P (proved), 2P (proved plus probable), 3P (proved plus probable plus possible), contingent resources, or prospective resources.
attributes.references: SPE PRMS Petroleum Resources Management System

attributes.name: segment
attributes.description: Segment classification code for external financial reporting under IFRS 8 Operating Segments. Represents a component of the business that engages in activities from which it may earn revenues and incur expenses.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Primary tax jurisdiction or fiscal regime under which this profit center operates, determining applicable tax rates, royalty structures, and fiscal terms.
attributes.references: International Tax and Fiscal Regime Standards

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Effective start date from which this profit center configuration is valid and active for transaction posting and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA Profit Center Master

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: Effective end date until which this profit center configuration remains valid. Null value indicates open-ended validity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA Profit Center Master

attributes.name: working_interest_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of working interest held by the company in the assets managed by this profit center. Working interest represents the operating interest that bears the cost of development and operation.
attributes.references: Oil and Gas Joint Venture Accounting

products.name: gl_account
products.description: Chart of accounts master record defining every general ledger account used in the oil and gas enterprise financial statements. Captures account number, account description, account type (asset, liability, equity, revenue, expense), financial statement item, account group, balance sheet/P&L indicator, tax category, reconciliation account flag, open item management flag, currency, and IFRS/GAAP mapping. Supports successful efforts and full cost accounting methods per SEC Rule 4-10 and COPAS standards. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA FI-GL module.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the general ledger account record. Primary key.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Master Data Standard

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: GL accounts can be company-code-specific or shared across a chart of accounts. The existing company_code STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to company_code.company_code_id to enable

attributes.name: account_group
attributes.description: The account group classification used to organize accounts into logical categories for reporting and analysis (e.g., current assets, fixed assets, operating expenses, capital expenditures).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Account Group Configuration; COPAS Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: account_long_description
attributes.description: Extended description providing detailed explanation of the account purpose, usage guidelines, and business context.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Master Data Standard

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: The short descriptive name of the GL account used for display and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Master Data Standard

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The unique account number used to identify this GL account in the chart of accounts. Typically a 4-10 digit numeric code structured according to the enterprise account numbering scheme.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Chart of Accounts; COPAS Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the GL account indicating whether it is available for posting transactions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Master Data Standard

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: The fundamental accounting classification of the account indicating whether it represents assets, liabilities, equity, revenue, or expenses in the financial statements.
attributes.references: GAAP Financial Statement Classification; IFRS IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: accounting_method_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Oil and Gas Accounting Method Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates which oil and gas accounting method applies to this account: successful efforts method or full cost method, as defined by SEC Rule 4-10 and FASB ASC 932.
attributes.references: SEC Rule 4-10; FASB ASC 932 Extractive Activities - Oil and Gas; COPAS Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: afe_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether expenditures posted to this account require an approved Authorization for Expenditure (AFE) for capital project control.
attributes.references: COPAS AFE Guidelines; Oil and Gas Capital Project Management Standards

attributes.name: balance_sheet_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this account appears on the balance sheet (true) or profit and loss statement (false).
attributes.references: GAAP Financial Statement Classification; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: capitalization_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether expenditures posted to this account are capitalized as assets (true) or expensed immediately (false). Critical for CAPEX vs OPEX classification.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; IFRS IAS 16; COPAS CAPEX Guidelines

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts
attributes.description: The chart of accounts code identifying which chart of accounts this GL account belongs to. Supports multiple charts for different reporting requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts Configuration

attributes.name: consolidation_account
attributes.description: The consolidation account number used for corporate financial consolidation and elimination entries across multiple legal entities and business units.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 810 Consolidation; IFRS IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements

attributes.name: cost_element
attributes.description: The cost element code used in SAP Controlling (CO) module for cost center accounting, internal orders, and profitability analysis. Links GL accounts to cost accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Element Accounting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this GL account master record was first created in the system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail Standards; SOX Compliance Requirements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the account local currency. For multi-currency accounts, this represents the primary account currency.

attributes.name: depreciation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this account is subject to depreciation, depletion, or amortization calculations for oil and gas assets.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 932; IFRS IFRS 6; COPAS DD&A Guidelines

attributes.name: financial_statement_item
attributes.description: The financial statement line item code that this account maps to for balance sheet and profit and loss statement reporting. Used for financial statement consolidation and SEC reporting.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-X; IFRS IAS 1; GAAP ASC 210/220

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: The functional area classification used for segment reporting and management accounting (e.g., exploration, drilling, production, refining, marketing, administration).
attributes.references: IFRS 8 Operating Segments; SAP S/4HANA Functional Area Configuration

attributes.name: gaap_mapping_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) Mapping Code
attributes.description: The US GAAP account classification code used for mapping this account to GAAP financial statement line items for SEC reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 210/220 Financial Statement Presentation; GAAP ASC 932 Oil and Gas

attributes.name: hse_category
attributes.description: The HSE category classification for accounts related to health, safety, and environmental compliance costs (e.g., environmental remediation, safety equipment, compliance monitoring).
attributes.references: EPA Environmental Compliance Standards; OSHA Safety Standards; ISO 14001/45001

attributes.name: ifrs_mapping_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) Mapping Code
attributes.description: The IFRS account classification code used for mapping this account to IFRS financial statement line items for international reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements; IFRS IFRS 6 Exploration for and Evaluation of Mineral Resources

attributes.name: joint_venture_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this account is used for joint venture accounting and joint interest billing (JIB) transactions under joint operating agreements (JOA).
attributes.references: COPAS Joint Interest Billing Standards; SAP Joint Venture Accounting

attributes.name: line_item_display_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether individual line items are stored and can be displayed for this account, enabling detailed transaction drill-down.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Line Item Management

attributes.name: loe_category
attributes.description: The lease operating expense category classification for production operating costs (e.g., well operations, facilities maintenance, utilities, labor). Used for LOE tracking and analysis.
attributes.references: COPAS LOE Accounting Standards; Oil and Gas Production Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID of the person who last modified this GL account master record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail Standards; SOX Compliance Requirements

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this GL account master record was last modified.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail Standards; SOX Compliance Requirements

attributes.name: open_item_management_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this account is managed on an open item basis, requiring line items to be explicitly cleared rather than simply netting to a balance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Open Item Management

attributes.name: posting_block_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether direct posting to this account is blocked, requiring transactions to be posted through subledgers or specific transaction types only.

attributes.name: profit_loss_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this account appears on the profit and loss statement (income statement).
attributes.references: GAAP Financial Statement Classification; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: reconciliation_account_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is a reconciliation account that is automatically posted to from subledgers (accounts receivable, accounts payable, asset accounting).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Reconciliation Account Configuration

attributes.name: reserves_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Petroleum Reserves Management System (PRMS) Reserves Category
attributes.description: The reserves category classification for accounts related to proved reserves, probable reserves, or possible reserves under SPE PRMS and SEC reporting standards.
attributes.references: SPE PRMS Petroleum Resources Management System; SEC Regulation S-X Rule 4-10

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this account is subject to SOX internal controls and requires additional review and approval workflows for financial reporting compliance.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; PCAOB Auditing Standards

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: The tax category classification code indicating how transactions posted to this account are treated for tax purposes (e.g., taxable revenue, non-taxable, tax-exempt, input tax, output tax).
attributes.references: IRS Tax Code; SAP S/4HANA Tax Configuration

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this GL account becomes valid and available for transaction posting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Master Data Standard

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this GL account remains valid. After this date, the account is no longer available for new postings. Null indicates no expiration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Master Data Standard

products.name: company_code
products.description: Master record for legal entities and company codes within the oil and gas enterprise organizational structure. Captures company code, company name, legal entity type (IOC subsidiary, JV entity, holding company, SPV), country of incorporation, fiscal year variant, chart of accounts assignment, local currency, reporting currency, tax jurisdiction, registered address, consolidation group, elimination company indicator, and intercompany partner assignments. Serves as the foundational organizational unit for all financial postings, statutory reporting, and multi-entity consolidation. Supports intercompany eliminations under IFRS 10, statutory reporting across jurisdictions, and SEC registrant identification. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA FI organizational structure.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the company code record. Primary key.

attributes.name: accounting_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used for oil and gas exploration and production activities. Successful efforts method capitalizes only costs of successful wells; full cost method capitalizes all exploration costs within a cost center. Determines DD&A (Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization) calculation and reserves disclosure.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 932 Extractive Activities - Oil and Gas, SEC Regulation S-X Rule 4-10

attributes.name: business_area_required_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether business area assignment is mandatory for financial postings in this company code. Business areas enable cross-company code segment reporting and profitability analysis by line of business (E&P, Refining, Petrochemicals, Marketing).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Business Area Configuration

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the chart of accounts assigned to this company code. The COA defines the structure of general ledger (GL) accounts used for recording financial transactions, supporting both statutory and management reporting requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Four-character alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the legal entity or company code within the enterprise organizational structure. Used as the primary business identifier for all financial postings and statutory reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Configuration

attributes.name: company_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the company or legal entity as registered with regulatory authorities. Used for statutory reporting, financial statements, and external communications.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: company_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the company code. Active indicates normal operations; inactive indicates no current transactions; dormant indicates temporary suspension; liquidation indicates wind-down in progress; merged indicates entity has been consolidated into another company code.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Master Data

attributes.name: consolidation_group
attributes.description: Identifier for the consolidation group or reporting unit to which this company code belongs. Used for multi-level consolidation, segment reporting, and management reporting hierarchies under IFRS 8 and SEC Regulation S-K.
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements, IFRS 8 Operating Segments

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the controlling area to which this company code is assigned. The controlling area is the organizational unit for cost accounting, internal orders, profit center accounting, and profitability analysis. Multiple company codes can share a single controlling area.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Controlling Area Configuration

attributes.name: country_of_incorporation
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the jurisdiction where the legal entity is incorporated and registered. Determines applicable tax laws, statutory reporting requirements, and regulatory oversight.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this company code record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance requirements.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404, SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail

attributes.name: credit_control_area
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the credit control area assigned to this company code. Used for managing customer credit limits, credit exposure monitoring, and accounts receivable risk management across one or more company codes.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this company code became active and available for financial postings. Represents the legal incorporation date or the date the entity was added to the ERP system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Configuration

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date on which this company code ceased operations or was deactivated for financial postings. Null if the company code is still active. Used for historical reporting and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Configuration

attributes.name: elimination_company_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this company code is used exclusively for intercompany elimination entries during consolidation. True if this is an elimination company; false if it is an operating entity.

attributes.name: field_status_variant
attributes.description: Four-character code defining the field status control rules for financial document entry in this company code. Determines which fields are required, optional, or suppressed during transaction posting, supporting data quality and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Field Status Variant Configuration

attributes.name: fiscal_year_variant
attributes.description: Two-character code defining the fiscal year calendar structure for this company code, including the number of periods, period start/end dates, and year-end closing rules. Aligns with statutory reporting requirements and internal management reporting cycles.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant Configuration

attributes.name: gaap_framework
attributes.description: Primary accounting framework used for statutory financial reporting. IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards), US GAAP (United States Generally Accepted Accounting Principles), or local GAAP as required by the country of incorporation.
attributes.references: IFRS Foundation, FASB Accounting Standards Codification

attributes.name: intercompany_partner_assignment
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or structured identifier of intercompany trading partner company codes with which this entity has regular intercompany transactions. Used for intercompany reconciliation, netting, and elimination processes.
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements, SAP S/4HANA Intercompany Reconciliation

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this company code record. Supports audit trail and change management requirements.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404, SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this company code record was last modified in the system. Supports audit trail, change tracking, and SOX compliance requirements.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404, SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail

attributes.name: legal_entity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the legal entity structure. IOC (International Oil Company) subsidiary, NOC (National Oil Company) subsidiary, joint venture entity, holding company, special purpose vehicle (SPV), or branch office.

attributes.name: local_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the functional currency of the company code. All financial transactions are recorded in this currency for statutory reporting and local GAAP compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes, IAS 21 The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: posting_period_variant
attributes.description: Four-character code defining the number of posting periods and special periods (e.g., year-end adjustment periods) for this company code. Controls the opening and closing of accounting periods for transaction posting and period-end close processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Period Variant Configuration

attributes.name: profit_center_required_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether profit center assignment is mandatory for financial postings in this company code. Profit centers enable internal management reporting, profitability analysis, and segment performance evaluation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Profit Center Accounting

attributes.name: registered_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the legal registered address of the company code as filed with regulatory authorities. Used for statutory correspondence, legal notices, and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: registered_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the legal registered address, typically containing building name, suite number, or additional location details.

attributes.name: registered_city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the legal registered address.

attributes.name: registered_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the legal registered address.

attributes.name: registered_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the legal registered address.

attributes.name: registered_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region of the legal registered address. Relevant for jurisdictions with state-level tax or regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: reporting_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the group reporting currency used for consolidated financial statements and management reporting. Transactions are translated from local currency to reporting currency for consolidation purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes, IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements

attributes.name: sec_cik_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Central Index Key (CIK) Number
attributes.description: Ten-digit Central Index Key (CIK) number assigned by the SEC to identify the registrant for EDGAR filings and public disclosures. Null if not an SEC registrant.

attributes.name: sec_registrant_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Registrant Indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this company code is a registrant with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and subject to SEC financial disclosure and reserves reporting requirements under Regulation S-X and S-K.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-X, SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: sox_scope_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this company code is within the scope of Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) compliance testing and internal control certification. True if SOX controls apply; false otherwise.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Tax authority jurisdiction code or identifier where the company code is registered for tax purposes. Determines applicable tax rates, filing requirements, and compliance obligations for income tax, VAT, sales tax, and other statutory taxes.
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines, Local Tax Authority Regulations

attributes.name: valuation_area
attributes.description: Four-character code defining the organizational level at which material and inventory valuation is performed. Typically aligned with the company code for legal valuation purposes, supporting IFRS IAS 2 Inventories and LIFO/FIFO/weighted average costing methods.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Valuation, IFRS IAS 2 Inventories

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: Transactional header record of every general ledger posting in the oil and gas enterprise, representing the atomic document unit of financial accounting. Captures journal entry number, posting date, document date, document type (original entry, accrual, reversal, intercompany, allocation, reclassification), company code, fiscal year, fiscal period, reference document, currency, exchange rate, reversal indicator, parking/hold status, and SOX control reference. Each journal entry contains one or more journal_entry_line items carrying the debit/credit detail. Supports IFRS/GAAP oil and gas accounting including DD&A postings, successful efforts write-offs, production revenue accruals, cost allocations, and intercompany eliminations. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA FI-GL (BKPF header).

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the journal entry header record. Primary key for the journal entry transaction.

attributes.name: cargo_nomination_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.cargo_nomination. Business justification: Cargo movements trigger accounting entries (revenue recognition at bill of lading, cost allocation) required for crude marketing P&L and audit trail.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Every journal entry is posted to a legal entity (company code). The existing company_code STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to company_code.company_code_id for referential integrity

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Journal entries can have a default cost center at header level (inherited by lines if not overridden). The existing cost_center STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to cost_center.cost

attributes.name: drilling_well_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to drilling.drilling_well. Business justification: Journal entries for DD&A, capitalization, and ARO accretion reference specific wells. Direct FK to drilling_well enables well-level GL analysis, successful efforts accounting, and SEC reserve-to-cost

attributes.name: finance_afe_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_afe. Business justification: Journal entries can be charged against AFEs for capital project accounting. The existing afe_number STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to finance_afe.finance_afe_id to enable AFE-lev

attributes.name: hedging_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.hedging_transaction. Business justification: Hedging transactions generate accounting entries (mark-to-market adjustments, realized gains/losses, hedge accounting entries) required for ASC 815/IFRS 9 compliance.

attributes.name: offtake_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.offtake_agreement. Business justification: Offtake agreements generate periodic accounting entries (revenue recognition, accruals, take-or-pay provisions) required for financial reporting and audit trail.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Journal entries can have a default profit center at header level (inherited by lines if not overridden). The existing profit_center STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to profit_cente

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.sales_order. Business justification: Sales orders generate revenue recognition journal entries (AR, revenue, deferred revenue) required for GAAP/IFRS compliance and audit trail from commercial transaction to GL.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Journal entries can be linked to WBS elements for project-level financial postings. The existing wbs_element STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to wbs_element.wbs_element_id to enabl

attributes.name: allocation_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry is the result of an automated cost allocation, distribution, or assessment cycle. True for allocation postings; False for direct manual or transactional postings.

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fixed asset (well, facility, equipment, pipeline) to which this journal entry relates. Used for asset capitalization, depreciation (DD&A), and asset retirement obligation (ARO) tracking.

attributes.name: batch_input_session
attributes.description: Name of the batch input session if this journal entry was created through batch processing or mass upload. Used to trace entries back to their batch source for error resolution and audit.

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: Code identifying the business area or segment (Upstream E&P, Midstream, Downstream Refining, Petrochemicals) for segment reporting and internal management reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording the exact date and time when this journal entry record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the document currency in which the journal entry amounts are denominated. All line items within the entry share this currency.

attributes.name: dd_and_a_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry represents a DD&A posting for oil and gas assets. True for DD&A entries calculated using unit-of-production or straight-line methods; False for other entries.
attributes.references: IFRS 6 Exploration for and Evaluation of Mineral Resources

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date printed on the original source document or invoice that gave rise to this journal entry. May differ from posting date. Used for document tracking, audit trail, and reconciliation with external parties.

attributes.name: document_header_text
attributes.description: Free-form text field providing a brief description or explanation of the business purpose of the journal entry. Visible at header level and inherited by all line items unless overridden.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Ten-digit accounting document number assigned by the system or entered manually. Serves as the business identifier for the journal entry within the company code and fiscal year. Unique within company code and fiscal year combination.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Two-character code classifying the business transaction type of the journal entry. Controls document number ranges, account types allowed, and posting behavior. Common types: SA (General Ledger), AB (Accounting Document), AF (Depreciation Posting), DR (Customer Invoice), KR (Vendor Invoice), RE (Invoice Receipt), RV (Reversal), ZP (Payment). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SA|AB|AF|DR|DZ|KA|KG|KN|KR|KZ|RE|RV|WA|WE|ZP — 15 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Type Configuration

attributes.name: entry_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the journal entry was physically entered into the system by the user. Used for audit trail and internal control monitoring.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate used to convert document currency amounts to local company code currency and group reporting currency. Expressed as units of local currency per one unit of document currency. Null if document currency equals local currency.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 21 The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Numeric fiscal period (1-16) within the fiscal year to which this journal entry is posted. Periods 1-12 represent regular monthly periods; periods 13-16 are special periods for year-end adjustments and closing entries.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Period Variant

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Four-digit fiscal year to which this journal entry is assigned based on the posting date and the company code fiscal year variant. Used for period-based reporting and year-end closing processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: Code representing the functional area or business function (Exploration, Drilling, Production, Refining, Marketing, HSE, G&A) for cost of sales and functional expense classification in financial statements.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry represents an intercompany transaction between two or more company codes within the enterprise. True for intercompany postings requiring elimination in consolidated financial statements.

attributes.name: internal_order
attributes.description: Alphanumeric identifier for the internal order used to collect costs for a specific purpose (maintenance campaign, turnaround, workover). Used for short-term cost tracking and budget monitoring.

attributes.name: joint_venture_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the joint venture, production sharing agreement (PSA), or joint operating agreement (JOA) to which this journal entry relates. Used for partner billing, cost recovery, and revenue distribution.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified this journal entry. Null if the entry has never been modified after initial creation. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording the exact date and time when this journal entry was last modified. Null if never modified. Used for audit trail and version control.

attributes.name: ledger_group
attributes.description: Identifier for the ledger or ledger group to which this journal entry is posted. Supports parallel accounting for different accounting principles (IFRS, GAAP, tax ledger). Default is leading ledger (0L).

attributes.name: parking_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the journal entry is parked (saved but not yet posted), posted (committed to the general ledger), or held (temporarily suspended pending approval). Parked documents do not update account balances until posted.

attributes.name: partner_share_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage share of costs or revenues allocated to a specific joint venture partner in this journal entry. Used for joint interest billing (JIB) and partner netting calculations. Null for non-JV transactions.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry is posted to the general ledger and becomes effective for financial reporting. Determines the fiscal period and fiscal year for the transaction. Used for period-end closing and financial statement preparation.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: posting_key_indicator
attributes.description: Two-digit code that controls the type of posting (debit or credit) and the account type (General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset). Inherited by line items but captured at header for summary control.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Key Configuration

attributes.name: reference_document
attributes.description: Free-text field containing the reference number of an external document, invoice, purchase order, Authorization for Expenditure (AFE) number, or other source document that originated this journal entry. Used for cross-referencing and audit trail.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry is a reversal of a previously posted document. True if this entry reverses another entry; False for original postings.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Two-digit code indicating the business reason for reversing the original document. Common codes: 01 (Reversal in current period), 02 (Reversal in prior period), 03 (Correction), 04 (Accrual reversal), 05 (Other). Null for non-reversal entries.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Reversal Reason Configuration

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the original journal entry that is being reversed by this entry. Populated only when reversal_indicator is True. Establishes audit trail linkage between original and reversing entries.

attributes.name: sox_control_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this journal entry to a specific SOX internal control or control activity. Used for SOX compliance testing, audit sampling, and control effectiveness monitoring.

attributes.name: successful_efforts_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry is related to successful efforts accounting treatment (capitalization of successful wells, expensing of dry holes). True for successful efforts postings; False otherwise.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 932 Extractive Activities - Oil and Gas

attributes.name: trading_partner_company_code
attributes.description: Company code of the intercompany trading partner for intercompany transactions. Used for intercompany reconciliation and consolidation elimination entries. Null for non-intercompany transactions.

attributes.name: transaction_code
attributes.description: SAP transaction code (T-code) used to create or post this journal entry. Examples: FB01 (Post Document), FB50 (G/L Account Posting), F-02 (General Posting). Used for audit trail and user activity analysis.

products.name: journal_entry_line
products.description: Individual line item within a general ledger journal entry, capturing the debit or credit posting to a specific GL account with full cost object assignment. Captures line item number, GL account, posting key (debit/credit), amount in transaction currency, amount in company code currency, cost center, profit center, WBS element, internal order, asset number, tax code, assignment field, text, business area, cost element, quantity, unit of measure, and business transaction type. Serves as the unified actual cost record for all financial and controlling postings — including LOE, CAPEX actuals, overhead allocations, and depreciation charges. Supports granular cost allocation across upstream, midstream, and downstream operations and LOE per BOE analysis when joined with production data. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA FI-GL (BSEG) and CO actual line items (COEP).
products.reference: SAP FI Journal Entry Line Item (BSEG)

attributes.name: journal_entry_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry line item. Primary key for the journal entry line product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL BSEG table structure

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Journal entry lines can be allocated to cost centers for detailed cost tracking. The existing cost_center_code STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to cost_center.cost_center_id to ena

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Every journal entry line posts to a GL account. The existing gl_account_code STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to gl_account.gl_account_id to enable chart of accounts validation, fi

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent journal entry header document. Links this line item to the overall journal entry batch and document number.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Journal entry lines can be allocated to profit centers for detailed profitability analysis. The existing profit_center_code STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to profit_center.profit

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: JE lines for PO accruals, adjustments, and reclassifications must reference PO for audit trail and accrual reconciliation. Standard accrual accounting for oil & gas procurement.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: JE lines for vendor accruals, adjustments, and manual postings need direct vendor reference for reconciliation and vendor account management. Real month-end close requirement in oil & gas.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Journal entry lines can be linked to WBS elements for project-level cost tracking. The existing wbs_element_code STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to wbs_element.wbs_element_id to e

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: The fixed asset number for asset-related postings including CAPEX capitalization, depreciation, and asset retirement. Links to wells, facilities, pipelines, and equipment in the asset register.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Asset Accounting, SEC/IFRS fixed asset accounting

attributes.name: asset_subnumber
attributes.description: The subnumber or component identifier within a main asset. Used for tracking individual components or sub-assets within a larger asset structure.

attributes.name: assignment_field
attributes.description: Free-form assignment field for additional reference information such as well name, lease number, AFE number, or vendor invoice number. Used for reconciliation and drill-down analysis.

attributes.name: baseline_payment_date
attributes.description: The baseline date from which payment terms are calculated for AP/AR line items. Typically the invoice date or goods receipt date.

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: The business area classification for cross-company code segment reporting. Represents upstream (E&P), midstream (transportation), downstream (refining), or petrochemical business segments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Business Area, IFRS 8 operating segment disclosure

attributes.name: business_transaction_type
attributes.description: The business transaction type code that classifies the nature of the posting. Examples include CAPEX, OPEX, LOE, DD&A, revenue, inventory movement, and intercompany transfer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA BSEG-VRGNG, COPAS transaction classification

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: The date on which this open item was cleared through payment, offset, or other settlement. Null for uncleared items.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the clearing transaction that settled this open item. Links to the payment or offset document.

attributes.name: company_code_currency_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount of this line item converted to the company code local currency. Used for financial statement preparation and statutory reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA BSEG-DMBTR, IFRS/GAAP functional currency reporting

attributes.name: company_code_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the local currency of the company code. Used for statutory reporting and consolidation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes, IFRS/GAAP local currency reporting

attributes.name: cost_element_code
attributes.description: The controlling cost element that mirrors the GL account for cost accounting purposes. Used for primary and secondary cost allocation in CO module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM Cost Element Accounting

attributes.name: debit_credit_indicator
attributes.description: Explicit indicator of whether this line item represents a debit (D) or credit (C) posting. Derived from posting key but stored for query performance.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date of the source document (invoice date, receipt date, contract date). May differ from posting date for backdated or future-dated transactions.

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: The functional area classification for cost-of-sales accounting and functional expense reporting. Distinguishes between production, exploration, development, G&A, and marketing expenses.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Functional Area, IFRS/GAAP functional expense classification

attributes.name: group_currency_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount of this line item converted to the group reporting currency. Supports consolidated financial statements and enterprise-wide analytics.

attributes.name: group_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the reporting currency of the corporate group. Used for consolidated financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes, IFRS consolidation requirements

attributes.name: internal_order_number
attributes.description: The internal order number for overhead cost collection and allocation. Used for tracking indirect costs, maintenance orders, and short-term cost objects that are not full projects.

attributes.name: line_item_number
attributes.description: Sequential line item number within the journal entry document. Determines the ordering and position of this line within the parent entry.

attributes.name: line_item_text
attributes.description: Descriptive text providing additional context for this journal entry line item. May include vendor name, invoice description, or transaction narrative.

attributes.name: partner_profit_center_code
attributes.description: The profit center of the trading partner for intercompany profit elimination and transfer pricing analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PA partner profit center, IFRS consolidation requirements

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: The payment terms code for accounts payable and receivable line items. Determines due date calculation and cash discount eligibility.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP/AR payment terms configuration

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which this line item is posted to the general ledger. Determines the fiscal period and year for financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA BSEG-BUDAT, IFRS/GAAP transaction date requirements

attributes.name: posting_key
attributes.description: Two-digit code that determines whether the line item is a debit or credit posting and controls the account type and field status. Standard values include 40 (debit GL), 50 (credit GL), 01 (debit customer), 11 (credit customer), 21 (debit vendor), 31 (credit vendor).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Key configuration

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The quantity associated with this line item for quantity-based postings. Used for inventory movements, production volumes, and unit cost calculations.

attributes.name: reference_key_1
attributes.description: First reference key field for customer-defined reference information. Often used for well identifier, lease code, or joint venture partner reference.

attributes.name: reference_key_2
attributes.description: Second reference key field for customer-defined reference information. May contain AFE number, production month, or cost category code.

attributes.name: reference_key_3
attributes.description: Third reference key field for customer-defined reference information. Supports additional dimensional analysis such as reservoir zone or product stream.

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the reversal transaction that negated this line item. Null if not reversed.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this line item has been reversed. True if the posting has been negated by a subsequent reversal document.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax code that determines the tax calculation procedure and tax accounts for this line item. Handles sales tax, use tax, VAT, and excise taxes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TV Tax Configuration, jurisdiction-specific tax regulations

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: The tax jurisdiction identifier for multi-jurisdictional tax reporting. Captures state, county, and local tax authorities for severance tax and production tax compliance.
attributes.references: State and local tax authority codes, PHMSA jurisdiction identifiers

attributes.name: trading_partner_code
attributes.description: The trading partner identifier for intercompany and joint venture transactions. Used for elimination entries in consolidation and partner netting in JIB processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA intercompany accounting, COPAS JIB partner netting

attributes.name: transaction_currency_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount of this line item in the original transaction currency. Positive for debits, negative for credits in some system configurations.

attributes.name: transaction_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the original transaction was denominated. May differ from company code currency for foreign currency transactions.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the quantity field. Common values include BBL (barrels), MCF (thousand cubic feet), MT (metric tons), GAL (gallons), and EA (each).
attributes.references: API measurement standards, ISO 80000 quantities and units

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The value date for cash management and bank reconciliation. Represents the date funds are available or debited from bank accounts.

products.name: finance_afe
products.description: Authorization for Expenditure (AFE) master record representing the formal capital or expense budget authorization for a specific oil and gas project or well. Captures AFE number, AFE title, AFE type (drilling, workover, facility construction, pipeline, EOR project), well or facility reference, operator, working interest (WI) percentage, gross AFE amount, net AFE amount, CAPEX/OPEX classification, AFE status (proposed, approved, active, closed, over-run), approval date, spud date, expected completion date, and cost code breakdown. Integrates with SAP Joint Venture Accounting for partner cost sharing and JIB billing.

attributes.name: finance_afe_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Authorization for Expenditure record. Primary key for the finance AFE product.

attributes.name: asset_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_facility. Business justification: AFEs are issued for facility construction and modification projects. Linking finance_afe to asset_facility enables facility-level AFE tracking, budget vs. actual reporting, and capitalization of facil

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: An AFE (Authorization for Expenditure) is issued by a specific legal entity (company code) in oil and gas operations. This FK establishes which legal entity authorized the capital or expense budget, w

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: AFEs can be charged to cost centers for expense tracking and organizational cost allocation. The existing cost_center_code STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to cost_center.cost_cent

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: AFEs post to GL accounts for financial statement capitalization. The existing gl_account_code STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to gl_account.gl_account_id to enable AFE capitalizat

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.project. Business justification: In oil and gas capital project management, an AFE is the formal budget authorization for a specific project (drilling program, facility construction, pipeline installation). Linking finance_afe to pro

attributes.name: superseded_afe_finance_afe_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous AFE record that this AFE supersedes or revises, enabling tracking of AFE revision history and budget change audit trail.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: AFEs can be linked to WBS elements for project-level cost tracking and integration with project management systems. The existing wbs_element STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to wbs

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the AFE project was completed and closed out, enabling variance analysis between planned and actual timelines.

attributes.name: actual_cost_to_date
attributes.description: The cumulative actual costs incurred against this AFE as of the current reporting date, enabling budget-versus-actual variance tracking and over-run detection.

attributes.name: afe_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique business identifier for the AFE, used for tracking and reference across joint venture partners and in Joint Interest Billing (JIB) statements.

attributes.name: afe_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the AFE, tracking its progression from proposal through approval, execution, and closure. Over-run status indicates actual costs have exceeded the authorized budget. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: proposed|approved|active|in_progress|closed|cancelled|over_run|suspended — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: afe_type
attributes.description: Classification of the AFE by project category, indicating the nature of the capital or operating expenditure (e.g., drilling, workover, facility construction, pipeline, Enhanced Oil Recovery (EOR) project, Plug and Abandonment (P&A)). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: drilling|workover|completion|facility_construction|pipeline|eor_project|abandonment|seismic|exploration|development — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the AFE was formally approved by the appropriate authority (e.g., joint venture partners, management committee, board of directors), authorizing the expenditure to proceed.

attributes.name: basin_name
attributes.description: Name of the geological basin or play in which the AFE project is located (e.g., Permian Basin, Gulf of Mexico, North Sea), supporting regional portfolio analysis.

attributes.name: capex_opex_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the AFE expenditure as Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) for asset acquisition or improvement, Operating Expenditure (OPEX) for routine operations and maintenance, or mixed for projects with both components.
attributes.references: IFRS/GAAP Oil and Gas Accounting Standards

attributes.name: contingency_percentage
attributes.description: The contingency reserve included in the AFE budget as a percentage of the base estimate, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1000 for 10%), to cover unforeseen costs and project uncertainties.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the geographic location of the AFE project, supporting regulatory reporting and geographic analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this AFE record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the AFE amounts (e.g., USD for United States Dollar, CAD for Canadian Dollar, GBP for British Pound).

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: The discount rate used in Net Present Value (NPV) calculations for this AFE, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1000 for 10%), reflecting the company's cost of capital and project risk profile.

attributes.name: estimated_irr
attributes.description: The estimated Internal Rate of Return (IRR) for the project at the time of AFE approval, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1500 for 15%), used to evaluate project economics and prioritize capital investments.

attributes.name: estimated_npv
attributes.description: The estimated Net Present Value (NPV) of the project at the time of AFE approval, representing the discounted cash flow value of expected future revenues minus costs, used for capital allocation decisions.

attributes.name: expected_completion_date
attributes.description: The planned date for completion of all AFE project activities and final cost reconciliation, used for project scheduling and financial forecasting.

attributes.name: expected_start_date
attributes.description: The planned date for commencement of the AFE project activities, used for scheduling and resource planning.

attributes.name: field_name
attributes.description: Name of the oil or gas field to which this AFE relates, enabling aggregation and analysis of capital and operating expenditures by field.

attributes.name: gross_afe_amount
attributes.description: The total authorized budget amount for the entire project before applying working interest, representing 100% of the estimated costs. Used for Joint Interest Billing (JIB) and partner cost allocation.

attributes.name: joa_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) that governs the joint venture relationship and cost-sharing arrangements for this AFE.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this AFE record was last modified, supporting audit trail and change tracking requirements.

attributes.name: net_afe_amount
attributes.description: The company's net authorized budget amount after applying the working interest percentage (net = gross × WI%). This is the amount the company is authorized to spend on its share of the project.

attributes.name: project_justification
attributes.description: Business justification and rationale for the AFE project, documenting the strategic objectives, expected benefits, and economic drivers supporting the investment decision.

attributes.name: remaining_budget
attributes.description: The remaining authorized budget available for expenditure, calculated as net AFE amount minus actual cost to date. Negative values indicate budget over-run.

attributes.name: revision_number

attributes.name: capitalization_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this actual cost is capitalized to a fixed asset (True) or expensed in the current period (False). Critical for CAPEX vs OPEX classification.

attributes.name: cost_allocation_method
attributes.description: The method used to allocate or assign this actual cost to the cost object (direct assignment, overhead allocation, activity-based costing, etc.).

attributes.name: cost_category
attributes.description: The high-level cost category classification for oil and gas financial management. CAPEX (Capital Expenditure) for capital projects, OPEX (Operating Expenditure) for operational costs, LOE (Lease Operating Expense) for well-level operating costs, DD&A (Depreciation Depletion and Amortization) for non-cash charges. attributes.name: cost_document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique document number assigned to this actual cost posting in the controlling module. Used for audit trail and reconciliation.

attributes.name: cost_element
attributes.description: The cost element code that classifies the nature of the cost (labor, materials, services, depreciation, etc.). Maps to the chart of accounts in financial accounting.

attributes.name: cost_object_type
attributes.description: The type of cost object against which the actual cost is posted. Determines the cost allocation structure in the oil and gas enterprise.
