attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this actual cost record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the actual cost amount is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: depreciation_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this actual cost represents a depreciation, depletion, or amortization charge. True for DD&A postings, False otherwise.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year when the actual cost was posted. Typically ranges from 1 to 12 for regular periods, with special periods for year-end adjustments.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the actual cost was posted, used for period-based financial reporting and analysis.

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: The functional area classification for this actual cost (e.g., Exploration, Production, Refining, Marketing, Administration) used for cost-of-sales accounting and functional reporting.

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this actual cost involves an intercompany transaction between legal entities within the enterprise. True if intercompany, False otherwise.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this actual cost record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: net_cost_amount
attributes.description: The net cost amount after applying working interest percentage or other allocation factors. Represents the company's share of the total cost.

attributes.name: originating_module
attributes.description: The SAP module or functional area that originated this actual cost posting (FI=Financial Accounting, CO=Controlling, MM=Materials Management, PM=Plant Maintenance, PS=Project System, PP=Production Planning, SD=Sales and Distribution, HR=Human Resources). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FI|CO|MM|PM|PS|PP|SD|HR — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date when the actual cost was posted to the controlling ledger. Represents the business event date for the cost transaction.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The quantity associated with the actual cost transaction, such as hours worked, barrels produced, or units consumed. Used for unit cost analysis.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this actual cost posting is a reversal of a previous posting. True if this is a reversal transaction, False otherwise.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: The cost document number of the original posting that this transaction reverses, if this is a reversal. Null if not a reversal.

attributes.name: source_document_line_item
attributes.description: The line item number within the source document that generated this actual cost. Provides granular traceability to the specific line in the originating transaction.

attributes.name: source_document_number
attributes.description: The unique document number of the originating source document (e.g., invoice number, purchase order number, timesheet ID). Enables traceability to source transactions.

attributes.name: source_document_type
attributes.description: The type of source document that originated this actual cost (e.g., purchase order, invoice, timesheet, material document). Used for drill-back and audit trail.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the quantity field (e.g., HR for hours, BBL for barrels, EA for each, TON for tons). Standardized per industry conventions.

attributes.name: variance_category
attributes.description: The category of variance analysis for which this actual cost is compared (budget variance, AFE variance, forecast variance, standard cost variance, prior year comparison).

attributes.name: working_interest_percentage
attributes.description: The working interest percentage applicable to this actual cost for joint venture cost allocation. Represents the ownership share of the cost object.

products.name: fixed_asset
products.description: Fixed asset master record for all capitalized assets in the oil and gas enterprise including wells, pipelines, processing facilities, FPSOs, compressors, and refinery units. Captures asset number, asset description, asset class (oil and gas properties, machinery, buildings, vehicles), company code, cost center, WBS element, capitalization date, acquisition value, accumulated depreciation, net book value, depreciation key (unit of production, straight-line, declining balance), useful life, depletion unit (BOE), asset status (active, under construction, retired, abandoned), SEC proved property classification, last depreciation run date, depreciation area values (book, tax, IFRS), and retirement/abandonment details. Supports DD&A calculations per successful efforts and full cost methods, periodic depreciation run tracking, and SEC ceiling test compliance. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA FI-AA module (ANLA/ANLC).

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation

attributes.name: api_well_number

attributes.name: asset_class

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA ANLA-ANLKL, IFRS IAS 16, GAAP ASC 360

attributes.name: asset_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the fixed asset including make, model, location, and operational purpose.

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: External business identifier for the fixed asset. Unique asset tag or registration number used across the enterprise for asset tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: asset_retirement_obligation_amount

attributes.name: asset_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fixed asset. Determines whether depreciation is active, asset is capitalized, or asset is subject to impairment testing. attributes.name: asset_sub_class
attributes.description: Detailed sub-classification within the asset class. Examples include producing wells, non-producing wells, gathering systems, processing plants, FPSO units, compressor stations, refineries, pipelines, drilling rigs, and support facilities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Custom Field, API Standards

attributes.name: capitalization_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset was placed in service and capitalized on the balance sheet. Marks the start of depreciation and depletion calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA ANLA-AKTIV, IFRS IAS 16, GAAP ASC 360

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fixed asset record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: cumulative_production

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: depletion_unit

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Custom Field, GAAP ASC 932, SPE PRMS

attributes.name: depreciation_area_book
attributes.description: Net book value in the book depreciation area for financial statement reporting per IFRS or GAAP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA ANLC Depreciation Area 01

attributes.name: depreciation_area_ifrs
attributes.business_glossary_term: Depreciation Area International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) Value
attributes.description: Net book value in the IFRS depreciation area for international financial reporting and consolidation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA ANLC Depreciation Area 30, IFRS IAS 16

attributes.name: depreciation_area_tax
attributes.description: Net book value in the tax depreciation area for tax return preparation and deferred tax calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA ANLC Depreciation Area 15

attributes.name: depreciation_key
attributes.description: Depreciation method applied to the asset. Unit of production is standard for oil and gas producing properties; straight-line for facilities and equipment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA ANLA-AFASL, IFRS IAS 16, GAAP ASC 932

attributes.name: estimated_ultimate_recovery
attributes.description: Total estimated recoverable reserves in depletion units for oil and gas producing properties. Used as denominator in unit of production depreciation calculation. Aligned with SEC proved reserves classification.
attributes.references: SPE PRMS, SEC Regulation S-X Rule 4-10, GAAP ASC 932

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Type of facility asset such as FPSO, platform, compressor station, processing plant, refinery unit, pipeline, or storage terminal. Used for asset classification and maintenance planning.

attributes.name: geographic_location
attributes.description: Geographic location of the asset including country, state/province, and basin. Used for regulatory reporting, tax jurisdiction determination, and portfolio segmentation.

attributes.name: impairment_indicator_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the asset has been identified for impairment testing due to triggering events such as commodity price decline, reserves downgrade, or operational issues.

attributes.name: impairment_loss_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative impairment loss recognized when the carrying amount exceeds the recoverable amount. Required for SEC ceiling test compliance for oil and gas properties under full cost method.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 36, GAAP ASC 360, SEC Regulation S-X Rule 4-10

attributes.name: last_depreciation_run_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent depreciation calculation run. Used to track periodic depreciation posting and ensure timely financial close.

attributes.name: last_impairment_test_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent impairment test performed on the asset. Required quarterly for full cost pool ceiling test and annually for successful efforts method.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fixed asset record was last updated. Used for change tracking and SOX compliance audit trails.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA ANLA-AEDAT, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: Current net book value of the fixed asset calculated as acquisition value minus accumulated depreciation. Represents the carrying amount on the balance sheet.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Calculated Field, IFRS IAS 16

attributes.name: net_revenue_interest_percentage
attributes.description: Ownership percentage representing the company's share of production revenue after royalties and overriding royalty interests. Used for revenue allocation and reserves valuation.

attributes.name: operator_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the company is the operator of the asset. Operator is responsible for day-to-day operations, AFE preparation, and joint interest billing.

attributes.name: operator_name
attributes.description: Name of the operating company responsible for the asset if the company is non-operated. Used for joint venture partner tracking and JIB reconciliation.

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset was retired, disposed, or abandoned. Marks the end of depreciation and triggers gain/loss calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA ANLA-DEAKT, IFRS IAS 16

attributes.name: retirement_proceeds
attributes.description: Cash or fair value received from asset sale or disposal. Used to calculate gain or loss on retirement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Custom Field, IFRS IAS 16

attributes.name: retirement_type
attributes.description: Type of asset retirement transaction. Determines accounting treatment for gain/loss recognition and plug and abandonment (P&A) cost capitalization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA ANLA-ANLHTXT, GAAP ASC 410

attributes.name: sec_proved_property_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Proved Property Classification
attributes.description: SEC reserves classification for oil and gas properties: PDP (Proved Developed Producing), PDNP (Proved Developed Non-Producing), PUD (Proved Undeveloped). Required for SEC financial disclosure and ceiling test compliance.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-X Rule 4-10, SPE PRMS, GAAP ASC 932

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Estimated useful life of the asset in years for straight-line or declining balance depreciation methods. Not applicable for unit of production method.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA ANLA-NDJAR, IFRS IAS 16

attributes.name: working_interest_percentage
attributes.description: Ownership percentage representing the company's share of capital costs and operating expenses for the asset. Used for joint venture accounting and AFE cost allocation.

products.name: project_economics
products.description: Financial economics master record for oil and gas capital projects capturing NPV, IRR, DCF, and payback period calculations used for investment decision-making and portfolio management. Captures project economics ID, project reference, evaluation date, discount rate, risk-adjusted discount rate, gross NPV, net NPV (WI-adjusted), IRR, payback period (years), peak CAPEX, total CAPEX, total OPEX, total LOE, gross revenue, net revenue (NRI-adjusted), BOE reserves (1P/2P/3P), finding and development cost (F&D cost per BOE), reserve replacement ratio, and economic limit date. Supports AFE justification, portfolio ranking, and SEC reserves economics.

attributes.name: project_economics_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the project economics evaluation record.

attributes.name: finance_afe_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_afe. Business justification: Project economics are calculated for AFEs (capital projects). The existing afe_number STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to finance_afe.finance_afe_id to enable linking economic anal

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the capital project being evaluated. Links to the master project record in the project management system.

attributes.name: well_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.well_asset. Business justification: Project economics are evaluated at the well level for FID, reserves booking, and development planning. Linking project_economics to well_asset enables well-level NPV, IRR, and F&D cost reporting — fun

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the project economics evaluation was formally approved for capital allocation.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The current approval status of the project economics evaluation in the AFE and capital allocation workflow.

attributes.name: boe_reserves_1p
attributes.business_glossary_term: Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE) Reserves - Proved (1P)
attributes.description: The proved reserves in barrels of oil equivalent. Reserves with reasonable certainty of being recoverable under existing economic and operating conditions.
attributes.references: SPE PRMS, SEC Regulation S-X Rule 4-10

attributes.name: boe_reserves_2p
attributes.business_glossary_term: Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE) Reserves - Proved Plus Probable (2P)
attributes.description: The proved plus probable reserves in barrels of oil equivalent. Includes proved reserves plus reserves with greater than 50% probability of recovery.

attributes.name: boe_reserves_3p
attributes.business_glossary_term: Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE) Reserves - Proved Plus Probable Plus Possible (3P)
attributes.description: The proved plus probable plus possible reserves in barrels of oil equivalent. Includes all reserve categories with at least 10% probability of recovery.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments and notes regarding the economic evaluation, assumptions, or special considerations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this project economics record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values in this evaluation (e.g., USD, GBP, CAD).

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: The base discount rate applied to future cash flows for NPV calculation, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 10.00 for 10%).

attributes.name: economic_limit_date
attributes.description: The projected date when the project reaches its economic limit and production is no longer profitable. Used for abandonment planning.

attributes.name: evaluation_date
attributes.description: The date on which this economic evaluation was performed. Critical for time-series analysis of project economics.

attributes.name: evaluation_type
attributes.description: The type of economic evaluation being performed: initial assessment, revised forecast, final economics, annual review, or reforecast.

attributes.name: finding_and_development_cost_per_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Finding and Development (F&D) Cost per Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: The finding and development cost per BOE. Total exploration and development costs divided by reserves added. Key metric for portfolio efficiency.

attributes.name: first_production_date
attributes.description: The projected or actual date of first commercial production from the project.

attributes.name: gas_price_assumption
attributes.description: The natural gas price assumption used in the economic evaluation, typically in USD per thousand cubic feet (MCF) or million British thermal units (MMBTU).

attributes.name: gross_npv
attributes.description: The gross net present value of the project before working interest adjustments. Represents the total economic value at the discount rate.

attributes.name: gross_revenue
attributes.description: The total gross revenue from hydrocarbon sales over the project lifecycle before royalties and working interest adjustments.

attributes.name: irr
attributes.description: The internal rate of return for the project, expressed as a percentage. The discount rate at which NPV equals zero.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user or system identifier that last modified this project economics record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this project economics record was last modified.

attributes.name: net_npv
attributes.description: The net present value adjusted for working interest ownership. Represents the company's share of project economics.

attributes.name: net_revenue
attributes.description: The net revenue after net revenue interest adjustments. Represents the company's share of revenue after royalties and burdens.

attributes.name: net_revenue_interest
attributes.description: The company's net revenue interest percentage after royalties and overriding royalty interests, expressed as a percentage. Determines revenue share.

attributes.name: oil_price_assumption
attributes.description: The oil price assumption used in the economic evaluation, typically in USD per barrel. May reference WTI or Brent benchmark.

attributes.name: payback_period_years
attributes.description: The number of years required to recover the initial capital investment from net cash flows.

attributes.name: peak_capex
attributes.description: The maximum annual capital expenditure required during the project lifecycle. Critical for cash flow planning.

attributes.name: price_deck_scenario
attributes.description: The price deck scenario used for the evaluation: base case corporate assumptions, high case, low case, SEC pricing rules, or current spot pricing.

attributes.name: project_life_years
attributes.description: The total economic life of the project in years from first production to economic limit.

attributes.name: reserve_replacement_ratio
attributes.description: The ratio of reserves added to reserves produced during the period. A ratio above 1.0 indicates reserves are being replaced faster than production.

attributes.name: risk_adjusted_discount_rate
attributes.description: The risk-adjusted discount rate incorporating project-specific risk factors, expressed as a percentage. Used for risk-weighted NPV calculations.

attributes.name: risk_assessment_category
attributes.description: The overall risk category assigned to the project based on technical, commercial, and operational risk factors.

attributes.name: sensitivity_analysis_performed
attributes.description: Indicates whether sensitivity analysis on key variables (price, reserves, costs) was performed as part of this evaluation.

attributes.name: total_capex
attributes.description: The total capital expenditure over the project lifecycle including drilling, completion, facilities, and infrastructure costs.

attributes.name: total_loe
attributes.description: The total lease operating expense over the project lifecycle. Direct costs of operating producing properties.

attributes.name: total_opex
attributes.description: The total operating expenditure over the project lifecycle including production operations, maintenance, and overhead.

attributes.name: working_interest
attributes.description: The company's working interest percentage in the project, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 65.00 for 65%). Determines cost-bearing obligation.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user or system identifier that created this project economics record.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The date on which the intercompany transaction was executed or recorded in the financial system.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1 - Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique transaction number assigned to the intercompany transaction for external reference and reconciliation tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Number Standard

attributes.name: transaction_subtype
attributes.description: A more granular classification within the transaction type to further specify the nature of the intercompany activity (e.g., crude oil transfer, natural gas transfer, technical services, administrative services, short-term loan, long-term loan).

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: The category of intercompany transaction indicating the nature of the business activity (e.g., crude oil or NGL product transfer, service charge, management fee, intercompany loan, dividend distribution, royalty payment, overhead allocation, interest charge, lease payment, or cost recharge). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: product_transfer|service_charge|management_fee|loan|dividend|royalty|overhead_allocation|interest_charge|lease_payment|recharge — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IFRS 10 - Consolidated Financial Statements; COPAS Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: transfer_price_documentation
attributes.description: A reference to the transfer pricing documentation or study that supports the pricing methodology and arm's length nature of the intercompany transaction.
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; IRS Section 482

attributes.name: transfer_price_method
attributes.description: The transfer pricing methodology applied to determine the intercompany transaction price (e.g., cost plus markup, market price, negotiated price, resale minus, comparable uncontrolled price) for tax compliance and arm's length pricing.
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; IRS Section 482

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the quantity transferred (e.g., BBL for barrels, BOE for barrel of oil equivalent, MCF for thousand cubic feet, MMCF for million cubic feet, MT for metric tons, GAL for gallons, LB for pounds, KG for kilograms). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BBL|BOE|MCF|MMCF|MT|GAL|LB|KG — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: The price per unit of product or service in the intercompany transaction, used to calculate the total transaction amount.

products.name: tax_provision
products.description: Transactional record of income tax provisions, deferred tax assets/liabilities, and tax accruals for oil and gas operations across jurisdictions. Captures tax provision ID, fiscal period, company code, jurisdiction (federal, state, country), tax type (corporate income tax, production tax, severance tax, windfall profit tax, resource rent tax), current tax expense, deferred tax expense, deferred tax asset, deferred tax liability, effective tax rate, statutory tax rate, temporary difference, and tax basis. Supports IFRS/GAAP tax accounting (IAS 12 / ASC 740) and SEC financial disclosure requirements.

attributes.name: tax_provision_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the tax provision record. Primary key for the tax provision entity.
attributes.references: IAS 12 Income Taxes, ASC 740 Income Taxes

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Tax provisions are calculated for legal entities. The existing company_code STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to company_code.company_code_id to enable legal entity-level tax report

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Tax provisions are posted to specific GL accounts in the chart of accounts (current tax expense, deferred tax asset, deferred tax liability accounts). The tax_provision table tracks current_tax_expens

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Tax provisions in oil and gas multinational operations are calculated at the profit center (business segment) level for segment tax reporting, transfer pricing documentation, and country-by-country re

attributes.name: accounting_standard
attributes.description: The accounting standard under which the tax provision is prepared. IFRS follows IAS 12, US GAAP follows ASC 740, and local GAAP follows jurisdiction-specific standards.
attributes.references: IAS 12 Income Taxes, ASC 740 Income Taxes

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: Status of tax authority audit for this jurisdiction and period. Tracks whether the tax position is under examination by tax authorities (IRS, state revenue departments, international tax authorities).

attributes.name: book_basis_amount
attributes.description: The financial statement carrying amount (book basis) of the underlying asset or liability. The difference between book basis and tax basis creates the temporary difference.

attributes.name: carryforward_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the tax loss carryforward or tax credit carryforward expires if not utilized. Some jurisdictions allow indefinite carryforwards; others have time limits (e.g., 20 years).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the tax provision record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this tax provision record (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP, EUR). All amounts are recorded in this currency.

attributes.name: current_tax_expense
attributes.description: The amount of income tax expense for the current period based on taxable income. Represents taxes payable or refundable for the current year.

attributes.name: deferred_tax_asset
attributes.description: The amount of income taxes recoverable in future periods related to deductible temporary differences, tax loss carryforwards, and tax credit carryforwards. Common in oil and gas for Depreciation Depletion and Amortization (DD&A) timing differences and Abandoned and Dry Hole (ADH) costs.

attributes.name: deferred_tax_expense
attributes.description: The amount of income tax expense or benefit related to changes in deferred tax assets and liabilities. Represents the tax effect of temporary differences between book and tax basis.

attributes.name: deferred_tax_liability
attributes.description: The amount of income taxes payable in future periods related to taxable temporary differences. Common in oil and gas for accelerated tax depreciation versus book depreciation and successful efforts versus full cost accounting differences.

attributes.name: effective_tax_rate
attributes.description: The actual tax rate calculated as total tax expense divided by pretax book income. Expressed as a decimal. Differs from statutory rate due to permanent differences, rate changes, and jurisdictional mix. Key metric for SEC financial disclosure and investor analysis.
attributes.references: IAS 12 Income Taxes paragraph 81, ASC 740-10-50-12, SEC Regulation S-K Item 303

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate used to convert foreign currency tax provisions to the reporting currency. Represents the rate from the local jurisdiction currency to the company reporting currency.
attributes.references: IAS 21 The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates, ASC 830

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year for which the tax provision applies. Typically 1-12 for monthly periods or 1-4 for quarterly periods.
attributes.references: IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements, GAAP

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which the tax provision applies. Four-digit year representation.
attributes.references: IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements, GAAP

attributes.name: interest_on_tax_position
attributes.description: Interest accrued on underpayment or overpayment of taxes, or on uncertain tax positions. Calculated based on applicable jurisdiction interest rates.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the tax jurisdiction (federal, state, country, or local). Format: ISO country code for federal (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR), or country-state for state/provincial (e.g., USA-TX, CAN-AB).
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, IRS Publication 515, OECD Tax Guidelines

attributes.name: jurisdiction_name
attributes.description: Full name of the tax jurisdiction (e.g., United States Federal, Texas, Alberta, United Kingdom).

attributes.name: jurisdiction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the tax jurisdiction level: federal (national), state (US state), provincial (Canadian province), country (international), local (county/city), or municipal.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Code, OECD Tax Guidelines

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the tax provision record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking to support SOX compliance.

attributes.name: net_deferred_tax_position
attributes.description: Net deferred tax asset or liability position, calculated as deferred tax asset minus deferred tax liability. Positive values indicate a net asset position; negative values indicate a net liability position.

attributes.name: penalty_on_tax_position
attributes.description: Penalties assessed or accrued related to tax positions, underpayments, or late filings. Common in oil and gas for royalty and severance tax disputes.

attributes.name: permanent_difference
attributes.description: Differences between book income and taxable income that will never reverse. Examples in oil and gas include percentage depletion in excess of cost depletion, non-deductible fines and penalties, and tax-exempt income.

attributes.name: pretax_book_income
attributes.description: Income before income taxes per the financial statements (book income). Used as the starting point for the tax provision calculation and effective tax rate reconciliation.

attributes.name: provision_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate the tax provision. Actual method uses actual year-to-date results, estimated method uses projections, and annualized method estimates full-year effective tax rate applied to interim periods per IAS 34 and ASC 740-270.

attributes.name: provision_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting assumptions, judgments, and significant items in the tax provision calculation. Used to document complex positions such as transfer pricing, Production Sharing Agreement (PSA) interpretations, and uncertain tax positions.

attributes.name: provision_status
attributes.description: Current status of the tax provision record in the financial close process. Draft provisions are prepared during the close cycle, preliminary provisions are subject to review, final provisions are approved for financial reporting, amended provisions reflect corrections, and audited provisions have been reviewed by external auditors.

attributes.name: reviewer_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual who reviewed and approved the tax provision calculation. Required for SOX internal controls over financial reporting.

attributes.name: statute_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the statute of limitations expires for this tax period, after which the tax authority can no longer assess additional tax. Typically 3 years from filing date in the US, but varies by jurisdiction.

attributes.name: statutory_tax_rate
attributes.description: The enacted tax rate for the jurisdiction. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2100 for 21%). Used to calculate the expected tax expense and for effective tax rate reconciliation.

attributes.name: tax_basis_amount
attributes.description: The tax basis of the underlying asset or liability that gives rise to the temporary difference. For oil and gas properties, represents the remaining tax basis for depletion and depreciation purposes under either successful efforts or full cost method.

attributes.name: tax_credit_amount
attributes.description: Tax credits available to reduce current tax liability. Oil and gas specific credits include Enhanced Oil Recovery (EOR) credits, marginal well credits, Carbon Capture and Storage (CCS) credits (Section 45Q), and renewable energy credits.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Code Section 43 (EOR), Section 45Q (CCS), ASC 740-10-25-46

attributes.name: tax_loss_carryforward
attributes.description: Net Operating Loss (NOL) available to offset future taxable income. Common in oil and gas during commodity price downturns or for companies with significant exploration and development expenditures.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Code Section 172, IAS 12 Income Taxes paragraph 34, ASC 740-10-30-18

attributes.name: tax_return_filed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the tax return for this jurisdiction and period was filed with the tax authority. Used to track filing compliance and statute of limitations.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Code Section 6072, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: tax_type
attributes.description: Type of tax for which the provision is recorded. Oil and gas specific types include production tax (tax on volume produced), severance tax (state tax on extraction), windfall profit tax (tax on excess profits), and resource rent tax (tax on economic rent from resources).
attributes.references: IRS Tax Code Section 29, State Severance Tax Statutes, OECD BEPS Guidelines

attributes.name: taxable_income
attributes.description: Income subject to tax as determined under the applicable tax law. Differs from book income due to permanent and temporary differences. For oil and gas, includes adjustments for Intangible Drilling Costs (IDC), depletion methods, and production-based deductions.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Code Section 61, IAS 12 Income Taxes paragraph 5

attributes.name: temporary_difference
attributes.description: Differences between the tax basis and book basis of assets and liabilities that will reverse over time. Common oil and gas temporary differences include DD&A timing, successful efforts versus tax accounting for exploration costs, and Asset Retirement Obligation (ARO) timing.

attributes.name: total_tax_expense
attributes.description: Total income tax expense for the period, calculated as current tax expense plus deferred tax expense. This is the amount reported on the income statement.

attributes.name: unrecognized_tax_benefit
attributes.description: The amount of tax benefit from an uncertain tax position that does not meet the more-likely-than-not recognition threshold. Common in oil and gas for transfer pricing positions, Production Sharing Agreement (PSA) interpretations, and cross-border transactions.

attributes.name: valuation_allowance
attributes.description: Reduction in deferred tax assets when it is more likely than not that some portion or all of the deferred tax asset will not be realized. Common in oil and gas during commodity price downturns or for marginal properties.

products.name: impairment_assessment
products.description: Transactional record of oil and gas asset impairment assessments conducted to evaluate whether the carrying value of proved and unproved properties, goodwill, or other assets exceeds their recoverable amount. Captures impairment assessment ID, assessment date, asset or cash-generating unit (CGU) reference, triggering event (price decline, reserve revision, regulatory change, abandonment decision), carrying amount, recoverable amount (higher of fair value less costs to sell and value in use), impairment loss recognized, reversal amount, discount rate used, price deck applied (WTI, Brent), reserve estimate used (1P/2P), and accounting standard (IAS 36 / ASC 360). Supports SEC ceiling test calculations under full cost method.
products.reference: IAS 36 / ASC 360 Asset Impairment — SEC Ceiling Test

attributes.name: impairment_assessment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the impairment assessment record. Primary key for the impairment assessment entity.
attributes.references: IAS 36 Impairment of Assets, ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: asset_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_facility. Business justification: Impairment assessments are performed on facility-level CGUs (cash-generating units) per IAS 36/ASC 360. impairment_assessment has fixed_asset_id but not asset_facility_id — facilities are the operatio

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Impairment assessments are performed for legal entities. The existing company_code STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to company_code.company_code_id to enable legal entity-level imp

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center associated with the asset or CGU being assessed for impairment.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fixed_asset. Business justification: Impairment assessments are conducted on specific fixed assets (proved properties, wells, pipelines, facilities) to determine if their carrying amount exceeds recoverable amount. The impairment_assessm

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the general ledger account to which the impairment loss or reversal is posted.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the profit center responsible for the asset or CGU being assessed for impairment.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Impairment assessments in oil and gas are conducted at the cash-generating unit (CGU) level, which often corresponds to WBS elements representing specific fields, wells, or development projects. The i

attributes.name: well_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.well_asset. Business justification: Well-level impairment assessments (ceiling test, proved property impairment) are standard in oil and gas under ASC 932 and IFRS 6. No existing FK from impairment_assessment to well_asset — critical fo

attributes.name: accounting_method
attributes.description: The oil and gas accounting method used: successful efforts method or full cost method, which determines how exploration and development costs are capitalized and amortized.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-X Rule 4-10, IFRS 6 Exploration for and Evaluation of Mineral Resources

attributes.name: accounting_standard
attributes.description: The accounting standard framework applied for the impairment assessment: IAS 36 (International Accounting Standard), ASC 360 (Accounting Standards Codification), IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards), or GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the impairment assessment was formally approved by the reviewer or management.

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the impairment assessment was performed or completed.

attributes.name: assessment_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique reference number assigned to the impairment assessment for tracking and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: IFRS/GAAP Oil and Gas Accounting Standards

attributes.name: assessment_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the impairment assessment: draft, in review, approved, posted to the general ledger, or cancelled.

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the impairment assessment based on the reason or timing of the evaluation.

attributes.name: brent_price_assumption
attributes.description: The assumed Brent crude oil price per barrel used in the impairment assessment cash flow projections.

attributes.name: carrying_amount
attributes.description: The book value or carrying value of the asset or CGU on the balance sheet at the assessment date, before any impairment loss is recognized.

attributes.name: ceiling_test_limit
attributes.description: The calculated ceiling test limit under the full cost method, representing the maximum allowable capitalized costs based on the present value of estimated future net revenues from proved reserves.

attributes.name: ceiling_test_performed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a ceiling test was performed as part of the impairment assessment under the full cost method, which limits capitalized costs to the present value of estimated future net revenues.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the user who created this impairment assessment record in the system.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this impairment assessment record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which all monetary amounts in this impairment assessment are denominated (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: The pre-tax discount rate applied in the discounted cash flow (DCF) calculation to determine value in use, reflecting the time value of money and asset-specific risks.

attributes.name: estimated_ultimate_recovery
attributes.description: The Estimated Ultimate Recovery (EUR) of hydrocarbons from the asset over its entire productive life, used in the impairment assessment.

attributes.name: fair_value_less_costs_to_sell
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fair Value Less Costs to Sell
attributes.description: The estimated amount obtainable from the sale of the asset in an arm's length transaction between knowledgeable, willing parties, less the costs of disposal.
attributes.references: IAS 36 Impairment of Assets, IFRS 13 Fair Value Measurement

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year in which the impairment assessment was performed and recorded.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the impairment assessment was performed and recorded.

attributes.name: gas_price_assumption
attributes.description: The assumed natural gas price per unit (e.g., per MMBTU or MCF) used in the impairment assessment cash flow projections.

attributes.name: impairment_loss_recognized
attributes.description: The amount by which the carrying amount exceeds the recoverable amount, recognized as an impairment loss in the financial statements.

attributes.name: impairment_reversal_amount
attributes.description: The amount of previously recognized impairment loss that is reversed in the current period due to an increase in the recoverable amount (not applicable to goodwill under IFRS).

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the user who last modified or updated this impairment assessment record in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this impairment assessment record was last modified or updated in the system.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or explanations related to the impairment assessment, including assumptions, methodologies, or special considerations.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the impairment loss or reversal was posted to the general ledger and reflected in the financial statements.

attributes.name: price_deck_applied
attributes.description: The commodity price forecast or price deck used in the impairment assessment, including references to benchmark prices such as West Texas Intermediate (WTI), Brent, or Henry Hub.

attributes.name: property_type
attributes.description: Classification of the oil and gas property being assessed: Proved Developed Producing (PDP), Proved Developed Non-Producing (PDNP), Proved Undeveloped (PUD), unproved properties, goodwill, or other assets.

attributes.name: recoverable_amount
attributes.description: The higher of the asset's fair value less costs to sell and its value in use, representing the maximum amount recoverable from the asset.

attributes.name: reviewer_name
attributes.description: The name of the individual or team responsible for reviewing and approving the impairment assessment.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this impairment assessment is subject to Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) internal control testing and compliance requirements.

attributes.name: triggering_event
attributes.description: Description of the event or indicator that triggered the impairment assessment, such as commodity price decline, reserve revision, regulatory change, abandonment decision, or adverse market conditions.

attributes.name: triggering_event_date
attributes.description: The date on which the triggering event occurred that necessitated the impairment assessment.

attributes.name: value_in_use
attributes.description: The present value of the future cash flows expected to be derived from the asset or CGU, calculated using discounted cash flow (DCF) analysis.

attributes.name: wti_price_assumption
attributes.description: The assumed West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude oil price per barrel used in the impairment assessment cash flow projections.

metric_views.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `oil_gas_ecm`.`_metrics`.`asset`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "High‑level financial and risk KPIs for assets"
  source: "`oil_gas_ecm`.`asset`.`asset`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "asset_type"
      expr: asset_type
      comment: "Classification of the asset (e.g., facility, equipment)"
  measures:
    - name: "asset_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of assets"
    - name: "total_capital_expenditure"
      expr: SUM(CAST(capital_expenditure AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of capital expenditure for assets"
    - name: "total_operational_expenditure"
      expr: SUM(CAST(operational_expenditure AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of operational expenditure for assets"
    - name: "avg_risk_score"
      expr: AVG(CAST(risk_score AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average risk score across assets"
    - name: "depreciation_to_current_ratio"
      expr: AVG(CAST(capital_expenditure AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(current_value AS DOUBLE), 0))
      comment: "Average ratio of capital expenditure to current value (depreciation effectiveness)"
$$
metric_views.description: High‑level financial and risk KPIs for assets

metric_views.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `oil_gas_ecm`.`_metrics`.`asset_equipment`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Financial and reliability KPIs for equipment"
  source: "`oil_gas_ecm`.`asset`.`equipment`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "equipment_type"
      expr: equipment_type
      comment: "Type/category of equipment"
    - name: "installation_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', installation_date)
      comment: "Month of equipment installation"
  measures:
    - name: "equipment_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of equipment records"
    - name: "total_acquisition_cost_usd"
      expr: SUM(CAST(acquisition_cost_usd AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of acquisition cost in USD for equipment"
    - name: "avg_mtbf_hours"
      expr: AVG(CAST(mtbf_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average mean time between failures (hours) for equipment"
    - name: "avg_mttr_hours"
      expr: AVG(CAST(mttr_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average mean time to repair (hours) for equipment"
    - name: "percent_safety_critical"
      expr: AVG(CAST(is_safety_critical AS INT)) * 100
      comment: "Percentage of equipment flagged as safety‑critical"
$$
metric_views.description: Financial and reliability KPIs for equipment

metric_views.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `oil_gas_ecm`.`_metrics`.`asset_failure_report`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Operational impact and cost of asset failures"
  source: "`oil_gas_ecm`.`asset`.`failure_report`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "failure_status"
      expr: failure_status
      comment: "Current status of the failure report"
    - name: "failure_type"
      expr: failure_type
      comment: "Categorization of failure cause"
    - name: "failure_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', failure_date)
      comment: "Month when the failure occurred"
  measures:
    - name: "failure_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Number of failure reports"
    - name: "total_downtime_hours"
      expr: SUM(CAST(downtime_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total downtime hours caused by failures"
    - name: "total_repair_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(repair_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of repair costs for failures"
    - name: "avg_production_impact_boe"
      expr: AVG(CAST(production_impact_boe AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average production impact (BOE) per failure"
    - name: "avg_mttr_hours"
      expr: AVG(CAST(mttr_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average mean time to repair (hours) for failures"
$$
metric_views.description: Operational impact and cost of asset failures

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `oil_gas_ecm`.`_metrics`.`asset_inspection_event`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Inspection activity and cost KPIs"
  source: "`oil_gas_ecm`.`asset`.`inspection_event`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "inspection_type"
      expr: inspection_type
      comment: "Type of inspection performed"
    - name: "inspection_status"
